papers.title: Quantum JT Gravity in a box as a P\"oschl-Teller Scattering Problem
papers.abstract: We present a canonical quantization of Jackiw--Teitelboim gravity with finite Dirichlet boundary conditions, using the geodesic length between the two boundaries and its conjugate momentum as reduced phase space variables. The dynamics is recast as the scattering problem of a nonrelativistic particle in a repulsive P\"oschl-Teller potential, naturally embedded within a hyperbolic reduction of the $\mathfrak{sl}(2,\mathbb{R})$ Casimir. We obtain exact wavefunctions of the universe and the disk partition function, interpreted as a transition matrix element between states of vanishing bare length. In the asymptotic limit, the theory reduces to Liouville quantum mechanics and reproduces the standard Schwarzian spectral density. At finite cutoff, however, the spectral measure exhibits genuinely nonperturbative corrections, absent in existing $T\bar T$ approaches. These contributions admit an interpretation in terms of pinched disk geometries and are responsible for a controlled violation of the Wheeler-DeWitt equation. We also obtain closed form expressions for thermal two-point functions in terms of Wilson functions and propose diagrammatic rules for time- and out-of-time-ordered four-point functions. We further address the issue of the branch cut singularity of the quasi-local energy and propose a UV completion of the model in which the Brown-York charge is extended beyond the black hole horizon. This extension naturally generalizes the scattering problem to configurations that foliate the black hole interior.

classification.title_zh: 盒中量子 JT 引力作为 Pöschl-Teller 散射问题
classification.abstract_zh: 我们给出了具有有限 Dirichlet 边界条件的 Jackiw–Teitelboim 引力的正则量子化，采用两个边界之间的测地线长度及其共轭动量作为约化相空间变量。动力学被改写为非相对论粒子在排斥 Pöschl-Teller 势中的散射问题，并自然嵌入 sl(2,R) Casimir 的双曲约化中。我们得到宇宙的精确波函数和圆盘配分函数，并将其解释为裸长度为零的态之间的跃迁矩阵元。在渐近极限下，理论约化为 Liouville 量子力学，并重现标准 Schwarzian 谱密度。然而在有限截断下，谱测度表现出真正非微扰修正，这是现有 Tbar T 方法所没有的。这些贡献可解释为被捏住的圆盘几何，并导致对 Wheeler–DeWitt 方程的受控违反。我们还得到了以 Wilson 函数表示的热两点函数闭式表达式，并提出了时间和乱序四点函数的图规则。我们进一步讨论了准局域能量分支割奇点问题，并提出该模型的 UV 完备化，其中 Brown–York 荷被延拓到黑洞视界之外。该延拓自然地将散射问题推广到叶理化黑洞内部的位形。
classification.one_liner: 用 Pöschl-Teller 散射对有限截断量子 JT 引力做正则量子化，得到精确波函数、非微扰谱修正与热/OTOC 关联函数。

papers.title: On the near-horizon interpretation of Krylov dynamics
papers.abstract: The Lanczos recursion maps operator growth onto the motion of a wave function on a semi-infinite chain, and for linearly growing Lanczos coefficients the deep region of the chain behaves like the near-horizon region of a black hole. We develop this correspondence in the time domain and determine how far it extends. Writing the Krylov equation as an exactly skew-adjoint difference operator, we derive a unitary continuum limit whose corrections are suppressed by $n^{-2}$ once the origin of the chain is fixed by the offset of the Lanczos coefficients. For $b_n\simeq\alpha n$ the Krylov evolution is chiral transport in $\ln n$, which coincides with infalling waves near the horizon of an AdS$_2$ black hole when the Krylov depth is identified with the blueshift of an infalling particle; this fixes $\alpha=\pi T$, while staggered configurations of the chain carry the outgoing chirality. For $b_n=\alpha\sqrt{n(n+2h-1)}$ the correspondence is exact: the Krylov basis is the discrete series of $\mathrm{SL}(2,\mathbb{R})$ carried by a bulk scalar of mass $m^2L^2=h(h-1)$, the Liouvillian is the boost generator of the black hole at temperature $T=\alpha/\pi$, and positivity of $b_n^2$ reproduces the Breitenlohner--Freedman bound, saturated by strictly linear coefficients. Beyond leading order we prove that, for every Lanczos sequence with a smooth large-$n$ expansion, the ingoing solutions of the Krylov equation have coefficients polynomial in frequency to all orders in $1/n$, whereas a massive bulk field has a pole at the first special point $\omega=-2\pi iT$ with residue proportional to $m^2$. Smooth subleading Lanczos data therefore cannot encode the bulk mass locally. The obstruction persists for the BTZ black hole, for which we obtain the Lanczos coefficients in closed form.

classification.title_zh: 论Krylov动力学的近视界解释
classification.abstract_zh: Lanczos递归把算符增长映射为半无限链上波函数的运动；当Lanczos系数线性增长时，链的深处行为类似黑洞近视界区域。我们在时域中发展这一对应并确定其适用范围。将Krylov方程写成精确的斜伴随差分算符后，我们得到一个酉连续极限，一旦链的原点由Lanczos系数的偏移固定，其修正按 n^{-2} 压低。对于 b_n≃α n，Krylov演化是 ln n 中的手征输运，当把Krylov深度等同于入射粒子的蓝移时，这与 AdS_2 黑洞近视界附近的入射波一致；这固定 α=πT，而链的交错构型携带出射手征性。对于 b_n=α√(n(n+2h-1))，对应是精确的：Krylov基是由质量满足 m^2L^2=h(h-1) 的体标量所承载的 SL(2,R) 离散系列，Liouvillian是温度为 T=α/π 的黑洞的boost生成元，而 b_n^2 的正性重现了Breitenlohner-Freedman界，并由严格线性系数饱和。超越领头阶，我们证明：对于每一个具有光滑大 n 展开的Lanczos序列，Krylov方程的入射解在各阶 1/n 上都具有频率的多项式系数；而大质量体场在第一个特殊点 ω=-2π iT 处有极点，其留数正比于 m^2。因此，光滑的次领头Lanczos数据不能局域地编码体质量。这一障碍对BTZ黑洞依然存在，我们给出了其Lanczos系数的闭式表达。
classification.one_liner: 论文在时域中建立Krylov/Lanczos动力学与AdS2及BTZ黑洞近视界波动的对应，并指出平滑次领头Lanczos数据无法局域编码体质量。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息与量子信息/黑洞近视界方向，涉及AdS2、BTZ和Krylov复杂度；但未直接覆盖用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、气泡成核或QNM等具体支线。

papers.title: Asymptotically Flat Rotating Topological Stars
papers.abstract: We construct a new class of smooth, horizonless, non-supersymmetric solutions in five-dimensional minimal supergravity, which we call rotating topological stars. Built from a Kerr-Taub-bolt geometry embedded in five dimensions, they constitute the first rotating generalization of the topological star compatible with both smoothness in the interior and standard Kaluza-Klein asymptotics, S$^1\times\mathbb{R}^{1,3}$. The solutions carry angular momentum, magnetic and electric charges, and form a discrete tower of states labeled by a primary quantum number controlling the spin. Remarkably, despite lying outside the black-hole extremality bound, they can approach arbitrarily closely (in conserved charges) the Kerr black string with a large boost along the fifth dimension, making them relevant prototypes for rotating and astrophysical black-hole microstates. We analyze their geometry in detail, including their gravitational multipoles that can significantly deviate from those of black holes and the presence of an ergoregion, and show that both geodesics and scalar perturbations separate, paving the way for analyzing their dynamics in future work.

classification.title_zh: 渐近平直旋转拓扑星
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在五维最小超引力中构造了一类新的光滑、无视界、非超对称解，称为旋转拓扑星。它们基于嵌入五维的 Kerr-Taub-bolt 几何，是首个同时满足内部光滑性和标准 Kaluza-Klein 渐近 S^1×R^{1,3} 的旋转拓扑星推广。解携带角动量、磁荷和电荷，并形成由控制自旋的主量子数标记的离散态塔。尽管位于黑洞极端性界限之外，它们在守恒荷上可以任意接近沿第五维大 boost 的 Kerr 黑洞弦，因而可作为旋转及天体物理黑洞微态的原型。我们详细分析其几何，包括可能显著偏离黑洞的多极矩和能层存在，并表明测地线和标量微扰均可分离，为未来动力学分析铺路。
classification.one_liner: 在五维最小超引力中构造渐近平直、旋转、无视界的拓扑星，并分析其几何与可分离微扰。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典超引力精确解与黑洞微态几何，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”支线；但不涉及全息超流、p波、multi-trace、QNM与非线性演化等具体重点方向。

papers.title: Bootstrapping M-theory Orbifolds
papers.abstract: We analyze correlation functions of $SU(k) \times SU(2)_F$ flavor currents in a family of three-dimensional ${\cal N}=4$ superconformal field theories, combining analytic bootstrap methods with input from supersymmetric localization. Via holographic duality, we extract gluon and graviton scattering amplitudes of M-theory on ${\rm AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb{Z}_k$ which contains a $\mathbb{C}^2/\mathbb{Z}_{k}$ orbifold singularity. From these results, we derive aspects of the effective description of M-theory on the orbifold singularity beyond its leading low energy limit. We also determine a threshold correction to the holographic correlator, which vanishes due to equal and opposite contributions from the two-loop gluon and the tree-level bulk graviton exchange.

classification.title_zh: Bootstrap M 理论 Orbifold
classification.abstract_zh: 我们分析三维 N=4 超共形场论中 SU(k)×SU(2)_F 味流关联函数，结合解析 bootstrap 方法与超对称局域化输入。通过全息对偶，我们提取 M 理论在 AdS4×S7/Z_k（包含 C2/Z_k orbifold 奇点）上的胶子与引力子散射振幅。由此推导该 orbifold 奇点上 M 理论有效描述在领头低能极限之外的性质。我们还确定全息关联子的阈值修正，该修正因两圈胶子与树级体引力子交换的等量反向贡献而抵消。
classification.one_liner: 结合解析 bootstrap 与超对称局域化，研究 AdS4×S7/Z_k 全息对偶中的味流关联子，并提取 M 理论 orbifold 上的胶子/引力子散射信息。

papers.title: Gravitational-Wave Constraints on $R^2$ Gravity
papers.abstract: Gravitational waves from compact binary coalescences provide a unique opportunity to test general relativity in the strong-field regime. Quadratic $f(R)=R+aR^2$ gravity is among the simplest higher-curvature extensions of general relativity and introduces a massive scalar degree of freedom whose finite interaction range can modify compact-binary dynamics and gravitational-wave emission. We map this theory onto the effective-field-theory waveform for generic massive scalar-tensor gravity, obtaining a theory-specific inspiral phase correction governed by the single coupling parameter $a$. Using Bayesian analyses of the binary-neutron-star events GW170817 and GW190425, we obtain a combined constraint on the quadratic-curvature coupling of $a\lesssim6.2\times10^6\,\mathrm{m}^2$ at $90\%$ credibility, corresponding to a lower bound on the scalar mass of $m_s\gtrsim3.2\times10^{-11}\,\mathrm{eV}$. This constitutes the strongest astrophysical constraint on the quadratic-curvature coupling, improving the previous best bound by approximately five orders of magnitude and demonstrating the sensitivity of binary-neutron-star inspirals to finite-range scalar interactions in the strong-field regime.

classification.title_zh: 引力波对 R^2 引力的限制
classification.abstract_zh: 致密双星并合产生的引力波为在强场区检验广义相对论提供了独特机会。二次 f(R)=R+aR^2 引力是广义相对论最简单的高曲率扩展之一，并引入一个有质量标量自由度，其有限相互作用范围可修改致密双星动力学和引力波辐射。我们将该理论映射到一般有质量标量-张量引力的有效场论波形，得到由单一耦合参数 a 控制的、理论特定的旋近相位修正。利用对双中子星事件 GW170817 和 GW190425 的贝叶斯分析，我们在 90% 可信度下得到二次曲率耦合的联合限制 a≲6.2×10^6 m^2，对应标量质量下界 m_s≳3.2×10^-11 eV。这是对二次曲率耦合最强的天体物理限制，比此前最佳界限改善约五个数量级，并展示双中子星旋近对强场区有限程标量相互作用的敏感性。
classification.one_liner: 利用双中子星引力波事件 GW170817 和 GW190425 对 f(R)=R+aR^2 引力给出二次曲率耦合与标量质量的最强天体制约。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论及引力波强场检验，直接匹配用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息。

papers.title: Observational Test of the Maximum-Entropy Conjecture for Black-Hole Mergers with GW250114
papers.abstract: The remnants of binary black-hole (BBH) mergers are accurately described by numerical relativity, but the physical principle governing the selection of the final states remains unclear. A recently proposed maximum-entropy conjecture suggests that a BBH merger produces the Kerr BH that maximizes the Bekenstein-Hawking entropy, subject to the post-Newtonian formalism or balance laws for energy and angular momentum. In this work, we test this conjecture with the event GW250114, inferring the progenitor and remnant properties from the observed pre-merge and post-merge signals, separately. We construct the surrogate Kerr entropy associated with candidate remnant states along the inferred energy-angular-momentum trajectory. We then compare the maximum-entropy state with the independently inferred mass and dimensionless spin of the final BH. We find that the conjecture predicts a remnant mass of $M_f=70.0^{+0.35}_{-0.21}\,M_\odot$ and spin of $\chi_f=0.70^{+0.00}_{-0.01}$, compared with the ringdown estimates $M_f={72.3}^{+3.6}_{-3.7}\,M_\odot$ and $\chi_f=0.74^{+0.05}_{-0.07}$. The entropy deviation is consistent with zero within the $68\%$ credible interval for our fiducial analysis, and variations in the pre-merger truncation time and quasi-normal modes (QNM) content reveal no compelling discrepancy with the conjecture.

classification.title_zh: 用GW250114对黑洞并合最大熵猜想进行观测检验
classification.abstract_zh: 双黑洞并合的残余体可由数值相对论精确描述，但决定末态选择的物理原理仍不清楚。近期提出的最大熵猜想认为，在能量和角动量守恒（或后牛顿平衡律）约束下，双黑洞并合会产生使Bekenstein-Hawking熵最大的Kerr黑洞。本文利用事件GW250114检验该猜想，分别从并合前和并合后信号推断 progenitor 与残余体性质，并沿推断的能量-角动量轨迹构造候选残余态的替代Kerr熵。作者将最大熵态与独立推断的末态黑洞质量和无量纲自旋进行比较，发现该猜想预言 M_f=70.0^{+0.35}_{-0.21} M_⊙、χ_f=0.70^{+0.00}_{-0.01}，而 ringdown 估计为 M_f=72.3^{+3.6}_{-3.7} M_⊙、χ_f=0.74^{+0.05}_{-0.07}。在基准分析中，熵偏差在68%可信区间内与零一致；改变并合前截断时间和QNM内容也未显示与该猜想有显著矛盾。
classification.one_liner: 用GW250114检验双黑洞并合末态选择最大Bekenstein-Hawking熵的猜想，结果与观测一致。

papers.title: Bumblebee radiation from neutral matter around a black hole
papers.abstract: We investigate bumblebee radiation generated by neutral matter orbiting a black hole with a radial spacelike vector vacuum. Starting from a point particle coupled minimally to the metric, we derive the curvature induced vector current and the potential response required by its conservation. For a localized circular source with no independent radial boundary current, this response gives $\delta V'=\xi\rho/4$. The axial vector source instead follows the radial transport of angular momentum and vanishes for circular motion. A slightly eccentric orbit excites an axial dipole at the orbital frequency $\Omega$ and a quadrupole contribution at $2\Omega$, with outgoing amplitudes proportional to $ev^3$ and $ev^4$, respectively, where $v=\sqrt{M/a}$. We construct their retarded response and obtain the leading coefficients through weak field matching. Reconstruction of the observer's tidal tensor gives the dipole strain $h_{\hat r\hat\phi}^{V,10}=\xi^2b^2\mu ev^3\sin\theta\cos[\Omega(t-R)]/(8\pi R)$. The corresponding partial luminosity is $P_{B,10}^{\infty}=\xi^2b^2\mu^2e^2v^{12}/(48\pi M^2)$ at the leading order. Remarkably, the ordinary neutral matter produces an additional radial transverse tidal signal even when the homogeneous gravitational master operator remains in Schwarzschild form.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞周围中性物质的 Bumblebee 辐射
classification.abstract_zh: 研究在具有径向类空矢量真空的黑洞周围，中性物质轨道运动产生的 bumblebee 辐射。从最小耦合点粒子出发，推导曲率诱导的矢量流及守恒所需的势响应；对于无独立径向边界流的局域圆轨道源，得到 δV'=ξρ/4。轴向矢量源随角动量径向输运，在圆轨道上消失；小偏心轨道在轨道频率 Ω 激发轴向偶极、在 2Ω 激发四极，出射振幅分别正比于 ev^3 和 ev^4，其中 v=sqrt(M/a)。构造延迟响应并通过弱场匹配得到首项系数；由观测者潮汐张量重构给出偶极应变和相应部分光度。结果表明，即使均匀引力主算子仍为 Schwarzschild 形式，普通中性物质也可产生额外的径向横向潮汐信号。
classification.one_liner: 研究黑洞周围中性物质在 bumblebee 矢量真空背景下产生的曲率诱导矢量辐射与潮汐应变信号。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典黑洞时空中的修改引力/矢量场辐射，涉及经典引力扰动、潮汐应变与辐射响应；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

papers.title: Gravitational waves flooding the Universe after wall domination
papers.abstract: We discuss a possible early Universe scenario, where radiation era is interrupted by the epoch of domination of domain walls eventually annihilating into particles. During this period the Universe undergoes accelerated expansion, while the comoving correlation length of the domain wall network remains constant. The network serves as a source of tensor modes, which get frozen upon exiting the horizon similarly to the case of inflationary fluctuations. The modes re-enter the horizon during the subsequent stage of radiation domination and since then contribute to the gravitational wave background. The spectral shape of gravitational waves predicted in this scenario is markedly different compared to the case of domain walls remaining sub-dominant all the way till annihilation. These gravitational waves are strong enough to be observed with present-day and future facilities in a broad range of frequencies. In particular, their energy density is sufficient to produce a significant impact on the effective number of neutrino species, unless the duration of wall domination is suitably constrained.

classification.title_zh: 畴壁主导后充斥宇宙的引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 我们讨论一种可能的早期宇宙场景，其中辐射时代被最终湮灭为粒子的畴壁主导时期所中断。在此期间宇宙经历加速膨胀，而畴壁网络的共动关联长度保持不变。该网络作为张量模的源，这些模在出视界时冻结，类似于暴胀涨落。这些模在随后的辐射主导阶段重新进入视界，并自此对引力波背景产生贡献。此场景预测的引力波谱形与畴壁一直保持次主导直至湮灭的情况显著不同。这些引力波足够强，可以在很宽的频率范围内被现有和未来的设施观测到。特别是，除非对壁主导的持续时间加以适当约束，否则其能量密度足以对有效中微子种数产生显著影响。
classification.one_liner: 研究早期宇宙中畴壁主导阶段产生的引力波背景及其可观测效应。

papers.title: The quasi-topological space of quasi-topological gravities
papers.abstract: We investigate general properties of quasi-topological theories of gravity involving infinite towers of polynomial densities and of their regular vacuum black hole solutions. We show that every positive-mass regular vacuum solution necessarily possesses a de Sitter core, while Minkowski and anti-de Sitter cores are excluded. Regarding the horizon structure, we prove that asymptotically flat and anti-de Sitter regular black holes always admit extremal configurations. We find that there is no upper bound on the number of horizons and that horizons of arbitrarily high degeneracy can arise. These results extend to more general theories of gravity with second-order equations on spherically symmetric backgrounds. Finally, we characterize the space of quasi-topological theories admitting regular black holes, showing that it is contractible (in particular, path-connected and simply connected) and that regularity is stable under suitably small deformations of the higher-order couplings. In the sense of Spanier, this space is naturally a contractible \emph{quasi-topological} space. Additionally, we prove that any theory defined by a set of couplings up to any arbitrarily high, but finite, curvature order can be completed into a theory yielding regular black hole solutions, while preserving the same set of lower-order couplings. These results show that regular solutions arise in a broad class of quasi-topological gravities and do not require fine-tuning of the couplings.

classification.title_zh: 准拓扑引力的准拓扑空间
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究涉及无限塔多项式密度的准拓扑引力理论及其正则真空黑洞解的一般性质。我们证明，每个正质量正则真空解必然具有 de Sitter 核心，而 Minkowski 与 anti-de Sitter 核心被排除。关于视界结构，我们证明渐近平直和渐近 anti-de Sitter 正则黑洞总存在极端构型。我们发现视界数量没有上限，且可出现任意高简并度的视界。这些结果可推广到球对称背景上具有二阶方程的更一般引力理论。最后，我们刻画允许正则黑洞的准拓扑理论空间，证明其可缩（特别地道路连通且单连通），且正则性在高阶耦合的适当小变形下稳定。在 Spanier 意义下，该空间自然是一个可缩的准拓扑空间。此外，我们证明任何由任意高但有限曲率阶耦合定义的理论都可补全为产生正则黑洞解的理论，同时保持相同低阶耦合。这些结果表明正则解出现在广泛准拓扑引力中，不要求耦合精细调节。
classification.one_liner: 证明准拓扑引力中正则真空黑洞必有 de Sitter 核心、视界数量无上限，且允许正则黑洞的耦合空间可缩，无需精细调节。

papers.title: The Start Time of Ringdown
papers.abstract: We determine the convergence of quasi-normal modes sums for a point-particle plunging into a Schwarzschild black hole. While a dynamical amplitude model reproduces the waveform after the particle crosses the bounce radius, a constant amplitude sum converges only after the start time $t_S$, which corresponds to the advanced time at which the particle hits the central singularity. For a plunge from the ISCO, $t_S \simeq 9.4 M$ after the peak of the $22$ mode. After $t_S$, dynamical and constant amplitudes models are equivalent; our analysis also implies that any "direct wave" must reduce to the late-time tail after $t_S$.

classification.title_zh: Ringdown 的开始时间
classification.abstract_zh: 我们确定点粒子落入 Schwarzschild 黑洞时准正规模式求和的收敛性。虽然动力学振幅模型在粒子越过反弹半径后能重现波形，但常数振幅求和仅在开始时间 t_S 之后收敛；该时间对应粒子到达中心奇点的超前时间。对于从 ISCO 落入的情形，t_S 约在 22 模峰值之后 9.4M。t_S 之后，动力学振幅模型与常数振幅模型等价；我们的分析还意味着，任何“直接波”在 t_S 之后都必须退化为晚期尾。
classification.one_liner: 确定点粒子落入 Schwarzschild 黑洞时 QNM 求和开始收敛的 ringdown 起始时间，并讨论直接波与晚期尾的关系。

papers.title: Form Factors in AdS from the Worldsheet
papers.abstract: We study AdS form factors describing closed strings scattering off D-branes. Assuming that these form factors admit worldsheet integral representations in terms of multiple polylogarithms, we determine their leading curvature corrections around the flat-space limit by matching their pole structure to CFT data. We focus on two examples of defects in 4d $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM: a $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS 't Hooft loop, dual to a D1 brane, and a pair of giant gravitons, dual to a D3 brane. For the 't Hooft loop, the worldsheet bootstrap completely fixes the form factor, and the result passes nontrivial checks from supersymmetric localization. For the giant gravitons, the bootstrap initially leaves five free coefficients, one of which can be fixed using localization. Remarkably, imposing instead that no new operators appear in the defect channel at this order fixes all five coefficients and reproduces the localization constraint. Under this additional assumption, we therefore obtain a unique D3-brane form factor, with supersymmetric localization providing an independent check.

classification.title_zh: 从世界面研究 AdS 中的形状因子
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究描述闭弦与 D-膜散射的 AdS 形状因子。假设这些形状因子具有以多重多对数函数表示的世界面积分表示，作者通过将其极点结构与 CFT 数据匹配，确定其在平直空间极限附近的领头曲率修正。重点讨论 4d N=4 SYM 中两个缺陷例子：对偶于 D1 膜的 1/2-BPS 't Hooft 环，以及对偶于 D3 膜的一对巨引力子。对于 't Hooft 环，世界面 bootstrap 完全固定形状因子，结果通过超对称局域化的非平凡检验。对于巨引力子，bootstrap 最初留下五个自由系数，其中一个可由局域化固定；若改为要求该阶缺陷道中不出现新算符，则可固定全部五个系数，并重现局域化约束。在此额外假设下，作者得到唯一的 D3-膜形状因子，并以超对称局域化作为独立检验。
classification.one_liner: 利用世界面 bootstrap 与 CFT 极点数据匹配，确定 't Hooft 环和巨引力子缺陷的 AdS 形状因子及领头曲率修正。

papers.title: Striped phases of N=4 SYM at finite density
papers.abstract: We construct spatially modulated phases of strongly coupled $\mathcal N=4$ supersymmetric Yang--Mills theory at finite $R$-charge density. Compactification on a three-torus and unequal background charges isolate an unstable charge-density mode. Its static threshold seeds a nonlinear branch of striped black branes in the STU model. The striped states have higher entropy than homogeneous states with the same energy and conserved charges. They connect continuously to the homogeneous branch, with an entropy excess that begins at fourth order in the modulation amplitude. These solutions provide a candidate endpoint of the charge-transport instability.

classification.title_zh: 有限密度下 N=4 SYM 的条纹相
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在有限 R 荷密度下构造强耦合 N=4 超对称 Yang-Mills 理论的空间调制相。通过在三维环面紧化和不等背景荷，隔离出一个不稳定的电荷密度模。其静态阈值在 STU 模型中催生条纹黑膜的非线性分支。条纹态在相同能量和守恒荷下比均匀态具有更高熵。它们连续连接到均匀分支，熵超出从调制振幅的四阶开始。这些解为电荷输运不稳定性的候选终点。
classification.one_liner: 在有限 R 荷密度下构造 N=4 SYM 的条纹黑膜相，并表明其比均匀态熵更高、可作为电荷输运不稳定性的终点。

papers.title: A dynamical Einstein-Proca-dilaton holographic model and exotic hybrid meson resonances
papers.abstract: A fully dynamical Einstein-Proca-dilaton (EPD) holographic model is developed for the exotic $J^{PC}=1^{-+}$ hybrid meson, incorporating the backreaction of the massive vector field dual to the hybrid current in the bulk. Solving the coupled EPD system yields a self-consistent gravitational background and the mass spectrum of hybrid resonances. While the soft-wall limit reproduces linear Regge behavior, the inclusion of backreaction yields quantitative shifts that improve agreement with experimental candidates. The finite-temperature regime is approached by studying black hole thermodynamics and spectral functions across the confinement-deconfinement transition, fixing the Hawking-Page temperature to $T_c \sim 150 \, \mathrm{MeV}$. Unlike non-backreacted AdS/QCD models, the dynamical background predicts a strong suppression of hybrid states already near the onset of deconfinement. These results demonstrate that gravitational backreaction has measurable consequences for both vacuum spectroscopy and in-medium properties of exotic hybrid mesons, emphasizing the relevance of a dynamical self-consistent approach in AdS/QCD.

classification.title_zh: 一个动力学 Einstein-Proca-dilaton 全息模型与奇特杂化介子共振
classification.abstract_zh: 本文为奇特 J^{PC}=1^{-+} 杂化介子构建了一个完全动力学的 Einstein-Proca-dilaton (EPD) 全息模型，其中包含对偶于杂化流的大质量矢量场在体中的背反。求解耦合的 EPD 系统可得到自洽的引力背景以及杂化共振的质量谱。软墙极限重现线性 Regge 行为，而引入背反会带来定量移动，并改善与实验候选态的一致性。有限温度情形通过研究黑洞热力学和跨越退禁闭相变的谱函数来处理，并将 Hawking-Page 温度固定为 T_c ~ 150 MeV。与非背反的 AdS/QCD 模型不同，动力学背景预测杂化态在退禁闭起始附近就已强烈受到抑制。这些结果表明，引力背反对奇特杂化介子的真空谱学和介质内性质都有可测量的影响，强调了在 AdS/QCD 中采用动力学自洽方法的相关性。
classification.one_liner: 构建含背反的动力学 EPD 全息模型，计算奇特杂化介子谱并研究退禁闭相变附近的抑制。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于 AdS/QCD 与动力学背反、有限温度谱函数研究；与用户列出的全息超流、探针膜、QNM 等支线不直接重合，但其相变与引力热力学部分相关。

papers.title: Spectral flow in AdS$\mathbf{_3}$ revisited
papers.abstract: We revisit an old idea that spectral flow in WZW models can be associated with certain $G$-bundles over a worldsheet. This allows us to introduce a novel method for computing correlators of spectrally-flowed vertex operators in WZW models with group $G$ and level $k$, by systematically computing the contribution from a network of line defects. Specialising to the case of $G=SL(2, \mathbb{R})$, as is relevant to AdS$_3$ string theory, we demonstrate that generic $n$-point functions of spectrally-flowed vertex operators at tree level can be rewritten in terms of an $(n+1)$-point function of $n$ unflowed vertex operators and one degenerate insertion. This is to be interpreted as an unflowed $n$-point function in an instanton background. Moreover, we conjecture that this $(n+1)$-point function can be recast as an $n$-point function of unflowed operators and we provide evidence for this. We demonstrate that the $(n+1)$-point function satisfies the same constraints from global spacetime conformal invariance as does an unflowed $n$-point function for a specific choice of spacetime coordinates that we determine. We verify that our results agree with bootstrap results in the literature. This provides the next step towards fully solving the $SL(2,\mathbb{R})$ WZW model.

classification.title_zh: 再访 AdS$_3$ 中的谱流
classification.abstract_zh: 我们重新审视一个旧想法：WZW 模型中的谱流可以与世界面上的某些 $G$-丛相关联。这使我们能够引入一种新方法，通过系统计算线缺陷网络的贡献，来计算群 $G$、能级 $k$ 的 WZW 模型中谱流顶点算符的关联函数。专门针对与 AdS$_3$ 弦论相关的 $G=SL(2,\mathbb{R})$ 情形，我们证明树级一般 $n$ 点谱流顶点算符函数可以重写为 $n$ 个未流顶点算符与一个退化插入的 $(n+1)$ 点函数。这应解释为瞬子背景中的未流 $n$ 点函数。此外，我们猜想该 $(n+1)$ 点函数可以改写为未流算符的 $n$ 点函数，并给出证据。我们证明，对于我们所确定的特定时空坐标选择，该 $(n+1)$ 点函数满足与未流 $n$ 点函数相同的全局时空共形不变性约束。我们验证结果与文献中的 bootstrap 结果一致。这为完全求解 $SL(2,\mathbb{R})$ WZW 模型提供了下一步。
classification.one_liner: 用线缺陷网络和瞬子背景重算 AdS$_3$ 弦论中 $SL(2,\mathbb{R})$ WZW 谱流顶点算符关联函数，并推进该模型求解。

papers.title: Partially Massless Condensates and Reentrant NUT/Bolt Phase Transitions in Conformal Gravity
papers.abstract: We study non-Einstein Bach-flat Taub-NUT/Bolt instantons with weakened AdS boundary conditions. In particular, the next-to-leading-order coefficient in the Fefferman--Graham expansion is nonvanishing, and it sources the partially massless response in the dual conformal field theory. As in the Einstein case, the holographic stress tensor of these instantons represents a perfect fluid with vorticity. Remarkably, we identify a non-Einstein Taub-Bolt branch supporting a nonvanishing partially massless response at zero source, while preserving the full symmetry of the squashed conformal boundary. The additional holographic degrees of freedom enrich the thermodynamic phase structure, allowing the conventional NUT/Bolt transition to disappear or give way to reentrant transitions. We further show that non-Einstein Bolts can possess negative thermodynamic volume and establish the absence of negative modes of a conformally coupled probe scalar on regular Bach-flat NUT backgrounds.

classification.title_zh: 共形引力中的部分无质量凝聚体与回归型NUT/Bolt相变
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究具有弱化AdS边界条件的非爱因斯坦Bach平坦Taub-NUT/Bolt瞬子。具体而言，Fefferman--Graham展开中的次领头阶系数非零，并在对偶共形场论中激发部分无质量响应。与爱因斯坦情形一样，这些瞬子的全息应力张量表示具有涡度的完美流体。引人注目的是，我们识别出一个非爱因斯坦Taub-Bolt分支，它在零源下支持非零的部分无质量响应，同时保持压扁共形边界的完整对称性。额外的全息自由度丰富了热力学相结构，使传统NUT/Bolt相变消失或让位于回归型相变。我们进一步表明，非爱因斯坦Bolt可以具有负的热力学体积，并证明在规则Bach平坦NUT背景上共形耦合试探标量不存在负模。
classification.one_liner: 研究弱AdS边界下非爱因斯坦Bach平坦Taub-NUT/Bolt瞬子，发现部分无质量响应及NUT/Bolt相变的重入/消失与负热力学体积。

papers.title: Complex phase diagram and thermodynamic supercriticality of five-dimensional four-charge AdS black holes in $STU-W^2U$ gauged supergravity
papers.abstract: In this paper, we investigate the complex phase structure and thermodynamic supercriticality of static four-charge anti-de Sitter (AdS) black holes in five-dimensional $STU-W^2U$ gauged supergravity, with all four physical electric charges held fixed. A Van der Waals-like first-order small/large black hole phase transition is found to terminate at a critical point. By analytically continuing the fixed-charge thermodynamic relations, we trace the two real spinodal singularities through criticality into a complex-conjugate pair in the supercritical region. The corresponding spinodal temperatures exhibit the characteristic $3/2$ near-critical scaling, connecting the subcritical temperature splitting with the imaginary parts of the supercritical complex temperatures. We construct the associated complex phase diagram and identify a Widom-type crossover line from the real-temperature projection of the complex spinodals. This line progressively deviates from the locus of real heat-capacity maxima as the pressure increases. At higher pressures, the real heat-capacity extrema eventually merge and disappear, while the complex spinodal singularities persist. Together, these results reveal a continuous connection between critical phase transitions and supercritical thermodynamics through complex singularity structures, providing further insight into the thermodynamic phase behavior of multicharge supergravity black holes.

classification.title_zh: 五维四电荷 AdS 黑洞在 STU-W^2U 规范超引力中的复相图与热力学超临界性
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究五维 STU-W^2U 规范超引力中静态四电荷反德西特（AdS）黑洞的复相结构与热力学超临界性，并固定四个物理电荷。发现类 Van der Waals 的一阶小/大黑洞相变终止于临界点。通过对固定电荷热力学关系进行解析延拓，我们追踪两个实 spinodal 奇点穿过临界性进入超临界区后成为复共轭对。相应的 spinodal 温度呈现特征性的 3/2 近临界标度，将亚临界温度劈裂与超临界复温度的虚部联系起来。我们构建了相应的复相图，并从复 spinodal 的实温度投影中识别出一条 Widom 型交叉线；随着压强增大，该线逐渐偏离实热容极大值轨迹。在更高压强下，实热容极值最终合并并消失，而复 spinodal 奇点仍然存在。这些结果通过复奇点结构揭示了临界相变与超临界热力学之间的连续联系，并为多电荷超引力黑洞的热力学相行为提供了进一步认识。
classification.one_liner: 固定电荷的五维四电荷 AdS 黑洞中，小/大黑洞相变的临界点可通过复 spinodal 奇点连续延伸到超临界热力学。

papers.title: Exact thermal correlators at vanishing momenta and the black hole singularity
papers.abstract: We study thermal two- and three-point functions of scalar primaries in holographic CFTs dual to AdS black branes. The three-point function arises from a cubic scalar interaction in the bulk. At vanishing external momenta, the tree-level results can be written in closed form and are exact in the operator dimensions. We reproduce them through direct CFT calculations in two dimensions. Their large-dimension expansions contain subleading exponential terms encoding the radial proper time from the horizon to the black hole singularity. These results provide an exact test of earlier WKB and saddle-point predictions for higher-point thermal correlators, confirming the proper-time signature while correcting the predicted asymptotic form.

classification.title_zh: 零动量下精确热关联函数与黑洞奇点
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究对偶于AdS黑膜的全息CFT中标量主场的热两点和三点函数。三点函数来自体中标量场的立方相互作用。在外部动量消失时，树级结果可写成闭式，并且对算符维度精确。我们通过在二维CFT中直接计算重现了这些结果。它们的大维度展开包含次领头指数项，这些项编码从视界到黑洞奇点的径向固有时。这些结果为早先针对更高点热关联函数的WKB和鞍点预言提供了精确检验，确认了固有时特征，同时修正了预言的渐近形式。
classification.one_liner: 在AdS黑膜全息CFT中给出零动量标量热两点与三点函数的闭式精确结果，并用其检验黑洞奇点固有时信号的WKB预言。

papers.title: Realistic neutron stars in the constant-Q branch of f(Q) gravity
papers.abstract: We investigate the hydrostatic equilibrium and global structure of neutron stars within symmetric teleparallel gravity, where gravitational interactions are mediated by the non-metricity scalar $Q$. Working within the metric-affine formulation, we adopt the regular, constant-$Q$ branch ($Q = Q_*$) of $f(Q)$ gravity, which preserves regularity at the stellar centre while maintaining explicit dependence on the non-linear functional form through $f(Q_*)$ and its derivatives. We propose three novel non-linear $f(Q)$ extensions: (i) a Born-Infeld-inspired model, (ii) a Hu--Sawicki analogue, and (iii) a Tsujikawa-inspired model. Incorporating state-of-the-art realistic unified equations of state, namely GPPVA(DD2) and SLy4, we numerically solve the modified Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff equations and evaluate stellar stability via the Harrison-Zel'dovich-Novikov criterion. The Born-Infeld and Hu-Sawicki analogues smoothly recover the general relativistic limit as their control parameters increase, predicting stellar radii for low-mass objects ($M < 2.0\,M_\odot$) that match observational constraints from X-ray binaries and GW170817; however, their maximum masses remain capped below $2.43\,M_\odot$ (DD2) and $2.06\,M_\odot$ (SLy4). Conversely, the Tsujikawa-inspired model significantly stiffens the effective gravitational coupling, accommodating massive compact objects up to $\sim 3.36\,M_\odot$ and offering a viable physical origin for the $2.59_{-0.09}^{+0.08}\,M_\odot$ secondary object in GW190814, albeit at the expense of overpredicting radii for typical low-mass neutron stars. These contrasting behaviours demonstrate a key phenomenological complementarity between maximum mass and radius bounds within the constant-$Q$ framework, highlighting the utility of multimessenger observations in constraining non-linear non-metricity gravity.

classification.title_zh: f(Q)引力常Q分支中的现实中子星
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究对称远平行引力中由非度规标量Q传递引力相互作用时的中子星流体静力学平衡与整体结构。作者在度规-仿射表述下采用f(Q)引力的正则常Q分支（Q=Q_*），该分支在恒星中心保持正则性，同时通过f(Q_*)及其导数保留非线性函数形式的影响。文章提出三种新的非线性f(Q)扩展：(i) Born-Infeld启发模型，(ii) Hu-Sawicki类比模型，(iii) Tsujikawa启发模型。结合最先进的现实统一状态方程GPPVA(DD2)与SLy4，数值求解修改后的Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff方程，并用Harrison-Zel'dovich-Novikov判据评估恒星稳定性。Born-Infeld与Hu-Sawicki类比模型在控制参数增大时平滑恢复广义相对论极限，其对低质量天体（M<2.0M⊙）给出的半径与X射线双星及GW170817观测约束相符；但其最大质量分别被限制在2.43M⊙（DD2）和2.06M⊙（SLy4）以下。相反，Tsujikawa启发模型显著硬化有效引力耦合，可容纳最高约3.36M⊙的致密天体，并为GW190814中2.59_{-0.09}^{+0.08}M⊙的次天体提供可行物理起源，但代价是过高预测典型低质量中子星的半径。这些对比行为表明常Q框架内最大质量与半径约束之间存在关键现象学互补性，并凸显多信使观测在约束非线性非度规引力中的作用。
classification.one_liner: 在f(Q)引力常Q分支中，用三种非线性模型和真实状态方程计算中子星结构，显示最大质量与半径约束之间的互补性。

papers.title: Gravitational Wave Birefringence in generalized Palatini Chern Simons
papers.abstract: The cosmological propagation of gravitational waves (GWs) can exhibit amplitude and phase polarization distortions when parity symmetry is broken, a phenomenon known as cosmological birefringence. In this paper, we investigate the phenomenology of GW birefringence in a gravitational model $f(R)$ coupled to a dynamical Chern-Simons (dCS) term, analyzed in the metric and Palatini formalisms. At the background level, this model can lead to dynamical dark energy, while for GW propagation we find that the Palatini formalism predicts both amplitude and velocity birefringence, whereas the metric formalism predicts amplitude birefringence only. We also find that the birefringence effects can either be suppressed or enhanced by the $f(R)$ interactions, depending on the specific form of $f(R)$. Considering three common $f(R)$ models (Hu-Sawicki, Exponential, and Hyperbolic gravity) fit to recent cosmological data, we find that birefringence is enhanced relative to the $f(R) = R$ case, by $1-10\%$ in the Palatini formalism and up to a factor of 2 in the metric formalism. We also translate current GW birefringence constraints to bounds on the dCS coupling within our model. Finally, we show that in our model the birefringence effect grows polynomially with source redshift, in contrast to the linear-distance scaling commonly assumed in phenomenological models of GW birefringence in the current literature.

classification.title_zh: 广义Palatini Chern-Simons中的引力波双折射
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波在宇宙学传播中，当宇称对称性破缺时可出现振幅和相位偏振畸变，即宇宙学双折射。本文研究f(R)引力与动力学Chern-Simons项耦合模型中的引力波双折射现象，分别在度规和Palatini形式下分析。背景层面该模型可导致动力学暗能量；对于引力波传播，Palatini形式预言振幅和速度双折射，而度规形式只预言振幅双折射。双折射效应可被f(R)相互作用压低或增强，取决于f(R)具体形式。选取Hu-Sawicki、指数型和双曲型三个拟合宇宙学数据的f(R)模型，发现相对于f(R)=R，双折射在Palatini形式下增强1–10%，在度规形式下最高增强约2倍。还将当前引力波双折射限制转化为对dCS耦合的约束。最后表明该模型中双折射效应随源红移呈多项式增长，不同于当前文献唯象模型中通常假设的线性距离标度。
classification.one_liner: 在f(R)+动力学Chern-Simons引力的度规/Palatini形式中，引力波双折射因f(R)修正而增强，且Palatini形式还给出速度双折射。

papers.title: Accurate waveforms for generic planar-orbit binary black holes: The multipolar effective-one-body model SEOBNRv6EHM
papers.abstract: Accurate and computationally efficient waveform models are required to infer the parameters of compact binaries from their gravitational wave (GW) emission. Among these parameters, orbital eccentricity serves as a smoking gun for dynamical formation channels and must be accounted for to avoid systematic errors in GW analyses. Here, we present SEOBNRv6EHM, a time-domain, multipolar waveform model for binaries on generic planar orbits, calibrated to quasi-circular (QC) numerical-relativity (NR) simulations from the SXS collaboration. In addition to the dominant $(2,2)$ mode, the model provides the $(2,1)$, $(3,3)$, $(3,2)$, $(4,4)$, and $(4,3)$ multipoles for the full inspiral-merger-ringdown process of coalescing binaries, as well as for dynamical captures and scattering encounters. The model is built within the effective-one-body (EOB) framework, and it employs novel resummations of the radiation-reaction force and waveform modes. We validate its accuracy through comparisons against 592 QC, 319 eccentric, one dynamical-capture, and two scattering SXS NR waveforms, and through scattering-angle comparisons against 61 SXS NR simulations. For QC and small-eccentricity binaries, its accuracy is comparable to previous-generation SEOBNRv5 models. For highly eccentric systems, however, SEOBNRv6EHM attains unprecedented accuracy, with waveform mismatches remaining below or close to $ 2\% $ across the total mass range $ 20-200\, \mathrm{M}_\odot $ for eccentricities up to $\sim 0.9$ at 14 periastron passages before merger. Additionally, SEOBNRv6EHM achieves waveform-generation walltimes that are $ 2 - 8 $ times faster than other state-of-the-art EOB eccentric models, enabling efficient and accurate applications in GW astronomy.

papers.title: Probing gravity at megahertz frequencies with levitated rotors
papers.abstract: The near-field gravitational interaction between masses is always thought of as instantaneous, an assumption experimentally tested only up to 1.7 kHz, where measurements yield a bounds at the $10^{-5}$ s level. We propose a near-field experiment reaching up to megahertz frequencies, in which a levitated microrotor modulates a mass quadrupole and a second rotor measures the resulting gravitational tidal field as a torque. Because the detector rotor acts as a mechanical local oscillator, the megahertz signal is downconverted to a convenient band of a few hertz, and since at fixed geometry neither the torque nor the integration time depends on the rotation rate, higher frequencies are reached at no cost in sensitivity. With parameters within reach of magnetically levitated NdFeB rotors, a signal at 2 MHz yields a torque of $2\cdot 10^{-25}$ Nm, detectable in under an hour at 10 mK. Treating a possible departure from instantaneous gravitational coupling through a field relaxation time, the measured torque could constrain it at the $10^{-8}$ s level, improving on the existing bounds by more than three orders of magnitude. As a byproduct of our analysis, we derive the sensitivity of a rotor operated as a tunable high-frequency gravitational-wave detector, finding that a noise-equivalent strain around $10^{-22}$ Hz$^{-1/2}$ could be achievable in the megahertz band.

classification.title_zh: 利用悬浮转子探测兆赫兹频率下的引力
classification.abstract_zh: 质量之间的近场引力相互作用通常被认为是瞬时的，这一假设仅在高达1.7 kHz的频率下经过实验检验，给出的约束处于10^-5秒量级。我们提出一个可达兆赫兹频率的近场实验，其中悬浮微转子调制质量四极矩，第二个转子通过力矩测量由此产生的引力潮汐场。由于探测转子充当机械本振，兆赫兹信号被下变频到几赫兹的方便频带；并且在固定几何结构下，力矩和积分时间均不依赖于旋转速率，因此达到更高频率不会损失灵敏度。在磁悬浮NdFeB转子可实现的参数下，2 MHz信号产生2×10^-25 N·m的力矩，可在10 mK温度下不到一小时内探测到。若通过场弛豫时间来描述可能偏离瞬时引力耦合的行为，所测力矩可在10^-8秒量级上约束它，比现有界限改善三个数量级以上。作为我们分析的副产品，我们推导了作为可调高频引力波探测器运行的转子的灵敏度，发现兆赫兹频段可实现约10^-22 Hz^-1/2的噪声等效应变。

papers.title: Gravitational-Wave Microlensing as a Probe of Compact Object Population
papers.abstract: The abundance of compact objects ranging from stellar to intermediate masses ($\sim 1 - 10^{5}M_{\odot}$) remains poorly constrained, particularly for populations such as primordial black holes and dark matter subhalos that emit little or no electromagnetic radiation. Gravitational-wave (GW) microlensing provides a complementary way to probe these populations through wave-optics effects imprinted on the GW signals, with implications for astrophysical and cosmological inference. We develop a hierarchical Bayesian framework to infer the population properties of microlenses from an ensemble of microlensed GW events, constraining the slope of the power-law lens mass function ($\alpha_{\rm ML}$), the lens number density ($n_0$), and the fraction of dark matter in compact lenses ($f_{\rm DM}$). Using simulated microlensed GW signals drawn from a realistic binary black hole population, we find that $\sim 100$ detected microlensed events are able to constrain both $\alpha_{\rm ML}$ and $n_0$, although a degeneracy between the two remains. For a low-mass-dominated lens population ($\alpha_{\rm ML}=2$) with $n_0=10^6~\mathrm{Mpc}^{-3}$, a three-year observation at the O4 sensitivity yields $\sim 130$ detectable microlensed events and recovers the injected dark-matter fraction, $f_{\rm DM}\simeq 1.2 \times 10^{-4}$, with a 90% credible interval of $7.3 \times 10^{-5} \lesssim f_{\rm DM} \lesssim 1.8 \times 10^{-4}$.

classification.title_zh: 引力波微透镜作为致密天体族群探针
classification.abstract_zh: 从恒星质量到中等质量（约 1–10^5 M⊙）的致密天体丰度仍受到很弱约束，尤其是原初黑洞和暗物质子晕等几乎不发射电磁辐射的族群。引力波微透镜通过引力波信号上的波光学效应，为探测这些族群提供了互补途径，并对天体物理与宇宙学推断具有重要意义。我们发展了一个分层贝叶斯框架，从一组微透镜引力波事件中推断微透镜的族群性质，约束幂律透镜质量函数斜率 α_ML、透镜数密度 n_0 以及致密透镜占暗物质的比例 f_DM。使用从真实双黑洞族群抽取的模拟微透镜引力波信号，我们发现约 100 个探测到的微透镜事件能够约束 α_ML 和 n_0，但二者之间仍存在简并。对于低质量主导的透镜族群（α_ML=2）且 n_0=10^6 Mpc^-3，在 O4 灵敏度下三年观测可得到约 130 个可探测微透镜事件，并恢复注入的暗物质比例 f_DM≃1.2×10^-4，90% 可信区间为 7.3×10^-5≲f_DM≲1.8×10^-4。

papers.title: Unsupervised Neural Operators for Rotating Relativistic Stars: High-Fidelity Equation of State Inference and Pulsar Spin Evolution at Scale
papers.abstract: Observed populations of rotating neutron stars~(NSs) with millisecond-order periods are powerful probes of fundamental physics. Mass-radius measurements inform poorly constrained properties of degenerate nuclear matter, whereas high-fidelity population synthesis connects unknowns in NS formation and binary evolution to large radio-timing surveys. However, repeated structure calculations are prohibitive due to the computational cost of solving the highly coupled partial differential equations of axisymmetric general relativistic hydrostatic equilibrium that govern rotating NS interiors. Non-rotating calculations or approximate rotational corrections can bias equation of state inference and limit the fidelity of population synthesis in tracing the evolutionary history of progenitors and propagating equation of state uncertainties. In this \textit{Letter}, we develop physics-informed neural operators that can solve the axisymmetric problem with high accuracy and negligible computational cost. \textit{Our solvers are trained in a fully unsupervised setting, with the training objective informed solely by the partial differential equations, and achieve a $10^3\times$ speed-up with negligible accuracy loss}. These solvers enable scalable EoS inference that self-consistently accounts for rotation and repeated stellar-structure calculations during binary evolution, making spin predictions that account for rotational structure and EoS uncertainties computationally accessible to population synthesis.

classification.title_zh: 旋转相对论恒星的無监督神经算子：高保真物态方程推断与大规模脉冲星自旋演化
classification.abstract_zh: 观测到的毫秒周期旋转中子星群体是基础物理的重要探针。质量-半径测量可约束简并核物质中约束较差的性质，而高保真群体合成把中子星形成与双星演化中的未知量同大型射电计时巡天联系起来。然而，求解描述旋转中子星内部的轴对称广义相对论流体静力平衡的高度耦合偏微分方程计算成本很高，重复的结构计算难以承受。非旋转计算或近似旋转修正可能使物态方程推断产生偏差，并限制群体合成追踪前身星演化历史和传播物态方程不确定性的保真度。本文开发物理信息神经算子，能以高精度和可忽略的计算成本求解轴对称问题。该求解器在完全无监督的设置下训练，训练目标仅由偏微分方程提供，并以可忽略的精度损失实现 10^3 倍加速。这些求解器使可扩展的物态方程推断能够自洽考虑旋转，并支持双星演化期间重复的恒星结构计算，从而使考虑旋转结构和物态方程不确定性的自旋预测在计算上可用于群体合成。
classification.one_liner: 用无监督物理信息神经算子快速求解旋转中子星的轴对称广义相对论平衡结构，以实现可扩展的物态方程推断和脉冲星自旋演化预测。

papers.title: Axial black hole perturbations in purely-metric Horndeski theories
papers.abstract: We study axial (odd-parity) perturbations about static and spherically-symmetric curvaturised black hole solutions of purely-metric Horndeski theories. We first review the construction of purely-metric theories of gravity with second-order equations of motion and an additional propagating scalar degree of freedom which is purely gravitational. We then revisit the formation, in a subclass of these theories, of a new branch of hairy black hole solutions under tachyonic instabilities of the scalar field near the Schwarzschild solution. Because a non-zero Ricci curvature grows and by analogy with black hole scalarisation, the latter black hole formation mechanism is dubbed \emph{curvaturisation}. We then apply the first-order approach to the dynamics of axial perturbations and find that it is equivalent to that of axial perturbations in general relativity evolving in a distinct effective metric. We explicitly provide that effective metric in terms of the background and the Lagrangian functions, and show that it shares the same causality structure as the background metric of curvaturised black holes. By turning to the Schr\"odinger-like formulation of the perturbations, we analyse the scattering potential and conclude that the axial perturbations of curvaturised black holes are linearly stable. Finally, we confirm these findings by explicitly computing the fundamental quasi-normal mode as well as the first five overtones for the quadrupole $\ell = 2$.

classification.title_zh: 纯度规Horndeski理论中的轴向黑洞微扰
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究纯度规Horndeski理论中静态球对称曲率化黑洞解的轴向（奇宇称）微扰。首先回顾具有二阶运动方程和额外传播标量自由度（纯引力性）的纯度规引力理论的构造。然后重新审视在这些理论的一个子类中，在Schwarzschild解附近标量场快子不稳定性下形成新分支毛发黑洞解的机制。由于非零Ricci曲率增长，并类比黑洞标量化，该形成机制被称为曲率化。接着我们将一阶方法应用于轴向微扰动力学，发现它等价于广义相对论中的轴向微扰在一个不同有效度规中演化。我们显式给出该有效度规（用背景和拉格朗日函数表示），并表明它与曲率化黑洞背景度规具有相同因果结构。转向微扰的类Schrödinger表述，我们分析散射势并得出曲率化黑洞的轴向微扰线性稳定。最后，通过显式计算四极ℓ=2的基本准正模及前五个泛音确认这些结果。

papers.title: Quasi-equilibrium tidal folds of white dwarfs around rotating black holes in shift-symmetric Einstein--scalar--Gauss--Bonnet gravity
papers.abstract: We examine how the geometry of rotating black holes in linear, shift-symmetric Einstein--scalar--Gauss--Bonnet (EsGB) gravity changes the limiting tidal equilibria of white dwarfs (WDs). The relativistic tidal field is obtained from numerical EsGB backgrounds in a parallel-transported frame and coupled to a compressible affine model. Comparisons with Kerr black holes matched in Arnowitt--Deser--Misner (ADM) mass and angular momentum show a positive shift in the orbital frequency at the tidal fold. At fixed spin the relative correction follows an approximately quadratic dependence on the EsGB coupling, consistent with the leading response of the metric to the scalar field. Over the sampled backgrounds, the relative correction reaches order $10^{-3}$. Black hole rotation also changes the relation between the tidal fold and the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO): the sampled prograde folds remain outside the ISCO, while retrograde folds move inside it at higher spins. Orbital orientation therefore controls whether tidal equilibrium is lost before the orbital stability limit is reached. For the stellar and black hole masses considered here, the characteristic gravitational wave (GW) frequencies fall in the millihertz band relevant to planned space based interferometers. Future GW observations capable of resolving deviations from Kerr predictions could constrain the EsGB coupling.

classification.title_zh: shift对称Einstein-标量-Gauss-Bonnet引力中旋转黑洞周围白矮星的准平衡潮汐折叠
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究线性shift对称Einstein-标量-Gauss-Bonnet（EsGB）引力中旋转黑洞的几何如何改变白矮星的极限潮汐平衡。相对论潮汐场由数值EsGB背景在平行传输标架中给出，并与可压缩仿射模型耦合。与在ADM质量和角动量上匹配的Kerr黑洞相比，潮汐折叠处的轨道频率出现正向移动。在固定自旋下，相对修正近似随EsGB耦合二次依赖，这与度规对标量场的领头响应一致；在所采样的背景上，相对修正达到10^{-3}量级。黑洞旋转也改变潮汐折叠与ISCO的关系：采样的顺行折叠仍位于ISCO之外，而逆行折叠在较高自旋下进入ISCO之内。因此轨道方向控制潮汐平衡是否在轨道稳定性极限之前丧失。对于所考虑的恒星和黑洞质量，特征引力波频率落在与计划中的空间干涉仪相关的毫赫兹波段。未来能够分辨Kerr预言偏离的引力波观测或可约束EsGB耦合。

papers.title: Probing black bounce spacetime through mass accretion rate
papers.abstract: We study steady, spherically symmetric accretion of a collisionless kinetic gas onto a compact object described by the Simpson--Visser (SV) metric, a one-parameter regularization of the Schwarzschild spacetime. Using the standard relativistic Vlasov formalism, we adopt boundary conditions at a finite injection radius $R$ and compute the mass accretion rate $\dot{M}$ for Vlasov gas with both monoenergetic and Maxwell--J\"uttner distribution functions. Throughout the computation, we also take into account the influence of particle's angular momentum. We carefully investigate the influence of the black bounce parameter on the mass accretion rate $\dot{M}$. By expanding accretion rate in terms of bounce parameter $a$, we found that the leading-order correction appears at quadratic order in $a$. This work extends the Vlasov accretion framework to a broader class of spherically symmetric spacetimes and quantifies the impact of the geometric modification on the accretion flow. In particular, since the shadows of the SV and Schwarzschild black holes are degenerate, comparing their mass accretion rates may offer a complementary probe for distinguishing these geometries in future astrophysical observations.

classification.title_zh: 通过质量吸积率探测黑洞反弹时空
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究无碰撞动力学气体在由Simpson--Visser（SV）度规描述的致密天体上的稳态球对称吸积，该度规是Schwarzschild时空的单参数正则化。使用标准相对论Vlasov形式，在有限注入半径R处采用边界条件，计算具有单能分布和Maxwell--Jüttner分布函数的Vlasov气体的质量吸积率\dot{M}。在整个计算中，我们还考虑粒子角动量的影响。我们仔细研究黑洞反弹参数对质量吸积率\dot{M}的影响。通过将吸积率按反弹参数a展开，我们发现领头阶修正出现在a的二次阶。本工作将Vlasov吸积框架推广到更广泛的球对称时空，并量化几何修改对吸积流的影响。特别地，由于SV黑洞和Schwarzschild黑洞的阴影是简并的，比较它们的质量吸积率可能为未来天体物理观测区分这些几何提供互补探针。

papers.title: Quasinormal modes of charged de Sitter black holes and strong cosmic censorship in conformal Killing gravity
papers.abstract: The strong cosmic censorship conjecture argues that the future evolution of the spacetime should be predictable from the initial data. However, within the framework of general relativity, some counterexamples to the conjecture have been found, especially for de Sitter spacetime. Spurred by challenges to the validity of the strong cosmic censorship conjecture, we extend such investigations to conformal Killing gravity, a promising candidate beyond Einstein's theory. Considering neutral massless scalar perturbations for charged de Sitter black hole, we not only shed light on the quasinormal mode spectrum, but also clarify whether the modifications from conformal Killing gravity and nonlinear electrodynamics can rescue the strong cosmic censorship conjecture, and further investigate how characteristic parameters affect its validity. As the first instance for investigating the conjecture in the framework of conformal Killing gravity, this paper reports some unexpected findings.

classification.title_zh: 共形Killing引力中带电de Sitter黑洞的准正规模与强宇宙监督
classification.abstract_zh: 强宇宙监督猜想认为时空的未来演化应当可由初始数据预测。然而，在广义相对论框架内，尤其对于de Sitter时空，已发现该猜想的一些反例。受强宇宙监督猜想有效性挑战的推动，本文将此类研究推广到共形Killing引力——一种超越爱因斯坦理论的有希望的候选理论。针对带电de Sitter黑洞的中性无质量标量扰动，我们不仅阐明了准正规模谱，还澄清了共形Killing引力与非线性电动力学的修正能否挽救强宇宙监督猜想，并进一步研究了特征参数如何影响其有效性。作为在共形Killing引力框架下研究该猜想的首个实例，本文报告了一些出乎意料的发现。

papers.title: Missing solutions in scalar-Gauss-Bonnet gravity
papers.abstract: We discover novel neutron star solutions under scalar-Gauss-Bonnet (sGB) gravity which have been missed altogether in the existing literature. The complete solution space also reveals a new regularity condition that has to be satisfied by all scalarized stars. Certain scalarized branches of neutron star solutions under sGB gravity have long been known to abruptly terminate on stellar mass-radius diagrams at lower stellar radii, a phenomenon that has no counterpart in classical scalar-tensor theories. Such termination has been strongly suspected to be physical rather than a numerical artifact nevertheless, since sGB theories feature a regularity condition at the center of the star, which can prevent the existence of certain configurations. Motivated by the recently re-emerging phase-transition view of scalarization, we first predict that these terminated branches can reappear after a "gap." We confirm this by finding such reappearing branches, and also determine which parts of the theory parameter space are more amenable to such occurrences. We then show that the previously known central regularity condition cannot explain all the non-existing solutions in the gaps, which leads us to the discovery of a new, non-central, condition for the existence of scalarized neutron stars under sGB gravity.

classification.title_zh: 标量-Gauss-Bonnet引力中缺失的解
classification.abstract_zh: 在标量-Gauss-Bonnet（sGB）引力下发现此前文献整体遗漏的新型中子星解。完整解空间还揭示出所有标量化星都必须满足的新正则性条件。已知sGB引力下某些标量化中子星解支会在质量-半径图的较小半径处突然终止，这在经典标量-张量理论中没有对应现象。作者受近期重新兴起的标量化相变观点启发，预言这些终止的解支可在“间隙”后重现，并通过找到重现解支加以确认，同时确定理论参数空间中更易出现该现象的区域。进一步表明，先前已知的中心正则性条件无法解释间隙中所有不存在的解，由此发现sGB引力中标量化中子星存在性的一个新的非中心条件。
classification.one_liner: 发现sGB引力中被遗漏的中子星解，并给出标量化星的新正则性条件与解支重现机制。

papers.title: Research on gravitational waves from extreme mass ratio inspirals in an axisymmetric Finslerian extension of Schwarzschild spacetime
papers.abstract: We investigate gravitational waves from extreme mass ratio inspirals in an axisymmetric Finslerian extension of the Schwarzschild spacetime. Its angular component is described by a two-dimensional Randers space, with the Schwarzschild limit recovered at Finslerian parameter $\epsilon = 0$. This structure breaks spherical symmetry, causing generic orbits to undergo orbital plane precession. Using multipolar radiation reaction and adiabatic orbital averaging, we derive the leading order Finslerian corrections to the energy, axial angular momentum, and total angular momentum fluxes. These corrections enter at Newtonian order and take different forms. We then incorporate these corrections into a higher-order Schwarzschild hybrid flux model to evolve the orbital elements and construct waveforms at mass quadrupole order using the numerical kludge method. The Finslerian corrections affect both the conservative orbital dynamics and the dissipative inspiral, producing cumulative phase shifts relative to the Schwarzschild waveform. For the representative source observed by LISA over one year with signal-to-noise ratio of 20, the noise weighted mismatch analysis shows that Finslerian waveforms with $|\epsilon| \gtrsim 2 \times 10^{-6}$ are distinguishable from their Schwarzschild counterparts, with higher initial eccentricities further lowering the distinguishable value of $|\epsilon|$. For a Schwarzschild injection, the Fisher matrix analysis yields a marginalized $1\sigma$ uncertainty of $\sigma_\epsilon \simeq 1.26 \times 10^{-6}$. These results show the potential of space-based gravitational wave detectors to probe the axisymmetric Finslerian extension of the Schwarzschild spacetime.

classification.title_zh: 轴对称Finslerian扩展Schwarzschild时空中极端质量比旋近的引力波研究
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究轴对称Finslerian扩展Schwarzschild时空中的极端质量比旋近引力波。该时空的角部分由二维Randers空间描述，当Finslerian参数ε=0时回到Schwarzschild极限。这一结构破坏球对称性，使一般轨道发生轨道面进动。利用多极辐射反作用和绝热轨道平均，推导了能量、轴向角动量和总角动量通量的领头阶Finslerian修正；这些修正从Newtonian阶进入且形式不同。随后将这些修正纳入高阶Schwarzschild混合通量模型以演化轨道根数，并用数值kludge方法在质量四极阶构造波形。Finslerian修正同时影响保守轨道动力学和耗散旋近，产生相对于Schwarzschild波形的累积相位偏移。对于LISA一年观测、信噪比为20的代表性源，噪声加权失配分析表明|ε|≳2×10^-6的Finslerian波形可与Schwarzschild对应波形区分，且更高初始偏心率会进一步降低可区分阈值。对Schwarzschild注入，Fisher矩阵分析给出边缘化1σ不确定度σ_ε≃1.26×10^-6。结果表明空间引力波探测器有潜力探测Schwarzschild时空的轴对称Finslerian扩展。

papers.title: Spacetime Evolution Induced by a Massive Cosmic String in Numerical Relativity
papers.abstract: Cosmic strings are one-dimensional topological defects formed during phase transitions in the early universe. ''Massive'' cosmic strings possess a sufficiently large tension to close their transverse space, forming a conical singularity outside the string, as a static gravitational effect. In a dynamical context, such strings are expected to drive topological inflation. In this work, we investigate the spacetime evolution induced by the formation of a massive cosmic string in a radiation-dominated cosmological background, imposing cylindrical symmetry. Using full numerical relativity simulations, we observe that the string core undergoes topological inflation and that its boundary moves inwards superluminally, which causally disconnects the core from the outer universe. Between the core and the asymptotic regions, a nearly matter-dominated decelerating region originates sourced by the oscillating string fields. This region is bounded by a local maximum (''belly'') and local minimum (''throat'') of the circumferential radius, while the throat recedes outwards at about 10% the speed of light. Furthermore, a gravitational wavefront is emitted from the string, characterizing the light cone of the string formation. Even behind the wavefront, the exterior region no longer exhibits a ''conical'' structure. Based on the simulation results, we construct a Penrose diagram, reflecting the causal structure of the entire spacetime.

classification.title_zh: 数值相对论中由大质量宇宙弦诱导的时空演化
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在辐射主导的宇宙学背景中，采用柱对称假设和完整数值相对论模拟，研究大质量宇宙弦形成所诱导的时空演化。模拟显示弦核发生拓扑暴胀，其边界向内超光速运动，从而在因果上与外部宇宙断开；在弦核与渐近区域之间，由振荡弦场 sourced 出一个近物质主导的减速区域，该区域由周向半径的局部极大（“belly”）和局部极小（“throat”）界定，且喉部以约 10% 光速向外退行。弦还发出引力波前，刻画弦形成的光锥；即使在波前之后，外部区域也不再呈现“锥形”结构。作者基于模拟结果构造了反映整个时空因果结构的 Penrose 图。

papers.title: Geodesic completeness and photon propagation in a superconducting T-duality black hole
papers.abstract: The purpose of this article is twofold. First, we study the geodesic completeness of the string T-duality black hole with the Raychaudhuri equation, for radial massive particles of arbitrary specific energy $\varepsilon$. Exact proper-time quadratures reveal three classes of observers: supercritical observers reach the regular centre in finite proper time through a caustic and pass through it, critical observers ($\varepsilon=1$) approach it only asymptotically with finite expansion, and subcritical observers are reflected at a fold caustic. Because the lapse is analytic and even in $r$, geodesics continue regularly through the centre, and all three classes are complete on the stipulated maximal extension. A diverging expansion therefore signals a caustic of the congruence rather than an endpoint of the geodesics, in contrast with Schwarzschild spacetime. Second, radial Maxwell rays are likewise complete but form a single class, since a massless ray carries no energy scale. We propose to model the black-hole core itself as a superconductor, with London response $\mu^2=4\pi\kappa\rho$ attributed to the existing source. A symmetry-breaking potential with a vacuum-energy offset reproduces the de Sitter core and its photon mass exactly at the centre and approximately in the inner core; since no static scalar theory reproduces the anisotropic source further out, the full radial response remains phenomenological. The resulting Hamiltonian rays follow timelike geodesics of $\mu^2g_{\mu\nu}$ up to reparametrisation and reproduce the three classes, separated by the central mass $\mu_0$, while the density gradient of the core adds a defocusing contribution near the centre. We also distinguish Hamiltonian completeness from completeness of the conformal metric.

classification.title_zh: 超导T-对偶黑洞中的测地线完备性与光子传播
classification.abstract_zh: 本文有两个目的。首先，我们用Raychaudhuri方程研究弦T-对偶黑洞的测地线完备性，针对任意比能ε的径向有质量粒子。精确固有时求积显示三类观测者：超临界观测者经焦散面在有限固有时到达正则中心并穿过；临界观测者（ε=1）仅渐近接近中心，具有有限膨胀；亚临界观测者在折焦散面处被反射。由于lapse解析且关于r为偶函数，测地线可规则穿过中心，三类在规定最大延拓上均完备。因此发散膨胀标志同余的焦散而非测地线终点，与Schwarzschild时空相反。其次，径向Maxwell光线同样完备但只形成一类，因为无质量光线不携带能标。我们提出将黑洞核心本身建模为超导体，London响应μ^2=4πκρ归因于已有源。带真空能偏移的对称破缺势在中心精确再现de Sitter核心及其光子质量，并在内核心近似再现；由于没有静态标量理论能在更外侧再现各向异性源，完整径向响应仍是现象学的。所得Hamiltonian光线在重参数化意义下沿μ^2g_{\mu\nu}的类时测地线，并再现三类，由中心质量μ0分隔，而核心的密度梯度在中心附近增加散焦贡献。我们还区分Hamiltonian完备性与共形度量的完备性。
classification.one_liner: 研究T-对偶超导黑洞的径向测地线与Maxwell光线完备性，并将黑洞核心建模为超导体。

papers.title: Black hole quasinormal mode excitation and mixing for coupled fields
papers.abstract: The idea of testing the nature of black holes and possible deviations from general relativity from their oscillation spectrum, known as ``black hole spectroscopy'', has become an experimental science. In many modified theories of gravity, the gravitational perturbations couple to additional degrees of freedom, leading to mode mixing and to a more complex ringdown signal. We adopt the parametrized quasinormal mode formalism for nonrotating black holes to study coupled perturbations in modified gravity theories in order to understand how the interaction with additional fields affects the quasinormal mode frequencies and their amplitudes. We compute the quasinormal mode spectrum of the coupled system in the frequency domain using direct integration and a matrix-valued continued-fraction method. We then compare the results with time-domain evolutions, where we extract the mode frequencies and amplitudes using the Prony method as well as least-squares fitting. In the weak-coupling regime, the scaling of the amplitudes associated with the gravitational-led and secondary-led modes can be understood perturbatively. The excitation of additional families of ringdown modes can become significant even when the frequency shifts remain moderate. We use our numerical time evolutions to provide ready-to-use coefficients for the mode amplitudes for representative initial data configurations. We work out specific examples, including dynamical Chern-Simons gravity and the special near-resonant case of coupled perturbations between the polar and axial quasinormal modes. Our theory-agnostic characterization of coupled systems should be useful to quantify systematic effects in black hole spectroscopy with next-generation gravitational-wave detectors.

classification.title_zh: 耦合场中黑洞准正规模式的激发与混合
classification.abstract_zh: 利用黑洞振荡谱检验黑洞本质及可能偏离广义相对论的思想，即“黑洞光谱学”，已成为一门实验科学。在许多修改引力理论中，引力扰动会与额外自由度耦合，导致模式混合并产生更复杂的铃宕信号。我们采用非旋转黑洞的参数化准正规模式形式，研究修改引力理论中的耦合扰动，以理解与额外场的相互作用如何影响准正规模式的频率及其振幅。我们在频域中使用直接积分和矩阵值连分式方法计算耦合系统的准正规模式谱，然后将结果与时域演化比较，其中使用 Prony 方法和最小二乘拟合提取模式频率和振幅。在弱耦合区域，引力主导和次级主导模式的振幅标度可以通过微扰论理解。即使频率移动保持中等，额外铃宕模式家族的激发也可能变得显著。我们利用数值时间演化，为代表性初始数据构型提供可直接使用的模式振幅系数。我们给出了具体例子，包括动力学 Chern-Simons 引力，以及极向与轴向准正规模式之间耦合扰动的特殊近共振情形。我们对耦合系统的理论无关刻画，应有助于量化下一代引力波探测器进行黑洞光谱学时的系统效应。
classification.one_liner: 研究修改引力中耦合扰动导致的准正规模式混合与振幅激发，为黑洞光谱学提供理论模板。

papers.title: Non-Stationary Wormholes and Matter Source Reconstruction in General Relativity
papers.abstract: We investigate non-stationary wormhole geometries in General Relativity embedded in evolving cosmological backgrounds. We employ a Simpson-Visser-like regularization of the temporal coordinate of the $(n+1)$-dimensional FLRW metric, together with a homogeneous Cuscuton field, to construct cosmological backgrounds in which the scale factor remains finite and non-zero at the would-be initial singularity. We then consider two specific dynamical wormhole geometries: the four-dimensional defect wormhole and the topologically charged Perry-Mann type wormhole. We show that the former can be supported by a canonical scalar field with vanishing potential, while the latter requires a mimetic matter sector to support its spatial structure, with the Cuscuton governing the cosmological evolution in both cases. We subsequently generalize the analysis to a separable non-stationary spacetime and derive a scaling condition that strongly constrains the admissible matter sources. In particular, for minimally coupled scalar and nonlinear electrodynamics fields, this condition removes the functional freedom available in static reconstruction schemes. We show that, within this framework, regular, asymptotically flat wormhole geometries cannot be obtained while simultaneously satisfying the required smoothness and reflection symmetry conditions. Our results illustrate both the possibility of constructing specific non-stationary wormholes in regular cosmological backgrounds and the restrictions that arise when attempting to generalize such constructions to arbitrary spatial geometries.

classification.title_zh: 广义相对论中的非定常虫洞与物质源重构
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究嵌入演化宇宙学背景中的广义相对论非定常虫洞几何。我们采用类似 Simpson-Visser 的方法对 (n+1) 维 FLRW 度规的时间坐标进行正则化，并结合均匀 Cuscuton 场，构造标度因子在原本初始奇点处保持有限且非零的宇宙学背景。随后考虑两种具体的动力学虫洞几何：四维缺陷虫洞和拓扑荷 Perry-Mann 型虫洞。我们表明，前者可由势为零的正则标量场支撑，而后者需要 mimetic 物质部门来支撑其空间结构，两种情形下均由 Cuscuton 控制宇宙学演化。我们进一步将分析推广到可分离的非定常时空，并导出强烈约束可容许物质源的标度条件。特别是，对于最小耦合标量场和非线性电动力学场，该条件消除了静态重构方案中存在的函数自由度。我们表明，在此框架内，无法在同时满足所需光滑性和反射对称性条件的情况下获得正则、渐近平坦的虫洞几何。我们的结果既说明了在正则宇宙学背景中构造特定非定常虫洞的可能性，也说明了将此类构造推广到任意空间几何时出现的限制。
classification.one_liner: 该文在广义相对论中构造非定常虫洞并分析其物质源重构条件与限制。

papers.title: Cycles Without End: An Ekpyrotic Braneworld Bounce with a Kinetically Coupled Entropic Mechanism
papers.abstract: Cyclic cosmologies replace inflation's single creation event with an eternal sequence of smooth turnarounds, but three problems have historically stood in their way: singular bounces, the blue tilt generic to single-field ekpyrotic contraction, and Tolman's observation that entropy production should make successive cycles longer and larger without bound. We resolve all three within one explicit model. A Randall-Sundrum brane with a timelike extra dimension regularizes the bounce without violating the null energy condition, and a single scalar field's potential carries the universe from a thawing dark-energy plateau through a sign-changing turnaround into a BKL-safe ekpyrotic contraction and back. We show that no correction internal to the brane's Friedmann equation, and no straight two-field trajectory, can rescue the spectral index from the generic ekpyrotic result $n_s\approx3$. We then build the minimal completion that can: a kinetically coupled entropy field, following the general mechanism of Ijjas, Lehners, and Steinhardt, whose coupling steepness has a closed-form, exact-scale-invariance value for this model's ekpyrotic potential, with only a percent-level offset needed to match the measured tilt $n_s=0.9649$. This fixes the local non-Gaussianity ($f_{\rm NL}\approx-0.02$) and tensor-to-scalar ratio ($r\approx7.6\times10^{-26}$). Matching the observed amplitude fixes the conversion coupling and brane tension to unremarkable values ($\lambda\approx5.7\times10^{-3}$, $\rho_c^{1/4}=10^{13}\,$GeV). Finally, because the brane construction is spatially flat, Tolman's entropy argument does not bound the number of cycles here: we derive $N_{\rm DE}\sim70$-80 e-folds of accelerated expansion needed each cycle to dilute the entropy produced back to a negligible density before the next contraction.

classification.title_zh: 无终之循环：具有动力学耦合熵机制的 ekpyrotic 膜世界反弹
classification.abstract_zh: 循环宇宙学用永恒平滑的 turnaround 序列取代暴胀的单次创生事件，但历史上三大障碍一直阻碍其发展：奇异反弹、单场 ekpyrotic 收缩普遍具有的蓝 tilt，以及 Tolman 指出熵产生应使后续循环无限变长变大。我们在一个显式模型中解决这三者。一个具有类时额外维的 Randall-Sundrum 膜在不违反零能量条件的情况下正则化反弹，单个标量场的势把宇宙从 thawing 暗能量平台经过变号 turnaround 带入 BKL-safe 的 ekpyrotic 收缩并返回。我们证明，膜 Friedmann 方程内部的修正以及直线双场轨迹，都无法使谱指数摆脱普遍 ekpyrotic 结果 n_s≈3。随后我们构建能够做到这一点的最小完成：一个动力学耦合的熵场，遵循 Ijjas、Lehners 和 Steinhardt 的一般机制；其耦合陡度对该模型的 ekpyrotic 势具有闭式的精确标度不变值，只需百分级偏移即可匹配测得 tilt n_s=0.9649。这固定了局域非高斯性 f_NL≈-0.02 和张量标量比 r≈7.6×10^-26。匹配观测幅度把转化耦合和膜张力固定为不显眼的值 λ≈5.7×10^-3、ρ_c^{1/4}=10^13 GeV。最后，由于膜构造是空间平坦的，Tolman 的熵论证在这里不限制循环数目：我们推导出每个循环需要 N_DE∼70-80 个 e-folds 的加速膨胀，以在下次收缩前把产生的熵稀释回可忽略密度。
classification.one_liner: 提出一个 Randall-Sundrum 膜世界 ekpyrotic 循环模型，用类时额外维实现非奇异反弹，并用动力学耦合熵场把谱指数修至观测值。

papers.title: Gravitational waves from super-Hubble bubbles
papers.abstract: We consider a cosmological first-order phase transition in which bubbles of true vacuum nucleate during inflation but do not collide and percolate until the Universe has entered the radiation-dominated era. If the collisions take place soon after the end of inflation, the size of these bubbles can be significantly greater than the Hubble length. This has two important consequences for the gravitational waves produced by the bubble collisions: First, as the peak frequency is determined by the comoving bubble radius, it can be well below the MHz frequencies typical for bubble collisions at the end of inflation. Second, when comparing collisions beginning at the same time, the amplitude of the gravitational waves is greatly enhanced relative to Hubble-sized and smaller bubbles. Together, these two effects mean that gravitational waves produced by super-Hubble bubbles soon after the end of inflation can be within the observable frequency and amplitude ranges of LIGO and NANOGrav, as well as LISA and other future gravitational wave experiments. We demonstrate this with a simple illustrative model.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 超视界气泡产生的引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 本文考虑宇宙学一阶相变：真空气泡在暴胀期间成核，但直到宇宙进入辐射主导时期才碰撞并渗流。若碰撞发生在暴胀结束后不久，气泡尺度可远大于哈勃长度。这对气泡碰撞产生的引力波有两个重要影响：峰值频率由共动气泡半径决定，可远低于暴胀结束时碰撞典型的 MHz 频率；在相同碰撞开始时间下，相比哈勃尺度及更小气泡，引力波振幅显著增强。因此，超哈勃气泡在暴胀结束后不久产生的引力波可落入 LIGO、NANOGrav、LISA 及未来引力波实验的可观测频率和振幅范围；作者用简单示意模型展示了这一点。
classification.one_liner: 暴胀期间成核的超视界真空气泡在暴胀后碰撞可产生增强且低频的引力波，可能落入 LIGO/NANOGrav/LISA 观测范围。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究宇宙学一阶相变气泡成核/碰撞产生的引力波，匹配重点标签“相变与气泡成核”，并涉及经典引力波观测；但不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: Odd-parity ringdown gravitational waves of a spherically symmetric black hole with perfect fluid accretion
papers.abstract: The ringdown waves from a black hole offer a clean probe of strong-field gravity, but a matter distribution that may be present around a realistic black hole renders the background spacetime dynamical and the ringdown frequencies time-dependent. We study the odd-parity ringdown of a Schwarzschild black hole that grows through the dilute, steady, spherically symmetric accretion of a perfect fluid. Working to first order in the accretion rate, we compute the ringdown waveform directly in the time domain on this dynamical background. Since the odd-parity matter perturbation decouples from the metric perturbation, the wave mode can be described by a purely tensorial mode on the accreting background. In particular, the ratio of the imaginary to the real part of the frequency cancels both the secular variation caused by the growth of the black hole and the redshift factor, so that its deviation from the Schwarzschild value purely reflects the surrounding environment. The time dependence of the frequency, on the other hand, reflects the accretion rate and allows us to define a second observable tied to it. We argue that measuring these observables across multiple modes may provide significant information to constrain the surrounding environment of the black hole.

classification.title_zh: 具有完美流体吸积的球对称黑洞的奇宇称铃宕引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞铃宕波是强场引力的干净探针，但真实黑洞周围可能存在的物质分布会使背景时空动力学化，并使铃宕频率随时间变化。我们研究一个通过稀薄、稳态、球对称完美流体吸积而增长的 Schwarzschild 黑洞的奇宇称铃宕。在吸积率一阶近似下，我们在该动力学背景上直接于时域计算铃宕波形。由于奇宇称物质扰动与度规扰动解耦，波模可由吸积背景上的纯张量模描述。特别地，频率虚部与实部之比同时消去黑洞增长引起的长期变化和红移因子，因此其相对 Schwarzschild 值的偏离纯粹反映周围环境。频率的时间依赖则反映吸积率，并允许定义与之相关的第二个观测量。我们认为跨多个模式测量这些观测量可为限制黑洞周围环境提供重要信息。
classification.one_liner: 在完美流体吸积的动态 Schwarzschild 背景上计算奇宇称铃宕，并提出对环境与吸积率敏感的可观测量。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典广义相对论与黑洞铃宕/QNM 研究，直接契合“经典引力/广义相对论”和“QNM与非线性演化”重点；但不涉及全息、超流超导、探针膜或相变成核等全息支线。

papers.title: Perturbative dynamics and relativistic effects of a dyonic Kalb-Ramond black hole
papers.abstract: We investigate perturbative dynamics, tidal effects, and relativistic frequency shifts in a dyonic Kalb-Ramond black hole generated by a Lorentz-violating antisymmetric tensor background. The geometry is controlled by the mass $M$, the electric charge $Q$, the magnetic charge $p$, and the Lorentz-violating parameter $\ell$, with the dyonic sector entering through the effective combination $P_{\ell}^{2}=Q^{2}/(1-\ell)^{2}+p^{2}/(1-2\ell)$. First, we analyze the gravitational Doppler effect for radial signal exchange between freely falling and static observers, showing how the dyonic charges weaken the redshift by shifting the frequency ratio toward unity. We then compute the radial and angular tidal forces in a freely falling frame and determine the characteristic radii at which the usual stretching and compression patterns are reversed. The gravitational time delay is also evaluated for null trajectories, showing that the electric and magnetic sectors reduce the delay relative to the reference configuration. In the perturbative sector, we study massless scalar, vector, and spinor test fields together with an effective axial metric model, computing sixth-order WKB spectra and independently checking selected modes using the asymptotic iteration method. At fixed mass and charges, increasing the Lorentz-violating parameter raises the tabulated oscillation frequencies and damping rates in the original time coordinate; their interpretation accounts for time normalization and changes in effective parameters. The independent comparisons support the tested higher-multipole fundamental modes. Time-domain evolutions exhibit damped ringdown followed by power-law tails, whose exponents are estimated through fits incorporating finite time corrections and numerical sensitivity checks.

classification.title_zh: 双荷 Kalb-Ramond 黑洞的微扰动力学与相对论效应
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究由 Lorentz 破坏反对称张量背景产生的双荷 Kalb-Ramond 黑洞的微扰动力学、潮汐效应和相对论频移。几何由质量 M、电荷 Q、磁荷 p 和 Lorentz 破坏参数 ℓ 控制，双荷部分通过有效组合 P_ℓ^2=Q^2/(1-ℓ)^2+p^2/(1-2ℓ) 进入。首先分析自由下落与静态观测者之间径向信号交换的引力多普勒效应，显示双荷使红移减弱、频率比趋近于 1。随后在自由下落系中计算径向和角向潮汐力，并确定拉伸与压缩模式反转的特征半径。对零测地线还计算了引力时间延迟，表明电磁扇区相对于参考构型减小延迟。在微扰部分，研究无质量标量、矢量、旋量试探场以及一个有效轴度量模型，计算六阶 WKB 谱，并用渐近迭代法独立校验部分模式。在固定质量和电荷下，增大 Lorentz 破坏参数会提高原时间坐标中列出的振荡频率和阻尼率；其解释考虑了时间归一化和有效参数变化。独立比较支持所检验的高多极基本模式。时间域演化显示阻尼铃宕后接幂律尾，其指数通过包含有限时间修正和数值敏感性检查的拟合估计。
classification.one_liner: 研究 Lorentz 破坏双荷 Kalb-Ramond 黑洞的引力频移、潮汐力、时间延迟以及 QNM 铃宕和幂律尾。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典黑洞时空中的微扰、QNM、潮汐与频移，属于经典引力/广义相对论及 QNM 支线；但不涉及全息或 AdS/CFT。

papers.title: Photon propagation and black hole imaging in Kruglov nonlinear electrodynamics
papers.abstract: Nonlinear electrodynamics (NLED) modifies photon propagation through an effective optical geometry, allowing optical phenomena to deviate from those predicted solely by the underlying spacetime metric. In this work, we revisit the Kruglov model, which generalizes Born--Infeld electrodynamics, and investigate the corresponding null geodesics in theeffective geometry through direct numerical integration, without relying on strong-field analytical approximations. We analyze the resulting photon spheres, gravitational lensing, black-hole shadows, and thin accretion-disk images, together with their dependence on the parameter $q$. For sufficiently small positive $q$, the effective angular metric develops a pole that generates stable photon orbits outside the event horizon and locally reverses the azimuthal evolution of photon trajectories, producing a distinctive bending pattern that resembles, although does not originate from, frame dragging. Conversely, negative $q$ introduces a zero of the effective correction factor, which acts as a turning point for photon trajectories and prevents them from entering the region where the background metric becomes complex. It produces measurable changes in light deflection, shadow radius, photon-ring morphology, and relativistic images. In particular, smaller positive values of $q$ produce thinner photon rings and enlarged shadow radii, whereas negative values generally lead to broader photon rings and smaller shadows. Comparison with the current Event Horizon Telescope constraints on Sgr~A* shows that a substantial region of the Kruglov parameter space remains compatible with present observations.

classification.title_zh: Kruglov 非线性电动力学中的光子传播与黑洞成像
classification.abstract_zh: 非线性电动力学（NLED）通过有效光学几何修改光子传播，使光学现象偏离仅由背景时空度规预言的結果。本文重新审视推广 Born–Infeld 电动力学的 Kruglov 模型，并通过直接数值积分研究有效几何中的零测地线，而不依赖强场解析近似。我们分析由此产生的光子球、引力透镜、黑洞阴影和薄吸积盘图像，以及它们对参数 q 的依赖。对于足够小的正 q，有效角向度规出现极点，在事件视界外产生稳定光子轨道，并局部反转光子轨迹的方位角演化，形成类似但不源于参考系拖曳的独特弯曲模式。相反，负 q 引入有效修正因子的零点，作为光子轨迹的转向点，阻止光子进入背景度规变为复数的区域。它会在光线偏折、阴影半径、光子环形态和相对论像中产生可测量变化。特别是，较小的正 q 产生更薄的光子环和更大的阴影半径，而负 q 通常导致更宽的光子环和更小的阴影。与当前事件视界望远镜对 Sgr A* 的约束比较表明，Kruglov 参数空间的相当一部分仍与现有观测相容。
classification.one_liner: 数值研究 Kruglov 非线性电动力学有效几何中的零测地线，分析光子球、透镜、黑洞阴影与吸积盘成像对参数 q 的依赖。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力与黑洞成像方向，使用非线性电动力学有效几何研究光子传播和阴影，不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息；与用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论支线相关。

papers.title: Universality of Primordial Anisotropies in Gravitational Wave Background
papers.abstract: We investigate the general structure of primordial anisotropies in the stochastic gravitational-wave background (SGWB). Many mechanisms generating primordial SGWB anisotropies, including fossil and propagation effects, exhibit similar multipole dependences despite their distinct physical origins, implying the presence of a common underlying structure. To characterize this structure, we introduce a model-independent framework, the Cosmological Form Factor (CFF), that describes how long-wavelength perturbations modulate short-scale SGWB statistics. Within this broad class of mechanisms, we show that the allowed angular and polarization structures of SGWB anisotropies are universally determined by general principles, including statistical isotropy, locality, and the basic properties of long-wavelength perturbations. In contrast to these universal structures, observables such as amplitudes and frequency dependence retain information about the origin. Our results provide a unified and effective description of primordial SGWB anisotropies, clarifying which aspects are universal and which are model dependent, and therefore offer a theoretical foundation for interpreting future gravitational-wave observations.

classification.title_zh: 引力波背景中原始各向异性的普适性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究随机引力波背景（SGWB）中原始各向异性的一般结构。许多产生原始SGWB各向异性的机制，包括化石效应和传播效应，尽管物理起源不同，却表现出相似的多极依赖，暗示存在共同的底层结构。为刻画这一结构，我们引入一个模型无关的框架——宇宙学形状因子（CFF），用于描述长波扰动如何调制短尺度SGWB统计。在这大类机制中，我们证明SGWB各向异性允许的角度和偏振结构由统计各向同性、局域性以及长波扰动的基本性质等一般原理普适地决定。与这些普适结构相对，振幅和频率依赖等观测量保留了关于起源的信息。我们的结果为原始SGWB各向异性提供了统一且有效的描述，阐明了哪些方面是普适的、哪些是模型依赖的，从而为解释未来引力波观测提供了理论基础。
classification.one_liner: 提出模型无关的宇宙学形状因子框架，揭示原始随机引力波背景各向异性的角度与偏振结构具有普适性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/引力波与宇宙学方向，与“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签有一般关联；但不涉及全息、纠缠、黑洞信息或其他全息重点支线，因此相关性为中等。

papers.title: New analytic Janus and $S^4$ solutions for $\mathcal{N}=2^*$
papers.abstract: We construct a three-parameter family of regular analytic supergravity solutions which are dual to (a) the $\mathcal{N}=2^*$ gauge theory on the four-sphere, and (b) $\mathrm{U}(1)^2$-invariant Janus interfaces in $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM with or without the $\mathcal{N}=2^*$ mass turned on. To this end we employ a five-dimensional supergravity model coupled to six scalars which arises as a certain consistent truncation of type IIB supergravity on $S^5$. The curved domain wall solutions feature a hidden integral of motion which allows for their analytic treatment. We relate the three parameters of the solution to field theory sources and vevs and show how regularity of the solutions restricts their range. We briefly discuss the holographic evaluation of the one-point function of the field theory Lagrangian for our family of Janus solutions.

secondary_topics: 非均匀态/孤子/涡旋/畴壁
classification.title_zh: N=2* 的新解析 Janus 与 S^4 解
classification.abstract_zh: 我们构造了一个三参数族的正则解析超引力解，它们对偶于 (a) 四球面上的 N=2* 规范理论，以及 (b) N=4 SYM 中具有或没有打开 N=2* 质量的 U(1)^2 不变 Janus 界面。为此，我们采用一个五维超引力模型耦合六个标量，该模型来自 IIB 型超引力在 S^5 上的某个一致截断。这些弯曲畴壁解具有隐藏的运动积分，从而允许解析处理。我们将解的三个参数与场论源和 vev 联系起来，并展示解的正则性如何限制其范围。我们简要讨论针对我们这族 Janus 解，对场论拉格朗日量一点函数的全息计算。
classification.one_liner: 在五维超引力中构造三参数解析 Janus 与 S^4 解，并联系对偶场论源/vev 与全息一点函数。
