papers.title: On the quantum statistical relation and the covariant phase space Hamiltonian
papers.abstract: We show how the covariant phase space Hamiltonian can be constructed in theories in which some of the fields have gauge freedoms. The addition to the action of boundary terms that guarantee the well-posedness of a variational principle and its exact gauge invariance for the prescribed boundary conditions turn out to be essential in this construction. The same ingredients are essential in the use of the action in the framework of Gibbons and Hawking's Euclidean approach to Quantum Gravity and we show how the on-shell action constructed with a Lagrangian with those properties can be expressed in terms of the covariant phase space Hamiltonian. We compute the Hamiltonian of several theories, one of which has Chern--Simons terms, using our prescription and show that, in black-hole backgrounds, the Hamiltonian gives directly the quantum statistical relation including terms related to non-gravitational charges and chemical potentials, as expected.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 论量子统计关系与协变相空间哈密顿量
classification.abstract_zh: 我们展示如何在部分场具有规范自由度的理论中构造协变相空间哈密顿量。为保证变分原理适定以及给定边界条件下作用量的精确规范不变性而加入作用量的边界项，在该构造中至关重要。这些相同要素对于在Gibbons和Hawking的欧几里得量子引力方法框架中使用作用量也至关重要；我们展示，用具有这些性质的拉格朗日量构造的在壳作用量可以表示为协变相空间哈密顿量。我们使用该方案计算了若干理论的哈密顿量，其中一个具有Chern-Simons项，并证明在黑洞背景下，该哈密顿量直接给出量子统计关系，包括与非引力荷和化学势相关的项，符合预期。
classification.one_liner: 构建带规范自由度的协变相空间哈密顿量，并证明在黑洞背景下可直接给出含非引力荷与化学势的量子统计关系。

papers.title: Deterministic Hypergraph SYK: Melonic Dominance and Maximal Chaos Without Disorder Averaging
papers.abstract: We show that the leading melonic structure of the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model can be realized by a single sparse Majorana Hamiltonian, without disorder averaging. In our deterministic hypergraph SYK model (hSYK), $N$ Majorana fermions interact through $O(dN)$ terms with uniform couplings, arranged on a fixed $q$-uniform, $d$-regular hypergraph. If the hypergraph is linear, has few short cycles, and is a spectral expander, then at large $d$ the two-point function obeys the melonic Schwinger-Dyson equation site by site. The leading thermodynamics are therefore those of SYK, and at leading order in $1/d$ every bilocal fluctuation other than the Schwarzian is gapped. The four-point ladder splits into scrambling modes labeled by eigenvalues of the site adjacency operator. At strong coupling, the uniform mode is maximally chaotic, and a non-uniform mode grows only if its eigenvalue exceeds $1/(q-1)$. Exact diagonalization of single instances with $N\le24$ agrees with the melonic two-point function and thermodynamics more closely than dense SYK of the same size, shows Wigner-Dyson level statistics, and reproduces the predicted mode structure of out-of-time-order correlators. Numerically, random linear hypergraphs typically satisfy these conditions, and for $d>q$ also avoid emergent symmetries. The model is a natural candidate for quantum simulation.

classification.title_zh: 确定性超图 SYK：无需无序平均的 melonic 主导与最大混沌
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明，Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) 模型的主导 melonic 结构可由单个稀疏 Majorana 哈密顿量实现，而无需无序平均。在我们的确定性超图 SYK 模型 (hSYK) 中，N 个 Majorana 费米子通过 O(dN) 个具有均匀耦合的项相互作用，这些项排列在一个固定的 q-均匀、d-正则超图上。若该超图是线性的、短圈很少且为谱扩展子，则在大 d 下，两点函数逐点满足 melonic Schwinger-Dyson 方程。因此主导热力学与 SYK 相同，并且在 1/d 领头阶，除 Schwarzian 外的所有双局域涨落都有能隙。四点梯形图分解为以格点邻接算符本征值标记的 scrambling 模式。在强耦合下，均匀模式具有最大混沌性，而非均匀模式仅当其本征值超过 1/(q-1) 时才增长。对 N≤24 的单实例进行精确对角化，与 melonic 两点函数和热力学的符合程度高于同尺寸的稠密 SYK，显示 Wigner-Dyson 能级统计，并重现了 out-of-time-order 关联函数所预言的模式结构。数值上，随机线性超图通常满足这些条件，且当 d>q 时还能避免涌现对称性。该模型是量子模拟的自然候选。
classification.one_liner: 提出确定性超图 SYK：单一稀疏 Majorana 哈密顿量在无需无序平均下实现 melonic 主导、SYK 热力学与最大混沌。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于 SYK/JT 全息与量子混沌方向，但未直接涉及用户列出的全息超导、p波、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM 或探针膜等重点支线。

papers.title: Freezing Swampland: A Krylov Complexity Diagnostic for the Weak Gravity Conjecture
papers.abstract: We propose a quantum-information-theoretic perspective on the Weak Gravity Conjecture through the behavior of Krylov spread complexity. For a charged thermofield double state holographically dual to an AdS Reissner--Nordstr\"om black hole, we show that the extremal limit on the black-hole side is accompanied by an effective freezing of Krylov spreading. In this regime, the return amplitude becomes effectively a pure phase, and the corresponding Krylov spread is suppressed. We then incorporate charged matter and study the effect of Schwinger pair production in the near-horizon region. Within this semiclassical near-extremal analysis, the frozen behavior is lifted once an allowed discharge channel is opened, and the dynamics become nontrivial again. This suggests a possible complexity-based diagnostic of a characteristic physical consequence of the Weak Gravity Conjecture: the availability of a superextremal charged state that can mediate discharge. More broadly, our results point to a connection between the swampland program, black-hole physics, and quantum information theory.

classification.title_zh: 冻结沼泽：弱引力猜想的Krylov复杂度诊断
classification.abstract_zh: 本文从量子信息角度，用Krylov展布复杂度研究弱引力猜想。对于全息对偶于AdS Reissner-Nordström黑洞的带电热场双态，作者指出黑洞侧的极端极限伴随Krylov展布的有效冻结：回归振幅变为纯相位，相应的Krylov展布被抑制。引入带电物质并考虑视界附近的Schwinger对产生后，一旦打开允许的放电通道，冻结行为被解除，动力学重新变得非平庸。作者据此提出，可用基于复杂度的诊断来刻画弱引力猜想的一个特征性物理后果：存在可介导放电的超极端带电态；并指出沼泽计划、黑洞物理与量子信息理论之间的联系。
classification.one_liner: 用Krylov展布复杂度在AdS带电黑洞与Schwinger放电中为弱引力猜想提供量子信息诊断。

papers.title: Gravitational form factors of the proton in the improved holographic QCD model
papers.abstract: We compute the gluonic contribution to the gravitational form factors of the proton using the improved holographic QCD model, in which the proton is described in terms of bulk Dirac fermions. Model parameters are constrained using lattice and phenomenological input, allowing us to obtain estimates for the gravitational form factors and to compare them with results from other approaches. Using the extracted form factors, we analyze mechanical properties of the proton, including pressure and shear distributions. We obtain estimates for the mechanical and mass radii of the proton, $\rho_{\text{mech}} \approx 0.63$ fm, $\rho_{\text{mass}} \approx 0.65$ fm, and compare these values with radius estimates from other nonperturbative studies.

classification.title_zh: 改进全息QCD模型中质子的引力形状因子
classification.abstract_zh: 我们使用改进的全息QCD模型计算质子引力形状因子的胶子贡献，其中质子在体时空中由Dirac费米子描述。模型参数由格点和现象学输入限制，从而给出引力形状因子的估计并与其他方法比较。利用提取的形状因子，我们分析质子的力学性质，包括压强和剪切分布，并估计质子力学半径约0.63 fm、质量半径约0.65 fm，与其他非微扰研究比较。
classification.one_liner: 用改进全息QCD与体Dirac费米子计算质子胶子引力形状因子并提取力学半径。

papers.title: Analytic approaches to anisotropic holographic superfluids in asymptotically hyperscaling violation geometry
papers.abstract: We explore anisotropic holographic superfluidity and find analytic solutions near critical point where superfluid/normalfluid phase transition appears in a holographic dual fluid system. In arXiv:hep-th/1109.4592, the authors obtained such an analytic solution in 5-dimensional Einstein-SU(2)Yang-Mills system, and it is asymptotically AdS$_5$. What is more in this note is that we get analytic solutions near the critical point in 3- and 4- dimensional Einstein-Scalar-U(1)$\times$SU(2)Yang-Mills systems, which become asymptotically hyperscaling violation geometry. We also get leading order back reactions to the background geometry, which clearly shows spatial anisotropy of the bulk geometry. To explore the properties of the spacetime, we compute holographic entanglement entropy and confirm that the superfluid/normalfluid phase transition must occur at the critical point.

classification.title_zh: 渐近超尺度破坏几何中各向异性全息超流体的解析方法
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究各向异性全息超流，并在全息对偶流体系统中超流/正常流体相变出现的临界点附近找到解析解。此前的工作在5维Einstein-SU(2) Yang-Mills系统中得到了此类解析解，且其背景渐近为AdS5。本文进一步在3维和4维Einstein-Scalar-U(1)×SU(2) Yang-Mills系统中得到临界点附近的解析解，其背景渐近为超尺度破坏几何。我们还得到对背景几何的首阶背反应，清楚显示了体几何的空间各向异性。为探究时空性质，我们计算全息纠缠熵，并确认超流/正常流体相变必须在临界点发生。

papers.title: Deconfinement Confined to the Heaviest Neutron Stars: Strange Quark Matter from a Flavor-Dressed Contact Interaction
papers.abstract: We study cold, electrically neutral, beta-equilibrated quark matter with u, d, and s quarks described by a symmetry-preserving contact interaction whose parameters are fixed in vacuum. The vector repulsion is varied as a fraction 0 < eta < 3/2 of the scalar coupling, and results are given with and without the flavor dressing of the effective coupling. Pure quark matter is not self-bound in this model, and no value of eta produces a star that reaches two solar masses while satisfying the tidal constraint from GW170817; the heaviest configurations owe their mass to an envelope of constituent quarks. We then construct hybrid stars with a relativistic mean-field hadronic phase fitted to GM1 saturation properties, using both Maxwell and Gibbs constructions and a deconfinement bag shift. Tying deconfinement to chiral restoration and requiring a continuous pressure yields an upper bound on this shift. Within that bound, quark matter appears inside stable stars only for eta < 1/2, never below about 4 n0, and only in stars between 2.2 and 2.35Msun, over a stable mass window of at most 0.02Msun. The vector strength that pure quark stars need to become massive prevents deconfinement in hybrid stars. Radii and tidal deformabilities of intermediate-mass stars are therefore set by the hadronic EoS alone; with the softer SLy4 EoS the transition moves to the maximum-mass configuration itself.

classification.title_zh: 去禁闭仅限于最重中子星：味修饰接触相互作用产生的奇异夸克物质
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究由 u、d、s 夸克描述的电中性、β平衡冷夸克物质，采用保持对称性的接触相互作用，其参数由真空确定。矢量排斥作为标量耦合的比例 0<η<3/2 变化，并给出有效耦合有无味修饰时的结果。纯夸克物质在该模型中不自束缚；没有 η 能使星体达到两倍太阳质量同时满足 GW170817 的潮汐约束；最重位形的质量来自组分夸克包层。随后我们用拟合 GM1 饱和性质的相对论平均场强子相构建混合星，采用 Maxwell 和 Gibbs 构造以及去禁闭袋移。将去禁闭与手征恢复相联系并要求压强连续，可给出该移的上界。在此界内，夸克物质仅在 η<1/2、密度不低于约 4n0、且星体质量在 2.2–2.35 Msun 时出现在稳定星内，稳定质量窗口至多 0.02 Msun。纯夸克星变重所需的矢量强度会阻止混合星中的去禁闭。因此中等质量星的半径和潮汐形变仅由强子 EoS 决定；使用较软的 SLy4 EoS 时，转变移到最大质量位形本身。

papers.title: Gravitational-wave lensing beyond the diffraction integral: proper-time methods and the bound lens
papers.abstract: Gravitational waves (GWs) can have wavelengths comparable to the Schwarzschild radius of their lenses, and detectors record their phase, so lensing requires wave optics. Its standard tool, the diffraction integral, follows from the particle path integral of a scalar wave on a static weak field, under the eikonal (one-way) and paraxial approximations, plus the thin-lens limit. We give a self-contained account of how the proper-time (worldline) representation overcomes these steps. An auxiliary proper time makes the wave equation exactly first order, with frequency as $1/\hbar$, so geometric optics and, for paraxial thin-lens paths, the diffraction integral follow from stationarity of an exact integral. For a point mass, the Duru-Kleinert (DK) gauge and Kustaanheimo-Stiefel map give the exact propagator; for a distant observer the DK time and fibre angle become the radius and azimuth of a lens plane, the result is the point-lens amplification factor with the offset set by the excess path, and geometric optics requires $w\gg1$ and $wy\gg1$. This agreement reflects the Coulomb potential, not the approximations: the exact eikonal condition, $\varepsilon_E\simeq\bar\lambda/d+GM/c^2d+\mathcal O(\sin^2\theta/2)$, fails near the lens and at large angles, and the one-way step is a non-relativistic limit. We then treat the bound lens, a GW source orbiting its lens, which emits a backscattered echo and moves during the lensing delays. Its exact time-domain signal gives each worldline its own retarded time and Doppler factor, so no single amplification factor describes it. In the diffraction regime the Shapiro phase alone misses all lensing beyond it, geometric optics misses 46-100% of it near conjunction at $w=0.3$, the paraxial geometry fails on the far side, and the static amplification factor along the orbit errs by $\approx(1-2)\,wM/R$ near conjunction and by the echo amplitude elsewhere.

classification.title_zh: 超越衍射积分的引力波透镜：固有时方法与束缚透镜
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波波长可与透镜的史瓦西半径相当，且探测器记录相位，因此透镜效应需要波光学描述。标准工具衍射积分来自静态弱场中标量波的粒子路径积分，并依赖程函（单向）、傍轴和薄透镜近似。本文自足地说明固有时（世界线）表示如何克服这些步骤：辅助固有时使波动方程精确成为一阶，频率作为 1/ħ，因此几何光学以及傍轴薄透镜路径下的衍射积分可由精确积分驻定性得到。对点质量，Duru-Kleinert 规范与 Kustaanheimo-Stiefel 映射给出精确传播子；对远处观测者，DK 时间与纤维角变为透镜平面的半径与方位角，结果给出点透镜放大因子，其偏移由超额路径设定，而几何光学要求 w≫1 与 wy≫1。这种一致反映的是库仑势而非近似：精确程函条件在透镜附近和大角度失效，单向步骤是非相对论极限。随后处理束缚透镜，即引力波源绕透镜运行，它发出背散射回声并在透镜延迟期间运动。其精确时域信号使每条世界线有自己的推迟时间与多普勒因子，因此没有单一放大因子能描述它。在衍射区，仅 Shapiro 相位会遗漏其后的全部透镜效应；在 w=0.3 的合附近，几何光学遗漏 46-100%；傍轴几何在远侧失效；沿轨道的静态放大因子在合附近误差约为 (1-2) wM/R，在其他地方误差为回声振幅。
classification.one_liner: 论文用固有时/世界线方法系统处理超越衍射积分的引力波波光学透镜，并分析源绕透镜运动的束缚透镜时域信号。

papers.title: Mixed-Order Parity-Violating Corrections to Rotating Black Holes in Combined Scalar Gauss-Bonnet and Dynamical Chern-Simons Gravity
papers.abstract: We construct the leading mixed-order $\mathcal{O}(\zeta_{\rm GB}\zeta_{\rm CS})$ deformation of rotating black holes in a combined scalar Gauss-Bonnet and dynamical Chern-Simons effective theory, the sector in which the parity-even and parity-odd corrections act simultaneously. Using a pseudospectral solution of the coupled mixed scalar and metric equations, we compute horizon and equatorial-geodesic observables--the horizon angular velocity, surface gravity, area, and Wald entropy; the innermost stable circular orbit and photon-ring radii; and photon-ring eikonal estimates of the ringdown--at fixed mass and angular momentum over the spin range $0.1\le a\le0.9$, where the solution is numerically convergent and the perturbative expansion is controlled for sufficiently small dimensionless couplings. We verify the exact Kerr and Schwarzschild limits, reproduce available pure-sector benchmarks, and quantify spectral, residual, and extraction uncertainties. The mixed solution satisfies every component of the field equations, including the one that is not imposed in its construction, and its Wald entropy satisfies the first law to about one part in $10^{5}$. The mixed coefficients exhibit spin dependence qualitatively distinct from the individual sectors within this EFT truncation. All four horizon quantities, and several orbital and eikonal ones, change sign as functions of spin. The ringdown results are leading photon-ring eikonal estimates; a full coupled finite-$\ell$ perturbation calculation is left to future work.

classification.title_zh: 联合标量 Gauss-Bonnet 与动力学 Chern-Simons 引力中旋转黑洞的混合阶宇称破坏修正
classification.abstract_zh: 我们构造了联合标量 Gauss-Bonnet 与动力学 Chern-Simons 有效理论中旋转黑洞的领头混合阶 O(ζ_GB ζ_CS) 形变，即宇称偶与宇称奇修正同时起作用的扇区。利用耦合混合标量与度规方程的伪谱解，我们在固定质量和角动量、自旋范围 0.1≤a≤0.9 内计算了视界与赤道测地线可观测量——视界角速度、表面引力、面积和 Wald 熵；最内稳定圆轨道与光子环半径；以及 ringdown 的光子环 eikonal 估计——在该范围内解数值收敛，且对于足够小的无量纲耦合微扰展开受控。我们验证了精确的 Kerr 与 Schwarzschild 极限，复现了可获得的纯扇区基准，并量化了谱、残差与提取不确定性。混合解满足场方程的每一个分量，包括构造中未施加的那个分量，其 Wald 熵满足第一定律到约 10^5 分之一。在该 EFT 截断内，混合系数表现出与各单独扇区定性不同的自旋依赖。四个视界量以及若干轨道和 eikonal 量随自旋改变符号。ringdown 结果是领头光子环 eikonal 估计；完整的耦合有限 ℓ 微扰计算留待未来工作。

papers.title: Particle dynamics in rotating charged Bumblebee black holes: An analytical correspondence with Kerr-Newman
papers.abstract: In this paper, we establish an analytical correspondence between the equatorial dynamics of spinless and spinning test particles in a slowly rotating charged Einstein--Bumblebee black hole spacetime and those in an effective Kerr--Newman spacetime. For spinning particles, the correspondence is established within the Mathisson--Papapetrou--Dixon framework under appropriate parameter matching. We show that corresponding circular orbits have identical radii and coordinate angular velocities, while their radial dynamics and local instability rates exhibit a Lorentz-violation-dependent scaling. Nevertheless, the correspondence does not imply complete dynamical equivalence, as orbital trajectories and radial perturbation growth over an azimuthal period generally differ. These results delineate the scope and limitations of the effective Kerr--Newman correspondence by distinguishing the dynamical properties preserved under parameter matching from those modified by the Lorentz-violating radial deformation.

classification.title_zh: 旋转带电Bumblebee黑洞中的粒子动力学：与Kerr-Newman的解析对应
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在缓慢旋转带电Einstein-Bumblebee黑洞时空中，建立无自旋与自旋测试粒子赤道动力学与有效Kerr-Newman时空之间的解析对应。对于自旋粒子，该对应在Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon框架下通过适当的参数匹配建立。作者表明，对应圆轨道具有相同的半径和坐标角速度，而其径向动力学与局部不稳定率表现出依赖Lorentz破坏的标度行为。尽管如此，该对应并不意味着完全动力学等价，因为轨道轨迹和每方位角周期的径向扰动增长通常不同。这些结果通过区分参数匹配下保持不变与受Lorentz破坏径向形变修改的动力学性质，界定了有效Kerr-Newman对应的适用范围与局限。

papers.title: Closed- and open-system characterization of the Yukawa-SYK model in real time
papers.abstract: Strongly correlated matter without quasiparticles is central to many-body physics, quantum chaos, and quantum gravity, motivating a considerable effort toward its realization in tabletop experiments. Two challenges remain: laboratory platforms are open systems, so conformal behavior must survive dissipation, and it must be identified through measurable quantities. We address both challenges in the Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (YSYK) model, in which bosons and fermions interact as in, e.g., light-matter systems, but through random all-to-all couplings that drive the boson to criticality without fine tuning. Solving the model in real time using the Schwinger-Keldysh formalism, we treat closed and open systems within a unified framework and, in both cases, consider a thermal steady state to map their phase diagrams. In addition to the known conformal and impurity (or SYK$_2$) regimes, we identify novel high-temperature regimes in which the fermions are driven by an essentially bare boson and show that their dynamics is captured by a quadratic model with time-dependent random hopping. Across all regimes, the fermionic softening of the boson is bounded by a ``criticality budget'' determined only by the Yukawa coupling and the temperature. Coupling the boson with a thermal environment induces a mass shift that deforms the boundaries between different regimes and exhausts the criticality budget, thus imposing a bound on temperature and dissipation rate compatible with self-tuned criticality. We further introduce a set of markers built from the two-point functions that separate all identified regimes, are accessible in linear response, and require no fit of the conformal exponents. We complement them with the quantum Fisher information, deriving upper bounds with and without dissipation. These results may help characterize holographic quantum matter beyond the closed setting.

classification.title_zh: Yukawa-SYK 模型的实时闭系统与开系统刻画
classification.abstract_zh: 无准粒子的强关联物质与多体物理、量子混沌和量子引力密切相关，并推动其在桌面实验中实现。该文研究 Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (YSYK) 模型，其中玻色子与费米子通过随机全连接耦合相互作用，使玻色子无需精细调节即可趋于临界。作者使用 Schwinger-Keldysh 形式在实时中求解模型，将闭系统和开系统纳入统一框架，并在两种情形下考虑热稳态以刻画相图。除已知的共形区和杂质 (SYK$_2$) 区外，他们识别出新的高温区：费米子由近似裸玻色子驱动，其动力学可由含时随机跃迁的二次模型描述。所有区域中，玻色子的费米子软化受仅由 Yukawa 耦合和温度决定的“临界性预算”限制。将玻色子与热环境耦合会诱导质量移动，改变区域边界并耗尽临界性预算，从而给出与自调节临界性相容的温度和耗散率上界。作者还引入由两点函数构造的标记，可区分所有识别出的区域、在线性响应中可及且无需拟合共形指数，并用量子 Fisher 信息给出有耗散和无耗散情形下的上界。

papers.title: Late-time echoes from planar wave-packet scattering by an ultracompact star
papers.abstract: We simulate the propagation and scattering of an incident plane scalar wave in the spacetime of an ultracompact, horizonless constant-density star using a time-domain multipole mode-sum method. By reconstructing the coherently superposed time-domain waveforms, we compare the star's dynamical response with that of a Schwarzschild black hole. We find that the early-time response closely mimics a black-hole ringdown due to wave scattering near the exterior unstable photon sphere. Conversely, the late-time signal develops a sequence of delayed echoes originating from wave trapping near the interior stable light ring and subsequent leakage through the exterior potential barrier. While individual multipoles exhibit regular echoes, their coherent superposition induces interference, producing complex waveforms with irregular profiles that nonetheless retain an underlying temporal organization with alternating peak separations. Finally, as a proof of concept, we perform a signal-to-noise ratio analysis using an assumed strain normalization, demonstrating that these weak, late-time signatures can be resolved by third-generation gravitational-wave detectors.

classification.title_zh: 超紧凑星对平面波包散射产生的晚期回声
classification.abstract_zh: 我们采用时域多极模求和方法，模拟入射平面标量波在超紧凑、无视界、常密度星时空中的传播与散射。通过重建相干叠加的时域波形，我们将该星的动力学响应与 Schwarzschild 黑洞进行比较。我们发现，由于波在外部不稳定光子球附近发生散射，早期响应与黑洞铃宕高度相似。相反，晚期信号发展出一系列延迟回声，这些回声源于波在内部稳定光环附近的捕获以及随后通过外部势垒的泄漏。虽然单个多极呈现规则回声，但其相干叠加会引起干涉，产生轮廓不规则的复杂波形，不过这些波形仍保留一种潜在的时间组织，即峰间隔交替变化。最后，作为概念验证，我们使用假定的应变归一化进行信噪比分析，表明这些微弱的晚期信号可以被第三代引力波探测器分辨。
classification.one_liner: 时域模拟表明，无视界超紧凑星在早期呈现黑洞式铃宕，晚期出现由内部稳定光环捕获并泄漏形成的延迟回声，并评估了其第三代引力波探测器可探测性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究超紧凑星的波散射、黑洞铃宕式早期响应与晚期引力波回声；不涉及全息对偶、量子信息或全息凝聚态等主题。

papers.title: Binary black hole mergers in massive Einstein-scalar-Gauss-Bonnet gravity
papers.abstract: We study fully non-linear binary black hole mergers in massive Einstein-scalar-Gauss-Bonnet (EsGB) gravity with a linear Gauss-Bonnet coupling function. In the absence of a well-developed initial data solver for EsGB gravity, we demonstrate that the conventional workaround solution for massless scalar fields results in confined junk radiation that contaminates late-time dynamics in the massive theory. We propose a solution to this problem by suitably modifying the equations of motion at the early stages of the simulation to tame such junk radiation, thereby allowing us to study the dynamics of the scalar field during the process of a black hole merger. This is followed by a preliminary analysis of the frequency content in the ringdown of the scalar and tensor modes. In particular, the quadrupole scalar mode exhibits a rich ringdown structure: while it is dominated by the spin-2 ``contamination'' frequency in the early stages, its late time morphology becomes primarily determined by the scalar mass frequency.

classification.title_zh: 大质量 Einstein-scalar-Gauss-Bonnet 引力中的双黑洞并合
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究具有线性 Gauss-Bonnet 耦合函数的大质量 Einstein-scalar-Gauss-Bonnet (EsGB) 引力中的全非线性双黑洞并合。由于 EsGB 引力尚无成熟的初值求解器，我们证明无质量标量场常用的变通方案会导致受困的 junk radiation，并在有质量理论中污染晚期动力学。我们提出通过适当修改模拟早期运动方程来抑制此类 junk radiation，从而能够研究黑洞并合过程中的标量场动力学。随后对标量和张量模式 ringdown 的频率内容进行初步分析。特别地，四极标量模式呈现丰富的 ringdown 结构：早期由自旋-2“污染”频率主导，晚期形态主要由标量质量频率决定。
classification.one_liner: 在 massive EsGB 引力中实现全非线性双黑洞并合模拟，并分析标量与张量 ringdown 的频率结构。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典引力/广义相对论中的双黑洞并合与 ringdown/QNM，符合“经典引力/广义相对论”和“QNM与非线性演化”重点标签；但不涉及全息对偶。

papers.title: Electrically charged black holes with electroweak hair
papers.abstract: We construct electrically charged black holes in Einstein's gravity coupled to the bosonic sector of the electroweak theory, focusing on static, spherically symmetric and asymptotically flat solutions, with the weak mixing angle fixed to its Standard Model value. Horizon regularity imposes a resonance condition relating the charged-vector frequency to the electromagnetic potential at the horizon, corresponding to the threshold of charged superradiance. A perturbative analysis further shows that nonextremal Reissner-Nordstr\"om black holes do not support regular, exponentially localized, spherically symmetric electroweak clouds satisfying such condition. Thus, the hairy solutions cannot emerge via a bifurcation from this electrovacuum family. Moreover, our numerical investigation reveals two apparently disconnected families of bosonic stars. Within the explored parameter space, the hairy black holes are connected to the strongly gravitating one.

classification.title_zh: 带弱电毛发的带电黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在爱因斯坦引力耦合弱电理论玻色子部分的框架下构造带电黑洞，聚焦静态、球对称且渐近平直的解，并将弱混合角固定为标准模型值。视界正则性给出带电矢量频率与视界电磁势之间的共振条件，对应带电超辐射阈值。微扰分析进一步表明，非极端 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞不支持满足该条件的正则、指数局域、球对称弱电云，因此毛发解不能从该电真空族分叉产生。数值研究还揭示出两个看似不连通的玻色星族；在所探索的参数空间内，毛发黑洞与强引力的一族相连。
classification.one_liner: 在爱因斯坦-弱电理论中构造带电黑洞毛发，并分析其视界共振条件、与 Reissner-Nordström 解及玻色星族的联系。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究经典广义相对论中的带电黑洞解与弱电毛发，直接匹配重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

papers.title: Bouncing and QNM convergence in Kerr
papers.abstract: We show that the convergence region of the QNM representation of the retarded Green's function of the Kerr spacetime is set by complex-time bouncing singularities, as in our previous work for the Schwarzschild case. The main difference between Kerr and Schwarzschild is that there are two distinct QNM families, prolate and oblate, which have different convergence regions. We provide explicit analytical formulae for the bounce radii and corresponding convergence regions in Boyer-Lindquist coordinates. We also provide an analysis of convergence in the Reissner-Nordstr\"om spacetime.

classification.title_zh: Kerr 时空中的反弹与 QNM 收敛
classification.abstract_zh: 我们表明，Kerr 时空中推迟格林函数的 QNM 表示的收敛区域由复时间反弹奇点决定，这与我们此前对 Schwarzschild 情形的工作一致。Kerr 与 Schwarzschild 的主要区别在于存在两个不同的 QNM 族——长球（prolate）与扁球（oblate）——它们具有不同的收敛区域。我们给出了 Boyer-Lindquist 坐标下反弹半径及相应收敛区域的显式解析公式。我们还对 Reissner-Nordström 时空中的收敛性作了分析。
classification.one_liner: Kerr 时空中 QNM 表示推迟格林函数的收敛区域由复时间反弹奇点决定，并给出长球/扁球两族 QNM 的反弹半径与收敛域解析公式。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接讨论 Kerr/RN 时空 QNM 表示推迟格林函数的收敛域与反弹奇点，属于 QNM/经典引力支线；但摘要未涉及全息对偶或非线性演化。

papers.title: Effective Optical Geometry and Holographic Phase Structure of a Magnetic AdS Black Hole
papers.abstract: We study circular null orbits, thermodynamic topology, and the holographic thermodynamic description of a four-dimensional magnetically charged AdS black hole in nonlinear electrodynamics. The background orbit structure is classified using Duan s phi-mapping construction and compared with the extraordinary electromagnetic characteristics. The latter defines an effective optical metric with an additional radial factor that modifies the orbit condition and introduces explicit dependence on the AdS radius. For four representative configurations, the local indices of the five isolated orbits are unchanged while their radii shift by up to 5.187 %. The background mass thresholds vary smoothly across sigma = 1/4 when the total mass is used, whereas the fixed-m0 parametrization is singular there. Regularity at the center requires sigma > 1 and m0 = 0. The thermodynamic analysis separates local stability indices from equilibrium coexistence: stable Gibbs-free-energy branches cross only in model-dependent parameter intervals. The boundary canonical ensemble exhibits critical behavior consistent with mean-field exponents, and the examined grand-canonical ensemble has a Hawking-Page crossing. In the mixed ensemble, the free-energy branches have a finite endpoint discontinuity, but the sampled competing states do not satisfy the full local-stability criterion

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 磁荷AdS黑洞的有效光学几何与全息相结构
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究四维非线性电动力学中磁荷AdS黑洞的圆形零测地线轨道、热力学拓扑以及全息热力学描述。利用Duan的phi映射构造对背景轨道结构进行分类，并与非常规电磁特性进行比较。后者定义了一个带有额外径向因子的有效光学度规，该因子修改轨道条件并显式引入对AdS半径的依赖。对于四个代表性构型，五个孤立轨道的局部指数保持不变，但其半径最多偏移5.187%。当使用总质量时，背景质量阈值在sigma=1/4附近平滑变化，而固定m0参数化在该处奇异。中心正则性要求sigma>1且m0=0。热力学分析将局部稳定性指数与平衡共存分开：稳定的Gibbs自由能分支仅在依赖模型的参数区间内相交。边界正则系综表现出与平均场指数一致的临界行为，所考察的大正则系综存在Hawking-Page交叉。在混合系综中，自由能分支具有有限端点不连续性，但采样的竞争态不满足完整的局部稳定性判据。
classification.one_liner: 研究磁荷AdS黑洞的有效光学轨道与热力学相结构，区分局部稳定性与共存，并讨论不同系综中的临界和Hawking-Page行为。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文涉及AdS黑洞的经典引力轨道结构与引力热力学相变，与用户重点中的经典引力/广义相对论和相变相关；但未直接研究全息超流、探针膜、QNM或非均匀态等具体支线。

papers.title: Gauge-invariant non-universal scalar couplings in teleparallel gravity
papers.abstract: We develop a gauge-invariant teleparallel framework in which the universality of the gravitational coupling is relaxed for a scalar field, while the gravitational sector retains the form of the teleparallel equivalent of General Relativity. The non-universal interaction is encoded in a scalar-sector tetrad whose coupling to the universal translational gauge potential is controlled by a field-dependent gravitational charge. A St\"uckelberg completion preserves local translational gauge invariance, and we derive the gravitational, scalar-field, and St\"uckelberg equations, together with the antisymmetric constraint and their consistency relations. As a first application, we investigate homogeneous and isotropic cosmology, where the St\"uckelberg constraint provides a first integral governing the evolution of the non-universal coupling. In the kination-dominated regime, the standard stiff-fluid behavior is recovered asymptotically, whereas in the potential-dominated regime, accelerated expansion requires additional conditions beyond potential domination. We identify compatible expanding solutions in which departures from universality are dynamically suppressed, including examples approaching power-law inflation or asymptotically de Sitter expansion. Including a universally coupled perfect fluid and a constant scalar potential, we obtain a late-time solution exhibiting a subdominant matter-like contribution to the background Friedmann equation and an asymptotic de Sitter limit. These results provide a gauge-theoretic realization of non-universal scalar couplings and highlight their potential implications for early- and late-time cosmology.

classification.title_zh: 远平行引力中规范不变的非普适标量耦合
classification.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个规范不变的远平行引力框架：在其中，引力扇区保持为广义相对论的远平行等价形式，而标量场的引力耦合普适性被放宽。非普适相互作用被编码在标量扇区的四足场中，其与普适平移规范势的耦合由一个依赖场值的引力荷控制。Stückelberg 补全保持了局部平移规范不变性；作者推导了引力、标量场与 Stückelberg 方程，以及反对称约束和一致性关系。作为首个应用，研究了均匀各向同性宇宙学，其中 Stückelberg 约束给出控制非普适耦合演化的首次积分。在 kination 主导区域，渐近恢复标准刚性流体行为；在势主导区域，加速膨胀需要势主导之外的额外条件。作者找到了非普适性偏离被动力学压低的相容膨胀解，包括趋近幂律暴胀或渐近 de Sitter 膨胀的例子。加入普适耦合的理想流体和常数标量势后，得到一个晚期解，其背景 Friedmann 方程含有次主导的类物质贡献，并具有渐近 de Sitter 极限。
classification.one_liner: 在远平行引力中构造带 Stückelberg 规范不变性的非普适标量耦合，并研究其早期与晚期宇宙学解。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于经典引力/远平行引力与宇宙学，而非全息或量子引力；与用户“经典引力/广义相对论”支线相关，但不涉及 AdS/CFT、纠缠或全息物态。

papers.title: Coisotropy-one homogeneous spacetimes I: (3,2)-Kinematical Lie algebras with $d\geq 3$
papers.abstract: This is the first of several papers devoted to the classification of coisotropy-one homogeneous spacetimes. It is the first step in extending the classification of spatially isotropic homogeneous spacetimes of kinematical Lie groups to the much vaster context of homogeneous spacetimes that are not spatially isotropic; that is, where the rotations no longer act transitively on the space of directions in each tangent space. In this first paper we classify (up to isomorphisms preserving the rotational subalgebra) a class of the relevant transitive Lie algebras, the so-called (3,2)-kinematical Lie algebras, for the coisotropy-one case in spatial dimension at least 4. As a by-product of this classification, we classify two-dimensional real representations of Bianchi Lie algebras up to a suitable notion of equivalence.

classification.title_zh: 余各向同性为1的齐性时空 I：d≥3 的 (3,2)-运动学李代数
classification.abstract_zh: 这是若干篇论文中的第一篇，致力于余各向同性为1的齐性时空分类。它是将运动学李群的空间各向同性齐性时空分类推广到更广泛的非空间各向同性齐性时空背景的第一步；也就是旋转不再在每个切空间的方向空间上传递作用。在第一篇论文中，我们分类（在保持旋转子代数的同构意义下）相关传递李代数的一类，即所谓的 (3,2)-运动学李代数，在余各向同性为1且空间维度至少为4的情形。作为该分类的副产品，我们按适当的等价概念分类 Bianchi 李代数的二维实表示。
classification.one_liner: 分类空间维度至少为4、余各向同性为1的 (3,2)-运动学李代数，并附带分类 Bianchi 李代数的二维实表示。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文分类齐性时空的运动学李代数，属于经典时空/引力对称性研究，与用户经典引力/广义相对论支线相关；但内容为数学分类，不涉及具体引力动力学或全息。

papers.title: The twistor construction of toric gravitational instantons
papers.abstract: We give an explicit construction of all ALF and ALE toric gravitational instantons in terms of certain rational matrix functions of one complex variable on the Riemann sphere; these provide patching matrices for their corresponding twistor holomorphic vector bundles. The reconstruction of the instantons arises from the solution to a Riemann--Hilbert splitting problem and we show how this can be solved via linear algebra, resembling but not equivalent to the Belinski--Zakharov ansatz. This construction gives a complete classification together with an explicit form for all toric gravitational instantons up to the resolutions of conical and orbifold singularities. We illustrate the formalism by computer--assisted numerical construction of two new ALF (but not AF) gravitational instantons with five nodes.

classification.title_zh: 环面引力瞬子的扭量构造
classification.abstract_zh: 我们给出所有 ALF 和 ALE 环面引力瞬子的显式构造，用黎曼球面上单复变量的某些有理矩阵函数表示；这些函数为其相应的扭量全纯向量丛提供拼接矩阵。瞬子的重构来自一个 Riemann–Hilbert 分裂问题的解，我们展示如何通过线性代数求解，类似但不等价于 Belinski–Zakharov ansatz。该构造给出所有环面引力瞬子的完整分类以及显式形式，直至锥形和 orbifold 奇点的消解。我们通过计算机辅助数值构造两个新的具有五个节点的 ALF（但非 AF）引力瞬子来说明该形式体系。
classification.one_liner: 用扭量与 Riemann–Hilbert 分裂显式构造并分类 ALF/ALE 环面引力瞬子，并数值给出两个新的五节点 ALF 例子。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典引力中的引力瞬子构造与分类，属于“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线；不涉及全息或量子场论。

papers.title: A Holographic Weyl Semimetal in an Effective Gauss--Bonnet Geometry
papers.abstract: We study how an effective Gauss--Bonnet deformation of the thermal geometry changes the competition between the conducting Weyl-semimetal and insulating flavour phases of the probe D3/D7 model. The phases are represented by horizon-reaching and smoothly capped D7 embeddings, respectively, whose free energies exhibit a first-order transition. At the temperatures examined, positive Gauss--Bonnet coupling shifts coexistence toward larger flavour mass and expands the thermodynamically preferred Weyl-semimetal region, while negative coupling shifts the boundary in the opposite direction. The normalized zero-temperature transition remains unchanged. An on-shell analysis shows that the leading finite-temperature shift is largely explained by an effective rescaling of the thermal scale, opposed by an intrinsic fixed-horizon geometric contribution. The enlargement of the conducting phase does not imply stronger electrical response: the longitudinal and anomalous Hall conductivity jumps at coexistence can decrease, and the coupling response of the longitudinal jump reverses with temperature. The mass-dependent maximum of the longitudinal DC conductivity can also cease to occur on the thermodynamically preferred branch. Thus the geometric deformation changes both which phase is favored and how the Weyl-semimetal phase conducts.

classification.title_zh: 有效Gauss--Bonnet几何中的全息Weyl半金属
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究有效Gauss--Bonnet热几何形变如何改变探针D3/D7模型中导电Weyl半金属相与绝缘味相之间的竞争。两相分别由到达视界和光滑封顶的D7嵌入表示，其自由能显示一阶相变。在所考察温度下，正Gauss--Bonnet耦合使共存点移向更大味质量并扩大热力学偏好的Weyl半金属区域，负耦合则使边界向相反方向移动；归一化零温转变保持不变。在壳分析表明，领头有限温移动主要可由热标度的有效重标度解释，并受到固定视界的几何贡献抗衡。导电相的扩大并不意味着电响应更强：共存处纵向和反常霍尔电导跳变可减小，纵向跳变的耦合响应随温度反转；纵向直流电导的质量依赖极大值也可能不再出现在热力学偏好支上。因此几何形变同时改变哪一相更受偏好以及Weyl半金属相如何导电。
classification.one_liner: 该文用有效Gauss--Bonnet形变的D3/D7全息模型研究Weyl半金属相与绝缘相的一阶竞争及电导响应如何随几何形变改变。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接使用D3/D7探针膜研究全息Weyl半金属相变与输运，与用户重点标签中的D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜及相变主题高度相关。

papers.title: Horizon exchange and the universal all-spin response of Kerr
papers.abstract: The radial Teukolsky equation is invariant under exchange of the outer and inner horizons, although the physical boundary condition is not. We derive an exact monodromy relation between the corresponding Mano--Suzuki--Takasugi (MST) near-zone responses. At leading order in frequency and to all orders in spin, this relation yields, for every multipole, an expression for the leading horizon-exchange-odd response. For gravitational perturbations, it determines the exchange-odd contribution to quadrupolar absorption and organizes the exchange-even dynamical response into a digamma function whose expansion accounts for the odd- and even-zeta structures found in Kerr-Compton calculations. The exact relation, rather than the individual previously known small-spin coefficients, is the central result.

classification.title_zh: 视界交换与 Kerr 的普适全自旋响应
classification.abstract_zh: 径向 Teukolsky 方程在外视界与内视界交换下不变，尽管物理边界条件并非如此。我们推导相应 Mano--Suzuki--Takasugi（MST）近区响应之间的精确单值（monodromy）关系。在频率领头阶并对自旋取所有阶，该关系对每个多极给出领先的视界交换奇响应表达式。对于引力扰动，它确定了交换奇项对四极吸收的贡献，并将交换偶动力学响应组织为 digamma 函数，其展开解释了 Kerr-Compton 计算中出现的奇偶 zeta 结构。核心结果是这一精确关系，而非此前已知的各个小自旋系数。
classification.one_liner: 推导 Kerr 径向 Teukolsky 方程在内外视界交换下的精确 MST 响应单值关系，并给出全自旋阶的视界交换奇响应与四极吸收贡献。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典黑洞微扰与 Teukolsky/MST 方法，契合“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线，但不涉及全息、超流超导、探针膜或量子信息等主要方向。

papers.title: Weyl Rescalings: A First Order Approach
papers.abstract: Weyl transformations, --local rescalings in which the metric transforms as $g_{\mu\nu}(x)\longrightarrow \Omega^2(x)\, g_{\mu \nu}(x)$--, are expected to be a symmetry of nature at extremely high energy, that should be (spontaneously) broken at low energy. In Cartan's first order formulation of gravity this translates into the condition that the local frames (vielbein) scale as $e^a(x) \longrightarrow \Omega(x) e^a(x)$. In this construction, the Lorentz connection one-form fields $\omega^a{}_b$ are independent from $e^a$, and since Lorentz transformations and dilatations commute, $\omega$ and $R(\omega)$ must be Weyl invariant, while in the second order metric formalism the Ricci tensor undergoes a non-homogeneous transformation. This generates a tension between the two formulations, which should be equivalent in the vanishing torsion limit. Here we show how the puzzle can be resolved taking into account the role of torsion. This also sheds some light on the conformal coupling of matter fields to gravity.

classification.title_zh: Weyl 标度变换：一阶方法
classification.abstract_zh: Weyl 变换是度规的局域重标度 g_{\mu\nu}(x)\to \Omega^2(x)g_{\mu\nu}(x)，预期是极高能下的自然对称性并在低能自发破缺。在 Cartan 一阶引力表述中，这对应局域标架（vielbein）按 e^a(x)\to \Omega(x)e^a(x) 缩放。该构造中 Lorentz 联络一形式场 \omega^a{}_b 独立于 e^a，且 Lorentz 变换与伸缩对易，因此 \omega 与 R(\omega) 必须 Weyl 不变；而在二阶度规形式中 Ricci 张量作非齐次变换，这造成两种在零挠率极限应等价的表述之间的张力。本文考虑挠率的作用来化解该谜题，并借此阐明物质场与引力的共形耦合。
classification.one_liner: 在 Cartan 一阶形式中引入挠率，调和 Weyl 变换下联络与曲率的不变性同二阶 Ricci 张量非齐次变换之间的矛盾。

papers.title: Crossover from Schwarzian dynamics to rotational soft modes in near-extremal Lovelock black holes
papers.abstract: Near-extremal black holes are controlled by a small set of soft modes, and counting these modes fixes the coefficient of $\log T$ in the entropy. We ask whether genuine six-derivative interactions change that count, working in seven-dimensional third-order Lovelock gravity, the simplest setting where the cubic Lovelock term is dynamical. The multiplicities stay the same, but the naive count fails. At fixed charge the Maxwell mode is frozen out, and the fifteen rotational modes of the $S^5$ act as a quantum rotor that only switches on above the scale $K_J^{-1}$. As a result, the coefficient of $\log T$ runs from $3/2$ at the lowest temperatures to $9$ above that scale, and never reaches the naive Gaussian value $19/2$. We compute the moment of inertia $K_J$ from the charged slow-rotation solution and find that the Lovelock couplings move the crossover without changing the multiplicities. Only large AdS black holes have a wide window in which the full rotational contribution competes with the classical entropy. Adding a probe charged scalar, we derive an analytic near-horizon Schwinger threshold in the cubic coupling. Its large-AdS limit tells us when the broad rotational crossover window can coexist with the absence of a charged-scalar Breitenlohner--Freedman (BF) bound violation.

classification.title_zh: 近极端 Lovelock 黑洞中从 Schwarzian 动力学到转动软模的过渡
classification.abstract_zh: 近极端黑洞由少量软模控制，计数这些模式决定熵中 log T 的系数。我们研究真正的六导数相互作用是否改变该计数，在七维三阶 Lovelock 引力中工作，这是三次 Lovelock 项具有动力学的最简单情形。多重度保持不变，但朴素计数失效。在固定电荷下 Maxwell 模被冻结，S^5 的十五个转动模作为量子转子，只在高于尺度 K_J^{-1} 时开启。因此 log T 的系数从最低温的 3/2 跑到该尺度以上的 9，永不达到朴素高斯值 19/2。我们从带电慢转解计算转动惯量 K_J，发现 Lovelock 耦合移动交叉但不改变多重度。只有大 AdS 黑洞有宽窗口，使完整转动贡献与经典熵竞争。加入探针带电标量，我们推导三次耦合中近视界 Schwinger 阈值的解析表达式。其大 AdS 极限告诉我们宽转动交叉窗口何时能与带电标量 Breitenlohner--Freedman (BF) 束缚违反的缺失共存。
classification.one_liner: 在七维三次 Lovelock 近极端黑洞中，log T 熵系数因 S^5 转动软模在 K_J^{-1} 以上开启而从 3/2 过渡到 9，Lovelock 耦合移动该交叉但不改变软模多重度。

papers.title: Fortuitous BMN Operators from Multiple Cores
papers.abstract: We develop a systematic construction of fortuitous cohomology classes in the BMN sector of $\mathcal N=4$ super Yang--Mills theory from multiple lower-rank building blocks. For arbitrary partitions of colour space, we construct corrected effective letters that obey the supersymmetry transformations of the corresponding lower-rank theories. These allow us to build gauge-invariant, $Q$-closed polynomial operators. A restriction map recovers the constituent cohomology classes, establishing non-exactness and fortuity without brute-force computations. As an explicit example, we combine two fortuitous $SU(2)$ cores to construct a fortuitous class in $SU(4)$. Our results provide a systematic approach to the structure of fortuitous cohomology at finite $N$.

classification.title_zh: 来自多核心的偶然 BMN 算符
classification.abstract_zh: 我们发展了一种系统构造 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论 BMN 扇区中偶然上同调类的方法，这些上同调类由多个低秩构建块组成。对于色空间的任意分割，我们构造修正的有效字母，它们满足相应低秩理论的超对称变换。这些构造使我们能够建立规范不变、Q-闭的多项式算符。一个限制映射可恢复组成的上同调类，从而无需暴力计算即可确立非精确性和偶然性。作为一个显式例子，我们组合两个偶然 SU(2) 核心来构造 SU(4) 中的一个偶然类。我们的结果为有限 N 下偶然上同调的结构提供了系统方法。
classification.one_liner: 系统构造 N=4 SYM 的 BMN 扇区中由多个低秩核心组合而成的有限 N 偶然 Q-闭上同调算符。

papers.title: Scalar radiation from circular orbits in D3 brane spacetimes: a Mano-Suzuki-Takasugi-like approach
papers.abstract: We study scalar perturbations in a ten-dimensional D3 brane spacetime, developing a (higher-dimensional) Mano-Suzuki-Takasugi-like formalism adapted to the present case leading to a sourced modification of a Mathieu equation. As an application, we compute the energy loss both at infinity and at the horizon in terms of scalar waves due to a scalar charge moving along a circular "equatorial" geodesic.

classification.title_zh: D3膜时空中圆轨道的标量辐射：一种类Mano-Suzuki-Takasugi方法
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究十维D3膜时空中的标量扰动，建立适用于该情形的（高维）类Mano-Suzuki-Takasugi形式，并得到一个带源修正的Mathieu方程。作为应用，计算标量电荷沿赤道圆测地线运动时，由标量波在无穷远和视界处造成的能量损失。
classification.one_liner: 在十维D3膜时空中建立类MST标量扰动方法，并计算圆轨道标量电荷的标量辐射能量损失。

papers.title: Gauge-invariant thermodynamic description of rotating black strings in 5D minimal supergravity via Kaluza-Klein reduction
papers.abstract: We develop a gauge-invariant formulation of the thermodynamics of rotating black strings in five-dimensional minimal supergravity through Kaluza-Klein reduction. At the two-derivative level, we consistently reduce the bulk action and the Gibbons-Hawking-York boundary term, carefully accounting for the surface contributions induced by the Chern-Simons coupling. The resulting four-dimensional theory is $\mathcal{N}=2$ supergravity coupled to a single vector multiplet, with prepotential $P=\frac{1}{3\sqrt{3}}\frac{X_1^3}{X_0}$. Employing the Hamiltonian formalism, we establish the quantum statistical relation between the Euclidean on-shell action and the Gibbs free energy. We further compute the leading four-derivative corrections to the thermodynamics of a rotating magnetic black string using the Reall-Santos method. The resulting corrections are in precise agreement with previous results obtained directly for the Kerr-Newman black hole in four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=2$ supergravity.

classification.title_zh: 通过Kaluza-Klein约化对5维最小超引力中旋转黑弦的规范不变热力学描述
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过Kaluza-Klein约化，建立五维最小超引力中旋转黑弦热力学的规范不变表述。在两导数层面，我们一致地约化体作用量与Gibbons-Hawking-York边界项，并仔细处理Chern-Simons耦合诱导的表面贡献。所得四维理论为与单个矢量多重态耦合的N=2超引力，其prepotential为 P=\frac{1}{3\sqrt{3}}\frac{X_1^3}{X_0}。利用Hamilton形式，我们建立欧几里得在壳作用量与Gibbs自由能之间的量子统计关系。进一步使用Reall-Santos方法计算旋转磁黑弦热力学的领头四导数修正。所得修正与此前直接针对四维N=2超引力中Kerr-Newman黑洞得到的结果精确一致。

papers.title: A Ghost-Free dS/AdS Correspondence in $\mathcal{N}=1$ Supergravity
papers.abstract: Reversing the sign of the scalar potential exchanges de Sitter and anti-de Sitter vacua and, through the domain-wall/cosmology correspondence, maps flat domain walls onto flat FLRW cosmologies, but its supersymmetric version has ghosts on the cosmological side. We show that this pointwise correspondence is realized between two ordinary, ghost-free four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=1$ supergravities with spontaneously broken supersymmetry. Within a single superconformal K\"ahler cone, a $\mathbb{Z}_2$ reflection of the nilpotent goldstino K\"ahler metric through the flat limit $V=0$ reverses $V\leftrightarrow-V$ pointwise while preserving the visible K\"ahler metric, the superpotential, and the unitary-gauge fermion Lagrangian. The paired vacua obey a sharp dictionary with $H=1/L$, $m^2_{\rm dS}=-m^2_{\rm AdS}$, equal conformal weights, and $m_{3/2}>H$, and are simultaneously stable precisely within the window $0\le m^2_{\rm dS}\le\frac94H^2$ set by the Breitenlohner--Freedman bound. Applied to string compactifications and cosmology, this correspondence pairs over-uplifted with under-uplifted anti-D3-brane vacua, confines the de Sitter swampland conjecture to the goldstino (anti-brane) sector, and maps slow-roll inflation onto a healthy AdS domain wall obeying the holographic $c$-theorem.

classification.title_zh: N=1 超引力中无鬼的 dS/AdS 对应
classification.abstract_zh: 翻转标量势符号会交换 de Sitter 与 anti-de Sitter 真空，并通过畴壁/宇宙学对应把平坦畴壁映射为平坦 FLRW 宇宙学，但其超对称版本在宇宙学侧存在鬼。本文表明，这种逐点对应可在两个普通、无鬼且超对称自发破缺的四维 N=1 超引力之间实现。在单一超共形 Kähler 锥内，对 nilpotent goldstino Kähler 度规作穿过平坦极限 V=0 的 Z2 反射，可逐点反转 V↔-V，同时保持可见 Kähler 度规、超势和幺正规范费米子拉氏量不变。配对真空满足 H=1/L、m^2_dS=-m^2_AdS、共形权重相等、m_{3/2}>H，并且恰好在 Breitenlohner-Freedman 界给出的 0≤m^2_dS≤9/4 H^2 窗口内同时稳定。应用于弦紧致化和宇宙学时，该对应将过抬升与欠抬升的 anti-D3-brane 真空配对，把 de Sitter swampland 猜想限制到 goldstino（anti-brane）扇区，并把慢滚暴胀映射为满足全息 c-theorem 的健康 AdS 畴壁。

papers.title: Obstruction to local entropy laws on arbitrary black-hole cuts in five-dimensional Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet gravity
papers.abstract: We study local entropy laws on arbitrary cuts of event horizons in five-dimensional Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet gravity, treated as an exact theory. No covariant local entropy can both reproduce the stationary black-hole entropy and be nondecreasing between every ordered pair of cuts, provided its density is smooth on an invariant open set of off-shell metric and cut jets containing a flat planar cut and every cut used in the argument. No global bound on derivative order is assumed. The counterexamples to the second law are vacuum black holes perturbed by a gravitational wave, with a strongly hyperbolic formulation near the relevant horizon interval and its stationary future. Shear makes the intrinsic curvature of a cut depend on its bending. The stationary entropy fixes the coefficient of this curvature term, and local corrections cannot cancel its response to cut bending. The obstruction appears at second order in wave amplitude on a smooth horizon, without a merger or topology change.

classification.title_zh: 五维Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet引力中任意黑洞截面上局部熵定律的阻碍
classification.abstract_zh: 本文把五维Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet引力作为精确理论研究事件视界任意截面上的局部熵定律。结果表明，若熵密度在包含平坦平面截面及论证所用各截面的某个不变开集上光滑，则不存在协变局部熵既能重现稳态黑洞熵，又在每对有序截面之间非减；论证不假设导数阶的全局上限。第二定律的反例来自受引力波扰动的真空黑洞，并在相关视界区间及其稳态未来附近采用强双曲表述。剪切使截面的内禀曲率依赖于其弯曲；稳态熵固定该曲率项的系数，而局部修正无法抵消其对截面弯曲的响应。该阻碍在光滑视界的波振幅二阶出现，无需并合或拓扑改变。
classification.one_liner: 在五维Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet引力中证明：满足平滑性与单调性要求的协变局部熵无法同时重现稳态黑洞熵，引力波扰动给出二阶反例。

papers.title: From off-shell strings to entropy flows
papers.abstract: Bit threads express holographic entropy as the maximal flux of a divergenceless vector field subject to a local capacity bound, but do not identify a physical carrier of that flux. In our previous work, we identified the projected string charge density with a bit-thread flow, reproduced the entropies of BTZ and ten-dimensional three-charge black holes, and showed that the maximal entropy flux is preserved under S- and T-dualities. However, the norm bound was imported from the bit-thread prescription, while the string-current configurations were prescribed along known bit-thread lines. In this paper, we give a stringy foundation for the local capacity and construct dynamical probe-string representatives of maximal flow. At genus zero and two-derivative order, the conical variation of the target-space action derived from the off-shell sphere fixes the string-frame entropy density. The gravitational replica construction and weighted flow-cut duality then yield the string-frame norm bound. We next find regular stationary F1 solutions in an NS-NS supported BTZ black hole whose spatial parts are logarithmic spirals. A uniform ensemble produces a conserved, constant-norm projected string charge density and realizes a maximal flow whose flux equals the BTZ entropy. We finally extend the construction to BTZ backgrounds with mixed NS-NS and RR flux. Varying the flux fraction changes the stationary F1 configurations at fixed metric and dilaton, while the corresponding conserved flows reproduce the same leading BTZ entropy. Thus, both the norm bound and its physical maximal-flow representative arise from string theory, with stationary strings providing physical channels for the entropic flux represented geometrically by bit threads.

classification.title_zh: 从离壳弦到熵流
classification.abstract_zh: Bit threads 将全息熵表示为满足局部容量界的无散度矢量场的最大通量，但没有指出该通量的物理载体。作者此前将投影弦电荷密度识别为 bit-thread flow，重现了 BTZ 和十维三电荷黑洞的熵，并表明最大熵通量在 S- 与 T-对偶下保持。本文为局部容量给出弦论基础，并构造最大流的动力学探针弦代表。在亏格零和两导数阶，由离壳球面得到的目标空间作用的锥形变分固定 string-frame 熵密度；引力 replica 构造与加权流-割对偶给出 string-frame 范数界。随后在 NS-NS 支撑的 BTZ 黑洞中找到正则稳态 F1 解，其空间部分为对数螺线；均匀系综产生守恒且范数恒定的投影弦电荷密度，并实现通量等于 BTZ 熵的最大流。最后将构造推广到混合 NS-NS 与 RR 通量的 BTZ 背景；改变通量比例会在固定度规和 dilaton 下改变稳态 F1 构型，而相应守恒流仍重现相同领头 BTZ 熵。因此，范数界及其物理最大流代表均来自弦论，稳态弦为 bit threads 几何表示的熵通量提供物理通道。
classification.one_liner: 该文用离壳弦与稳态 F1 解为 bit-thread 熵流的局部容量界和最大流代表提供弦论基础，并在 BTZ 背景中重现全息熵。

papers.title: Resonant electroweak clouds around Schwarzschild black holes
papers.abstract: We construct nonlinear electroweak clouds around Schwarzschild black holes in the bosonic Weinberg-Salam theory. These configurations are supported by harmonically time-dependent charged gauge fields, while their energy-momentum tensor remains static. Regularity at the horizon imposes a resonance condition relating the field frequency to the horizon electrostatic potential. Unlike linear clouds, these solutions exhibit a finite mass and electric charge gap, and exist only up to a maximal horizon size. We obtain both magnetic and electric clouds, including spherically symmetric and dipolar configurations, which reduce to electroweak balls in the vanishing-horizon limit. We also report a new family of dipolar electroweak balls, which can be energetically favoured over their spherical counterparts at fixed electric charge. Our results, obtained in the probe limit for electroweak couplings away from their measured values, establish a new realization of nonlinear resonant vector hair in a non-Abelian gauge-Higgs theory.

classification.title_zh: 史瓦西黑洞周围的共振电弱云
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在玻色 Weinberg-Salam 理论中构造了史瓦西黑洞周围的非线性电弱云。这些构型由随时间作谐振变化的带电规范场支撑，而其能量-动量张量保持静态。视界处的正则性给出一个共振条件，将场频率与视界静电势联系起来。与线性云不同，这些解具有有限的质量与电荷间隙，并且只存在到最大视界尺寸。我们得到了磁性和电性云，包括球对称和偶极构型；它们在视界消失极限下退化为电弱球。我们还报告了一类新的偶极电弱球，在固定电荷下它们可能在能量上优于对应的球对称构型。我们的结果是在电弱耦合偏离其测量值的探针极限下获得的，确立了非阿贝尔规范-希格斯理论中非线性共振矢量毛的一种新实现。

papers.title: Compact holography via polarized IKKT
papers.abstract: The polarized IKKT matrix model is a $U(N)$ supersymmetric matrix integral proposed to be dual to an $N$ D-instanton sector of Euclidean type IIB string theory. We show a direct path from matrix model saddles to supergravity saddles: matrix model resolvent $\to$ holomorphic function $\to$ 2D Coulomb potential $\to$ 4D Coulomb potential $\to$ supergravity fields, where the last step was previously described. Here, the 2D electrostatics picture is an exact finite $N$ reformulation of a localization deformation of the matrix model that gives a constrained gas of dipoles in a background field. We show a matching between supergravity and matrix model on-shell actions and protected observables for all saddles. We show that the supergravity saddles have a compact and non-singular metric in string frame with the Einstein frame asymptotic region replaced by a pointlike D-instanton source. We provide evidence that the physics of particular gravity saddles can be obtained through restricting the domain of the matrix model integral to a basin associated with the corresponding matrix model saddle. We describe certain large $N$ decoupling limits where families of the saddles decouple from the rest to give the gravity duals of certain higher-dimensional field theories.

classification.title_zh: 通过极化 IKKT 实现的紧致全息
classification.abstract_zh: 极化 IKKT 矩阵模型是一个 U(N) 超对称矩阵积分，被提议对偶于欧氏 IIB 型弦理论的一个 N 个 D-瞬子扇区。我们展示了从矩阵模型鞍点到超引力鞍点的直接路径：矩阵模型预解式 → 全纯函数 → 二维库仑势 → 四维库仑势 → 超引力场，其中最后一步此前已有描述。这里，二维静电图像是对矩阵模型某个局域化形变的精确有限 N 重构，该形变给出背景场中受约束的偶极子气体。我们证明超引力和矩阵模型在所有鞍点上的壳作用量与受保护可观测量相匹配。我们证明这些超引力鞍点在弦框架下具有紧致且非奇异的度规，其爱因斯坦框架渐近区域被一个点状 D-瞬子源取代。我们提供证据表明，通过将矩阵模型积分区域限制到与相应矩阵模型鞍点相关的盆地，可以得到特定引力鞍点的物理。我们描述了某些大 N 退耦极限，其中若干鞍点族从其余部分退耦，从而给出某些高维场论的对偶引力。
classification.one_liner: 论文建立极化 IKKT 矩阵模型鞍点到超引力鞍点的直接映射，并用矩阵积分描述紧致非奇异全息对偶。

papers.title: A Sojourn Through $c=1$ String Theory
papers.abstract: We revisit the $S$-matrix, the thermal $S$-matrix and the thermal free energy of $c=1$ string theory from the worldsheet perspective. By numerically integrating Virasoro conformal blocks with DOZZ structure constants, we compute the scattering amplitudes and thermal amplitudes up to 6-point at tree level and up to 3-point at one loop, in addition to the genus two thermal free energy. All results are in agreement with the predicted answers from the $c=1$ matrix model.

classification.title_zh: c=1 弦论之旅
classification.abstract_zh: 我们从世界面视角重新审视 c=1 弦论的 S-矩阵、热 S-矩阵和热自由能。通过数值积分带有 DOZZ 结构常数的 Virasoro 共形块，我们计算了树级最高至 6 点的散射振幅与热振幅、单圈最高至 3 点的振幅，以及亏格二的热情形自由能。所有结果均与 c=1 矩阵模型的预言相符。
classification.one_liner: 用世界面 Virasoro 共形块数值计算 c=1 弦论的散射与热情形，并与矩阵模型预言对照。

papers.title: A New Holographic Duality for Conformal Mass Deformations
papers.abstract: We construct a space-dependent conformal mass deformation of ABJM on the half-space $z>0$ and show that the vacua of this theory are dual to a large class of half-BPS bubbling solutions of the form $AdS_3\times S^3\times S^3\times\Sigma$, with superalgebra $D(2,1|\gamma)^{\oplus2}$, parametrized by $\gamma<0$. The conformal symmetry of a plane is preserved provided that the mass deformation scales as $m(z)=\frac{c}{z}$. We give the first field-theory explanation of the exceptional superalgebra parameter $\gamma$ in M2-brane field theory in terms of the coefficient of the inverse-distance mass deformation of ABJM: $\gamma=\frac{1-2c}{1+2c}$. We demonstrate this using the methods of Polchinski and Strassler, which we first apply to the Janus interfaces of $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills and ABJM to relate localized mass sources to scalar matching conditions.

secondary_topics: 非均匀态/孤子/涡旋/畴壁
classification.title_zh: 共形质量形变的新全息对偶
classification.abstract_zh: 我们构造了 ABJM 理论在半空间 z>0 上的空间依赖共形质量形变，并证明该理论的真空对偶于一大类形式为 AdS3×S3×S3×Σ、超代数为 D(2,1|γ)^{⊕2}（γ<0）的半 BPS bubbling 解。只要质量形变按 m(z)=c/z 缩放，平面的共形对称性便得以保持。我们首次从场论角度解释了 M2 膜场论中的例外超代数参数 γ，将其表示为 ABJM 逆距离质量形变系数的函数：γ=(1-2c)/(1+2c)。我们使用 Polchinski 和 Strassler 的方法证明这一点；我们先将该方法应用于 N=4 超杨-米尔斯和 ABJM 的 Janus 界面，以把局域质量源与标量匹配条件联系起来。
classification.one_liner: 构造 ABJM 半空间共形质量形变的新全息对偶，并用 Polchinski-Strassler 方法解释 D(2,1|γ) 参数。

papers.title: Meet biform singletons in your area! Topological actions for edge modes
papers.abstract: We present topological field theories propagating biform singleton fields as edge modes. In even spacetime dimensions $D=2p$, these are irreducible representations of the conformal algebra $\mathfrak{so}(2,2p)$ with two-column Young diagrams of height $p$. Their duality properties depend on the parity of $p$: They propagate chiral degrees of freedom for odd $p$, and exhibit electric--magnetic duality for even $p$. We are able to construct the topological actions by realising the hidden conformal symmetry inherent to singletons geometrically in terms of an auxiliary bulk $\text{AdS}_{2p+1}$ geometry. Using these as a starting point, we are able to apply a recently established covariant boundary reduction procedure to yield novel action formulations with manifest Lorentz covariance. We also show how, breaking manifest Lorentz covariance, we recover known formulations of biform singletons.

classification.title_zh: 在你的领域遇见双形式单态！边缘模式的拓扑作用量
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出传播双形式单态场作为边缘模式的拓扑场论。在偶数时空维数 D=2p 中，这些场是共形代数 so(2,2p) 的不可约表示，对应高度为 p 的两列 Young 图。它们的对偶性质依赖于 p 的奇偶性：当 p 为奇数时传播手征自由度，当 p 为偶数时表现出电磁对偶。我们通过辅助体 AdS_{2p+1} 几何把单态中隐藏的共形对称性几何化，从而构造这些拓扑作用量。以此为基础，我们应用近期建立的协变边界约化程序，得到具有显式 Lorentz 协变性的新作用量表述。我们还表明，在破坏显式 Lorentz 协变性后，可以恢复已知的双形式单态表述。
classification.one_liner: 利用辅助 AdS_{2p+1} 几何与协变边界约化，为作为边缘模式传播的双形式单态构造拓扑作用量。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 AdS 辅助几何、边界共形对称性与 singleton 边缘模式，属于全息/边界对称性形式工作；但与用户列出的全息超流、QNM、探针膜等重点支线不直接重合。

papers.title: Spin alignment of vector mesons in a plasma at finite density
papers.abstract: Holographic predictions for vector meson spin alignment at finite density have been limited by how the chemical potential is implemented. Existing models use a baryon chemical potential and report that the alignment is insensitive to it, while zero-density benchmarks do not address the geometric deformation. We address this limitation by using a charged AdS black-hole background with a quark chemical potential and solving the coupled bulk vector equations with infalling horizon conditions. The zero-density limit reproduces previous results of Sheng et al. [Phys. Rev. D 110, 056047 (2024)]. At \(T=0.15~\mathrm{GeV}\), the \(J/\psi\) spectral function has a resonance peak at \(\mu=0\) that lowers and broadens with increasing \(\mu\), whereas the \(\phi\) spectral function shows no pronounced peak. In the helicity frame, \(\rho_{00}\) deviates positively from \(1/3\) for the \(J/\psi\) and negatively for the \(\phi\). The density response is more visible in our setup than the weak baryon chemical potential sensitivity reported in a four-flavor soft-wall model. This difference illustrates the model dependence of the density response: it is controlled by the chemical potential normalization. We identify the presence of the resonance peak and the signs of the helicity deviations as robust qualitative features, and treat the numerical shifts of \(\rho_{00}\) as model-dependent estimates.

classification.title_zh: 有限密度等离子体中矢量介子自旋排列的全息研究
classification.abstract_zh: 有限密度下矢量介子自旋排列的全息预言受化学势实现方式限制。已有模型使用重子化学势并报告自旋排列对其不敏感，而零密度基准未处理几何形变。我们通过使用带夸克化学势的带电AdS黑洞背景，并在入射视界条件下求解耦合的体矢量方程来解决这一限制。零密度极限重现了Sheng等人先前的结果[Phys. Rev. D 110, 056047 (2024)]。在T=0.15 GeV时，J/ψ谱函数在μ=0处有一个共振峰，该峰随μ增加而降低并展宽，而φ谱函数没有明显峰。在螺旋度框架中，J/ψ的ρ00正向偏离1/3，φ的ρ00负向偏离1/3。与四味软墙模型中报告的弱重子化学势敏感性相比，我们的设置中密度响应更明显。这一差异说明密度响应的模型依赖性：它由化学势归一化控制。我们将共振峰的存在以及螺旋度偏离的符号认定为稳健的定性特征，而将ρ00的数值移动视为依赖模型的估计。
classification.one_liner: 在带电AdS黑洞背景下求解体矢量方程，研究有限密度等离子体中J/ψ与φ介子的谱函数和自旋排列，并指出密度响应依赖化学势归一化。

papers.title: Holographic light-quark energy loss in a spinning plasma
papers.abstract: In this work, we investigate light-quark energy loss in a strongly coupled plasma described by a spinning black-brane background obtained from the large-black-hole limit of the Myers-Perry geometry. The parameter $a$ characterizes the boost/rotation parameter of the dual fluid in this holographic setup and is related to the angular velocity in the corresponding limit. We employ two complementary probes, the falling-string and shooting-string descriptions, to compute the stopping distance and the instantaneous energy loss of a light quark moving either transverse or parallel to the local tangential-flow direction. The results show that light quarks quench more readily in a hot environment. For parallel propagation, a counter-propagating configuration enhances energy loss, whereas a co-propagating configuration suppresses it. For transverse propagation, increasing the magnitude of the rotational motion promotes energy loss. In addition, the instantaneous energy loss increases along the trajectory of the endpoint. These results describe classical probe dynamics in the local planar limit and do not include intrinsic-spin effects.

classification.title_zh: 旋转等离子体中的全息轻夸克能量损失
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究强耦合等离子体中的轻夸克能量损失，背景为 Myers-Perry 几何大黑洞极限得到的旋转黑膜。参数 a 表征该全息设置中对偶流体的 boost/旋转，并在相应极限下与角速度相关。作者采用落弦和射弦两种互补探针，计算轻夸克沿局域切向流方向横向或平行运动时的停止距离和瞬时能量损失。结果表明轻夸克在热环境中更易淬灭；平行传播时逆流配置增强能量损失而顺流配置抑制能量损失；横向传播时增大旋转运动强度会促进能量损失；瞬时能量损失沿端点轨迹增加。这些结果描述局域平面极限下的经典探针动力学，不包含内禀自旋效应。
classification.one_liner: 在旋转黑膜背景中用落弦/射弦探针计算轻夸克在强耦合旋转等离子体中的停止距离与瞬时能量损失。

papers.title: QCD Axion Conversion in Magnetospheres of Neutron Stars
papers.abstract: The axion-converted-photons flux plays a key role in searches of QCD axions as a dark matter (DM) candidate. In addition to solving the strong CP problem, these may explain the properties of the mysterious DM. Neutron star (NS) cooling by neutrino/axion emissions rate constrains the astrophysical properties of superdense matter. We attempt to analyse the impact of strong magnetic fields on the emission properties of axions by employing the APR, FPS, and SLY equation of State (EoS). We modify the Tolman Oppenheimer Volkoff (TOV) equations by considering effects of strong fields' and generate profiles. We assume Cooper-pair-breaking formation (PBF) and the Bremsstrahlung process occurring in the core of NS. We use the radial distance-dependent magnetic field configuration within the permissible limit of the central magnetic field. Our work explores the variations in the axion masses of 10 meV, 15 meV, and 20 meV as a cooling source for spherically symmetric magnetised NSs. We have also shown the energy spectrum of axions and their conversion to photons. Our analysis shows that the cooling rate and the luminosity of observables (axions) for NSs change significantly due to the magnetic field. The results for the luminosity of axions is quite sensitive to its mass and EoS, as the less separation is observed for SLY EoS in comparison to the FPS and APR EoS. We report that the spectrum of axions from the Bremsstrahlung process dominates over the PBF process at lesser axion energies, within the possible axion mass range for PSR J1357-6429 NS. Our results reveal that the impact of the magnetic field is less at lower axion energies, indicating the necessity for including a magnetic field in axion-to-photon conversion mechanisms. The results for the axions mass 10 meV and 15 meV as compared to 20 meV confirms the existing report of the 16 meV.

classification.title_zh: 中子星磁层中的QCD轴子转化
classification.abstract_zh: 该文研究强磁场对中子星轴子发射性质的影响，并讨论轴子转化为光子的通量。作者采用APR、FPS和SLY状态方程，在考虑强磁场效应后修改Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff（TOV）方程并生成中子星轮廓。他们假设中子星核心发生Cooper对破坏形成（PBF）和轫致辐射过程，并使用在中心磁场允许范围内随径向距离变化的磁场位形。工作考察了10 meV、15 meV和20 meV轴子质量作为球对称磁化中子星冷却源时的变化，并给出轴子能谱及其转化为光子的结果。分析表明，磁场会显著改变中子星的冷却率和轴子观测量光度；轴子光度对轴子质量和状态方程较敏感，SLY状态方程下与FPS、APR相比观测到的分离较小。对于PSR J1357-6429，在可能轴子质量范围内，低轴子能量时轫致辐射过程的轴子谱主导于PBF过程。结果还显示磁场在较低轴子能量处影响较小，说明在轴子-光子转化机制中有必要纳入磁场。10 meV和15 meV轴子质量的结果相对于20 meV确认了已有的16 meV报告。
classification.one_liner: 用修改TOV方程和中子星冷却过程计算强磁场下QCD轴子发射及轴子-光子转化谱。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题是中子星强磁场中的轴子发射、冷却与轴子-光子转化，并涉及修改TOV方程；不属于AdS/CFT或全息研究，仅与经典引力/中子星天体物理相关。

papers.title: Observable gravitational waves from unstable ALP catastrogenesis
papers.abstract: We focus on gravitational waves (GWs) observable in pulsar timing array and interferometric searches that are produced by the annihilation of cosmic string-wall networks in axion-like particle (ALP) models. We called this process "catastrogenesis." It produces GWs with a characteristic peaked spectrum. These GWs would not be observable if the ALPs were stable. We thus assume that ALPs decay into two photons before Big-Bang nucleosynthesis (BBN). The large ALP-photon coupling required could induce field dissipation and friction on cosmic walls through interactions with the radiation background. We study the conditions under which these effects are negligible and map the parameter regions yielding observable GW signals onto the usual ALP mass-coupling parameter space. We find that, in these regions, ALPs dominate the energy density of the Universe before they decay, leading to a period of intermediate matter domination, which would leave a clear imprint on the GW spectrum.

classification.title_zh: 来自不稳定 ALP catastrogenesis 的可观测引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 我们关注在脉冲星计时阵列和干涉仪搜索中可观测的引力波（GWs），这些引力波由轴子样粒子（ALP）模型中宇宙弦-壁网络湮灭产生。我们将此过程称为“catastrogenesis”。它产生具有特征峰谱的GWs。如果ALPs稳定，这些GWs将不可观测。因此我们假设ALPs在BBN之前衰变为两个光子。所需的大ALP-光子耦合可通过与辐射背景相互作用引起场耗散和宇宙壁上的摩擦。我们研究这些效应可忽略的条件，并将产生可观测GW信号的参数区域映射到通常的ALP质量-耦合参数空间。我们发现，在这些区域中，ALPs在衰变前主导宇宙能量密度，导致一个中间物质主导时期，这会在GW谱上留下清晰印记。
classification.one_liner: 不稳定 ALP 模型中宇宙弦-壁网络湮灭产生特征峰状引力波，可在 PTA/干涉仪中观测，并伴随中间物质主导印记。

papers.title: Holographic spin alignment of vector mesons in a spinning black-hole background
papers.abstract: Holographic predictions for vector-meson spin alignment are difficult to compare between charmonium and light vector mesons, as the two sectors are typically treated in different rotating backgrounds and spectral prescriptions. Consequently, it remains unclear whether a single rotating medium can generate the opposite polarization preferences observed in data. We address this by placing \(J/\psi\) and \(\phi\) in one soft-wall model on the planar limit of a five-dimensional equal-spin Myers--Perry (MP) AdS black hole, computing spectral functions and spin alignment within the same current-correlator framework; the nonrotating results of Sheng et al. [Phys. Rev. D 110, 056047 (2024)] are recovered at \(a=0\). At \(T=0.15~\mathrm{GeV}\), \(J/\psi\) retains a clear resonance peak, whereas \(\phi\) shows no narrow peak and instead behaves as a broad distribution consistent with unstable \(s\bar{s}\) pairs. For \(J/\psi\) along \(z\), rotation enhances the positive deviation of \(\rho_{00}^{h}\) from \(1/3\) at low and intermediate momenta but suppresses it at high momenta; along \(x\), the effect is small. For \(\phi\), rotation enhances the negative deviation, more along \(z\) than along \(x\). The opposite helicity-frame signs and the opposing azimuthal and rapidity trends of the global alignment provide a reference for interpreting data: trends inconsistent with these would challenge the simplest single homogeneous rotating-medium interpretation. We distinguish model-dependent numerical details from qualitative features stable within this model class.

classification.title_zh: 旋转黑洞背景下矢量介子自旋排列的全息研究
classification.abstract_zh: 论文将 J/ψ 与 φ 置于同一软墙模型的五维等自旋 Myers–Perry AdS 黑洞平面极限背景中，用同一流关联函数框架计算谱函数和自旋排列，并在 a=0 时回到 Sheng 等人的非旋转结果。在 T=0.15 GeV 下，J/ψ 保留清晰共振峰，φ 无窄峰而呈与不稳定 s\bar{s} 对一致的宽分布。对沿 z 的 J/ψ，旋转在低/中动量增强 ρ00^h 相对 1/3 的正偏离、在高动量抑制；沿 x 效应小。对 φ，旋转增强负偏离，沿 z 比沿 x 更明显。相反螺旋度符号及整体排列相反的方位角和快度趋势为解释数据提供参考；与此不符的趋势会挑战最简单的单一均匀旋转介质解释。作者区分模型依赖数值细节与该模型类中稳定的定性特征。

papers.title: Fast mixing of the SYK model at high temperatures
papers.abstract: The Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model is a strongly interacting fermionic system. Its dynamics are difficult to analyze with Lieb-Robinson bounds and cluster expansions due to its all-to-all disordered interactions. We prove that, with high probability over the disorder, the SYK model admits a quantum Gibbs sampler with a system-size-independent spectral gap at sufficiently high constant temperatures. This yields polynomial-time preparation of SYK Gibbs states on a quantum computer. While prior non-rigorous computations that suggested SYK thermalization were limited to studying local correlators, we emphasize that our result holds up to arbitrary inverse polynomial trace distance. Our proof introduces the pseudo-Lindbladian approach to fermions then applies two key new ideas: a Bochner inequality for quantum dynamics, and an especially simple SYK analysis based on a comparison to classical dynamics.

classification.title_zh: 高温下 SYK 模型的快速混合
classification.abstract_zh: Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) 模型是强相互作用费米子系统。由于其全连接无序相互作用，其动力学难以用 Lieb-Robinson 界和集团展开分析。我们证明，在足够高的常数温度下，以对无序的高概率，SYK 模型允许一个谱隙与系统尺寸无关的量子 Gibbs 采样器。这给出了在量子计算机上多项式时间制备 SYK Gibbs 态。此前的非严格计算暗示 SYK 热化，但仅局限于局域关联函数；我们强调我们的结果在任意逆多项式迹距离下成立。我们的证明先引入费米子的伪 Lindbladian 方法，然后应用两个关键新想法：量子动力学的 Bochner 不等式，以及一种基于与经典动力学比较的特别简单的 SYK 分析。
classification.one_liner: 证明高温 SYK 模型存在系统尺寸无关谱隙的量子 Gibbs 采样器，从而多项式时间制备其 Gibbs 态。
classification.relevance_reason: SYK 属于 JT/SYK/AdS2 全息模型族，但摘要聚焦量子 Gibbs 采样与混合，不直接涉及用户列出的全息超流、multi-trace、QNM 等具体支线。

papers.title: Multipolar neutrino radiation in binary neutron star mergers: Angular structure, rotational variability, and implications for electron fraction
papers.abstract: The angular structure and temporal variability of neutrino emission from binary neutron star mergers are characterized using fully general-relativistic simulations with energy-integrated M1 neutrino transport across a representative set of equations of state, total masses and mass ratios. The main analysis is restricted to merger remnants that do not collapse to a black hole within the simulated time intervals. The angle-dependent neutrino energy flux is extracted on a spherical surface outside the remnant and decomposed into spherical harmonics to quantify its multipolar content and evolution. Following the initial post-merger transient, the neutrino radiation flux approaches an axisymmetric configuration dominated by a strong quadrupolar component, producing persistent polar flux enhancement and equatorial suppression due to torus shadowing. The dipolar contribution remains subdominant, indicating the absence of sustained one-sided emission. The degree of anisotropy increases with mass asymmetry and for softer equations of state, reflecting the compactness and morphology of the remnant--disk system. Superimposed on this time-averaged geometry, coherent azimuthal modulations associated with the $m=1$ mode are identified. The associated half frequency, $f_{\mathrm{dom}}/2\simeq0.6$--$0.7\,\mathrm{kHz}$, is compared with local rotation rates in the simulated remnant--disk systems, suggesting a possible dynamical association between the remnant structure and neutrino variability. Finally, we quantify how the same quadrupole-dominated radiation geometry induces a latitude-dependent equilibrium electron fraction. The polar material is driven close to the neutrino-equilibrium target, whereas equatorial material remains systematically more neutron rich and below equilibrium.

classification.title_zh: 双中子星并合中的多极中微子辐射：角结构、旋转变异性及对电子分数的启示
classification.abstract_zh: 本文利用完全广义相对论模拟，并结合能量积分的 M1 中微子输运，在一组具有代表性的状态方程、总质量和质量比下，刻画双中子星并合产生的中微子辐射的角结构和时间变异性。主要分析限于在模拟时间间隔内未坍缩为黑洞的并合遗迹。作者在遗迹外的球面上提取依赖角度的中微子能流，并将其分解为球谐函数，以量化其多极内容和演化。在并合后的初始瞬变之后，中微子辐射通量趋于轴对称位形，并由强四极成分主导，由于环面遮挡产生持续的极区通量增强和赤道区抑制。偶极贡献仍处于次要地位，表明不存在持续的单侧发射。各向异性程度随质量不对称性增加以及状态方程变软而增大，反映了遗迹—盘系统的致密性和形态。在时间平均几何之上，还识别出与 m=1 模式相关的相干方位角调制。相关的半频率 f_dom/2≈0.6–0.7 kHz 与模拟遗迹—盘系统中的局域旋转速率进行比较，暗示遗迹结构与中微子变异性之间可能存在动力学关联。最后，作者量化了同一四极主导的辐射几何如何导致依赖纬度的平衡电子分数。极区物质被驱动至接近中微子平衡目标，而赤道区物质则系统性地更富中子并低于平衡。
classification.one_liner: 完全广义相对论模拟显示，双中子星并合遗迹的中微子辐射在瞬变后呈四极主导的轴对称角结构，并带有 m=1 方位调制，进而造成纬度依赖的电子分数。

papers.title: Complete quasinormal modes of Type-D black holes. II. Extremal Kerr black holes
papers.abstract: We develop a double-confluent Heun method that extends our previous study of complete quasinormal-mode (QNM) spectra of Type-D black holes to extremal Kerr black holes. Radial boundary conditions and angular regularity determine the gravitational frequencies at extremality. Compared with earlier spectra restricted to the conventional Riemann sheet, analytic continuation across frequency branch cuts reveals additional QNMs on unconventional Riemann sheets. Spin continuation follows our Schwarzschild mode families toward extremality, with the survey extending through the 41st overtone on specified angular branches and Riemann sheets. We show for the first time that unconventional Class I modes with $m<0$, continued from unconventional Schwarzschild modes, form zero-damping sequences approaching the superradiant bound $M\omega=m/2$ in the extremal limit. Within a fixed angular sector, finite-damping and zero-damping sequences are interspersed in the Schwarzschild overtone ordering, so a single overtone cutoff cannot separate them. Matching near the superradiant bound distinguishes nonextremal sequences accumulating at the critical frequency from isolated QNMs at exact extremality. Scattering-amplitude calculations verify representative roots and their sheet assignments. The expanded spectrum clarifies how Schwarzschild mode families reorganize at extremality, with completeness established by contour counting within a bounded frequency domain on a specified angular branch and Riemann sheet.

classification.title_zh: Type-D 黑洞的完整准正规模。II. 极端 Kerr 黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种双合流 Heun 方法，将此前关于 Type-D 黑洞完整准正规模（QNM）谱的研究推广到极端 Kerr 黑洞。径向边界条件与角向正则性决定了极端情况下的引力频率。与以往局限于常规黎曼面的谱相比，跨越频率分支割线的解析延拓揭示了非常规黎曼面上的额外 QNM。自旋延拓沿我们此前给出的 Schwarzschild 模式族趋向极端极限，并在指定角向分支与黎曼面上扩展到第 41 阶 overtone。我们首次表明，由非常规 Schwarzschild 模式延拓而来、满足 m<0 的非常规 Class I 模式，在极端极限下形成趋近超辐射边界 Mω=m/2 的零阻尼序列。在固定角向扇区内，有限阻尼序列与零阻尼序列在 Schwarzschild overtone 排序中交错出现，因此单一 overtone 截断无法将它们分开。超辐射边界附近的匹配将积累于临界频率的非极端序列与严格极端情况下的孤立 QNM 区分开来。散射振幅计算验证了代表性根及其黎曼面归属。扩展后的谱澄清了 Schwarzschild 模式族在极端极限下如何重组；完备性通过在指定角向分支与黎曼面上的有界频率域内进行围道计数来确立。
classification.one_liner: 用双合流 Heun 方法计算极端 Kerr 黑洞的完整 QNM 谱，揭示跨黎曼面的额外模式及趋近超辐射边界的零阻尼序列。

papers.title: Regularization effects on the observational appearance of asymmetric thin-shell wormholes from a new string-cloud geometry
papers.abstract: We investigate how rational regularization of the new Letelier--Alencar string-cloud geometry changes the optical appearance of reflection-asymmetric thin-shell wormholes. We compare junctions with two nonregular exteriors, a regular observer exterior paired with a nonregular one, or two regular exteriors at fixed leading asymptotic masses, throat radius, string strength and regulator fractions. Critical scales, ray classes, orbit numbers and transfer functions are combined with three emission profiles and matched black-hole controls. Face-on and inclined images use the same prescribed emitter motion: circular timelike geodesics outside the innermost stable circular orbit and an inward plunge conserving its specific energy and angular momentum inside. Although the core is excised, regularization changes the retained exterior and throat matching. For the sampled parameters, the observer critical screen impact decreases from $10.392\mu_1$ to $9.642\mu_1$, where $\mu_1$ is the observer-side asymptotic mass scale. Regularizing the second exterior then contracts the reflected interval from $3.890\mu_1$ to $1.248\mu_1$ without changing ordinary observer-side rays. Returned brightness depends on source support and velocity-dependent frequency shifts: the regular--regular image nearly coincides with its black-hole control for the outer-edge emission model face-on, while inner emission reveals returned structures. At large sampled inclination that near-degeneracy can be lifted. This separates regularization-dependent propagation from the emission and viewing conditions that determine its image contrast.

classification.title_zh: 新 string-cloud 几何中非对称薄壳虫洞观测外观的正则化效应
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究新 Letelier–Alencar string-cloud 几何的有理正则化如何改变反射不对称薄壳虫洞的光学外观。在固定领头渐近质量、喉半径、弦强度和正则化分数下，比较两个非正则外部、一个正则观察者外部配一个非正则外部、以及两个正则外部的接合。结合临界尺度、光线类别、轨道数和转移函数与三种发射剖面，并与黑洞对照。正面和倾斜图像采用相同规定发射体运动：最内稳定圆轨道外的圆类时测地线，以及内部保持比能和角动量的向内坠落。尽管核心被切除，正则化改变保留外部和喉部匹配。对采样参数，观察者临界屏幕碰撞参数从 10.392 μ1 降至 9.642 μ1；正则化第二外部后反射区间从 3.890 μ1 收缩至 1.248 μ1，而不改变普通观察者侧光线。返回亮度依赖源支撑和速度相关频移：正则-正则图像在外缘发射模型正面几乎与黑洞对照重合，而内部发射显露返回结构；大倾角可解除近简并。这将正则化依赖的传播与决定图像对比度的发射和观测条件分离。
classification.one_liner: 研究 string-cloud 薄壳虫洞的正则化如何通过测地线和发射模型改变其光学图像，并与黑洞对照区分传播效应与观测条件。

papers.title: A catalog of long, eccentric and precessing binary black hole simulations from ICTS-TIFR
papers.abstract: We present a catalogue of 31 binary black hole simulations performed with the Spectral Einstein Code (SpEC) on the Sonic cluster at ICTS-TIFR, Bengaluru between August 2023 and December 2024, targeting the sparsely covered corner of parameter space in which orbital eccentricity and spin-orbit precession are present simultaneously: 17 configurations are both eccentric and precessing, spanning mass ratios $1 \le q \le 11$ and initial eccentricities up to $\hat{e}_0 = 0.40$. The longest, EccPrecDiff002, inspirals for 80 orbits (159 gravitational-wave cycles), to our knowledge the longest simultaneously eccentric and precessing binary black hole evolution to date. Compile-time optimisation of SpEC and its third-party library stack for the AMD Zen-2 architecture delivered a 90% speedup of the initial-data solver and a 40% speedup of the evolution, roughly half of the latter traceable to a single defect in how pre-2.34 glibc reported cache topology on AMD processors. The campaign consumed $1.18 \times 10^{6}$ CPU-hours. We document the post-processing pipeline and validate the frame transformation and waveforms. Eccentricity is measured from the waveforms and compared against the initial data. The first law of binary black hole mechanics, a test of approximate helical symmetry, is satisfied to better than 0.54% for every configuration with $e_{\omega} < 0.2$, and we show that even precessing systems can be regarded as possessing approximate helical symmetry in the co-precessing frame. Using the aligned-spin simulations to calibrate the numerical floor, the co-precessing approximation's mirror-symmetry violation lies three to four ordersof magnitude above it, growing from 0.7% to 5.3%with opening angle. EccPrecDiff002 spans the band above 5 Hz without hybridisationfor $M \le 62\,M_\odot$, giving a single-interferometer signal-to-noise ratio of 961 in Cosmic Explorer at 1 Gpc.

classification.title_zh: 来自 ICTS-TIFR 的长周期、偏心且进动双黑洞模拟目录
classification.abstract_zh: 本文给出 31 个双黑洞数值相对论模拟目录，使用 Spectral Einstein Code（SpEC）在 ICTS-TIFR 的 Sonic 集群上完成，时间范围 2023 年 8 月至 2024 年 12 月，目标是轨道偏心与自旋-轨道进动同时存在的参数空间。其中 17 个构型同时具有偏心和进动，质量比范围 1≤q≤11，初始偏心率最高达 e0=0.40。最长模拟 EccPrecDiff002 旋进 80 圈（159 个引力波周期），是迄今最长的同时偏心且进动的双黑洞演化。针对 AMD Zen-2 架构的编译期优化使初始数据求解器加速 90%、演化加速 40%，其中约一半演化加速来自 pre-2.34 glibc 缓存拓扑报告缺陷的修复。该项目消耗 1.18×10^6 CPU 小时。文章记录了后处理流程并验证了坐标系变换和波形，偏心率从波形中测量并与初始数据比较。对所有 e_ω<0.2 的构型，双黑洞力学第一定律作为近似螺旋对称性的检验满足优于 0.54%；作者还表明，在共进动坐标系中，进动系统也可视为具有近似螺旋对称性。通过校准数值下限，共进动近似的镜像对称性破坏比下限高三到四个数量级，并随张角从 0.7% 增长到 5.3%。对于 M≤62 M⊙，EccPrecDiff002 无需混合即可覆盖 5 Hz 以上频段，在 1 Gpc 处 Cosmic Explorer 单干涉仪信噪比为 961。

papers.title: Universal Bounds on Black Hole Observables Imposed by Energy Conditions
papers.abstract: Energy conditions (ECs) underpin fundamental results in general relativity, yet their observational validity in strong gravitational fields remains largely untested. Here, we establish a direct correspondence between the local stress-energy tensor, photon-orbit dynamics, and strong-field observables associated with black hole shadows, photon rings, and eikonal gravitational-wave ringdown for static, spherically symmetric black holes within general relativity. We show that imposing local ECs at unstable photon spheres yields analytic bounds on these observables. In particular, the demagnification of successive photon rings provides an exact diagnostic of the local tangential null energy condition. These bounds offer a direct route to constraining the matter fields sourcing spacetimes and testing ECs through strong-field observations. Combining them with observational measurements of these observables further restricts admissible black hole geometries and additionally constrains the otherwise inaccessible photon sphere geometry and local stress-energy content, demonstrating their observational potential in the strong-field regime.

classification.title_zh: 能量条件对黑洞可观测量的普适限制
classification.abstract_zh: 能量条件是广义相对论中许多基本结果的基础，但其在强引力场中的观测有效性仍基本未受检验。本文在广义相对论框架内，针对静态球对称黑洞，建立局部应力能量张量、光子轨道动力学与黑洞阴影、光子环及eikonal引力波铃宕等强场可观测量之间的直接对应。我们表明，在不稳定光子球处施加局部能量条件，会给出这些可观测量的解析限制。特别地，连续光子环的缩倍率提供了局部切向零能量条件的精确诊断。这些限制为约束源时空的物质场、并通过强场观测检验能量条件提供了直接途径。将其与这些可观测量的观测测量相结合，会进一步限制允许的黑洞几何，并额外约束原本不可及的光子球几何与局部应力能量内容，展示其在强场区域的观测潜力。
classification.one_liner: 在静态球对称广义相对论黑洞中，光子球处的局部能量条件给出阴影、光子环和eikonal铃宕的解析普适界限，并可诊断切向零能量条件。
