papers.title: Quasi-normal Modes and Instabilities of Rotating Relativistic Stars
papers.abstract: We derive the basic equations suitable for the coupled fluid--spacetime eigenvalue problem from the second-order action in full general relativity and accurately determine quasi-normal modes of a variety of rapidly rotating stars with outgoing-wave boundary conditions. For MIT-bag strange stars, the spectrum realizes Chandrasekhar's instability picture, with distinct Chandrasekhar--Friedman--Schutz and Jacobi-like neutral conditions and the transition to dynamical bar-mode growth. For neutron stars, we determine the $f$-, $r$-, and other inertial-mode spectra and their radiative damping or growth times. Interactions between $f$- and inertial modes reveal avoided crossings and exchanges for radiative damping or growth rates. We locate quasiradial collapse thresholds through a static stability analysis and independently verify them by tracking the fundamental $F$-mode frequency to zero, clarifying that the central density at the onset of the dynamical instability is always larger than that of the secular instability for uniform rotation. Our formalism and numerical implementation can also resolve highly damped $w$-modes.

classification.title_zh: 旋转相对论性星体的准正规模与不稳定性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们从全广义相对论中的二阶作用量出发，推导适用于耦合流体—时空本征值问题的基本方程，并在出射波边界条件下精确确定多种快速旋转星体的准正规模。对于 MIT 袋模型奇异星，谱表现出 Chandrasekhar 不稳定性图像，具有不同的 Chandrasekhar–Friedman–Schutz 与类 Jacobi 中性条件，并过渡到动力学棒模增长。对于中子星，我们确定 f 模、r 模及其他惯性模谱及其辐射阻尼或增长时标。f 模与惯性模之间的相互作用揭示避免交叉以及辐射阻尼或增长率的交换。我们通过静态稳定性分析定位准径向坍缩阈值，并通过追踪基本 F 模频率至零独立验证这些阈值，澄清在均匀旋转下动力学不稳定性起始时的中心密度总是大于长期不稳定性对应的中心密度。我们的形式体系和数值实现也可分辨高度阻尼的 w 模。

papers.title: Kerr metric perturbations in Lorenz gauge via numerical relativity methods
papers.abstract: Gravitational self-force calculations are needed to accurately describe the motion of a small body in a spinning (Kerr) black hole spacetime, which is vital to predict gravitational wave signals from asymmetric-mass compact binaries. Accurate calculations for the upcoming LISA mission require a minimum of second perturbative order in the mass ratio, which has thus far only been achieved for nonspinning (Schwarzschild) black holes due to nonlinear complexities of the Einstein equations. In this work, we calculate Kerr metric perturbations with a new computational approach based on numerical relativity methods, extending recent scalar self-force results to full general relativity. We formulate the perturbative Lorenz-gauge Einstein equations in terms of azimuthal $m$-modes in the frequency domain and solve the resulting elliptic partial differential equations using a spectral discontinuous Galerkin discretization, adaptive mesh refinement, and preconditioned iterative solvers. With our new method, we achieve exponentially convergent first-order gravitational self-force calculations for circular equatorial orbits in Kerr spacetime up to spin $|a|/M=0.998$ (the Thorne limit). Our framework is designed to carry over to second order by delivering accurate and well-behaved first-order data for nonlinear source construction, and as a solver for the second-order metric perturbations themselves.

classification.title_zh: 用数值相对论方法计算Lorenz规范下的Kerr度规扰动
classification.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于数值相对论的新计算框架，用于计算Kerr时空中的度规扰动，以支持引力自作用力计算。作者将Lorenz规范下的微扰Einstein方程按方位角m模式在频域表述，并用谱间断Galerkin离散、自适应网格加密和预条件迭代求解器求解所得椭圆偏微分方程。该方法对Kerr时空中圆赤道轨道实现指数收敛的一阶引力自作用力计算，自旋可达|a|/M=0.998（Thorne极限）。该框架设计为可推广到二阶：为一阶数据用于非线性源构造提供准确且良态的结果，并可作为二阶度规扰动的求解器。
classification.one_liner: 提出基于数值相对论的谱方法，在Lorenz规范下计算Kerr度规扰动并实现近极限自旋的一阶引力自作用力。

papers.title: Dirac stars in Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg theory
papers.abstract: We study self-gravitating configurations of a charged classical spinor field coupled to gravity and to Euler-Heisenberg (EH) nonlinear electrodynamics, truncated at quartic order. The spinor is gauged under a U(1) field and may carry a quartic self-interaction. For static and spherically symmetric configurations we derive the field equations, reduce them to a dimensionless eigenvalue problem for the spinor frequency and solve it numerically. In the uncharged limit our solutions coincide with the known Dirac stars of general relativity. The electric charge increases the frequency, the mass and the size of the stars, and the maximal mass grows from $0.709$ to $1.027$ (in units of $M_{\rm Pl}^2/\mu$) when the charge coupling rises from zero to $0.75$. The quartic term changes the relation between the electric field and the enclosed charge, so that the field inside the star is weaker than in the Maxwell case. Our central result concerns stars with the same number of fermions, and therefore the same total charge. For them the quartic term changes the mass by less than $0.2\%$, but it makes the stars more compact and more strongly bound and shifts the turning point of the family to a smaller particle number. This shift is what lowers the maximal mass, by $9\%$ (from $0.924$ to $0.840$) at charge coupling $0.6$ as the dimensionless EH coupling goes from zero to $200$. In the weak-field regime of quantum electrodynamics (QED) the relative mass correction is $-1.5\times10^{-5}(E_{\max}/E_c)^2$, so the larger couplings describe the quartic model as an effective nonlinear electrodynamics rather than a controlled QED correction. All solutions satisfy the null, weak, strong and dominant energy conditions, show a positive pressure anisotropy, and remain free of horizons. Their stability is discussed through the binding energy and the turning point of the mass curve.

classification.title_zh: 爱因斯坦-欧拉-海森堡理论中的狄拉克星
classification.abstract_zh: 研究了带电经典旋量场与引力及截断至四阶的欧拉-海森堡非线性电动力学耦合的自引力位形。旋量场带 U(1) 规范荷，并可含四阶自相互作用。针对静态球对称位形导出场方程，将其约化为旋量频率的无量纲本征值问题并数值求解。无电荷极限下与已知广义相对论狄拉克星一致。电荷增大会提高频率、质量和尺寸；当电荷耦合从 0 增至 0.75 时，最大质量从 0.709 增至 1.027（以 M_Pl^2/μ 为单位）。四阶项改变电场与包围电荷的关系，使星体内部场弱于麦克斯韦情形。核心结果是：对具有相同费米子数因而相同总电荷的星体，四阶项使质量改变小于 0.2%，但使星体更致密、束缚更强，并把族转折点移到更小粒子数；在电荷耦合 0.6、无量纲 EH 耦合从 0 到 200 时，这一移动使最大质量降低 9%（从 0.924 到 0.840）。在 QED 弱场区，相对质量修正为 -1.5×10^-5(E_max/E_c)^2，因此较大耦合对应的是把四阶模型作为有效非线性电动力学，而非受控 QED 修正。所有解满足零、弱、强和主导能量条件，呈现正的压力各向异性，且无事件视界。通过束缚能和质量曲线转折点讨论了稳定性。
classification.one_liner: 数值构造了爱因斯坦-欧拉-海森堡非线性电动力学中的带电狄拉克星，并分析电荷与四阶非线性项对质量、致密度和稳定性的影响。

papers.title: Full-Stokes response to a stochastic gravitational-wave background in pulsar timing arrays: Fully analytic overlap reduction functions at finite distance and coherence of close pulsar pairs
papers.abstract: We derive fully analytic overlap reduction functions for the full-Stokes response of a pulsar timing array to an anisotropic tensor gravitational-wave background in general relativity. The response retains both pulsar distances and their complete propagation phases. At each fixed finite sky multipole, the intensity and circular polarization responses reduce to finite combinations involving exponential integrals and logarithms, while the electric and magnetic linear polarization responses require only elementary functions. We evaluate all components through $\ell=8$. Symmetry separates exact nulls from additional Earth-term nulls that propagation can lift. Even an unpolarized background can produce an imaginary cross-spectrum. For a pair with three-dimensional separation $d$, the pulsar terms can remain coherent when $2\pi fd/c\lesssim1$, even if both pulsars are many wavelengths from Earth. A uniform approximation retaining all four Earth and pulsar terms connects this regime to the short-wavelength limit, and a rotationally invariant relation fixes the leading transverse magnetic response. Common-distance errors cancel from the aligned pair phase, while relative-depth errors directly affect coherence. Under Gaussian differential averaging, fixed low-multipole norms and the squared norm summed over all multipoles decay at different rates as the response shifts to higher multipoles. Published pulsar configurations illustrate the roles of distance accuracy, bandwidth, and timing fits. At fixed pointwise intensity, a polarization covariance bound and a relative-depth noise budget quantify when differencing suppresses the background. Independent sky integration and matched-accuracy benchmarks test the analytic expressions over the parameter ranges studied.

classification.title_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列对随机引力波背景的全斯托克斯响应：有限距离下完全解析重叠约化函数与近脉冲星对相干性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在广义相对论中推导了脉冲星计时阵列对各向异性张量随机引力波背景全斯托克斯响应的完全解析重叠约化函数。响应保留脉冲星距离及其完整传播相位。在每个固定有限天球多极，强度与圆偏振响应化为涉及指数积分与对数的有限组合，而电、磁线偏振响应仅需初等函数。我们计算到 ℓ=8。对称性区分精确零点与传播可抬升的额外地球项零点。即使非偏振背景也能产生虚交叉谱。对于三维间距为 d 的脉冲星对，当 2π f d/c ≲ 1 时，脉冲星项可保持相干，即使两颗脉冲星距地球很多波长。保留全部四个地球项和脉冲星项的均匀近似将该区域与短波极限连接起来，旋转不变关系固定领头横向磁响应。共同距离误差从对齐对相位中抵消，相对深度误差直接影响相干性。在高斯差分平均下，固定低多极范数与全多极平方和随响应移向高多极以不同速率衰减。已发表脉冲星构型说明距离精度、带宽和计时拟合的作用。在固定逐点强度下，偏振协方差界与相对深度噪声预算量化差分何时抑制背景。独立天空积分与匹配精度基准在研究所覆盖参数范围内检验解析表达式。
classification.one_liner: 推导脉冲星计时阵列对随机张量引力波背景全斯托克斯响应的有限距离解析重叠约化函数，并分析近脉冲星对相干性、偏振与误差预算。

papers.title: Excitation factors and exceptional points of Kerr--Newman quasinormal modes
papers.abstract: We study excitation factors and investigate exceptional points (EPs) of Kerr--Newman quasinormal modes using the exact separated gravitoelectromagnetic equations. At fixed charge, the magnitudes of the excitation factors for the gravitational-led modes studied here decrease with increasing spin, whereas those for electromagnetic-led modes exhibit both monotonic and nonmonotonic behavior. The magnitude of the excitation factor for the first overtone can be comparable to or larger than that for the fundamental mode. We identify 42 EPs at which pairs of modes coalesce in the gravitational-led and electromagnetic-led sectors. Some EPs form sequences involving successive overtone pairs, with higher-overtone pairs coalescing progressively closer to the extremal limit. The additional EPs identified outside these sequences all share the same mode-pair labels as sequence members, but occur at different values of the black hole spin and charge. These findings clarify how rotation and charge shape the relative excitation strengths of different modes and the pattern of mode coalescence in the non-Hermitian spectrum of Kerr--Newman black holes.

classification.title_zh: Kerr-Newman 准正规模的激发因子与例外点
classification.abstract_zh: 本文利用精确分离的引力电磁方程研究 Kerr-Newman 准正规模的激发因子，并考察其例外点（EPs）。在固定电荷下，所研究的引力主导模式的激发因子幅度随自旋增大而减小，而电磁主导模式则呈现单调与非单调行为。第一泛音模式的激发因子幅度可与基模相当甚至更大。我们在引力主导和电磁主导扇区中识别出 42 个模式对发生并合的例外点。部分例外点形成涉及相邻泛音对的序列，较高泛音对并合的位置逐渐更接近极端极限。这些序列之外识别出的其他例外点均与序列成员具有相同的模式对标签，但出现在不同的黑洞自旋与电荷取值处。这些结果阐明了旋转与电荷如何塑造不同模式的相对激发强度，以及 Kerr-Newman 黑洞非厄米谱中的模式并合图样。
classification.one_liner: 利用精确分离方程计算 Kerr-Newman 准正规模的激发因子，并识别出 42 个模式并合例外点及其随自旋、电荷变化的图样。

papers.title: Scale-Dependent Weak-Field Dynamics in Horndeski Theory: Galaxy Rotation Curves and Turnaround Scales
papers.abstract: In this work, the weak-field dynamics of a gravitational-wave compatible subclass of Horndeski gravity is investigated on galactic and intergalactic scales. The analysis is performed within the weak-field approximation for stationary and approximately spherically symmetric configurations, retaining the nonlinear scalar derivative interactions responsible for scale-dependent modifications of the gravitational field. On galactic scales, the transition regime is investigated through the effective potential, the stability of circular orbits, galaxy rotation curves, and the relation between dynamical and lensing masses. The analysis shows that the scalar field modifies the orbital dynamics and the radial dependence of the rotational velocity, while generating a nonvanishing gravitational slip between the dynamical and lensing mass estimates. On intergalactic scales, the asymptotic weak-field dynamics is investigated and a turnaround scale is derived from the balance between the effective gravitational attraction and the large-scale curvature contribution. At large distances, the asymptotic gravitational field is governed by the background curvature contribution.

classification.title_zh: Horndeski 理论中的尺度依赖弱场动力学：星系旋转曲线与折返尺度
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在星系和星系际尺度研究 Horndeski 引力中与引力波相容的一个子类的弱场动力学。分析在弱场近似下针对静态且近似球对称的位形进行，保留导致引力场尺度依赖修改的非线性标量导数相互作用。在星系尺度，通过有效势、圆轨道稳定性、星系旋转曲线以及动力学质量与透镜质量之间的关系研究过渡区域。分析表明，标量场修改轨道动力学和旋转速度的径向依赖，同时在动力学质量与透镜质量估计之间产生非零引力滑移。在星系际尺度，研究渐近弱场动力学，并由有效引力吸引与大尺度曲率贡献之间的平衡导出折返尺度。在大距离上，渐近引力场由背景曲率贡献主导。
classification.one_liner: Horndeski 弱场中的尺度依赖修正改变星系旋转曲线并导出折返尺度。

papers.title: A Unified AI Framework for Rapid and Accurate Waveform Generation of Compact Binary Coalescences
papers.abstract: The astrophysical discovery potential of future gravitational wave detectors will hinge on accurate and rapid waveform generation. Third generation detectors are expected to observe many long duration compact binary coalescence signals that can probe binary formation and evolution as well as the nature of matter under extreme conditions. We develop a unified framework that combines physical modeling with deep learning. The framework uses an analytic residual spectral representation, shared learning, and decoders for each binary type. It generates waveforms for binary black holes, binary neutron stars, and neutron star black hole binaries, providing a single unified generator for all compact binary coalescences. The generated waveforms include the physical effects described by each reference model, such as spin precession, higher order modes, matter effects, and postmerger radiation for binary neutron stars. The waveforms span hundreds to thousands of cycles, with mean mismatches ranging from $5.89\times10^{-4}$ to $5.34\times10^{-2}$ relative to the reference waveforms. Batch generation achieves a maximum speedup of about 1800 over reference waveform generation.

classification.title_zh: 用于致密双星并合快速准确波形生成的统一AI框架
classification.abstract_zh: 未来引力波探测器的天体物理发现潜力取决于准确且快速的波形生成。第三代探测器预计将观测到许多长持续时间的致密双星并合信号，这些信号可探测双星形成与演化以及极端条件下的物质性质。我们开发了一个将物理建模与深度学习相结合的统一框架。该框架使用解析残差谱表示、共享学习以及针对每种双星类型的解码器。它为双黑洞、双中子星和中子星-黑洞双星生成波形，为所有致密双星并合提供单一统一生成器。生成的波形包含各参考模型所描述的物理效应，如自旋进动、高阶模式、物质效应以及双中子星的并合后辐射。波形跨越数百到数千个周期，相对于参考波形的平均失配范围为5.89×10^-4到5.34×10^-2。批量生成相对于参考波形生成实现最高约1800倍加速。
classification.one_liner: 提出一个结合物理建模与深度学习的统一框架，用于快速、准确地生成黑洞、中子星及混合双星并合的引力波波形。

papers.title: On Isaacson's Procedure in $f(R)$-Gravity with Second Order Metric Perturbations
papers.abstract: In the recent paper arXiv:2504.02253 we generalized classical Isaacson's procedure for describing back-reaction of the averaged energy-momentum for high frequency gravitational waves to $f(R)$ gravity case with a choice of the de Sitter background. To describe this second order effect we used standard first order decomposition of metric tensor. In this paper, we take into account possible contribution to this process from second order term in metric tensor decomposition. We find that on the de Sitter background all possible contributions from this term are strongly suppressed and therefore results obtained in the paper arXiv:2504.02253 are left unchanged.

classification.title_zh: 关于二阶度规扰动下 f(R) 引力中的 Isaacson 程序
classification.abstract_zh: 在近期论文 arXiv:2504.02253 中，我们将用于描述高频引力波平均能量动量反作用的经典 Isaacson 程序推广到选取 de Sitter 背景的 f(R) 引力情形。为描述该二阶效应，我们使用了度规张量的标准一阶分解。本文考虑度规张量分解中的二阶项对该过程可能带来的贡献。我们发现，在 de Sitter 背景上，该二阶项的所有可能贡献都被强烈抑制，因此 arXiv:2504.02253 中得到的结果保持不变。
classification.one_liner: 在 de Sitter 背景的 f(R) 引力中检验 Isaacson 程序的二阶度规扰动贡献，发现其被强烈抑制而不改变先前结果。

papers.title: Imaginary Time as a Complex Representation of Relativity
papers.abstract: We develop a systematic complex representation of Lorentzian relativity based on the imaginary temporal coordinate $X^0=ict$. Rather than treating this substitution as a Wick rotation to Euclidean spacetime, we formulate it as an invertible change of representation in which physical spacetime is identified with a real subspace of a complex vector space. This construction introduces two related metric structures: a complex-bilinear form and a Hermitian form, both of which reproduce the original Lorentzian interval when restricted to physical spacetime. We extend the representation to relativistic dynamics, including proper time, four-momentum, and the Hamilton-Jacobi formulation, and show that the metric, connection, curvature tensors, Einstein equations, and conservation laws retain their conventional content in curved spacetime. Explicit applications to the Kerr and Friedmann-Lema\^itre-Robertson-Walker geometries demonstrate consistency for rotating and time-dependent spacetimes. We further examine relativistic wave equations and their nonrelativistic limit, showing how the Schr\"odinger equation and its relation to Euclidean-time evolution emerge within the same complex temporal framework. The resulting formulation introduces no new physical predictions, but clarifies the geometric role of imaginary temporal coordinates and reveals structural connections among relativistic geometry, action, wave propagation, and analytic continuation.

classification.title_zh: 虚时间作为相对论的复表示
classification.abstract_zh: 本文以虚时间坐标 X^0=ict 为基础，系统发展洛伦兹相对论的复表示。作者不把它视为到欧氏时空的 Wick 旋转，而是视为可逆的表示变换，将物理时空识别为复向量空间的实子空间；构造复双线性型与 Hermitian 型两种度规结构，并说明它们在物理时空上的限制均回到原洛伦兹间隔。文章把该表示推广到固有时间、四动量和 Hamilton-Jacobi 形式，并说明度规、联络、曲率张量、Einstein 方程与守恒律在弯曲时空中保持通常内容；通过对 Kerr 与 FLRW 几何的显式应用验证旋转及时变时空中的一致性。最后讨论相对论波动方程及其非相对论极限，说明 Schrödinger 方程和欧氏时间演化如何在同一复时间框架中出现。该表述不引入新物理预言，但澄清虚时间坐标的几何角色，并揭示相对论几何、作用量、波传播与解析延拓之间的结构联系。
classification.one_liner: 将 X^0=ict 表述为洛伦兹相对论的可逆复表示，并验证其在弯曲时空与相对论波动方程中的一致性。

papers.title: Multimessenger astrophysics drives the case for an Australian Gravitational-Wave observatory
papers.abstract: The next generation of an international network of gravitational-wave observatories is now in the advanced planning stages. With Australia's substantial history of contributions in this field, its history of scientific mega-projects like the Square Kilometer Array, and its unique geographic location and conditions, it is ideally placed to host an observatory in the global network. It has already been demonstrated that a gravitational wave detector in Australia plays an important role in minimizing the sky localization uncertainty of gravitational wave events. We study a particular science case for an Australian observatory, focusing on its potential contributions to multimessenger astronomy. We demonstrate that an observatory in Australia can enable the detection of up to eight multimessenger gravitational-wave plus kilonova events per year, with localisations better than $1-10\deg^2$ in both second- and third-generation networks. We show that, in a global network of XG observatories, an Australian observatory with 2G sensitivity would still enable significant advances in multimessenger science. The full case for an Australian observatory must be considered in a much broader context; however, this work indicates it could make substantial contributions to multimessenger astrophysics.

classification.title_zh: 多信使天体物理推动澳大利亚引力波天文台的建设论证
classification.abstract_zh: 下一代国际引力波天文台网络正处于高级规划阶段。鉴于澳大利亚在该领域的长期贡献、参与平方公里阵列等大型科学项目的经验以及独特的地理位置和条件，它非常适合在全球网络中承办一座天文台。已有研究表明，位于澳大利亚的引力波探测器在减小引力波事件天区定位不确定性方面发挥重要作用。我们研究澳大利亚天文台的一个具体科学案例，聚焦其对多信使天文学的潜在贡献。我们证明，澳大利亚天文台在第二代和第三代网络中均能以优于1-10平方度的定位精度，使每年最多探测到八次引力波加千新星的多信使事件。我们还表明，在全球第三代/XG天文台网络中，一座具有第二代灵敏度的澳大利亚天文台仍能显著推动多信使科学发展。澳大利亚天文台的完整论证需在更广泛背景下考虑；但本工作表明它可为多信使天体物理作出实质性贡献。
classification.one_liner: 该文论证澳大利亚引力波天文台可提升多信使引力波-千新星事件的探测率与定位精度。

papers.title: Kerr metric perturbations for second-order self-force theory
papers.abstract: We present a calculation of the first-order metric perturbation arising from a point mass moving on a circular, equatorial orbit in Kerr spacetime. The metric perturbation is specifically aimed at meeting the requirements of second-order self-force theory: it is highly accurate; incorporates all contributions, including those associated with perturbations to the black hole's mass and angular momentum; is in Lorenz gauge near the worldline and in (near) Bondi--Sachs gauge at large radius; and can be efficiently evaluated across the entire exterior spacetime. The Lorenz gauge gives a well-understood singular structure at the particle, while the (near) Bondi--Sachs gauge ensures the asymptotic fall-off needed for an asymptotically flat second-order source. Our formalism reconstructs the metric from separable Teukolsky-type equations, decomposed into spin-weighted spheroidal harmonic modes and solved spectrally on hyperboloidal slices. The resulting $(\ell,m)$-mode sums converge rapidly across most of the domain, but slowly near the point mass; we overcome this with a novel use of a puncture to extract accurate $m$-mode data, yielding output accurate to $\sim 10^{-10}$ per $m$-mode and suitable for use at second order. Our metric-perturbation results cover a range of Kerr spins $-0.9 \le a/M \le 0.9$ and orbital radii out to $50M$. In addition to its immediate application in second-order self-force calculations, our results can also be used as input to other calculations involving Kerr metric perturbations, including studies of environmental effects and quasinormal modes.

classification.title_zh: 用于二阶自作用理论的Kerr度规微扰
classification.abstract_zh: 我们计算了Kerr时空中沿圆轨道、赤道面运动的点质量所产生的一阶度规微扰。该微扰专门面向二阶自作用理论的要求：高精度；包含所有贡献，包括与黑洞质量和角动量微扰相关的贡献；在世界线附近为Lorenz规范，在大半径处为（近）Bondi-Sachs规范；并可在整个外部时空高效求值。Lorenz规范在粒子处给出易于理解的奇异结构，而（近）Bondi-Sachs规范确保渐近平直二阶源所需的渐近衰减。我们的形式从可分离的Teukolsky型方程重构度规，分解为自旋加权球谐模式，并在双曲切片上谱求解。所得(ℓ,m)模式和在大部分区域快速收敛，但在点质量附近收敛缓慢；我们通过新颖地使用puncture提取精确m模式数据来克服这一点，输出每m模式精度约1e-10，适用于二阶。结果覆盖Kerr自旋-0.9≤a/M≤0.9和轨道半径至50M。除直接用于二阶自作用计算外，结果还可作为其他涉及Kerr度规微扰计算的输入，包括环境效应和准正规模研究。

papers.title: Multi-domain spectral method for Kerr spacetimes: a hyperboloidal Teukolsky $m$-mode solver for self-force computations
papers.abstract: We solve the frequency-domain, $m$-mode Teukolsky equation for the spin-weight $s=-2$ Weyl scalar $\psi_4$ sourced by a point mass on a circular, equatorial orbit around a Kerr black hole. The equation is posed on hyperboloidal slices that reach the event horizon and future null infinity, so that the physical (retarded) solution is selected by regularity alone, without imposing radiation conditions. The particle is treated with the $m$-mode puncture/effective-source scheme, and the resulting two-dimensional elliptic problem is solved with a four-domain pseudo-spectral method in which the equatorial symmetry is broken and handled by an even/odd decomposition of the field. We test the method for orbital radius $r_0=10M$ and spins up to $|a|/M=0.9$, covering prograde and retrograde orbits. The energy fluxes to infinity agree with independent Black Hole Perturbation Toolkit results to $\sim10^{-7}$ for the dominant modes and to better than $2\times10^{-5}$ for all modes up to $m=20$ at moderate resolutions. The static $m=0$ mode requires no special treatment.

classification.title_zh: Kerr时空的多域谱方法：用于自力计算的双曲型Teukolsky m模式求解器
classification.abstract_zh: 本文求解频率域m模式Teukolsky方程，针对Kerr黑洞周围圆轨道、赤道面点质量源产生的自旋权重s=-2 Weyl标量ψ4。方程定义在到达事件视界和未来零无穷的双曲型切片上，因此仅靠正则性即可选出物理的推迟解，无需施加辐射条件。粒子采用m模式puncture/有效源方案处理，所得二维椭圆问题用四域伪谱方法求解，并通过场的偶/奇分解处理被打破的赤道对称性。作者在轨道半径r0=10M、自旋至|a|/M=0.9（包括顺行和逆行轨道）下测试方法。至无穷远的能量通量与独立Black Hole Perturbation Toolkit结果在主导模式上约一致到10^-7，在中等分辨率下对所有m≤20模式优于2×10^-5；静态m=0模式无需特殊处理。
classification.one_liner: 提出并验证了双曲型切片上的多域谱Teukolsky m模式求解器，用于Kerr黑洞自力计算。

papers.title: Reference-renormalized Jacobi primitives for finite-distance massive-particle deflection
papers.abstract: We develop a reference-renormalized Jacobi-primitive Gauss-Bonnet formalism for finite-distance weak deflection of massive particles in static, spherically symmetric spacetimes. The construction uses the fixed-energy Jacobi metric associated with timelike geodesics and treats the radial curvature primitive as a quantity defined only up to an additive constant. Instead of fixing this constant by requiring the primitive to vanish at a circular timelike orbit, we subtract a reference Jacobi geometry at the same conserved particle energy and impose endpoint normalization on the curvature-density discrepancy. This gives a circular-orbit-free primitive representation of the Gauss-Bonnet curvature contribution while preserving the operational finite-distance definition of the bending angle through local source and receiver directions. We prove that the reference-normalized and circular-orbit-normalized prescriptions agree whenever both are admissible, since their primitives differ only by a constant that cancels from the exact curvature strip integral. The method remains applicable when no admissible circular timelike orbit exists, when the orbit lies outside the Riemannian Jacobi domain, or when the natural no-lens comparison geometry is non-Euclidean. We demonstrate the formalism in three representative settings: Schwarzschild-like bumblebee, Kottler, and Janis-Newman-Winicour (JNW) spacetimes. The formalism therefore identifies circular-orbit anchoring as an auxiliary primitive gauge choice rather than a prerequisite for finite-distance Jacobi Gauss-Bonnet deflection.

classification.title_zh: 有限距离大质量粒子偏折的参考重正化雅可比原函数
classification.abstract_zh: 本文为静态球对称时空中大质量粒子的有限距离弱偏折建立了参考重正化的雅可比原函数高斯-博内形式。构造基于与类时测地线相关的固定能量雅可比度规，并将径向曲率原函数视为仅定义到相加常数的量。作者不通过在类时圆轨道处令原函数为零来固定常数，而是在相同守恒粒子能量下减去参考雅可比几何，并对曲率密度差施加端点归一化。这给出了不依赖圆轨道的原函数表示，同时保留由局部源和接收方向定义的有限距离偏折角操作定义。作者证明当两种处方均可适用时，参考归一化与圆轨道归一化一致，因为其原函数仅差一个在精确曲率条带积分中抵消的常数。该方法适用于不存在可容许类时圆轨道、轨道位于黎曼雅可比区域之外、或自然无透镜比较几何非欧几里得的情形。文中在 Schwarzschild-like bumblebee、Kottler 和 JNW 时空中展示了该形式。该形式表明圆轨道锚定是辅助的原函数规范选择，而非有限距离雅可比高斯-博内偏折的前提。

papers.title: Quasinormal-mode encounters: Pseudospectra near Kerr--Newman exceptional points
papers.abstract: Exceptional points (EPs), at which two quasinormal frequencies and their eigenvectors coalesce, can enhance the spectral instability of black hole quasinormal modes. We investigate this behavior in Kerr--Newman spacetimes through pseudospectra and condition numbers for neutral massless scalar fields and coupled gravitoelectromagnetic (GE) perturbations. For the scalar field, we follow the $(\ell,m)=(1,1)$ spheroidal branch and derive the energy norm from the stress-energy tensor. For GE perturbations, we use a coupled four-field system equipped with a positive radiative energy. Along matched parameter paths toward the selected EPs, the frequency splitting follows a square-root law and the condition numbers grow as the inverse square root of the distance to the EP. Their product, which approximates the norm of the double-pole coefficient, does not depend on the offset or, for GE, on the angular truncation and projection used. The pseudospectral contours resolve the transition from individual-mode sensitivity to the collective response of the pair. At the selected backgrounds and resolution, both pair members are more sensitive than two more-damped modes at the same background, but this ordering holds only below a crossover offset that decreases with radial resolution. For the GE pair, angular refinement also displaces the coalescence by more than the selected offset. Within the discretized problems and energy norms considered here, these results describe qualitative trends of spectral instability near EPs rather than continuum magnitudes, and motivate further study of their possible role in black-hole ringdown.

classification.title_zh: 准正规模相遇：Kerr–Newman 例外点附近的伪谱
classification.abstract_zh: 例外点（EP）是准正规模频率及其本征向量合并的点，可增强黑洞准正规模的谱不稳定性。本文通过伪谱和条件数研究 Kerr–Newman 时空中无质量中性标量场以及耦合引电磁（GE）扰动的这种行为。对标量场，作者沿 (ℓ,m)=(1,1) 椭球分支并由应力-能量张量导出能量范数；对 GE 扰动，使用具有正辐射能量的耦合四场系统。沿匹配参数路径趋近所选 EP 时，频率劈裂遵循平方根规律，条件数按到 EP 距离的负平方根增长；二者乘积近似双极点系数范数，不依赖偏移量，对 GE 也不依赖所用角向截断和投影。伪谱等值线分辨出从单模敏感性到模式对集体响应的转变。在所选背景和分辨率下，模式对两个成员比同一背景中两个更阻尼的模式更敏感，但这种排序仅在低于某个交叉偏移时成立，且该偏移随径向分辨率降低。对 GE 模式对，角向细化还会使合并位置移动超过所选偏移。本文强调，在所考虑的离散化问题和能量范数内，这些结果描述 EP 附近谱不稳定性的定性趋势而非连续谱幅度，并推动进一步研究其在黑洞铃宕中的可能作用。

papers.title: Constraints on the number of inner horizons from gravitational Noether charges
papers.abstract: A central question in the study of black hole interiors is how matter and geometry constrain the number of horizons. In Einstein gravity, one known method is to use the ADM decomposition of the field equations to derive a differential inequality for the lapse, which then constrains the possible existence of multiple inner horizons. We show that the same obstruction can instead be formulated through the Komar integral as a bulk-boundary balance of gravitational Noether charge. In higher-curvature gravity, a direct ADM analysis becomes more complicated, whereas the gravitational Noether charge naturally retains this bulk-boundary structure. We naturally apply the gravitational Noether charge analysis to Lovelock gravity. We introduce a TCC-like curvature condition and prove that, together with the thermodynamically motivated assumption of positive Wald entropy, it allows at most one nondegenerate inner Killing horizon inside a nondegenerate event horizon. This suggests that the obstruction reflects a compatibility between bulk gravitational response and horizon thermodynamics.

classification.title_zh: 引力Noether荷对内部视界数目的限制
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞内部研究的一个核心问题是物质和几何如何限制视界数目。在Einstein引力中，一种已知方法是利用场方程的ADM分解导出关于lapse的微分不等式，从而限制多个内部视界的可能存在。我们表明，同样的阻碍可以用Komar积分表述为引力Noether荷的体-边平衡。在高阶曲率引力中，直接的ADM分析变得更复杂，而引力Noether荷自然保留这种体-边结构。我们将引力Noether荷分析自然应用于Lovelock引力，引入一个类TCC的曲率条件，并证明它与热力学动机的正Wald熵假设一起，允许在非退化事件视界内至多存在一个非退化内部Killing视界。这表明该阻碍反映了体引力响应与视界热力学之间的相容性。

papers.title: Black hole free energy landscapes from constrained instantons
papers.abstract: We apply gravitational path integral factorization to provide a semiclassical interpretation of generalized black hole free energy landscapes at fixed external temperature and angular velocities. Boundary integral transforms express the formal partition function as an integral over constrained sectors labeled by complete local partial-Neumann data on an auxiliary hypersurface. Independent variation establishes paired regular subregion solutions as constrained instantons, with Lagrange multipliers supporting lapse and tangential shift jumps that accommodate thermal and rotational mismatches. For selected nonextremal stationary families with an asymptotic boundary, the constrained saddle action takes the form $I_{\rm constr}=\beta\mathcal F_{\rm gen}=\beta(E_{\mathcal B}-\Omega_{\mathcal B}^{I}J_{\mathcal B,I})-S$, with $\beta=T^{-1}$. Here $E_{\mathcal B}$ and $J_{\mathcal B,I}$ are renormalized Hamiltonian charges and $S$ is the black hole entropy, whose contribution to the action comes from the regular horizon cap. Interior stationary points of the landscape correspond to smooth equilibrium saddles when the retained variations independently span the entropy and angular momentum directions. We extend the construction to local, parity-even $f(\mathrm{Riemann})$ theories without curvature derivatives by retaining the complete auxiliary interface data. The same thermodynamic form follows with Wald entropy, without a small-deficit expansion. Schwarzschild and Kerr black holes illustrate the Einstein construction, while five-dimensional static AdS black holes in Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet gravity and the rotating BTZ branch of new massive gravity provide explicit checks of the higher-curvature extension.

classification.title_zh: 来自约束瞬子的黑洞自由能景观
classification.abstract_zh: 我们应用引力路径积分分解，为固定外部温度和角速度下的广义黑洞自由能景观提供半经典解释。边界积分变换将形式配分函数表示为对约束扇区的积分，这些扇区由辅助超曲面上的完备局部 partial-Neumann 数据标记。独立变分确立成对的正则子区域解作为约束瞬子，其拉格朗日乘子支持时间流逝和切向位移的跳跃，以容纳热失配和转动失配。对于若干具有渐近边界的非极端定常族，约束鞍点作用量取 I_constr=β F_gen=β(E_B - Ω_B^I J_{B,I}) - S 的形式，其中 β=T^{-1}。这里 E_B 和 J_{B,I} 是重整化哈密顿荷，S 是黑洞熵，其对作用量的贡献来自正则视界帽。当保留的变分独立张成熵和角动量方向时，景观的内部驻点对应于光滑平衡鞍点。我们通过保留完整的辅助界面数据，将构造推广到无曲率导数的局部宇称偶 f(Riemann) 理论。相同热力学形式在 Wald 熵下成立，且不需要小亏缺展开。Schwarzschild 和 Kerr 黑洞说明 Einstein 构造，而 Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet 引力中的五维静态 AdS 黑洞和 new massive gravity 的转动 BTZ 分支为高阶曲率推广提供显式检验。

papers.title: Axial-metric/polar-gauge perturbations of the Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov wormhole
papers.abstract: We study linear perturbations of the Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov (MMP) wormhole in the parity sector pairing axial metric and polar gauge perturbations. The lowest Landau level (LLL) of the fermions responds through its charge. Its exact Schwinger current gives the longitudinal electric field the MMP screening mass $m_S^2=\alpha q^2$, and the axial metric perturbation shifts the worldsheet gauge field of every LLL state at relative order $l(l+1)/q$. We assume that the Casimir stress tensor follows the tilting field lines. Force balance and charge conservation then fix a polarisation current, the counterpart of the polar Hall current, up to self-conserved currents. The higher Landau levels enter through the one-loop Euler-Heisenberg action, to first order in $\eta_{\rm H}=g_c^2/12\pi^2$. Virtual transitions to them could enter at the order of the $l(l+1)/q$ shift and are not estimated. At first order in the fermion backreaction $\alpha$ the system reduces to three coupled master equations in closed form, and mouth and throat match. Consistency does not select the fermion constitutive relation. Among local closures without derivatives, covariance fixes it up to one kernel. At $\alpha=0$ the throat has a screened, a light massive and a massless neutral channel, and the Schwinger response already breaks the isospectrality of the two parities. The higher levels raise the squared light mass by $\eta_{\rm H}l(l+1)$ in AdS$_2$ units and break it further. At the formal point $m_S^2=0$ the massive channels have real $O(\alpha)$ shifts on every closed-throat level, as does the light channel at the physical $m_S^2$ on every level below the screened channel. The neutral channel has an exact zero-energy solution, a persistent current along the field lines, which the $O(\alpha)$ mouth terms and the higher levels leave intact. Finite-element runs find no bound state below it, and its stability is open.

classification.title_zh: Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov 虫洞的轴度规/极规范扰动
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov（MMP）虫洞在将轴度规扰动与极规范扰动配对的宇称扇区中的线性扰动。费米子最低朗道能级（LLL）通过其电荷响应；其精确 Schwinger 电流使纵向电场获得 MMP 屏蔽质量 m_S^2=αq^2，而轴度规扰动以相对阶 l(l+1)/q 移动每个 LLL 态的世界面规范场。我们假设 Casimir 应力张量跟随倾斜的场线。力平衡与电荷守恒随后将极化电流（极霍尔电流的对应物）确定到自守恒电流为止。更高朗道能级通过一阶 η_H=g_c^2/12π^2 的单圈 Euler-Heisenberg 作用进入；向这些能级的虚跃迁可能以 l(l+1)/q 移动的阶进入，但未作估计。在费米子背反 α 的一阶，系统化为三个闭式耦合主方程，且口部与喉部匹配。一致性并不选择费米子本构关系；在无导数的局部闭合中，协变性将其固定到一个核。α=0 时，喉部有一个被屏蔽道、一个轻质量道和一个无质量中性道，且 Schwinger 响应已经破坏两种宇称的等谱性。更高能级在 AdS2 单位下将轻质量平方提高 η_H l(l+1)，并进一步破坏等谱性。在形式点 m_S^2=0，有质量道在每个闭喉能级上具有实的 O(α) 移动；轻道在物理 m_S^2 下、在屏蔽道以下的每个能级上也如此。中性道具有精确的零能解，即沿场线的持续电流，O(α) 口部项与更高能级均使其保持不变。有限元计算未发现其下方存在束缚态，其稳定性仍待研究。

papers.title: Polar-metric/axial-gauge perturbations of the Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov wormhole
papers.abstract: We study linear perturbations of the Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov traversable wormhole in the sector where polar metric perturbations couple to axial gauge perturbations, and reduce it to two coupled master equations of Zerilli-Moncrief type. In the throat the Casimir energy of the lowest Landau level of charged fermions holds the wormhole open, and the linearised Bianchi identities hold only if the fermions respond. Once their state is fixed, their two-dimensional response follows from the conformal anomaly. We lift it to four dimensions on the field lines, assuming that the metric of each line scales with the local field strength. Through the trace anomaly this scaling couples the field strength to the worldsheet curvature, reminiscent of a Wen-Zee term. The response comes with a Hall current that sources the axial gauge mode. At zeroth order in the fermion backreaction $\alpha$ the throat is AdS$_2\times S^2$ and the modes are two Poschl-Teller problems with squared masses $l(l-1)$ and $(l+1)(l+2)$. We give the $O(\alpha)$ corrections in closed form. In the mouths the fermions act through the anomaly at the same order, and mouths and throat match. The higher Landau levels act through the one-loop Euler-Heisenberg action. We keep it to first order in $\eta_{\rm H}=g_c^2/12\pi^2$, which is not suppressed by $1/q$. It enlarges the AdS$_2$ radius and splits the levels shared by the two modes. On the closed-throat levels examined their $O(\alpha)$ mixing is of second order. The $O(\alpha)$ frequency shifts there, measured by the static observer at the throat centre, are real and depend on the assumed scaling, compared here with a lift on the coordinate planes. Region by region, at first order in $\alpha$ and $\eta_{\rm H}$ and on the levels examined, we find no growing mode at $l=2,3,4$, although the $O(\alpha)$ mouth rests on an estimate. Stability of the wormhole as a whole is not shown.

classification.title_zh: Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov虫洞的极向度规/轴向规范扰动
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov可穿越虫洞的线性扰动，在极向度规扰动与轴向规范扰动耦合的扇区，并将其约化为两个Zerilli-Moncrief型耦合主方程。在喉部，带电费米子最低朗道能级的Casimir能量维持虫洞张开；仅当费米子响应时，线性化Bianchi恒等式才成立。一旦其状态固定，它们的二维响应由共形反常给出。我们假设施加每条场线上的度规随局域场强标度，将其提升到四维。通过迹反常，这种标度将场强与世界面曲率耦合，类似于Wen-Zee项。该响应伴随一个Hall电流，后者作为轴向规范模式的源。在费米子反作用α的零阶，喉部为AdS2×S2，模式是两个Pöschl-Teller问题，其质量平方为l(l-1)和(l+1)(l+2)。我们以闭式给出O(α)修正。在口部，费米子通过同阶的反常起作用，且口部与喉部匹配。更高朗道能级通过一圈Euler-Heisenberg作用量起作用。我们将其保留到η_H=g_c^2/12π^2的一阶，该量不被1/q压低。它增大AdS2半径，并分裂两个模式共享的能级。在所考察的闭合喉部能级上，它们的O(α)混合为二阶。那里由喉部中心的静态观察者测量的O(α)频率移动为实数，并依赖于所假定的标度；此处与在坐标平面上的提升进行比较。逐区域地，在α和η_H的一阶、在所考察的能级上，我们在l=2,3,4未发现增长模式，尽管O(α)口部依赖于一个估计。尚未证明虫洞整体的稳定性。
classification.one_liner: 将MMP可穿越虫洞的极向度规-轴向规范线性扰动约化为Zerilli-Moncrief型主方程，并计算O(α)频率修正与所考察能级的稳定性。

papers.title: Regular black holes with Minkowskian cores: energy-condition obstruction and optical screening
papers.abstract: We construct an asymptotically flat black-hole geometry with a Minkowskian core using gravitational decoupling and analyze its static and rotating extensions. Rather than imposing global energy-condition viability, we show that the vanishing central density required by the Minkowskian core produces a local null-energy-condition obstruction for the present static closure class. The exact mass profile can be written in terms of the regularized incomplete gamma function, which makes transparent both the horizon structure and the exponential localization of the deformation. This localization yields an analytic optical-screening mechanism: on the black-hole branch, deviations of the critical impact parameter from Schwarzschild are controlled by the exponentially suppressed mass deficit at the photon sphere. We also clarify the status of the rotating extension: curvature invariants remain finite on the physical domain $r\geq0$, but this local statement does not by itself establish a globally regular analytic extension through the Kerr disk. These results separate local core regularization from global completeness and explain why strong modifications of the interior can coexist with very small changes in exterior optical observables.

classification.title_zh: 具有闵可夫斯基核心的正则黑洞：能量条件阻碍与光学屏蔽
classification.abstract_zh: 本文利用引力解耦构造了一个具有闵可夫斯基核心的渐近平直黑洞几何，并分析其静态与旋转推广。作者并不要求全局能量条件成立，而是指出：闵可夫斯基核心所要求的中心密度消失，会在当前静态闭合类中产生局域零能量条件阻碍。精确质量函数可用正则化不完全伽马函数表示，从而清楚显示视界结构和形变的指数局域化。这种局域化给出一个解析的光学屏蔽机制：在黑洞分支上，临界碰撞参数相对史瓦西的偏离由光子球处指数压低的质量亏缺控制。文章还澄清了旋转推广的地位：曲率不变量在物理区域 r≥0 上保持有限，但这一局域陈述本身不足以建立穿过 Kerr 盘的全局正则解析延拓。结果表明，局域核心正则化与全局完备性应加以区分，并解释了为何内部强修改可以与外部光学观测量的小改变共存。
classification.one_liner: 构造带闵可夫斯基核心的渐近平直正则黑洞，指出局域零能量条件阻碍，并给出由形变指数局域化导致的光学屏蔽机制。

papers.title: Relativistic and Newtonian Proca Stars: A Tale of Two Limits
papers.abstract: We investigate a representative set of static solitonic solutions of the Einstein-Proca theory in the Newtonian regime, where the field frequency approaches the particle mass, $\omega \to \mu$, and compare them with the corresponding solutions of the spin-1 Schr\"odinger-Poisson system, which provides the effective description in this limit. While this correspondence is relatively straightforward in the Einstein-Klein-Gordon case, the vector nature of the Proca field, combined with the enhanced $U(3)$ symmetry of the nonrelativistic spin-1 regime, gives rise to several nontrivial features that require careful analysis. We establish a mapping between the two descriptions by identifying $\ell=0$ electric Proca stars with radially polarized (hedgehog) configurations and $\ell=1$ electric Proca stars with linearly polarized configurations. We further clarify some aspects of the ground state and resolve several apparent discrepancies between relativistic and Newtonian solutions, particularly concerning their morphology and stability properties. An important conclusion of this work is that the nonrelativistic regime supports a richer spectrum of stable equilibrium configurations than the relativistic theory, including stable excited states.

classification.title_zh: 相对论性与牛顿性 Proca 星：两种极限的故事

papers.title: Constructing Bulk Topological Orders via Layered Gauging
papers.abstract: Understanding quantum phases and phase transitions in the presence of symmetries is a central objective of quantum many-body physics. A powerful modern paradigm for investigating this problem is topological holography, which relates symmetries in $k$ dimensions to "bulk" topological orders in $(k+1)$ dimensions. While conceptually profound, most existing bulk construction methods rely on sophisticated mathematical formalisms and can be difficult to apply to certain symmetry types. In this work, we propose a physically intuitive and versatile method, termed the layered gauging construction, to systematically generate $(k+1)$-dimensional (liquid or fracton) topological orders from $k$-dimensional generalized symmetries. Roughly speaking, the prescription is to stack many layers of $k$-dimensional quantum systems with certain symmetries into a $(k+1)$-dimensional pile, and then sequentially gauge a diagonal symmetry acting on each nearest-neighbor pair of layers. The detailed procedure depends on the specific symmetry types. We have successfully implemented the method in a number of examples in different spatial dimensions, with symmetries that are conventional, higher-form, subsystem, anomalous, nonabelian, or noninvertible. We hence conjecture the method to be very general. For example, from the subsystem symmetry of the $2d$ plaquette Ising model, we derive the X-cube model and also an anisotropic fracton topological order. Additionally, starting from an anomalous $Z_2$ symmetry in $1d$, we construct a new square lattice model realizing the double semion topological order. From a quantum-error-correction perspective, our layered gauging construction may be viewed as a generalization of the hypergraph-product construction beyond the standard Calderbank-Shor-Steane setting.

classification.title_zh: 通过分层规范化构造体拓扑序
classification.abstract_zh: 理解存在对称性时的量子相与相变是量子多体物理的核心目标。拓扑全息为研究该问题提供了一个现代范式，它将 k 维中的对称性与 (k+1) 维中的“体”拓扑序联系起来。尽管概念深刻，现有大多数体构造方法依赖复杂数学形式，且难以应用于某些对称类型。本文提出一种物理直观且通用的方法，称为分层规范化构造，以从 k 维广义对称性系统生成 (k+1) 维（液体或 fracton）拓扑序。粗略地说，该方案是将许多层具有特定对称性的 k 维量子系统堆叠成 (k+1) 维堆叠，然后依次规范化作用在每对相邻层上的对角对称性。具体步骤依赖于对称类型。作者在不同空间维度、具有常规、高阶形式、子系统、反常、非阿贝尔或不可逆对称性的多个例子中实现了该方法，并因此猜想该方法具有普遍性。例如，从二维 plaquette Ising 模型的子系统对称性出发，导出了 X-cube 模型以及一个各向异性 fracton 拓扑序；从一维反常 Z2 对称性出发，构造了一个实现 double semion 拓扑序的新方格晶格模型。从量子纠错角度看，该分层规范化构造可视为超图乘积构造在标准 Calderbank-Shor-Steane 设定之外的推广。
classification.one_liner: 提出分层规范化方法，从 k 维广义对称性系统构造 (k+1) 维体拓扑序，并给出 fracton、double semion 等例子。

papers.title: A New Spin on Dissipative Tides: First-Post-Newtonian Effects in Compact Binary Inspirals
papers.abstract: Tidal dissipation in spinning compact binaries imprints characteristic corrections on the late-inspiral gravitational-wave signal. We develop a next-to-leading order post-Newtonian description of dissipative, electric-quadrupolar tides in spinning compact binaries, deriving the center-of-mass equations of motion, a generalized energy-balance law, and the corresponding Fourier-phase correction for quasi-circular orbits with spins aligned or anti-aligned with the orbital angular momentum. Using the most general, low-frequency, linear tidal response compatible with rotational symmetry, we show that spin-induced tidal dissipation enters the gravitational-wave phase at 2.5 post-Newtonian order and carries a logarithmic frequency dependence, so it is not degenerate with the coalescence phase. For binary black holes, our dissipative flux reproduces horizon absorption in the extreme-mass-ratio limit. These results provide new waveform ingredients for precision modeling of spinning compact binaries in the high-signal-to-noise era.

classification.title_zh: 关于耗散潮汐的新自旋视角：致密双星旋进中的一阶后牛顿效应
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究自旋致密双星中潮汐耗散对晚期旋进引力波信号的特征修正。作者建立了自旋致密双星中耗散型电四极潮汐的次领头阶后牛顿描述，推导了质心运动方程、推广的能量平衡定律，以及自旋与轨道角动量平行或反平行的准圆轨道对应的傅里叶相位修正。采用与旋转对称性相容的最一般低频线性潮汐响应，他们表明自旋诱导的潮汐耗散在 2.5 后牛顿阶进入引力波相位，并带有对数频率依赖，因此不会与并合相位简并。对于双黑洞，其耗散通量在极端质量比极限下重现视界吸收。

papers.title: Stability analysis and double critical phenomenon in the Einstein-Maxwell-scalar theory
papers.abstract: We investigate the dynamical stability and phase transition behavior in a holographic superfluid model incorporating higher-order self-interaction terms $\lambda |\psi|^4$, $\tau|\psi|^6$, and a non-minimal coupling $h(\psi)=e^{\alpha|\psi|^2}$. Thermodynamic and dynamical stability analyzes show that the thermodynamic stability and dynamical stability of the system are consistent. Phase diagram analysis reveals rich critical and supercritical phenomena. For fixed $\lambda<0$ and $\alpha$, increasing $\tau$ shrinks the first-order phase transition region to a critical point and then enters the supercritical region. When varying $\alpha$, the system can exhibit no critical point and, most notably, a double critical phenomenon in which, as $\alpha$ increases, the system first enters the supercritical region and then re-enters the first-order phase transition region. This double critical phenomenon driven by a single parameter is reported for the first time in holographic superfluid models, revealing a complex nonmonotonic coupling effect between the non-minimal coupling and higher-order interaction terms.

classification.title_zh: Einstein-Maxwell-scalar 理论中的稳定性分析与双临界现象
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了包含高阶自相互作用项 λ|ψ|^4、τ|ψ|^6 以及非最小耦合 h(ψ)=e^{α|ψ|^2} 的全息超流模型中的动力学稳定性和相变行为。热力学与动力学稳定性分析表明，系统的热力学稳定性和动力学稳定性一致。相图分析揭示了丰富的临界和超临界现象。对于固定的 λ<0 和 α，增大 τ 会将一级相变区域收缩到一个临界点，然后进入超临界区域。当改变 α 时，系统可以表现出无临界点，并且最值得注意的是出现双临界现象：随着 α 增大，系统先进入超临界区域，然后重新进入一级相变区域。这种由单一参数驱动的双临界现象首次在全息超流模型中被报道，揭示了非最小耦合与高阶相互作用项之间复杂的非单调耦合效应。

papers.title: A Tribute to S. Deser: Conserved Quantities in Generic Gravity Theories
papers.abstract: I describe parts of my joint work with S. Deser [March 19, 1931 - April 21, 2023] which started when I was working as a post-doc at Brandeis University in 2001. Our work was mostly, but not exclusively, on conserved charges of higher curvature theories of gravity. I also describe some recent developments, such as expressing the conserved charges in terms of the linearized Riemann tensor; I expound upon the computations. I also reminisce about our interaction for over two decades that went beyond our scientific collaboration. The physics part of this review is intended for graduate students and researchers interested in extended theories of gravity, especially about the conserved quantities and perturbative techniques in these theories.

classification.title_zh: 致敬 S. Deser：广义引力理论中的守恒量

papers.title: Exact holographic superfluid at the Bogomolny point: transport, large charge, and R\'enyi entropies
papers.abstract: The Abelian Higgs model in AdS$_5$, in the probe limit, is a standard holographic model of a strongly coupled superfluid, usually solved numerically. When the scalar mass saturates the Breitenlohner-Freedman bound and the quartic coupling takes the Bogomolny value, its condensed phase can be found in closed form on every static, uncharged AdS$_5$ background with maximally symmetric spatial sections. We prove that it is linearly stable, as is any nodeless probe-limit condensate in the standard quantization with a nonnegative quartic coupling and no superflow. On each slicing it answers a different question about the dual conformal field theory. On the planar black brane it is the superfluid at all temperatures below $T_c$: the superfluid fraction follows the Gorter-Casimir two-fluid law exactly, and the speed and the attenuation of sound are found in closed form. In global AdS$_5$ it describes a state of charge $Q$ on $\mathbb{R}\times S^3$, arguably the lowest-energy one, and gives its scaling dimension in closed form at all $Q$, classically in the bulk. Its excitations include towers that the superfluid effective theory does not describe; they come from an infrared fixed point of the probe sector. The hyperbolic slicing gives in closed form a homogeneous hairy phase of the black holes that compute the charged R\'enyi entropies of a ball. Its condensate does not vanish at the entangling surface. When sourced by operators inserted there, the phase sets in at R\'enyi index exactly one at zero chemical potential, as found for a neutral scalar.

classification.title_zh: Bogomolny点处的精确全息超流体：输运、大电荷与Rényi熵
classification.abstract_zh: AdS5中的Abelian Higgs模型在探针极限下是强耦合超流体的标准全息模型，通常需数值求解。当标量质量饱和Breitenlohner-Freedman界且四次耦合取Bogomolny值时，其凝聚相可在每个具有最大对称空间截面的静态不带电AdS5背景上以闭式给出。我们证明它是线性稳定的，正如标准量子化中具有非负四次耦合且无超流的任何无节点探针极限凝聚相一样。在每种切片上，它回答对偶CFT的不同问题。在平面黑膜上，它是所有低于Tc温度下的超流体：超流组分严格遵循Gorter-Casimir双流体定律，声速与声衰减以闭式给出。在整体AdS5中，它描述R×S3上电荷Q的态，可说是最低能量态，并在所有Q下以闭式给出其标度维度（体论经典）。其激发包括超流体有效理论不描述的塔，它们来自探针扇区的红外不动点。双曲切片以闭式给出计算球带电Rényi熵的黑洞的均匀毛发相。其凝聚在纠缠面上不为零。当由插入该处的算符源激发时，该相在零化学势下Rényi指数恰为一时出现，如同中性标量所见。

papers.title: Entanglement Bounds on Cardy Growth in Higher Dimensions
papers.abstract: We propose bounds relating thermal entropy to entanglement in unitary conformal field theories: $f\le4\pi^2a$ in four dimensions and $f\le2.99830949\ldots\,F$ in three dimensions. Here $f$ is the dimensionless coefficient of the cosmological constant term in the thermal effective action, $a$ is the Euler anomaly coefficient, and $F$ is the sphere free energy. These bounds arise naturally as the high-temperature limits of proposed inequalities for spherical R\'enyi entropy that extend the conformal collider bound in four dimensions and an analogous conjecture in three dimensions. To verify this proposal, we formulate a stronger conjectural inequality common to both dimensions, expressed in terms of the stress-tensor three-point function and saturated by every free theory. We establish this inequality in controlled regimes of weakly coupled gauge theories, large-$N$ vector models, and holographic CFTs. Finite-$N$ numerical results provide additional support. Our proposal suggests that the equality between the universal coefficients governing the Cardy formula and entanglement entropy in two-dimensional CFTs extends to higher dimensions in the form of a universal inequality.

classification.title_zh: 高维 Cardy 增长的纠缠上界
classification.abstract_zh: 本文提出在幺正共形场论中把热熵与纠缠联系起来的界：四维中 f≤4π²a，三维中 f≤2.99830949…F。这里 f 是热有效作用中宇宙学常数项的无量纲系数，a 是 Euler 反常系数，F 是球面自由能。这些界自然地来自所提出的球面 Rényi 熵不等式的高温极限；这些不等式推广了四维的共形对撞机界和三维的类似猜想。为检验该提议，我们给出一个同时适用于两维度的更强猜想不等式，用应力张量三点函数表示，并被每个自由理论饱和。我们在弱耦合规范理论、大 N 矢量模型和全息 CFT 的可控区域中建立该不等式，有限 N 数值结果提供额外支持。该提议暗示，二维 CFT 中控制 Cardy 公式与纠缠熵的普适系数相等这一事实，在高维以普适不等式的形式推广。
classification.one_liner: 提出并检验将热有效作用常数与纠缠熵联系起来的普遍上界，暗示二维 CFT 中 Cardy 公式与纠缠熵系数相等在高维推广为不等式。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文讨论 CFT 中热熵与纠缠熵的普遍上界，并用全息 CFT 作为验证区域之一；不涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p 波、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、相变气泡成核、QNM、冷原子或 D3-D7/Floquet 探针膜等方向。

papers.title: On 2-loop AdS$_2$ superstring partition function in AdS$_5 \times S^5$ and AdS$_4\times CP^3$
papers.abstract: We revisit the 2-loop computation of the partition function of the GS superstring expanded near the AdS$_2$ surface in AdS$_5\times S^5$ and AdS$_4\times {\rm CP}^3$, dual to $\frac{1}{2}$ BPS circular Wilson loop in ${\cal N}=4$ SYM and ABJM theories. In arXiv:2601.08809 it was done in AdS$_5\times S^5$ using dimensional regularization and a UV pole was found. Since dimensional regularization is problematic for the GS string, here we use a heat-kernel cutoff instead. Then the contribution of the local path integral measure, proportional to $\delta(0)$, can no longer be ignored. We show that it cancels the $\delta(0)$ terms coming from the quartic interactions in the action, leaving the square of the difference ${\rm Str}\,E$ between the regularized numbers of bosonic and fermionic modes. The result is thus UV finite, the pole of arXiv:2601.08809 being an artefact of dimensional regularization. If all fields are regularized with the same smearing kernel, ${\rm Str}\,E=0$ and the 2-loop coefficient $f_2$ vanishes, in tension with $f_2=\frac{3}{32\pi^2}$ in SYM theory. In the AdS$_4\times{\rm CP}^3$ case the same cancellation leaves a finite term proportional to the square of the coincident value of the massless 2d fermion Green's function, giving, ironically, $f_2=\frac{3}{32\pi^2}$ instead of $f_2=0$ required by localization. This term is the level-zero (string) part of the result of arXiv:2609.14497 for the AdS$_2\times S^1$ M2 brane in AdS$_4\times S^7/\mathbb Z_k$, where it is cancelled by the higher $S^1$ modes, which also remove a finite mass shift of the massless fermion in conflict with the AdS$_2$ supersymmetry. This suggests that the type II string path integral measure should contain an extra contribution, supplied in the IIA case by the parent M2 brane; in the AdS$_5\times S^5$ case it is still to be identified and may resolve the remaining 2-loop mismatch with localization.

classification.title_zh: 论 AdS5×S5 与 AdS4×CP3 中 AdS2 超弦配分函数的两圈计算
classification.abstract_zh: 我们重新审视 AdS5×S5 和 AdS4×CP3 中靠近 AdS2 面展开的 GS 超弦配分函数的两圈计算，其对偶为 N=4 SYM 和 ABJM 理论中的 1/2 BPS 圆形 Wilson 圈。arXiv:2601.08809 曾在 AdS5×S5 中用维数正规化完成该计算并发现一个 UV 极点。由于维数正规化对 GS 弦存在问题，这里改用热核截断。此时局域路径积分测度的贡献正比于 δ(0)，不能再被忽略。我们证明它会抵消作用量中四次相互作用产生的 δ(0) 项，只留下正规化玻色模式数与费米模式数之差 Str E 的平方。因此结果 UV 有限，arXiv:2601.08809 中的极点只是维数正规化的假象。若所有场都用相同的 smear kernel 正规化，则 Str E=0，两圈系数 f2 消失，这与 SYM 理论要求的 f2=3/(32π^2) 相矛盾。在 AdS4×CP3 情形中，同样的抵消留下一个有限项，它正比于无质量二维费米子 Green 函数重合值的平方，讽刺地给出 f2=3/(32π^2)，而不是 localization 要求的 f2=0。该项是 arXiv:2609.14497 中 AdS4×S7/Z_k 内 AdS2×S1 M2 膜结果的 level-zero（弦）部分；在那里它被更高的 S1 模式抵消，而这些模式也移除了与 AdS2 超对称相冲突的无质量费米子有限质量移动。这暗示 type II 弦路径积分测度应包含额外贡献，在 IIA 情形由母 M2 膜提供；在 AdS5×S5 情形中该贡献尚待识别，并可能解决与 localization 之间剩余的两圈不匹配。
classification.one_liner: 用热核截断重算 AdS2 超弦两圈配分函数，表明先前 UV 极点是维数正规化假象，并指出与 localization 的系数不匹配可能需修正弦路径积分测度。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 与弦论配分函数的基础技术计算，讨论 Wilson 圈对偶、正规化与 localization 匹配；与所列全息超流超导、p波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、QNM、D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜等具体支线无直接交集。

papers.title: Love at First Loop: Quantum Deformability of Near-Extremal Black Holes
papers.abstract: The static Love numbers of black holes vanish in classical, four-dimensional, asymptotically flat General Relativity. We study how this changes for the response of near-extremal Reissner--Nordstr\"om black holes to a minimally coupled massless scalar, at energies where the Schwarzian mode of the near-horizon throat fluctuates strongly. The black hole then responds as a quantum system with a spectrum of states. Its static response is a polarizability, given by virtual transitions between them. For $\ell=0$ the static Love number vanishes, by the shift symmetry of the scalar, but for multipoles $\ell\geq1$ the static Love numbers are nonzero: the finite rotational energy of the spin-$\ell$ intermediate states spoils the cancellation responsible for the classical result. Since the throat no longer has a classical geometry from which to read off a tidal response, we define it through the retarded Green's function, and compute its full frequency dependence at leading order in $r_+\omega$. Its conservative part requires renormalization: the near-horizon theory fixes the coefficient of its logarithm, and with it a dependence on the energy that no local term can remove, while its finite local terms are matching data of the four-dimensional theory. The dissipative part is finite and scheme independent. For $\ell\geq1$, it vanishes at low frequencies when the energy is below the rotational gap, while at the gap threshold it becomes non-analytic in frequency and produces a late-time $t^{-3/2}$ tail.

classification.title_zh: 初圈之爱：近极端黑洞的量子可变形性
classification.abstract_zh: 在经典、四维、渐近平直广义相对论中，黑洞的静态 Love 数消失。我们研究近极端 Reissner–Nordström 黑洞对最小耦合无质量标量的响应，在近水平喉部的 Schwarzian 模式强烈涨落的能量尺度下如何改变。此时黑洞作为具有态谱的量子系统响应，其静态响应是由这些态之间虚跃迁给出的极化率。对于 ℓ=0，静态 Love 数因标量的平移对称性而消失；但对于 ℓ≥1 的多极，静态 Love 数非零：自旋 ℓ 中间态的有限转动能破坏了导致经典结果消失的抵消。由于喉部不再具有可读取潮汐响应的经典几何，我们通过推迟 Green 函数定义它，并在 r_+ω 领头阶计算其完整频率依赖。其保守部分需要重整化：近水平理论固定其对数项的系数，从而给出任何局域项都无法消除的能量依赖，而其有限局域项是四维理论的匹配数据。耗散部分有限且与方案无关。对于 ℓ≥1，当能量低于转动能隙时它在低频消失，而在能隙阈值处对频率非解析，并产生晚期 t^{-3/2} 尾。
classification.one_liner: 研究近极端RN黑洞在Schwarzian强涨落下的量子潮汐响应，发现ℓ≥1静态Love数非零，并给出推迟Green函数的频率依赖与t^{-3/2}晚时尾。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究黑洞量子响应与推迟Green函数的频率依赖及晚时尾，涉及Schwarzian模式，与用户重点关注的QNM/响应类标签部分相关，但不直接属于全息超流超导、p波序参量、探针膜或相变成核等方向。

papers.title: Fast holographic inversion of superconducting domes
papers.abstract: A holographic superconductor whose scalar mass depends on the gauge field strength, $M(\Fsq)$, reproduces a superconducting dome for a suitable $M$, but recovering $M$ from a dome has taken days. We obtain the condition that fixes the critical temperature from two integrations, started at the horizon and at the boundary, and its derivative with respect to $M$ from the same two solutions, so training needs no finite differences and an inversion takes ten minutes to an hour. With this speed we study the interval between the horizon value of $\Fsq$ at the lowest doping and $\Fsq=0$, which no horizon reaches and at whose end the scalar mass $M(0)$ fixes the dimension of the dual operator. Holding $M(0)$ at several values, the pinned masses, and retraining the rest, we find reconstructions that share the minima of $M$ and agree wherever the horizons reach, apart from the deepest end, but differ on that interval. A rule that keeps the reconstruction with the simplest closed form recovers the scalar mass and the mass function of a dome generated from a quadratic $M$. On Gaussian and double-Gaussian domes and the measured phase diagrams of YBa$_{2}$Cu$_{3}$O$_{y}$ and 2M-WS$_{2}$ its choice rests on ties or narrow margins, and it recovers the scalar mass of only two of the four domes generated from the closed forms it keeps for them. The dome thus constrains $M$ where its horizons reach but not the scalar mass, which a second observable would have to fix.

classification.primary_topic: 全息凝聚态/超流超导/强关联
secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 超导穹顶的快速全息反演
classification.abstract_zh: 一个标量质量依赖于规范场强度 M(F^2) 的全息超导体，在合适的 M 下能重现超导穹顶，但从穹顶反演 M 过去需要数天。我们得到由从视界和边界出发的两个积分确定临界温度的条件，并由同样两个解得到其对 M 的导数，因此训练无需有限差分，一次反演需十分钟到一小时。借助这一速度，我们研究最低掺杂处 F^2 的视界值与 F^2=0 之间的区间；没有视界达到 F^2=0，而在该区间端点 M(0) 固定对偶算符的维度。将 M(0) 固定于若干值、固定质量并重新训练其余部分，我们发现重构在 M 的极小值处共享，并在视界可达处一致（最深端除外），但在该区间上不同。一个保留具有最简单闭合形式重构的规则，可恢复由二次 M 生成的穹顶的标量质量和质量函数。在高斯与双高斯穹顶以及 YBa2Cu3Oy 和 2M-WS2 的测量相图上，其选择依赖并列或狭窄差距，并且对于从其保留的闭合形式生成的四个穹顶，只恢复其中两个的标量质量。因此穹顶只在视界可达处约束 M，而不约束标量质量；后者需要第二个可观测量来确定。
classification.one_liner: 提出快速全息反演方法，从超导穹顶反推标量质量函数，并指出穹顶仅在其视界可达区域约束 M，标量质量需额外观测量确定。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究全息超导体的超导穹顶反演与标量质量重构，属于用户重点的全息超流超导方向。

papers.title: Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov equations and the analytic structure of strings in AdS$_3$
papers.abstract: The pole structure of string correlators in AdS$_3$ encodes essential information about the AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ duality. The corresponding residues for spectrally flowed three-point functions have been extracted from their exact expressions and shown to match the predictions of the holographic CFT. Away from the tensionless point, the latter is defined perturbatively in terms of a deformed symmetric orbifold. For $n$-point functions, such a matching has so far only been achieved for a specific subset of poles, and only by means of free-field techniques. Here we develop an alternative approach. We show that, starting from the localization properties of worldsheet correlators, one can solve the Knizhnik--Zamolodchikov (KZ) equations on the corresponding locus and perform the integration over worldsheet moduli explicitly for any $n$ and for arbitrary values of the spectral flow charges. In this way we reproduce, directly from the exact worldsheet theory and including the normalization, the residues previously obtained with free-field methods. We expect this to provide a systematic framework for computing the remaining residues and, ultimately, for determining the full analytic structure of string amplitudes in AdS$_3$.

classification.title_zh: Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov 方程与 AdS$_3$ 中弦的解析结构
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究 AdS$_3$ 中弦关联函数的极点结构及其对 AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ 对偶的编码。作者提出一种替代方法：从世界面关联函数的局域化性质出发，在相应轨迹上求解 Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov 方程，并对任意 $n$ 和任意 spectral flow 荷显式完成世界面模空间的积分。由此直接从精确世界面理论并包含归一化，重现了此前用自由场方法得到的留数。作者预计这将为计算其余留数并最终确定 AdS$_3$ 弦振幅的完整解析结构提供系统框架。
classification.one_liner: 用 KZ 方程和世界面局域化系统计算 AdS$_3$ 弦关联函数的留数，推进其完整解析结构。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ 全息对偶与弦世界面关联函数的基础研究，与理论全息方向相关；但未直接涉及用户重点列出的全息超流超导、探针膜、QNM、相变成核等具体支线。

papers.title: Matrix Holography on an Optical Lattice
papers.abstract: We propose an analog quantum-simulation protocol based on a lattice of atomic ensembles and time-averaged Floquet dynamics to construct the four-body potentials that typically appear in bosonic BFSS-like matrix quantum mechanics. In contrast to gate-based digital implementations requiring deep circuits, our approach generates the target model through a fixed set of control stages per Floquet cycle, keeping the number of consecutive unitaries constant with respect to the matrix size $N$. The principal scaling cost in our construction is given by the frequency range required to control the growing lattice. We show that this cost grows at most as $\mathcal{O}(N^3)$, giving a polynomial scaling route to large$-N$, attractive to experimental implementation. Additionally, we demonstrate that the coupling parameter can be tuned beyond $\mathcal{O}(1)$, enabling the simulation of strong-coupling physics necessary for holographic phases.

classification.title_zh: 光晶格上的矩阵全息
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种基于原子系综晶格与时间平均 Floquet 动力学的模拟量子模拟方案，用以构造通常出现在玻色 BFSS 类矩阵量子力学中的四体势。与需要深电路的基于门数字实现不同，我们的方法在每个 Floquet 周期通过固定的一组控制阶段生成目标模型，使连续幺正操作的数目不随矩阵尺寸 N 增长。我们构造中的主要标度成本来自控制不断增大的晶格所需的频率范围；我们证明该成本至多按 O(N^3) 增长，从而给出通往大 N 的多项式标度路径，有利于实验实现。此外，我们证明耦合参数可被调至 O(1) 以上，从而能够模拟全息相所需的强耦合物理。
classification.one_liner: 提出用原子系综光晶格与时间平均 Floquet 动力学模拟 BFSS 类矩阵量子力学，控制成本随 N 多项式增长并可达到强耦合。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文涉及 BFSS 类矩阵量子力学和全息相，与矩阵模型/量子引力支线相关；但其核心是冷原子模拟方案，而非对偶字典、具体全息模型求解或用户重点标签中的超流、探针膜、QNM 等方向。
focus_tags: 冷原子/双组分BEC/凝聚态实验启发

papers.title: Who Writes the Gravitational Second Law of Thermodynamics?
papers.abstract: We define gravitational entropy as the manifestly integrable surface charge associated with local transverse Lorentz boosts, entirely bypassing the conventional reliance on spacetime diffeomorphisms. Any notion of entropy must satisfy the second law. To answer the question posed in the title, an analogy with Newtonian classical mechanics is instructive: Newton's second law of motion is written by inertial observers who are defined by the first law of mechanics. We show that the second law of gravitational thermodynamics is written by free-fall observers with path parameterization in which the non-affinity of the geodesics is equal to the expansion of their velocity vector field. We then provide a proof of the local second law by studying variations in entropy as viewed by this class of covariantly-defined causal free-fall observers. We show that the entropy variation is strictly non-decreasing, provided the matter sector satisfies the integrated strong energy condition along the observer path.

classification.title_zh: 谁书写引力热力学第二定律？
classification.abstract_zh: 本文将引力熵定义为与局部横向洛伦兹助推相关的、显式可积的面电荷，从而完全绕开对时空微分同胚的传统依赖。任何熵概念都必须满足第二定律。为回答标题中的问题，文章借助与牛顿经典力学的类比：牛顿第二运动定律由第一定律定义的惯性观察者书写。作者表明，引力热力学的第二定律由自由落体观察者书写，其路径参数化使测地线的非仿射度等于其速度矢量场的膨胀。随后，作者通过研究这类协变定义的因果自由落体观察者所看到的熵变，给出了局部第二定律的证明，并表明只要物质部分沿观察者路径满足积分强能量条件，熵变就严格非减。
classification.one_liner: 该文把引力熵刻画为局部横向洛伦兹助推对应的可积面电荷，并证明在自由落体观察者视角下、物质满足积分强能量条件时局部第二定律成立。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典引力中的引力熵与局部热力学第二定律，属于用户重点标签中的“经典引力/广义相对论”支线；未涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

papers.title: D4-branes wrapped on topological disks from matter-coupled F(4) gauged supergravity
papers.abstract: We study a number of supersymmetric $AdS_4\times \Sigma$ solutions with $\Sigma$ being a topological disk with non-trivial $U(1)$ holonomy on the boundary or a ``half-spindle'' from matter-coupled $F(4)$ gauged supergravity. The gauged supergravity is coupled to three vector multiplets with $SO(3)\times SO(3)$ gauge group. The resulting solutions preserve eight supercharges and $SO(2)\times SO(2)$ or $SO(2)_{\text{diag}}$ symmetries and are expected to be dual to $N=2$ SCFTs in three dimensions arising from compactifications of five-dimensional $N=2$ SCFT on a half-spindle. All of the solutions lie within the $U(1)\times U(1)$ subsector of the matter-coupled $F(4)$ gauged supergravity that can be embedded in massive type IIA theory. After uplifted to ten dimensions, the solutions can be interpreted as a system of D4-D8-branes wrapped on $\Sigma$. Some of the solutions are asymptotic to a locally $AdS_6$ geometry and can be identified as codimension-2 conformal defects within the $N=2$ SCFT in five dimensions. For these solutions, the circle inside $\Sigma$ decompactifies in the $AdS_6$ limit rendering the holographic free energy infinite. There also exist solutions with finite free energy in the dual three-dimensional SCFTs. In addition, we show that the results both extend the previously known solutions and provide a novel class of solutions.

classification.title_zh: 物质耦合 F(4) 超引力中缠绕拓扑圆盘的 D4 膜
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究物质耦合 F(4) 超引力中的若干超对称 AdS_4×Σ 解，其中 Σ 是边界上具有非平凡 U(1) holonomy 的拓扑圆盘或“半纺锤”。该超引力耦合三个矢量多重态，规范群为 SO(3)×SO(3)。所得解保持八个超荷以及 SO(2)×SO(2) 或 SO(2)_diag 对称性，并预期对偶于由五维 N=2 SCFT 在半纺锤上紧化产生的三维 N=2 SCFT。所有解都位于可嵌入 massive type IIA 理论的 U(1)×U(1) 子扇区。提升到十维后，这些解可解释为缠绕在 Σ 上的 D4-D8 膜系统。部分解渐近于局部 AdS_6 几何，可识别为五维 N=2 SCFT 中的余维二共形缺陷；在这些解中，Σ 内的圆在 AdS_6 极限下解紧化，使全息自由能发散。也存在对偶三维 SCFT 中自由能有限的解。作者还表明，这些结果既扩展了已知解，也提供了一类新解。
classification.one_liner: 在物质耦合 F(4) 超引力中构造 AdS4×拓扑圆盘/半纺锤超对称解，并讨论其全息对偶、D4-D8 膜解释以及缺陷与自由能性质。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 超引力解与 D4-D8 膜构造，不直接涉及用户重点列出的全息超流超导、p波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子或 D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜与 Floquet 驱动等方向。

papers.title: Gravitational Faraday rotation, gravitational spin Hall effect, and spin-refined causality analysis from Magnusian matrix in effective field theories of gravity
papers.abstract: The effects of black hole's spin in effective field theories (EFTs) of gravity are explored through observables of wave scattering on black hole backgrounds in the geometric optics approximation. The considered observables are polarisation rotation angle, wavenumber kick (or deflection angle), and (Shapiro/Wigner--Smith) time delay, each of which are related to gravitational Faraday rotation, gravitational spin Hall effect, and infrared causality. The observables are computed from scattering amplitudes through the Magnusian formalism, where the Magnusian is promoted to a matrix to account for helicity information. It is found that (1) the gravitational spin Hall effect in EFTs of gravity are qualitatively different from that of general relativity due to "noncommutative" wavenumber kicks, and (2) black hole's spin slightly enhances the causality constraints on EFT coefficients.

classification.title_zh: 引力有效场论中基于Magnusian矩阵的引力法拉第旋转、引力自旋霍尔效应与自旋精化因果性分析
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在几何光学近似下，通过黑洞背景上的波散射可观测量，探讨黑洞自旋在引力有效场论（EFT）中的作用。所考虑的可观测量包括偏振旋转角、波数踢（或偏折角）以及（Shapiro/Wigner-Smith）时间延迟，它们分别关联于引力法拉第旋转、引力自旋霍尔效应和红外因果性。这些可观测量由散射振幅经Magnusian形式计算，其中Magnusian被提升为矩阵以纳入螺旋度信息。结果显示：(1) 由于“非对易”的波数踢，引力EFT中的引力自旋霍尔效应与广义相对论情形有定性不同；(2) 黑洞自旋会略微增强对EFT系数的因果性约束。
classification.one_liner: 利用几何光学下的黑洞波散射与Magnusian矩阵形式，研究引力EFT中的自旋相关偏振、偏折和时间延迟及因果性约束。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题属于经典引力/黑洞散射与有效场论引力，涉及几何光学和自旋效应，与经典引力支线相关；不涉及全息或用户列出的全息凝聚态、超流超导等标签。

papers.title: R7-branes and AdS$_{\text{9}}$ solutions in type IIB
papers.abstract: We consider the recently found $\mathrm{AdS}_9$ backgrounds in type IIB supergravity. We start by reviewing the solutions in a more convenient set of coordinates, which allows us to explicitly compute a few relevant observables, including the holographic central charge. Subsequently, we study non-supersymmetric 7-brane configurations sourced by the IIB axio-dilaton. We find explicit analytic 7-brane solutions that possess the above $\mathrm{AdS}_9$ backgrounds as their near-horizon geometry. Finally, we discuss the relation of these 7-brane solutions to the R7 branes by imposing the reflection monodromy $\tau \rightarrow -\bar \tau$ in the transverse plane.

classification.title_zh: IIB 型理论中的 R7-膜与 AdS₉ 解
classification.abstract_zh: 我们考虑最近在 IIB 型超引力中发现的 AdS₉ 背景。首先用更方便的坐标重新审视这些解，从而显式计算全息中心荷等若干相关观测量。随后研究由 IIB 轴-伸缩子源生的非超对称 7-膜位形，找到以这些 AdS₉ 背景为近地平几何的显式解析 7-膜解。最后，通过在横截平面施加反射单值性 τ→−τ̄，讨论这些 7-膜解与 R7-膜的关系。
classification.one_liner: 在 IIB 超引力中整理 AdS₉ 背景并构造以之为近地平几何的非超对称 7-膜解，讨论其与 R7-膜及反射单值性的关系。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 IIB 超引力中的 AdS₉ 背景、7-膜解与全息中心荷，属于 AdS/CFT 与弦论背景构造；不涉及用户重点的全息超流/超导、p波、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、相变气泡成核、QNM、冷原子或 D3-D7/Floquet 等支线。

papers.title: Emergence of Lorentzian geometry from string Carroll geometry
papers.abstract: The near horizon region of a generic non extremal black hole has been extensively studied in terms of a Carrollian geometry with two null directions, also called a string Carroll geometry. We investigate how this string Carroll geometry evolves to a Lorentzian throat as the four dimensional Reissner-Nordstr\"om (RN) black hole approaches extremality. We identify the quadratic temporal contribution that is suppressed in the non extremal description but is required to recover the $\mathrm{AdS}_2$ curvature. Approaching the outer horizon and extremality simultaneously, scaling the horizon separation together with the radial distance and correspondingly rescaling Killing time, brings this contribution into the leading longitudinal metric alongside the Rindler sector. In ingoing Eddington-Finkelstein coordinates, the string Carroll metric alone has a Lorentzian limit with a flat longitudinal sector. The quadratic temporal term arises from the bilinear of the leading and subleading longitudinal coframe fields and supplies the missing curvature, while higher radial contributions vanish. The reconstructed limiting geometry is already locally $\mathrm{AdS}_2\times S^2$ at finite positive scaled horizon separation; setting this parameter to zero makes the selected horizon extremal without changing the local curvature. The limiting metric and Maxwell field satisfy the Einstein-Maxwell equations. In static coordinates, the temporal component again follows from the quadratic term, while the radial component requires summing contributions from all radial orders. The reconstruction provides a geometric starting point for investigating which expansion data must be retained when extending calculations based on the non extremal string Carroll description into the throat regime, including their implications for string, particle and field dynamics.

classification.title_zh: 从弦Carroll几何中涌现洛伦兹几何
classification.abstract_zh: 非极端黑洞近视界区域常由具有两个零方向的Carroll几何（弦Carroll几何）描述。本文研究四维Reissner-Nordström黑洞趋近极端时，弦Carroll几何如何演化为洛伦兹喉。作者识别出非极端描述中受抑制、但恢复AdS2曲率所需的二次时间项；同时趋近外视界与极端极限，缩放视界间距和径向距离并重标度Killing时间，可将该贡献带入领头纵向度规并与Rindler扇区并列。在ingoing Eddington-Finkelstein坐标下，仅弦Carroll度规本身也具有纵向扇区为平直的洛伦兹极限；二次时间项来自领头与次领头纵向余标架场的双线性，提供缺失曲率，而更高径向贡献消失。重构的极限几何在有限正缩放视界间距时已局部为AdS2×S2；令该参数为零可使所选视界极端而不改变局部曲率。极限度规与Maxwell场满足Einstein-Maxwell方程。在静态坐标中，时间分量同样来自二次项，而径向分量需对所有径向阶求和。该重构为将基于非极端弦Carroll描述的计算推广到喉区时需保留哪些展开数据提供几何起点，并涉及对弦、粒子和场动力学的意义。
classification.one_liner: 四维RN黑洞趋近极端时，弦Carroll近视界几何通过二次时间项重构出AdS2×S2洛伦兹喉。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要属于Carroll几何与黑洞近视界的经典引力研究，涉及AdS2喉重构；与用户的经典引力支线相关，但摘要未涉及全息超流、探针膜、QNM等具体重点标签，也未明确讨论全息对偶。

papers.title: Asymptotic Algebras and Holography of Information in CGHS Model
papers.abstract: Holography of Information (HoI) and the island formula are two recent approaches to the black hole information loss paradox that yield different Page curves. The difference between the Page curves has been argued to be rooted in the algebra that each approach focuses on. In this paper, we study the candidate algebras for the CGHS model. For the gravitational completion constructed here and under assumptions analogous to those made in previous HoI literature, we establish HoI for the CGHS model coupled to a massless scalar by constructing the radiative phase space and asymptotic algebras at future null infinity. We prove that the quantum state of the right-moving modes can be recovered from an arbitrarily small neighbourhood of the past endpoint of the right future null infinity. We then argue that island reconstruction is incompatible with exact commutativity of the left and right radiative algebras. We discuss the possible distinction between the HoI and island approaches for the CGHS model.

classification.title_zh: CGHS 模型中的渐近代数与信息全息
classification.abstract_zh: 信息全息（HoI）与岛公式是处理黑洞信息悖论的两种近期方案，给出不同 Page 曲线；差异被认为源于各自关注的代数。本文研究 CGHS 模型的候选代数。作者构造引力完成，并在类似此前 HoI 文献的假设下，通过构造未来零无穷的辐射相空间和渐近代数，对耦合无质量标量的 CGHS 模型建立 HoI。证明右行模的量子态可从右未来零无穷过去端点的任意小邻域恢复。随后论证岛重建与左右辐射代数的精确对易不相容。讨论 CGHS 模型中 HoI 与岛方案的可能区别。
classification.one_liner: 在 CGHS 模型中构造未来零无穷渐近代数并建立信息全息，同时论证岛重建与左右辐射代数精确对易不相容。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于黑洞信息悖论与全息信息方向，未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、探针膜、QNM 等具体支线。

papers.title: Finite N Black Holes through the Brick Wall
papers.abstract: In AdS/CFT at finite $N$, black holes are described by ordinary quantum systems with finite entropy and discrete spectra, while semiclassical bulk effective field theory treats the near-horizon region as an ideal continuum. We reconsider the brick-wall model as a simple effective description of the finite $N$ departure from the semiclassical near-horizon continuum in AdS/CFT. A Dirichlet wall is reflecting; however, once the regulated near-wall modes are replaced by interacting stretched-horizon degrees of freedom, the exterior simple sector can look absorptive and black-hole-like. If these degrees of freedom are thermally populated while the exterior incoming modes are in their vacuum, they radiate as ordinary hot matter, and this gives Hawking radiation. Furthermore, we show that finite $N$ prevents the near-horizon sector from being an ideal continuum absorber; the brick-wall model is a simple effective representation of this limitation, where the failure of perfect absorption appears as residual reflection or echoes. Such return effects appear on the echo time scale $\kappa^{-1}\log S_{\rm BH}$ and are not expected to be suppressed as $e^{-S_{\rm BH}}$, although their detailed amplitude is model-dependent. We also discuss brick-wall-like models in which the effective inner boundary arises dynamically from a regular matter core rather than from an imposed boundary condition.

classification.title_zh: 通过砖墙模型研究有限 N 黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 在有限 N 的 AdS/CFT 中，黑洞由具有有限熵和离散谱的普通量子系统描述，而半经典体有效场论把近视界区域视为理想连续体。我们重新考虑砖墙模型，将其作为有限 N 对半经典近视界连续体偏离的简单有效描述。Dirichlet 墙是反射的；但一旦受调控的近墙模式被替换为相互作用的拉伸视界自由度，外部简单扇区可表现为吸收性并类似黑洞。若这些自由度处于热布居而外部入射模式处于真空，它们像普通热物质一样辐射，从而给出霍金辐射。我们还表明有限 N 阻止近视界扇区成为理想连续吸收体；砖墙模型是这一限制的简单有效表示，其中完美吸收的失败表现为残余反射或回声。这类返回效应出现在回声时标 κ^{-1} log S_BH 上，预计不会以 e^{-S_BH} 被压低，尽管其具体振幅依赖模型。我们还讨论了砖墙类模型，其中有效内边界由规则物质核动力学产生，而非由强加边界条件产生。
classification.one_liner: 用砖墙模型刻画有限 N AdS/CFT 黑洞近视界连续体的失效，并讨论霍金辐射与回声。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 中有限 N 黑洞与近视界量子物理，涉及霍金辐射和回声；与用户列出的全息黑洞/量子信息主题相关，但未直接落在多数重点支线标签上。

papers.title: Modular Krylov Complexity as a Boundary Probe of Area Operators and Entanglement Islands
papers.abstract: We show that the area operator of a quantum extremal surface can be reconstructed directly from boundary dynamics without reference to bulk geometry. Our approach combines the operator-algebra quantum error-correction (OAQEC) structure of AdS/CFT with modular Krylov complexity. Using Lanczos coefficients of boundary modular dynamics, we extract the spectrum of the modular Hamiltonian restricted to the algebra of the entanglement wedge and isolate its central contribution, which is identified with the area operator. The construction is purely boundary-based and applies to superpositions of semiclassical geometries as well. As a prospective application, we discuss island formation and the Page transition in evaporating black holes using boundary modular evolution, bypassing any bulk extremization. More broadly, our results establish modular Krylov complexity as a probe of emergent spacetime geometry, providing a new route to accessing black hole interiors from boundary quantum dynamics.

classification.title_zh: 模 Krylov 复杂度作为面积算符与纠缠岛的边界探针
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明，量子极值面的面积算符可以直接从边界动力学重构，而不依赖体几何。我们的方法结合了 AdS/CFT 的算符代数量子纠错（OAQEC）结构与模 Krylov 复杂度。利用边界模动力学的 Lanczos 系数，我们提取限制在纠缠楔代数上的模哈密顿量谱，并分离其中心贡献，将其识别为面积算符。该构造纯基于边界，并且适用于半经典几何的叠加。作为一个前瞻性应用，我们讨论蒸发黑洞中岛的形成与 Page 转变，使用边界模演化绕过任何体极值化。更广泛地说，我们的结果确立模 Krylov 复杂度作为涌现时空几何的探针，为从边界量子动力学访问黑洞内部提供了一条新途径。
classification.one_liner: 用边界模 Krylov 复杂度从边界动力学重构量子极值面面积算符，并讨论纠缠岛与 Page 转变。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 与量子信息/黑洞信息交叉方向，涉及纠缠楔、面积算符和纠缠岛；但与用户列出的全息超流超导、p波、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、QNM、D3-D7/Floquet、经典引力等重点支线没有直接对应。

papers.title: Time Evolution of Multi-Party Entanglement Signals
papers.abstract: We study the real-time dynamics of multi-party entanglement signals in chaotic quantum many-body systems including but not necessarily restricted to holographic conformal field theories. We find that scrambling dynamics generates multiparty entanglement with rich structure including: (a) qualitatively different dynamical behaviours for different signals, likely reflecting different dynamics for different kinds of entanglement patterns, (b) discontinuities indicating dynamical phase transitions in the entanglement structure, (c) transient and non-monotonic multiparty entanglement, and (d) periods during which the extensive entanglement of some regions is entirely multipartite. Our main technical tool is the membrane theory of entanglement dynamics.

classification.title_zh: 多分体纠缠信号的时间演化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究混沌量子多体系统中多分体纠缠信号的实时动力学，这些系统包括但不限于全息共形场论。我们发现扰乱动力学产生具有丰富结构的多分体纠缠，包括：(a) 不同信号具有定性不同的动力学行为，可能反映不同纠缠模式的不同动力学；(b) 不连续性，表明纠缠结构中的动力学相变；(c) 瞬态且非单调的多分体纠缠；(d) 某些区域的广延纠缠完全为多分体纠缠的时段。我们的主要技术工具是纠缠动力学的膜理论。
classification.one_liner: 利用膜理论研究混沌量子多体中多分体纠缠信号的实时演化，发现动力学相变和非单调瞬态结构。

papers.title: Contact diagrams for chords
papers.abstract: We demonstrate how contact chord diagrams can arise from certain Fock-space models and compute the corresponding correlation functions using the chord path integral technique. In particular, our three-point functions are in the right form dictated by conformal symmetry, and some of our four-point functions match the results of some AdS$_2$ contact Witten diagrams.

classification.title_zh: Chord 图的接触图
classification.abstract_zh: 我们展示接触 chord 图如何从某些 Fock 空间模型中出现，并使用 chord 路径积分技术计算相应的关联函数。特别地，我们的三点函数具有共形对称性所要求的形式，且部分四点函数与某些 AdS2 接触 Witten 图的结果一致。
classification.one_liner: 展示 Fock 空间模型产生接触 chord 图，并用 chord 路径积分计算关联函数；三点函数符合共形对称性，部分四点函数匹配 AdS2 接触 Witten 图。
