papers.title: The entanglement membrane in 2d CFT: reflected entropy, RG flow, and information velocity
papers.abstract: The time evolution of entanglement entropy in generic chaotic many-body systems has an effective description in terms of a minimal membrane, characterised by a tension function. For 2d CFTs, a degenerate tension function reproduces several results regarding the dynamics of the entropy; this stands in contrast to higher dimensions where the tension is non-degenerate. In this paper we use holography to show that, in order to correctly capture the reflected entropy in 2d CFT, one needs to add an additional degree of freedom to the membrane description. Furthermore, we show that the conventional non-degenerate membrane tension function emerges upon introducing a relevant deformation of the CFT, dual to a planar BTZ black hole with scalar hair and with an interior Kasner universe. Finally, we also study the membrane description for reflected entropy and information velocity arXiv:1908.06993 in higher dimensions.

classification.title_zh: 二维 CFT 中的纠缠膜：反射熵、RG 流与信息速度
classification.abstract_zh: 一般混沌多体系统中纠缠熵的时间演化可用最小膜有效描述，并由张力函数刻画。对于二维 CFT，退化的张力函数能复现若干熵动力学结果，这与高维中非退化张力的情形形成对比。本文利用全息方法表明，要在二维 CFT 中正确捕捉反射熵，需在膜描述中增加一个额外自由度。进一步地，作者证明在引入 CFT 的相关形变后，会出现传统的非退化膜张力函数；该形变对偶于带标量毛的平面 BTZ 黑洞，并具有内区 Kasner 宇宙。最后，本文还研究了高维中反射熵与信息速度的膜描述。
classification.one_liner: 用全息方法修正二维 CFT 的纠缠膜描述以纳入反射熵，并研究 RG 流与高维信息速度。

papers.title: Comments on Celestial CFT and $AdS_{3}$ String Theory
papers.abstract: In a recent work, Ogawa et al. (2024) proposed a model for celestial conformal field theory (CFT) based on the $H_{3}^{+}$-Wess-Zumino-Novikov-Witten (WZNW) model. In this paper, we extend the model advanced by Ogawa et al. (2024), demonstrating how it can holographically generate tree-level MHV scattering amplitudes for both gluons and gravitons when analytically continued to the ultra-hyperbolic Klein space $\mathbf{R}_{2}^{2}$, thereby offering an alternative to celestial Liouville theory. We construct a holographic dictionary in which vertex operators and conformal primaries in celestial CFT are derived from their worldsheet counterparts in Euclidean $AdS_{3}$ (bosonic) string theory. Within this dictionary, we derive the celestial stress-energy tensor, compute the two- and three-point functions, and determine the celestial operator product expansion (OPE). Additionally, we derive a system of partial differential equations that characterises the celestial amplitudes of our model, utilising the Knizhnik--Zamolodchikov (KZ) equations and worldsheet Ward identities. In the Appendix, we provide a concise introduction to the $H_{3}^{+}$-WZNW model, with emphasis on its connection to Euclidean $AdS_{3}$ string theory.

classification.title_zh: 关于天球 CFT 与 AdS3 弦论的评论
classification.abstract_zh: 本文评述并扩展 Ogawa 等人（2024）基于 H3+ WZNW 模型提出的天球共形场论模型。作者展示，在解析延拓到超双曲 Klein 空间 R2^2 后，该模型可由全息方式生成胶子与引力子的树级 MHV 散射振幅，从而为天球 Liouville 理论提供替代方案。文中构建了全息字典，将天球 CFT 中的顶点算符和共形原初场对应到欧氏 AdS3（玻色）弦论的世界面对象；在该字典下导出天球能动张量，计算两点与三点函数，并确定天球算符乘积展开。作者还利用 Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov 方程与世界面 Ward 恒等式，导出刻画该模型天球振幅的偏微分方程组。附录简要介绍 H3+ WZNW 模型，并强调其与欧氏 AdS3 弦论的联系。
classification.one_liner: 扩展 H3+-WZNW 天球 CFT，并通过欧氏 AdS3 弦论全息字典生成胶子与引力子的树级 MHV 天球振幅。

papers.title: 6d Large Charge and 2d Virasoro Blocks
papers.abstract: We compute observables in the interacting rank-one 6d $\mathcal{N}=(2,0)$ SCFT at large R-charge. We focus on correlators involving $\Phi^n$, namely symmetric products of the bottom component of the supermultiplet containing the stress-tensor. By using the moduli space effective action and methods from the large-charge expansion, we compute the OPE coefficients $\langle\Phi^n\Phi^m\Phi^{n+m}\rangle$ in an expansion in 1/n. The coefficients of the expansion are only partially determined from the 6d perspective, but we manage to fix them order-by-order in 1/n numerically by utilizing the 6d/2d correspondence. This is made possible by the fact that this $6d$ observable can be extracted in 2d from a specific double-scaling limit of the vacuum Virasoro block, which can be efficiently computed numerically. We also extend the computation to higher-rank SCFTs, and discuss various applications of our results to 6d as well as 2d.

classification.title_zh: 6维大荷与2维Virasoro块
classification.abstract_zh: 我们计算了相互作用的rank-one 6维 N=(2,0) SCFT 在大R荷下的可观测量。重点关注涉及 Φ^n 的关联函数，即包含应力张量超多重态底分量的对称乘积。利用模空间有效作用量和大荷展开方法，我们计算了OPE系数 ⟨Φ^nΦ^mΦ^{n+m}⟩ 的1/n展开。该展开的系数从6维角度只能部分确定，但我们利用6d/2d对应，通过数值方法逐阶固定它们。这是因为该6维可观测量可从真空Virasoro块的特定双标度极限在2维提取，而该块可被高效数值计算。我们还将计算推广到更高阶SCFT，并讨论结果在6维和2维中的应用。
classification.one_liner: 利用6d/2d对应和真空Virasoro块数值计算6维N=(2,0) SCFT大R荷下的OPE系数。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主题为6维SCFT大荷展开与2维Virasoro块，不涉及用户重点的全息超流/超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、QNM、D3-D7探针膜或经典引力。

papers.title: Holographic RG Flows from Running Couplings
papers.abstract: We investigate the RG flow in the holographic setup and study new IR physics at the IR fixed point, when a relevant scalar operator deforms a two-dimensional conformal field theory (CFT). On the dual gravity side, the renormalization group (RG) flow from the UV to the IR CFT can be described by a scalar field rolling from an unstable to a stable equilibrium point. Specifically, to make the scale dependence of the RG flow more explicit, we study the running coupling constant obtained by solving the beta function. After considering a simple scalar potential, we study the change of the coupling constant and its effect on the ground state along the RG flow. We showed that the central charge monotonically decreases along the RG flow, and its value at the IR fixed point is determined by the conformal dimension of the deformation operator and the coupling constant at the IR fixed point. We further investigate how changing the ground state influences the two-point function and conformal dimension of a local operator in the probe limit.

classification.title_zh: 从跑动耦合研究全息RG流
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在全息框架下研究RG流，考察相关标量算符变形二维共形场论时在IR固定点出现的新物理。对偶引力侧从UV到IR CFT的RG流由标量场从不稳定平衡点滚向稳定平衡点描述。为更显式体现能标依赖，我们通过求解beta函数研究跑动耦合常数。采用简单标量势后，研究耦合常数变化及其沿RG流对基态的影响。结果表明中心荷沿RG流单调减小，其IR固定点值由变形算符的共形维数和IR固定点耦合常数决定。我们进一步在探针极限下研究基态改变如何影响局部算符的两点函数和共形维数。
classification.one_liner: 研究二维CFT相关变形对偶引力中的全息RG流，并分析中心荷与探针两点函数随IR固定点的变化。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于全息RG流与AdS/CFT字典的基础研究，但未直接涉及用户列出的全息超流超导、探针膜、QNM与非线性演化等具体重点支线。

papers.title: New horizons for inhomogeneous quenches and Floquet CFT
papers.abstract: A fruitful avenue in investigating out-of-equilibrium quantum many-body systems is to abruptly change their Hamiltonian and study the subsequent evolution of their quantum state. If this is done once, the setup is called a quench, while if it is done periodically, it is called Floquet driving. We consider the solvable setup of a two-dimensional CFT driven by Hamiltonians built out of conformal symmetry generators: in this case, the quantum dynamics can be understood using two-dimensional geometry. We investigate how the dynamics is reflected in the holographic dual three-dimensional spacetime and find new horizons. We argue that bulk operators behind the new horizons are reconstructable by virtue of modular flow.

classification.title_zh: 非均匀淬火与 Floquet CFT 的新视界
classification.abstract_zh: 研究二维 CFT 在由共形对称生成元构成的哈密顿量驱动下的非平衡动力学，包括单次非均匀淬火和周期 Floquet 驱动。利用二维几何描述量子演化，并考察其在三维全息对偶时空中的体现，发现新视界；作者论证新视界后的体算符可借助模流重构。
classification.one_liner: 用二维 CFT 几何与三维全息对偶研究非均匀淬火/Floquet 驱动，发现新视界并讨论模流重构。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究驱动二维 CFT 的非平衡动力学及其三维全息对偶，涉及新视界与模流重构，属于全息非平衡与 AdS/CFT 字典方向；未以经典广义相对论为主要对象。

papers.title: Exact static two-body gravitational potential at first self-force order
papers.abstract: The static interaction potential of two non-spinning point masses in general relativity was previously computed through seventh post-Newtonian order using methods of effective field theory. Its probe limit, or zeroth-self-force contribution, is determined exactly by the Schwarzschild geometry. We derive a closed-form expression for the static first-self-force correction, quadratic in the light mass, and establish its weak-field expansion to all orders. Working in harmonic gauge, we construct the required Green function for the coupled linearised gravitational equations about the Schwarzschild background. We fix its homogeneous contributions and regularised coincident limit by matching to the dimensionally continued point-source theory. The result reproduces known perturbative coefficients and determines all higher static post-Newtonian coefficients in this mass sector.

classification.title_zh: 一阶自力阶的精确静态两体引力势
classification.abstract_zh: 广义相对论中两个非自旋点质量的静态相互作用势此前已通过有效场论方法计算到七阶后牛顿阶。其探测极限，即零阶自力贡献，由 Schwarzschild 几何精确确定。我们推导了静态一阶自力修正的闭式表达式，该修正对轻质量是二次的，并建立了其到所有阶的弱场展开。在谐和规范下，我们构造了围绕 Schwarzschild 背景的耦合线性化引力方程所需的 Green 函数。我们通过匹配到维度延拓的点源理论，固定其齐次贡献与正则化重合极限。结果复现已知微扰系数，并确定了该质量扇区中所有更高阶静态后牛顿系数。
classification.one_liner: 在 Schwarzschild 背景下构造线性化引力 Green 函数，给出两体静态一阶自力势的闭式表达式及全阶弱场展开。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究广义相对论框架下的两体静态引力势与一阶自力修正，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: Exact Regular Planar Black Holes solutions in Bumblebee gravity
papers.abstract: We discuss possibilities of finding exact regular planar black hole solutions in bumblebee gravity with temporal and radial components of the bumblebee field. We consider quadratic and linear potentials, with vanishing and nonzero cosmological constants, respectively. The field equations determine the nonminimal coupling and the relations between the model parameters. Found solution produce regular planar black hole with planar deformation function. Analytical expressions for this functions has been found. This solutions free of singularities at the $r=0$.

classification.title_zh: Bumblebee 引力中的精确正则平面黑洞解
classification.abstract_zh: 我们讨论了在 bumblebee 引力中寻找精确正则平面黑洞解的可能性，其中 bumblebee 场包含时间分量和径向分量。我们分别考虑二次势和线性势，宇宙学常数分别取零和非零。场方程确定了非最小耦合以及模型参数之间的关系。所得解产生具有平面形变函数的正则平面黑洞。我们找到了这些函数的解析表达式。这些解在 r=0 处无奇点。
classification.one_liner: 在 bumblebee 引力中构造含时间与径向分量的精确正则平面黑洞解，并给出形变函数的解析形式。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究修改引力中的经典平面黑洞精确解，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；未涉及 AdS/CFT、全息字典或量子信息内容。

papers.title: A new toric ALF gravitational instanton
papers.abstract: We construct a new explicit toric ALF gravitational instanton. The instanton has Euler characteristic $\chi = 4$ and Hirzebruch signature $\tau = 1$. The topology at infinity is a lens space $L(3,1)$. The solution depends on one parameter and is constructed from the Belinski--Zakharov four-soliton solution. We prove that the instanton is smooth and positive definite on and away from the axis. This is the first example of a non-Hermitian ALF (not AF) gravitational instanton.

classification.title_zh: 一个新的 toric ALF 引力瞬子
classification.abstract_zh: 作者构造了一个新的显式 toric ALF 引力瞬子。该瞬子欧拉示性数为 χ=4，Hirzebruch 符号差为 τ=1，无穷远处拓扑为透镜空间 L(3,1)。解依赖于一个参数，由 Belinski-Zakharov 四孤子解构造。作者证明该瞬子在轴上及轴外均光滑且正定。这是首个非 Hermitian ALF（非 AF）引力瞬子的例子。
classification.one_liner: 构造了首个非 Hermitian 的 toric ALF 引力瞬子，并证明其光滑正定。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论中的显式引力瞬子构造，直接匹配用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；不涉及全息或量子信息。

papers.title: Spectral instability of charged scalar quasinormal modes and superradiance: Stabilizing the unstable
papers.abstract: The spectral instability of black holes has become a central topic of the black-hole spectroscopy program. Small changes to the black-hole scattering potential are known to produce disproportionately large migrations of its quasinormal modes in the complex plane, but it is unclear whether this sensitivity carries over to energy extraction through superradiance. We study this relation for massless charged scalar fields on Reissner--Nordstr\"om and Reissner--Nordstr\"om--de Sitter backgrounds. A localized positive potential bump, small in mass-scaled height, is displaced outward from the light ring while the original radiative boundary conditions are preserved. In the asymptotically flat case, a quasinormal branch enters the superradiant frequency regime while remaining damped. By searching for competing modes, we show that the least-damped positive-frequency mode also enters this regime, after a series of mode overtakings driven by quasinormal-mode migration. The real-frequency amplification, nevertheless, is only weakly affected and develops no pronounced narrow resonance. In de Sitter black holes, the bump can move an initially growing monopole mode into the damped half of the complex plane, stabilizing selected configurations that are initially modally unstable. After stabilization, the peak superradiant amplification can remain above both its unperturbed value and a gain of $100\%$; it falls below $100\%$ only for more distant bump locations. A prescribed positive perturbation can thus suppress modal growth without changing the superradiant frequency bounds or immediately suppressing the scattering peak.

classification.title_zh: 带电标量准正规模的光谱不稳定性与超辐射：使不稳定稳定
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞的光谱不稳定性已成为黑洞光谱学计划的核心议题。已知对黑洞散射势的小改动会使准正规模在复平面上发生不成比例的大迁移，但这种敏感性是否延续到通过超辐射提取能量仍不清楚。作者在 Reissner–Nordström 与 Reissner–Nordström–de Sitter 背景上研究无质量带电标量场的这一关系。一个质量标度高度很小的局域正势垒被向外移离光球，同时保持原来的辐射边界条件。在渐近平直情形中，一个准正规模分支进入超辐射频率区间但仍保持阻尼；通过寻找竞争模式，作者表明，在准正规模迁移驱动的一系列模式交叉之后，最弱阻尼的正频模式也进入该区间。然而实频放大仅受弱影响，并未出现明显的窄共振。在 de Sitter 黑洞中，该势垒可将一个最初增长的单极模式移入复平面的阻尼半平面，从而稳定某些最初模式不稳定的构型。稳定之后，峰值超辐射放大仍可高于其未扰动值并高于 100%；只有当势垒位置更远时它才降到 100% 以下。因此，一个指定的正扰动可以抑制模式增长，而不改变超辐射频率边界，也不立即抑制散射峰。
classification.one_liner: 微小正势垒可迁移 RN/RN-dS 黑洞带电标量 QNM 并稳定部分增长模，但超辐射放大基本不受显著影响。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究黑洞准正规模谱不稳定性与超辐射，属于 QNM 与经典引力支线；摘要未涉及全息对偶、全息超导/超流或 AdS/CFT 字典。

papers.title: Cloudy black-hole configurations of the composed Einstein-Yang-Mills-Higgs field theory: Analytic treatment
papers.abstract: Non-Abelian black holes that violate the non-hair conjecture are known to exist in the Einstein-Yang-Mills-Higgs field theory. The onset of hair formation in this composed physical system is marked by the presence of `cloudy' black-hole spacetimes, magnetically charged Reissner-Nordstr\"om black holes that support spatially regular linearized field configurations. In the present paper we explore, using {\it analytical} techniques, the physical and mathematical properties of the composed black-hole-linearized-field bound-state configurations of the Einstein-Yang-Mills-Higgs theory. In particular, we derive a remarkably compact analytical formula for the discrete resonance spectrum $\{\mu_k\}^{k=\infty}_{k=1}$ of the dimensionless mass-radius parameter $\mu\equiv m_{\text{w}} r_+$ that characterizes the cloudy black-hole-field configurations in the regime $1\ll r_+\ll m^{-1}_{\text{w}}$ of small-mass weakly-magnetized black holes (here $r_+$ is the horizon radius of the central supporting black hole and $m_{\text{w}}$ is the mass of the Yang-Mills field due to the Higgs effect). Interestingly, our results reveal that the excited black-hole-field resonances are characterized by the asymptotic $k$-independent dimensionless ratio ${{\mu_{k+1}}/{\mu_{k}}}=e^{-{{2\pi}/{\sqrt{3}}}}$.

classification.title_zh: 复合 Einstein-Yang-Mills-Higgs 场论中的云状黑洞构型：解析处理
classification.abstract_zh: Einstein-Yang-Mills-Higgs 场论中已知存在违反无毛猜想的非阿贝尔黑洞；毛发形成的起点表现为“云状”黑洞时空，即支持空间规则线性化场构型的磁荷 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞。本文用解析技术研究该理论中黑洞-线性化场束缚态的物理与数学性质，推导出描述云状黑洞-场构型的无量纲质量-半径参数 μ≡m_w r_+ 的离散共振谱 {μ_k} 的紧凑解析公式，适用于小质量弱磁化黑洞区域 1≪r_+≪m_w^{-1}（r_+ 为中心黑洞视界半径，m_w 为 Higgs 效应导致的 Yang-Mills 场质量）。结果表明激发黑洞-场共振满足渐近的 k 无关比值 μ_{k+1}/μ_k=e^{-2π/√3}。
classification.one_liner: 用解析方法给出 Einstein-Yang-Mills-Higgs 理论云状黑洞线性化束缚态的离散共振谱及其渐近比值。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究经典 Einstein-Yang-Mills-Higgs 黑洞与线性化场共振，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

papers.title: A simple flux criterion for trapped surface formation by short pulses of gravitational radiation and matter
papers.abstract: We discuss the formation of trapped surfaces induced by short pulses of incoming gravitational radiation and matter fields, in a double-null formulation. We identify a hierarchy of orders in the pulse width for the geometric and matter quantities consistent with the evolution equations. Under the assumption that this hierarchy holds throughout the region considered, the incoming fluxes undergo approximately conservative inward transport and are thereby amplified. The Raychaudhuri equation then gives an initial flux criterion for trapped surface formation. The conditions on the matter are expressed through the Ricci components and their derivatives, which allows the argument to be developed without specifying a particular matter model.

classification.title_zh: 短脉冲引力辐射与物质形成陷俘面的简单通量判据
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在双零坐标表述下讨论由入射引力辐射和物质场短脉冲诱导的陷俘面形成。作者识别出与演化方程一致的、按脉冲宽度组织的几何量和物质量层级；在该层级于所考虑区域成立的假设下，入射通量近似做保守的内向输运并被放大。随后Raychaudhuri方程给出陷俘面形成的初始通量判据。对物质的约束通过Ricci分量及其导数表达，因此论证无需指定具体物质模型。
classification.one_liner: 在双零坐标下利用脉冲宽度层级与Raychaudhuri方程，给出短脉冲引力辐射/物质形成陷俘面的初始通量判据。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究短脉冲引力辐射与物质导致陷俘面形成的经典广义相对论判据，直接属于重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”。

papers.title: Static Vacuum Geometry Encodes Gravitational Collapse and Cosmology
papers.abstract: We show that, within covariant Hamiltonian gravity in spherical symmetry, a prescribed one-parameter family of static vacuum geometries uniquely determines the local dynamics of gravitational collapse coupled to irrotational dust, despite the nonuniqueness of the underlying gravitational Hamiltonian. We further derive necessary and sufficient conditions under which the resulting dynamics admits a homogeneous and isotropic cosmological sector. These conditions establish a two-way correspondence between static vacuum geometries and modified Friedmann dynamics and impose a universal restriction on the spatial-curvature dependence of the latter. Our results provide a criterion for determining whether independently proposed black-hole and cosmological models can arise from a common covariant gravitational theory.

classification.title_zh: 静态真空几何编码引力坍缩与宇宙学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明，在球对称的协变哈密顿引力中，给定的一参数静态真空几何族唯一地确定与无旋尘埃耦合的引力坍缩的局域动力学，尽管底层引力哈密顿量不唯一。我们进一步导出所得动力学允许均匀各向同性宇宙学扇区的充要条件。这些条件在静态真空几何与修正 Friedmann 动力学之间建立双向对应，并对后者对空间曲率的依赖施加普遍限制。我们的结果为判断独立提出的黑洞模型和宇宙学模型是否能来自同一协变引力理论提供了判据。
classification.one_liner: 球对称协变哈密顿引力中，静态真空几何可唯一决定坍缩动力学，并给出其与修正 Friedmann 宇宙学对应的判据。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/广义相对论及宇宙学；未涉及全息对偶或量子引力，但与用户重点中的经典引力支线直接相关。

papers.title: Black Hole Love Numbers with Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.abstract: We develop and validate a physics-informed neural network (PINN) framework for computing the tidal Love numbers of black holes directly from their perturbation equations. We consider static perturbations of the Kerr black hole, whose exact hypergeometric solutions provide a controlled benchmark for both the numerical solver and the extraction of the physical response. The framework combines exact enforcement of the horizon boundary conditions with an $H^2$-Sobolev loss that incorporates derivatives of the differential-equation residual. The Love number is then obtained by extracting the asymptotic coefficients of the learned solution, without using the analytic connection formula. Across the tested scalar, vector, and tensor perturbations, the method recovers the finite dissipative response with relative errors below $10^{-5}$. Controlled comparisons show that the higher-derivative loss terms improve solution accuracy by orders of magnitude, while independent tests of the extraction procedure distinguish solver errors from errors in recovering the response coefficients. The conservative response, which vanishes analytically, is constrained by the numerical error floor. These results demonstrate that PINNs can accurately compute black-hole tidal response and establish a validated framework for future extensions to frequency-dependent and non-separable perturbation problems.

classification.title_zh: 用物理信息神经网络计算黑洞潮汐 Love 数
classification.abstract_zh: 本文提出并验证一个物理信息神经网络（PINN）框架，用于直接从黑洞微扰方程计算潮汐 Love 数。作者考虑 Kerr 黑洞的静态微扰，其精确超几何解为数值求解器和物理响应提取提供受控基准。该框架将视界边界条件的精确实施与包含微分方程残差导数的 H^2-Sobolev 损失相结合，并通过学习到的解的渐近系数提取 Love 数，而不使用解析连接公式。在标量、矢量和张量微扰测试中，方法恢复了有限的耗散响应，相对误差低于 10^{-5}。受控比较表明，高阶导数损失项将解精度提高数个量级，而对提取过程的独立测试可区分求解器误差与响应系数恢复误差。解析上为零的保守响应受数值误差下限约束。结果表明 PINN 能准确计算黑洞潮汐响应，并为未来推广到频率依赖和不可分离微扰问题建立经过验证的框架。
classification.one_liner: 该工作验证了 PINN 可直接从 Kerr 黑洞静态微扰方程高精度提取潮汐 Love 数，并建立了可扩展的数值框架。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典广义相对论中的黑洞微扰与潮汐响应计算，直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线；不涉及全息、量子引力或量子信息。

papers.title: Cuscuton Fifth Force: Implications of Non-Dynamical Scalars for Structure Growth
papers.abstract: The cuscuton is a scalar field that obeys a constraint rather than an evolution equation, so it modifies gravity without adding a propagating scalar degree of freedom. We study the cosmology of effective cuscuton theory when matter is minimally coupled in the Jordan frame, and therefore conformally coupled to the cuscuton in the Einstein-frame. We derive the background and linear perturbation equations and show that the algebraic cuscuton response mediates a fifth force even though the scalar itself does not propagate. The same conformal factor also changes Einstein-frame particle masses and the friction of matter perturbations, tying the strength and sign of the force to the background evolution rather than to an independent coupling. We study a power-law family of models which contain both tracking solutions and sign-switching solutions; in the latter the effective cuscuton density runs from negative during matter domination to a positive, cosmological-constant-like value today. Using a modified version of CLASS, including the induced particle-mass dependence of recombination, we illustrate the corresponding changes to CMB temperature and linear matter power spectra for benchmark models, without fitting to data. In the strongest benchmarks the fifth force changes the effective gravitational coupling on sub-horizon scales by about one percent, smaller than the accompanying changes to the matter power spectrum and the acoustic scale. For the sign-switching solutions this change is negative over most of cosmic history, so a non-propagating field can weaken rather than strengthen gravitational attraction.

classification.title_zh: Cuscuton 第五力：非动力学标量对结构增长的影响
classification.abstract_zh: Cuscuton 是一种服从约束而非演化方程的标量场，因此它修改引力但不增加传播的标量自由度。本文研究有效 cuscuton 理论的宇宙学：物质在 Jordan 框架中最小耦合，从而在 Einstein 框架中与 cuscuton 共形耦合。我们推导背景和线性扰动方程，并表明尽管标量本身不传播，其代数响应仍会媒介一种第五力。同一共形因子还改变 Einstein 框架中的粒子质量以及物质扰动的摩擦项，使该力的强度和符号与背景演化相关，而不是与独立耦合相关。我们研究一类幂律模型，其中包含 tracking 解和符号切换解；在后一类解中，有效 cuscuton 密度在物质主导时期为负，而今天变为正的、类似宇宙学常数的值。使用修改版 CLASS（包含复合时期由诱导粒子质量依赖带来的效应），我们在基准模型中展示对 CMB 温度谱和线性物质功率谱的相应改变，但不拟合数据。在最强基准中，第五力使亚视界尺度上的有效引力耦合改变约百分之一，小于伴随的物质功率谱和声学尺度的变化。对于符号切换解，这一改变在大部分宇宙历史中为负，因此一个非传播场可以削弱而非增强引力吸引。
classification.one_liner: Cuscuton 非传播标量可通过代数响应产生第五力，并在特定宇宙学模型中削弱结构增长。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于修改引力宇宙学，研究非动力学标量、第五力和结构增长；不是全息或 AdS/CFT 研究，与用户重点的全息超流、p波、multi-trace、QNM、D3-D7 等标签无直接关联，仅与经典引力/宇宙学有弱相关。

papers.title: Excess inner-horizon entropy and the thermodynamics of Kerr formation
papers.abstract: \noindent We develop a charge-matched thermodynamic framework for the regular rotating black-hole family underlying an exact model of Kerr formation. Since the Kerr endpoint already possesses a Cauchy horizon, hidden entropy is identified with the excess inner-horizon area relative to Kerr at fixed mass $M$ and angular momentum $J=Ma$: $\Sexc=\pi[h_c^2-(r_-^{\Kerr})^2]$, where $h_c$ is the regular inner-horizon radius and $r_-^{\Kerr}=M-\sqrt{M^2-a^2}$. Under regularity and interior-profile assumptions, we prove $r_-^{\Kerr}<h_c<h$ and establish the sharp bound $0<\Sexc<4\pi M\sqrt{M^2-a^2}$. The Schwarzschild limit yields $\Sexc=\pi h_c^2$, while $\Sexc=0$ at the Kerr endpoint. The Kerr reference entropy satisfies $S_+^{\Kerr}+S_-^{\Kerr}=4\pi M^2$, so rotation redistributes its two-horizon contributions at fixed mass. For the time-dependent model, we derive exact evolution equations for the inner root and $\Sexc$, interpreted as root-bookkeeping identities unless the roots are established as dynamical horizons. In the minimal $N=1$ trajectory, the apparent pole at $n=2$ is removable in the mass profile, giving a logarithmic continuation of the root equation, although the stationary curvature is singular there. The stationary Ricci-scalar density is locally absolutely integrable for $-1<n\leq2$, with the Kerr endpoint $n=-1$ treated separately. Minkowski breaking occurs at $n=0$, independently of inner-horizon disappearance. Quasi-extremal regular configurations approach, but cannot attain, the entropy bound without losing a regular Killing horizon.

classification.title_zh: 内视界过剩熵与Kerr形成的热力学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为构成Kerr形成精确模型的规则旋转黑洞族建立电荷匹配的热力学框架。由于Kerr端点已有Cauchy视界，隐藏熵被认定为固定质量M和角动量J=Ma下相对于Kerr的内视界面积超出量：Sexc=π[h_c^2-(r_-^Kerr)^2]，其中h_c是规则内视界半径，r_-^Kerr=M-sqrt(M^2-a^2)。在规则性和内部剖面假设下，证明r_-^Kerr<h_c<h并建立严格界0<Sexc<4πM sqrt(M^2-a^2)。Schwarzschild极限给出Sexc=πh_c^2，而在Kerr端点Sexc=0。Kerr参考熵满足S_+^Kerr+S_-^Kerr=4πM^2，因此旋转在固定质量下重新分配两个视界的贡献。对于含时模型，推导内根和Sexc的精确演化方程，解释为根记账恒等式，除非这些根被确立为动力学视界。在最小N=1轨迹中，n=2处的表观极点在质量剖面中可移除，给出根方程的对数延拓，尽管稳态曲率在该处奇异。稳态Ricci标量密度在-1<n≤2时局部绝对可积，Kerr端点n=-1单独处理。Minkowski破坏发生在n=0，与内视界消失无关。准极端规则构型接近但不能达到熵界而不失去规则Killing视界。
classification.one_liner: 为Kerr形成精确模型中的规则旋转黑洞建立热力学框架，以内视界面积超出Kerr参考定义隐藏熵，并推导其严格界、演化方程及端点行为。

papers.title: Holonomy classification, gyroscope precession, and Landau levels in G\"odel-type spacetimes and their superfluid analog
papers.abstract: We derive the parallel-transport holonomies of circles centered on the symmetry axis in the homogeneous G\"odel-type family of Rebou\c{c}as and Tiomno, which includes the G\"odel universe, the causal member with $m^2=4\Omega^2$, and the Som--Raychaudhuri limit. The holonomy is governed by a single invariant $\Delta(r)$, whose sign determines whether the Lorentz transformation is elliptic, parabolic, or hyperbolic. We determine the number of parabolic radii across the family and prove that, whenever the azimuthal circles become closed timelike curves (CTCs), the chronology radius satisfies $\Delta(r_c)=-\cosh(mr_c)<0$. We also express this invariant in terms of Killing-vector scalars, derive the vector and spinor Wilson loops, give the exact condition for trivial holonomy after a finite number of turns, and analyze Fermi--Walker transport on circular CTCs. Finally, we discuss an analogy with the effective metric of a rotating superfluid, valid under stated conditions, and derive exact expressions for the radial $L^2$ localization of Klein--Gordon Landau modes relative to the Som--Raychaudhuri chronology radius. The geometric results are exact within the metric family considered; the discussion of the analog system relies on the validity of a coarse-grained effective description.

classification.title_zh: Gödel型时空中的和乐分类、陀螺仪进动与朗道能级及其超流类比
classification.abstract_zh: 本文推导了Rebouças-Tiomno均匀Gödel型族中绕对称轴圆周的平行移动和乐，该族包括Gödel宇宙、m^2=4Ω^2的因果成员和Som-Raychaudhuri极限。和乐由单一不变量Δ(r)控制，其符号决定洛伦兹变换为椭圆、抛物或双曲型。作者确定族中抛物半径数目，并证明当方位圆周成为闭合类时曲线时，时序半径满足Δ(r_c)=-cosh(mr_c)<0；还用Killing矢量标量表示该不变量，导出矢量与旋量Wilson圈，给出有限圈数后和乐平凡的精确条件，并分析圆形CTC上的Fermi-Walker输运。最后讨论与旋转超流有效度规的类比（在所述条件下成立），并给出Klein-Gordon朗道模相对于Som-Raychaudhuri时序半径的径向L^2局域化的精确表达式。几何结果在所考虑度规族内是精确的；类比系统讨论依赖粗粒化有效描述的成立。
classification.one_liner: 对Gödel型时空的平行移动和乐做精确分类，并联系陀螺仪进动、CTC、Wilson圈及旋转超流朗道模类比。

papers.title: The Fluctuation-Dissipation Theorem and Dynamical Love Number in Schwarzschild Black Holes
papers.abstract: We study the real-time response of a Schwarzschild black hole in the Hartle-Hawking state to an external massless scalar field. Using a complexified radial contour to represent the Schwinger-Keldysh closed time path, we describe dissipation, thermal fluctuations and conservative tidal response within a common framework. Before performing tidal matching, we derive the equilibrium fluctuation-dissipation relation directly from the radial construction for every scalar multipole at arbitrary real frequency. In the low-frequency tidal expansion, we recover the known relation between the logarithmic running of the conservative dynamical Love coefficient at order $\omega^2$ and the leading dissipative response at order $\omega$. We explain how the same leading absorptive coefficient enters both relations at low frequency and trace the unit coefficient of the running relation to the Schwarzschild horizon slope. In the Hartle-Hawking state, this common coefficient relates the logarithmic running directly to the zero-frequency thermal noise. Kubo-Martin-Schwinger analyticity determines the thermal noise from the dissipative response, whereas the near-zone radial equation and tidal matching determine the conservative logarithmic running.

classification.title_zh: Schwarzschild黑洞中的涨落-耗散定理与动力学Love数
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究Schwarzschild黑洞在Hartle-Hawking态下对无质量标量场外源的实时响应。作者用复化径向围道表示Schwinger-Keldysh闭合时间路径，将耗散、热涨落和守恒潮汐响应纳入统一框架；在潮汐匹配前，对任意实频率和每个标量多极子直接从径向构造导出平衡涨落-耗散关系。低频潮汐展开中，他们重现了ω^2阶守恒动力学Love系数的对数跑动与ω阶主导耗散响应之间的已知关系，并说明同一主导吸收系数如何进入两关系，以及跑动关系的单位系数来自Schwarzschild视界斜率。在Hartle-Hawking态中，该共同系数将对数跑动与零频热噪声联系起来；KMS解析性由耗散响应确定热噪声，而近区径向方程和潮汐匹配确定守恒对数跑动。
classification.one_liner: 在Schwarzschild黑洞实时响应中统一描述耗散、热涨落与动力学Love数的潮汐响应，并导出低频涨落-耗散关系。

papers.title: Exact scalarization thresholds and onset laws for a nonminimally coupled scalar field on the Ellis wormhole
papers.abstract: We study a real scalar field nonminimally coupled to curvature on a fixed Ellis wormhole background. The scalar perturbation decouples at linear order, and the substitution $ x=a \tan z $ reduces its static radial equation to a trigonometric P\"oschl-Teller problem. This yields the exact threshold spectrum $ \zeta_{n\ell}=(n+\ell+1)^2/2 $, closed-form Gegenbauer profiles, and an exact count of negative radial eigenvalues in each angular sector. The s-wave thresholds are zero-energy resonances at which the growth rate rises linearly, whereas the $ \ell \geq1\ $ threshold states are square integrable and the growth rate rises as a square root. At the first threshold we also obtain the next-order term, $ \sigma a=(\pi/4)g-(3\pi/16)g^2+O(g^3) $ with $g=2\zeta-1 $. For a probe field with quartic self-interaction, we show that no nontrivial spherical static solution exists for $\zeta\leq1/2 $ and derive local branch expansions near the s-wave thresholds. Numerical evolutions are consistent with saturation on the nodeless branch. These nonlinear results refer to the probe-field model; they do not establish the existence or stability of fully backreacted scalarized wormholes.

classification.title_zh: Ellis虫洞上非最小耦合标量场的精确标量化阈值与起始定律
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究固定Ellis虫洞背景上非最小耦合到曲率的实标量场。标量扰动在线性阶解耦，通过替换 x=a tan z 将静态径向方程化为三角Pöschl-Teller问题。由此得到精确阈值谱 ζ_{nℓ}=(n+ℓ+1)^2/2、闭式Gegenbauer剖面，以及每个角扇区中负径向本征值的精确计数。s波阈值是零能共振，其增长率线性上升；而 ℓ≥1 的阈值态平方可积，增长率按平方根上升。在第一个阈值处还得到下一阶项 σ a=(π/4)g-(3π/16)g^2+O(g^3)，其中 g=2ζ-1。对于带四次自相互作用的探针场，作者证明当 ζ≤1/2 时不存在非平凡球对称静态解，并推导了s波阈值附近的局部分支展开。数值演化与无节点分支上的饱和行为一致。这些非线性结果仅针对探针场模型，并未确立完全背反作用标量化虫洞的存在性或稳定性。
classification.one_liner: 在固定Ellis虫洞背景上给出非最小耦合标量场标量化阈值的精确谱、起始律及探针场非线性分支结果。

papers.title: Symmetry breaking from conformality loss on holographic R\'enyi defects
papers.abstract: The R\'enyi entropies of a ball are computed by a conformal defect, the R\'enyi defect, dual in holography to a hyperbolic black hole. At an index $n_*$ its charged operator merges with its alternate-quantization partner, and the defect loses conformality. Beyond $n_*$ it flows with no source to a conformal defect that breaks the U(1) symmetry; below $n_*$ that defect needs a symmetry-breaking source, so at large $N$, conformality loss makes the breaking spontaneous. The scalar hair beyond $n_*$, expected to break the symmetries of hyperbolic space, thus preserves them outside a thin layer at the entangling surface, as conformal symmetry requires. The region outside the layer sets the universal term of the R\'enyi entropy. We demonstrate the mechanism in the probe Abelian Higgs model in AdS$_5$ at the Bogomolny point, where the saddles are in closed form and numerical methods confirm the flows. On a sphere we prove that a positive source-free flow exists exactly when $n>n_*$ and the sphere is large enough; it is then unique and ends at the symmetry-breaking defect. The mechanism needs a scalar mass in a finite window, and for potentials attractive at small amplitude, the symmetry can break before conformality is lost. For operators of low enough dimension, already the second R\'enyi entropy lies beyond the merger. Classical backreaction does not move the merger at any order; we argue that away from $n_*$ the flows persist at first order.

classification.title_zh: 全息 Rényi 缺陷上共形性丧失引发的对称性破缺
classification.abstract_zh: 本文通过共形缺陷（Rényi 缺陷）计算球的 Rényi 熵，该缺陷在全息对偶中对应双曲黑洞。在指标 n_* 处，其带电算符与替代量子化伙伴合并，缺陷失去共形性。当 n>n_* 时，缺陷无源地流向破坏 U(1) 对称性的共形缺陷；当 n<n_* 时需要对称破缺源，因此在大 N 下共形性丧失使破缺成为自发。n_* 之外的标量毛预期会破坏双曲空间对称性，但按共形对称性要求，它在纠缠面薄层之外保持这些对称性；薄层外区域决定 Rényi 熵的普适项。我们在 AdS5 的探针 Abelian Higgs 模型 Bogomolny 点展示该机制，其中鞍点有闭式解，数值方法确认了流动。在球面上，我们证明正的无源流恰在 n>n_* 且球足够大时存在，并且唯一、终止于对称破缺缺陷。该机制要求标量质量位于有限窗口；对于小振幅吸引势，对称性可在共形性丧失前破缺。对于维度足够低的算符，第二 Rényi 熵已越过合并点。经典 backreaction 在任何阶都不移动合并点；我们论证远离 n_* 时流动在一阶持续。
classification.one_liner: 全息 Rényi 缺陷在 n_* 处因带电算符与替代量子化伙伴合并而丧失共形性，并在大 N 下无源地触发 U(1) 对称性自发破缺。

papers.title: Smoothing the Bouncing-Geodesic Singularity in AdS/CFT
papers.abstract: Black hole singularities remain a central open problem in quantum gravity. In the AdS/CFT correspondence, bulk spacelike extremal surfaces can probe the black hole interior, and information about the near-singularity geometry is encoded in analytically continued boundary correlators. As the bouncing geodesic approaches the black hole singularity, it becomes nearly null and gives rise to characteristic divergences at complex times. Importantly, these complex-time singularities emerge only in the strict semiclassical limit ($G_N\to 0$ or $c\to\infty$) and are governed by the asymptotically linear quasinormal mode (QNM) spectrum. At finite $c$, nonlinear deformations of the QNM trajectories produce suppression kernel that smooths out the complex-time singularities. Using Liouville CFT as an analytically solvable example, we explicitly demonstrate the finite-$c$ deformation of the QNM spectrum and its associated pole-zero structure. We also identify a complementary Gaussian smoothing mechanism arising from finite-energy fluctuations in the thermal spectral decomposition. These results show how finite $G_N$ quantum corrections modify the holographic imprints of the classical black hole singularity.

classification.title_zh: 平滑 AdS/CFT 中反弹测地线的奇异性
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞奇点仍是量子引力的核心开放问题。在 AdS/CFT 中，体空间类空极值面可探测黑洞内部，近奇点几何的信息编码在解析延拓的边界关联函数中。当反弹测地线接近黑洞奇点时，它变得近乎类光，并在复时间产生特征发散。重要的是，这些复时间奇点只在严格半经典极限（G_N→0 或 c→∞）出现，并由渐近线性的准正规模（QNM）谱控制。在有限 c 下，QNM 轨迹的非线性变形产生抑制核，从而平滑复时间奇点。以 Liouville CFT 作为解析可解例子，我们明确展示 QNM 谱的有限 c 变形及其相关的极点-零点结构。我们还识别出热谱分解中有限能量涨落引起的互补高斯平滑机制。这些结果表明有限 G_N 量子修正如何修改经典黑洞奇点的全息印记。
classification.one_liner: 利用有限 c 的 QNM 谱变形与热谱高斯平滑，展示 AdS/CFT 中反弹测地线复时间奇点如何被量子修正抹平。

papers.title: The generalized entropy in holographic semiclassical de Sitter spacetime
papers.abstract: We consider generalized de Sitter entropy which includes both entanglement entropy of the strongly coupled quantum field and the gravitational Wald entropy in the framework of holographic semiclassical gravity. The quantum corrected de Sitter spacetime is constructed perturbatively by considering static deformations of the classical solution. By applying the Noether charge formula to our semiclassical model, we show that both the renormalized entropies remain finite without introducing a cutoff, even when the bulk AdS gravitational field does not satisfy the Dirichlet boundary condition. We show that the first order variation of the generalized entropy with respect to the de Sitter horizon always vanishes when the conformal boundary metric is promoted to a dynamical variable.

classification.title_zh: 全息半经典 de Sitter 时空中的广义熵
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在全息半经典引力框架下考虑广义 de Sitter 熵，其中同时包含强耦合量子场的纠缠熵与引力的 Wald 熵。通过考虑经典解的静态形变，微扰地构造量子修正的 de Sitter 时空。将 Noether 荷公式应用于该半经典模型，我们证明即使体 AdS 引力场不满足 Dirichlet 边界条件，两个重整化熵也无需引入截断即保持有限。我们还证明，当共形边界度规被提升为动力学变量时，广义熵对 de Sitter 视界的一阶变分总是为零。
classification.one_liner: 在全息半经典 de Sitter 中给出含纠缠熵与 Wald 熵的广义熵，并证明其重整化有限及视界一阶变分消失。

papers.title: A Matrix View of Holographic Null-State Equations in $d\geq 2$
papers.abstract: We show that the null-state-type partial differential equations recently derived from AdS gravity with a black hole can be efficiently organized using finite-dimensional matrices with systematic off-diagonal structures. This matrix formulation generates an infinite tower of CFT differential equations at arbitrary levels. The $d=2$ matrix reproduces a known result based on Virasoro null-state vectors at large central charge and admits an algebraic representation in terms of a linear combination of the identity matrix and $\mathfrak{sl}_2$ generators, with a heavy-state deformation encoding the central charge contribution. The $d=4$ governing matrix exhibits a similar yet richer structure involving products of $\mathfrak{sl}_2$ generators. We also discuss recursion relations and factorized product structures associated with these holographic differential equations.

classification.title_zh: d≥2 中全息零态方程的矩阵视角
classification.abstract_zh: 我们表明，最近从带黑洞的 AdS 引力导出的零态型偏微分方程，可以用具有系统非对角结构的有限维矩阵高效组织。该矩阵表述在任意层级生成无穷多的 CFT 微分方程。d=2 矩阵重现了基于大中心荷下 Virasoro 零态矢量的已知结果，并给出由单位矩阵与 sl2 生成元线性组合构成的代数表示，其中重态变形编码中心荷贡献。d=4 的主导矩阵展现出类似但更丰富的结构，涉及 sl2 生成元的乘积。我们还讨论了与这些全息微分方程相关的递推关系和因子化乘积结构。
classification.one_liner: 用有限维矩阵系统化组织由 AdS 黑洞引力导出的全息零态型 CFT 微分方程，并给出 d=2 与 d=4 的代数结构。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于 AdS/CFT 与 CFT 零态方程的形式结构研究，和全息基础相关；但不直接落在用户列出的具体重点标签（全息超流超导、p波、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7、经典引力）上。

papers.title: No smooth real instanton saddles in self-dual Yang-Mills on AdS$_4$
papers.abstract: In the self-dual limit of Yang-Mills theory on Euclidean AdS$_4$ studied by Heuveline, Ruzziconi, Sheta and Strominger, the boundary condition of the second-order action becomes vacuous, but the boundary equation of the first-order action is non-trivial. We show that, with this equation, the vacuum is the only saddle with a real gauge field when both fields are smooth up to the conformal boundary, for any compact gauge group. In particular, the self-dual solutions of Sarioglu and Tekin (2009) are not saddles; we also correct their charges, which omitted a surface term at the conformal boundary. Complex saddles and singular limits remain open.

classification.title_zh: AdS$_4$ 上自对偶 Yang-Mills 中不存在光滑实瞬子鞍点
classification.abstract_zh: 在 Heuveline、Ruzziconi、Sheta 和 Strominger 所研究的欧几里得 AdS$_4$ 上 Yang-Mills 理论的自对偶极限中，二阶作用量的边界条件变得空洞，但一阶作用量的边界方程非平凡。我们证明，在该方程下，当两个场都光滑到共形边界时，对于任意紧致规范群，真空是唯一具有实规范场的鞍点。特别地，Sarioglu 和 Tekin (2009) 的自对偶解不是鞍点；我们还修正了他们的荷，其遗漏了共形边界处的表面项。复鞍点和奇异极限仍未解决。
classification.one_liner: 证明在欧氏 AdS$_4$ 自对偶 Yang-Mills 中，光滑实规范场下真空是唯一鞍点，并修正 Sarioglu-Tekin 解的荷。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 基础/边界条件与鞍点问题，但不涉及用户列出的全息超导、p波、畴壁、multi-trace、相变、QNM、探针膜或经典引力等具体研究支线。

papers.title: Summing over Seifert Manifolds in Narain Ensemble Averages
papers.abstract: The ensemble average of Narain conformal field theories over their moduli space is a real-analytic Eisenstein series, whose Poincar\'e expansion can be interpreted as a sum over lens spaces weighted by the partition functions of Abelian Chern-Simons theory. In this paper we extend this correspondence from lens spaces to Seifert manifolds, which gives an example of a restricted sum over topologies of the kind that arises in three-dimensional quantum gravity. A Seifert manifold is obtained from a fixed core, a punctured surface times a circle, by gluing solid tori to its boundary tori, and we place a copy of the Narain theory on each of these tori. The ensemble average supplies the sum over the solid tori, or more precisely over marked presentations with fixed base genus, number of fibers and integer Seifert invariant. The resulting sum converges absolutely and is a polynomial in the components of the vector-valued Eisenstein series. When all the boundary tori share a single modulus, the average acquires connected corrections, which we identify with wormholes gluing the core to itself; for two boundary tori, the terms with rational Lagrangian sublattices of the Siegel-Eisenstein series are realized by wormholes containing an exceptional fiber. After reduction along the fiber, the construction closely parallels the two-dimensional topological gravity of Marolf and Maxfield, with the base of the fibration playing the role of their spacetime. We also discuss Dehn fillings of 3-manifolds with torus boundary, non-orientable bases, and the surgery formula. Our results suggest that modularity could be an organizing principle in the summation of geometries in quantum gravity.

classification.title_zh: Narain 系综平均中对 Seifert 流形的求和
classification.abstract_zh: Narain 共形场论在其模空间上的系综平均是一个实解析 Eisenstein 级数，其 Poincaré 展开可解释为以 Abel Chern-Simons 理论配分函数加权的透镜空间求和。本文把这一对应从透镜空间推广到 Seifert 流形，给出三维量子引力中受限拓扑求和的一个例子。Seifert 流形由固定核心（带 puncture 的曲面乘圆）在其边界环面上粘接实心环面得到，并在每个环面上放置一份 Narain 理论。系综平均提供对实心环面的求和，更准确地说，是对固定基亏格、纤维数和整数 Seifert 不变量的带标记表示的求和；所得求和绝对收敛，并且是向量值 Eisenstein 级数分量的多项式。当所有边界环面共享单一模时，平均获得连通修正，作者将其识别为把核心与自身粘接的虫洞；对于两个边界环面，Siegel-Eisenstein 级数中具有有理 Lagrangian 子格的项由含例外纤维的虫洞实现。沿纤维约化后，该构造与 Marolf-Maxfield 的二维拓扑引力密切平行，其中纤维化的基扮演其时空的角色。文中还讨论了带环面边界的三维流形的 Dehn 填充、不可定向基以及手术公式。结果提示模性可能是量子引力中几何求和的组织原则。
classification.one_liner: 将 Narain CFT 系综平均的 Poincaré 展开从透镜空间推广到 Seifert 流形，并把虫洞修正与三维量子引力中的拓扑求和联系起来。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文讨论 Narain CFT 系综平均与 Seifert 流形拓扑求和、虫洞及三维量子引力，不涉及重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子或 D-brane 探针膜等方向。

papers.title: An Amplitudes Approach to Spinning Black Hole Scattering
papers.abstract: The detection of gravitational waves has opened a new era of precision studies of gravity, demanding advances in our understanding of compact binary dynamics. Scattering amplitudes provide a powerful framework for studying these systems using methods from high-energy physics. In this thesis, we study classical black hole scattering, systematically including spin---an important feature of real astrophysical systems---to describe Kerr black hole dynamics. We model Kerr black holes as massive point particles in finite-spin representations and compute their scattering dynamics perturbatively. We resolve an ambiguity mixing classical and quantum contributions using our spin interpolation method, obtaining a classical amplitude for Kerr black hole scattering through quartic order in spin at third post-Minkowskian order. From this amplitude, we extract the gauge-invariant radial action, enabling the computation of classical non-aligned-spin observables---such as the linear and angular impulses---using covariant Dirac brackets. The amplitude exhibits spin-shift symmetry, remaining invariant under a shift of the black hole spin by the momentum transfer. Motivated by this property, we study the conserved quantities governing the scattering process and show that the dynamics of a probe black hole remains integrable at asymptotic infinity through quartic order in probe spin. Finally, we show that the quartic-in-spin radial action for a probe black hole in a Kerr background, at any order in perturbation theory, is completely fixed by the aligned-spin dynamics, provided that it satisfies asymptotic integrability and spin-shift symmetry.

classification.title_zh: 自旋黑洞散射的振幅方法
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波探测开启了引力的精确研究新时代，要求对致密双星动力学有更深入理解。散射振幅提供了利用高能物理方法研究这些系统的强大框架。本论文研究经典黑洞散射，系统地包含自旋——真实天体物理系统的重要特征——以描述 Kerr 黑洞动力学。我们将 Kerr 黑洞建模为有限自旋表示中的大质量点粒子，并微扰计算其散射动力学。我们使用自旋插值方法解决混合经典与量子贡献的歧义，在第三 post-Minkowskian 阶获得直至自旋四次的 Kerr 黑洞散射经典振幅。从该振幅中，我们提取规范不变的径向作用量，使得能够使用协变 Dirac 括号计算经典非对齐自旋可观测量——例如线性和角冲量。该振幅表现出自旋平移对称性，在黑洞自旋按动量转移平移下保持不变。受此性质启发，我们研究支配散射过程的守恒量，并表明探针黑洞的动力学在探针自旋四次以内于渐近无穷远仍可积。最后，我们表明，Kerr 背景中探针黑洞的自旋四次径向作用量，在任意微扰阶，只要满足渐近可积性和自旋平移对称性，就完全由对齐自旋动力学确定。
classification.one_liner: 用散射振幅方法系统包含自旋，计算 Kerr 黑洞经典散射及可观测量。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典黑洞散射与广义相对论动力学，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；不涉及全息。

papers.title: Quasinormal Modes Criticality across Black Hole Extremality
papers.abstract: We investigate the extremal solution branch to nonextremal branch transition in Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg anti-de Sitter black holes, where the nonlinear electromagnetic parameter $\lambda$ governs the existence of the extremal branch solution. At fixed pressure and charge, extremal black hole only exist for $\lambda\leq\lambda_c$. For $\lambda>\lambda_c$, the lowest Hawking temperature keeps nonzero. Near this threshold, the lowest temperature follows a linear critical scaling, $T_{\min}\propto(\lambda-\lambda_c)^{\alpha_T}$. We investigate the corresponding dynamical behavior by computing the quasinormal modes of a massless scalar perturbation along the lowest-temperature black hole branch. As the critical threshold is approached, two complex-frequency quasinormal modes branches collide on the imaginary axis and reorganize into distinct purely imaginary branches. Then the imaginary parts of these modes, together with higher overtones, reach zero at the critical threshold, described by $\Gamma_n\propto(\lambda-\lambda_c)^{\alpha_n}$, with $\alpha_n\simeq\alpha_T$. The resulting zero-damped modes become increasingly localized near the event horizon, and their relative damping rates closely follow the overtone spacing predicted by the near-horizon AdS$_2$ spectrum. Our results show that the thermodynamic and dynamical critical behavior remain closely connected even when extremal black hole solutions cease to exist, providing further evidence for the relevance of near-extremal spectral behavior in this distinct critical regime.

classification.title_zh: 跨黑洞极端性的准正规模临界性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究爱因斯坦-欧拉-海森堡反德西特黑洞中极端解支向非极端解支的转变，其中非线性电磁参数 λ 控制极端解支是否存在。在固定压强和电荷下，极端黑洞仅当 λ≤λ_c 时存在；当 λ>λ_c 时，最低霍金温度保持非零。在该阈值附近，最低温度遵循线性临界标度 T_min∝(λ−λ_c)^{α_T}。我们通过计算沿最低温度黑洞支的无质量标量微扰准正规模来研究相应动力学行为。接近临界阈值时，两支复频率准正规模在虚轴上碰撞并重组成不同的纯虚支。随后这些模式的虚部以及更高阶 overtone 在临界阈值处趋于零，满足 Γ_n∝(λ−λ_c)^{α_n}，且 α_n≃α_T。由此得到的零阻尼模式越来越局域于事件视界附近，其相对阻尼率密切遵循近视界 AdS_2 谱所预言的 overtone 间距。结果表明，即使极端黑洞解不再存在，热力学与动力学临界行为仍紧密关联，进一步支持近极端谱行为在这一不同临界区域中的相关性。
classification.one_liner: 在 Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg AdS 黑洞中，极端解消失的临界阈值附近，准正规模发生虚轴碰撞并出现零阻尼，其标度指数与最低温度临界标度一致。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文直接研究 AdS 黑洞准正规模临界行为，并涉及经典引力与黑洞热力学，与 QNM 和经典引力支线高度相关；但摘要未显式讨论全息对偶或用户重点的全息超流、探针膜等方向。

papers.title: Chiral magnetic wave and axial charge relaxation in flavor branes
papers.abstract: We investigate the chiral magnetic wave and axial charge relaxation in the chiral symmetry broken phase of the holographic D3/D7 model with massless quarks, where the axial charge in the flavor sector can relax through transfer to the adjoint sector in the probe limit. We find that the dispersion relations of the quasi-normal modes are well described by the phenomenological expression for the chiral magnetic wave when the relaxation rate is small. We then determine how this rate depends on vector charge density and the chiral condensate. At higher temperatures, it increases with charge density and decreases with increasing condensate, while these dependences become non-monotonic at lower temperatures. These results show that the phenomenological description of the chiral magnetic wave also applies in the chiral symmetry broken phase in the quasi-hydrodynamic regime.

classification.title_zh: 味膜中的手征磁波与轴荷弛豫
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在无质量夸克的全息 D3/D7 模型的手征对称性破缺相中研究手征磁波与轴荷弛豫；在该模型中，味扇区的轴荷可通过在探针极限下转移到伴随扇区而弛豫。我们发现，当弛豫率较小时，准正规模的色散关系可由手征磁波的唯象表达式很好地描述。随后我们确定该弛豫率如何依赖矢量荷密度和手征凝聚。在较高温度下，它随荷密度增加而增大，并随凝聚增加而减小；而在较低温度下，这些依赖关系变为非单调。这些结果表明，手征磁波的唯象描述在准流体力学区域的手征对称性破缺相中同样适用。
classification.one_liner: 在D3/D7全息模型中研究手征对称性破缺相的手征磁波与轴荷弛豫，并用准正规模色散关系检验唯象描述。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接涉及D3/D7探针味膜与准正规模色散关系，并讨论手征磁波和轴荷输运，与用户重点标签中的D3-D7探针膜及QNM方向高度相关。

papers.title: Quantum Black Holes in Non-Linear Electrodynamics
papers.abstract: Techniques of AdS/CFT correspondence and braneworld holography have proven to be a useful tool for solving the problem of semi-classical gravity where quantum matter provides the back-reaction to classical spacetime geometry. In this paper, we apply this approach to Einstein gravity coupled to RegMax nonlinear electrodynamics and construct novel type of charged quantum black holes. We then discuss their thermodynamics and horizon structure.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 非线性电动力学中的量子黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: AdS/CFT 对应与膜世界全息技术已被证明是处理半经典引力问题的有用工具，其中量子物质会对经典时空几何产生反作用。本文将这一方法应用于与 RegMax 非线性电动力学耦合的 Einstein 引力，构造了一类新型带电量子黑洞，并讨论其热力学与视界结构。
classification.one_liner: 利用 AdS/CFT 与膜世界全息，在耦合 RegMax 非线性电动力学的 Einstein 引力中构造带电量子黑洞并分析其热力学与视界结构。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT/膜世界全息与量子黑洞构造，并涉及 Einstein 引力、非线性电动力学和黑洞热力学；与用户列出的全息超流超导、p波、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、QNM、D3-D7 探针膜等具体支线无直接重合，但对全息与经典引力/黑洞热力学方向有中等相关性。

papers.title: The Multi-trace Eigenstate Thermalization Hypothesis
papers.abstract: We introduce a multi-trace eigenstate thermalization hypothesis, an extension of ETH that governs connected correlations of operator matrix elements with arbitrary index structures, including several disjoint index cycles. We derive multi-trace ETH from local rotational invariance, relate its independent data to higher-order free cumulants, and construct a cyclic matrix model that encodes the resulting multi-cycle data. We provide evidence for multi-trace ETH in chaotic quantum systems and compute multi-trace correlations in low-dimensional gravity. In few-body systems, multi-trace contributions arise from correlated periodic orbits, including a linear ramp contribution to the one-point spectral form factor. In two dimensions, we compute interaction-induced multi-trace correlations from a quartically coupled bulk scalar in JT gravity, relating winding matter diagrams to corrections of matter-channel weights and anomalous dimensions. In three dimensions, we show that multi-trace non-Gaussianities arise from both topology-changing saddles and light matter. Using Virasoro TQFT and conformal mean-field theory, we compute examples involving knot and link complements and torus wormholes with matter loops. Across these settings, multi-trace ETH provides a common framework for both connected correlators in chaotic quantum systems and multi-boundary wormhole amplitudes in gravity.

classification.title_zh: 多迹本征态热化假说
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出多迹本征态热化假说（multi-trace ETH），它是 ETH 的推广，用于描述具有任意指标结构、包括多个不相交指标循环的算符矩阵元连通关联。我们从局域旋转不变性推导多迹 ETH，将其独立数据与高阶自由累积量联系起来，并构造一个循环矩阵模型来编码由此得到的多循环数据。我们为混沌量子系统中的多迹 ETH 提供证据，并在低维引力中计算多迹关联。在少体系统中，多迹贡献来自相关的周期轨道，包括对单点谱形状因子的线性斜坡贡献。在二维中，我们计算 JT 引力中四次耦合体标量所诱导的相互作用多迹关联，将绕转物质图与物质通道权重及反常维数修正联系起来。在三维中，我们展示多迹非高斯性来自拓扑改变鞍点和轻物质。利用 Virasoro TQFT 和共形平均场论，我们计算了涉及纽结与链环补集以及带物质环的环面虫洞的例子。在这些情形中，多迹 ETH 为混沌量子系统中的连通关联子和引力中的多边界虫洞振幅提供了统一框架。
classification.one_liner: 提出多迹 ETH，将混沌量子系统的连通关联与低维引力中的多边界虫洞振幅统一起来。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接发展 multi-trace ETH，并系统联系混沌量子系统关联函数与低维引力多边界虫洞振幅，正好覆盖用户重点标签“multi-trace”。

papers.title: Holographic Approaches to Hadron Structure
papers.abstract: We give an introduction to and an overview of holographic approaches to QCD and hadron structure. After an introduction to the string-theoretic foundations of holographic QCD, we review the predictions of top-down and bottom-up models for the phenomenology of mesons, baryons, and glueballs. We focus on the top-down model following from probe flavor branes in the Witten model of low-energy Yang-Mills theory and, in the more phenomenological approach of bottom-up models, mostly on minimal models based on five-dimensional anti-de Sitter space, which also implement global symmetries and their anomalies consistently, but allow the high-energy behavior to better match real QCD.

classification.title_zh: 强子结构的全息方法
classification.abstract_zh: 我们介绍并概述全息方法在QCD和强子结构中的应用。在介绍全息QCD的弦论基础之后，我们回顾top-down和bottom-up模型对介子、重子和胶球现象学的预言。我们重点关注由Witten低能Yang-Mills模型中的探针味膜得到的top-down模型；在更现象学的bottom-up模型中，主要关注基于五维反de Sitter空间的最小模型，这些模型也一致地实现了整体对称性及其反常，同时允许高能行为更好地匹配真实QCD。
classification.one_liner: 综述全息QCD中top-down探针味膜与bottom-up AdS模型对介子、重子和胶球强子结构的预测。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文是面向全息QCD与强子结构的综述，涉及top-down探针味膜和bottom-up AdS模型，与用户重点中的探针膜方向有一般关联；但不涉及全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、QNM与Floquet驱动等重点内容。

papers.title: Global and crustal properties of neutron stars
papers.abstract: We investigate how the treatment of the neutron star crust affects both the global properties of the star and the properties of the crust itself. Three approaches are compared: a direct connection between a fixed crust and the core equation of state (EOS), a smooth crossover between them, and a unified EOS in which the crust is computed within a compressible liquid-drop model with the same nuclear empirical parameters of the relativistic mean-field model used for the core. For each approach, we consider four values of the symmetry energy slope, $44 \le L \le 92$ MeV. For a $1.4\,M_\odot$ star, some global properties are weakly to moderately affected: the radius and the moment of inertia agree within 1\% among the three approaches. On the other hand, the tidal deformability obtained with the direct connection is up to 21\% lower than the unified one for $L = 92$ MeV. A much larger contrast comes from the crustal properties. Relative to the unified EOS, the direct connection yields a crust that is 15--36\% thinner, 6--12 times less massive, and that carries a fraction of the total moment of inertia 5--8 times smaller (0.3--1.1\% instead of 2.8--6.2\%). The differences between crust treatments are thus comparable to or larger than those arising from variations in $L$ for crustal properties, while they remain subleading for global ones.

classification.title_zh: 中子星的全局与壳层性质
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了中子星壳层的处理方式如何影响恒星的全局性质以及壳层本身的性质。比较了三种方法：固定壳层与核心状态方程（EOS）直接连接、二者之间平滑过渡，以及在可压缩液滴模型中用与核心相对论平均场模型相同的核经验参数计算壳层的统一 EOS。对每种方法，我们考虑对称能斜率 L 的四个取值，44 ≤ L ≤ 92 MeV。对于 1.4 倍太阳质量恒星，一些全局性质受到弱到中等影响：三种方法给出的半径和转动惯量在 1% 内一致。另一方面，对于 L = 92 MeV，直接连接得到的潮汐形变比统一 EOS 低最多 21%。壳层性质的对比大得多。相对于统一 EOS，直接连接给出的壳层薄 15–36%，质量小 6–12 倍，携带的转动惯量份额小 5–8 倍（0.3–1.1% 而非 2.8–6.2%）。因此，壳层处理方式之间的差异与 L 变化对壳层性质的影响相当或更大，而对全局性质仍处于次要地位。
classification.one_liner: 比较三种中子星壳层处理对全局性质与壳层性质的影响。

papers.title: Holographic study of the scalar meson $K_0^*(1430)$ with dynamical longitudinal confinement
papers.abstract: Within the framework of light-front holographic QCD, where transverse confinement is inherently realized through holography, the structure and mass spectrum of the light scalar meson $K_0^{*}(1430)$ are investigated by employing the invariant mass ansatz and enhancing the model with a longitudinal confinement potential (specifically, the 't Hooft equation and the analytically solvable LMZV potential). The combined transverse and longitudinal confinement dynamics lead to more reliable calculations of key observables, including decay constants, parton distribution function, $\xi$-moments, and twist-$2$ and twist-$3$ distribution amplitudes. Transition form factors for the semileptonic decay $B \rightarrow K_0^{*} \ell^+ \ell^-$ are computed from these amplitudes, yielding predictions for differential branching ratios and longitudinal lepton polarization asymmetries as functions of $q^2$. The results are compared with other theoretical models, offering valuable insights into the non-perturbative dynamics of QCD. The predicted observables provide theoretically motivated benchmarks for future experimental investigations of $B\rightarrow K_0^*(1430)\ell^+\ell^-$ decays at LHCb and Belle II.

classification.title_zh: 具有动力学纵向囚禁的标量介子 K_0^*(1430) 的全息研究
classification.abstract_zh: 在光前全息 QCD 框架中，横向囚禁由全息机制自然实现；本文采用不变质量拟设，并引入纵向囚禁势（具体为 't Hooft 方程和可解析求解的 LMZV 势），研究轻标量介子 K_0^*(1430) 的结构与质量谱。横向与纵向囚禁动力学的结合使关键可观测量的计算更可靠，包括衰变常数、部分子分布函数、ξ-矩以及 twist-2 和 twist-3 分布振幅。基于这些振幅计算了半轻子衰变 B → K_0^* ℓ^+ ℓ^- 的跃迁形状因子，并给出微分分支比和纵向轻子极化不对称性随 q^2 变化的预言。结果与其他理论模型进行了比较，为 QCD 的非微扰动力学提供了有价值的认识。所预言的观测量为 LHCb 和 Belle II 未来对 B → K_0^*(1430) ℓ^+ ℓ^- 衰变的实验研究提供了理论动机的基准。
classification.one_liner: 在光前全息 QCD 中引入纵向囚禁势，计算 K_0^*(1430) 的结构函数及 B → K_0^* ℓ^+ ℓ^- 衰变可观测量的理论预测。

papers.title: Heavy-quark limit of $B$-meson distribution amplitudes in light-front holography with longitudinal confinement
papers.abstract: The heavy-quark limit of light-front holographic wave functions for heavy--light mesons is investigated, with particular emphasis on the leading-twist $B$-meson light-cone distribution amplitude, $\phi_B^+(\omega)$. Two prescriptions for incorporating finite quark masses are compared: the invariant mass ansatz (IMA) and the longitudinal confining framework based on the Li--Maris--Zhao--Vary (LMZV) potential. In the IMA, although the peak of the distribution amplitude remains at a soft spectator momentum, its characteristic width decreases as $\Delta\omega \propto m_B^{-1/2}$ in the heavy-quark limit, causing the longitudinal distribution to collapse asymptotically to $\delta(\omega-m_q)$. Accordingly, the inverse moment approaches the finite limit $\lambda_{B,\mathrm{IMA}} \to m_q = \mathcal{O}(\Lambda_{\mathrm{QCD}})$. In contrast, the LMZV framework approaches a finite leading-power (LP) profile with a stable width of order $\mathcal{O}(\Lambda_{\rm QCD})$ and a stable inverse moment, $\lambda_{B,\mathrm{LMZV}}^{\mathrm{LP}} = m_q + \sigma/2 = \mathcal{O}(\Lambda_{\mathrm{QCD}})$, which is independent of the heavy-quark mass. The heavy-quark scaling of $f_B$ is also examined using the local axial-vector current at zero transverse separation. While the LMZV longitudinal wave function has a non-singular heavy-quark limit, the bare light-front current does not reproduce the canonical heavy-quark effective theory scaling $f_B \propto m_B^{-1/2}$: the decay constant scales as $f_B \propto m_B^{-1}$ in the LMZV framework and as $f_B \propto m_B^{-5/4}$ in the IMA. Thus, a non-singular heavy-quark limit of the longitudinal wave function is necessary but insufficient to ensure the correct heavy-quark scaling of local current matrix elements without systematic current matching.

classification.title_zh: 带纵向禁闭的光前全息中B介子分布振幅的重夸克极限
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究重-轻介子光前全息波函数在重夸克极限下的行为，重点分析领头扭度B介子光锥分布振幅 φ_B^+(ω)。文章比较了引入有限夸克质量的两种方案：不变质量拟设（IMA）和基于 Li--Maris--Zhao--Vary（LMZV）势的纵向禁闭框架。在 IMA 中，分布振幅峰值仍位于软旁观者动量处，但其特征宽度随重夸克极限按 Δω ∝ m_B^{-1/2} 减小，导致纵向分布在渐近上坍缩为 δ(ω-m_q)；相应地，逆矩趋于有限极限 λ_{B,IMA} → m_q = O(Λ_QCD)。相反，LMZV 框架趋于具有 O(Λ_QCD) 稳定宽度的有限领头幂剖面，并给出与重夸克质量无关的稳定逆矩 λ_{B,LMZV}^{LP}=m_q+σ/2=O(Λ_QCD)。文章还利用零横向间隔处的局域轴矢量流考察 f_B 的重夸克标度。虽然 LMZV 纵向波函数具有非奇异的重夸克极限，但裸光前流并不能重现重夸克有效理论的标准标度 f_B ∝ m_B^{-1/2}：在 LMZV 框架中衰变常数标度为 f_B ∝ m_B^{-1}，在 IMA 中为 f_B ∝ m_B^{-5/4}。因此，纵向波函数的非奇异重夸克极限是必要的，但若没有系统的流匹配，它不足以保证局域流矩阵元具有正确的重夸克标度。
classification.one_liner: 比较两种有限夸克质量方案下B介子光前全息分布振幅的重夸克极限，指出纵向波函数非奇异不足以保证局域流矩阵元的正确HQET标度。

papers.title: Signatures of quark matter from neutron star mass-radius curve
papers.abstract: Signatures of the presence of quark matter inside neutron stars are obtained from the analysis of more than 250,000 mass-radius curves that describe nucleonic, hyperonic and hybrid stars, based on five different hadronic relativistic mean-field models and four different descriptions of quark matter. A radius maximum occurring above $1.7\,M_\odot$ strongly favors quark matter inside the star. A second criterion identifying the presence of quark matter is $X>-0.2$km, where X=[R(2.0)-R(1.6)]-[R(1.6)-R(1.4)] is obtained from the radius of stars with 2.0, 1.6 and 1.4 $M_\odot$. It is also shown that most of the hyperonic stars have a radius maximum that peaks around 1.5$M_\odot$ and compactness below 0.27 for the maximum-mass configuration, while for the nucleonic stars that have a radius maximum, this peaks below 1.3$M_\odot$ and the compactness of the maximum-mass configuration lies above 0.26.

classification.title_zh: 中子星质量-半径曲线中的夸克物质特征
classification.abstract_zh: 通过分析超过25万条描述核子星、超子星和杂化星的质量-半径曲线，基于五种强子相对论平均场模型和四种夸克物质描述，寻找中子星内部存在夸克物质的信号。结果表明：半径最大值出现在1.7倍太阳质量以上时强烈支持星体内部存在夸克物质；第二个判据为 X=[R(2.0)-R(1.6)]-[R(1.6)-R(1.4)] > -0.2 km。研究还表明，多数超子星的半径最大值约在1.5倍太阳质量附近，且最大质量构型的致密度低于0.27；而对于存在半径最大值的核子星，该峰值低于1.3倍太阳质量，最大质量构型的致密度高于0.26。
classification.one_liner: 大规模质量-半径曲线统计给出中子星内部夸克物质的可观测判据。

papers.title: Higher-Order Symmetry Energy Effects on the Properties of Neutron Stars
papers.abstract: We study the effects of the symmetry-energy curvature $K_{\rm sym}$ on the equation of state (EoS) and neutron-star properties within the relativistic mean-field (RMF) framework. We construct controlled families of RMF parametrizations based on the TM1 and IUFSU models by varying $K_{\rm sym}$ while keeping the symmetry energy $J$ and its slope $L$ fixed at saturation density. We find that, although a larger $K_{\rm sym}$ leads to a lower symmetry energy at suprasaturation densities and a reduced proton fraction in $\beta$-equilibrated matter, it results in a stiffer EoS and a higher sound speed. The maximum neutron-star mass is weakly affected, whereas the canonical radius $R_{1.4}$ exhibits a nearly linear dependence on $K_{\rm sym}$.

classification.title_zh: 高阶对称能曲率对中子星性质的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 在相对论平均场（RMF）框架下研究对称能曲率 K_sym 对状态方程和中子星性质的影响。基于 TM1 和 IUFSU 模型构造受控参数族，在饱和密度处固定对称能 J 及其斜率 L，仅改变 K_sym。结果表明：较大的 K_sym 会降低超饱和密度处的对称能并减少 β 平衡物质中的质子分数，却导致更硬的状态方程和更高的声速。最大中子星质量受影响较弱，而规范半径 R_{1.4} 对 K_sym 呈近似线性依赖。
classification.one_liner: 固定 J 和 L 变化 K_sym 时，较大的对称能曲率使超饱和密度对称能降低、质子分数减少，但 EoS 更硬、声速更高，最大质量弱受影响而 R_{1.4} 近似线性依赖 K_sym。

papers.title: The imprint of individual neutron star spins on ejecta, $r$-process nucleosynthesis, and kilonovae in binary neutron star mergers
papers.abstract: To leading order, the gravitational-wave (GW) signal from binary neutron stars depends on the individual spins, $\chi_1$ and $\chi_2$, only through the effective spin parameter $\chi_{\rm eff}$. We present the first systematic investigation of individual-spin effects on ejecta, $r$-process nucleosynthesis, and kilonova emission, including comparisons at fixed total mass, mass ratio and $\chi_{\rm eff}$. We use numerical relativity ejecta from three total mass regimes with the finite-temperature, composition-dependent SFHo equation of state and neutrino emission and absorption. For $M_{\rm tot}=2.55\,M_\odot$ at fixed $\chi_{\rm eff}=0$, individual spins change the dynamical ejecta mass by a factor of ${\sim}45$, while the absolute $A\geq140$ yield spans more than two orders of magnitude and the lanthanide to light $r$-process mass ratio increases from ${\sim}2$ to ${\sim}70$. Prompt-collapse $4.10\,M_\odot$ models show heavy-element yield differences exceeding four orders of magnitude at $\chi_{\rm eff}=0$. The kilonova retains the individual-spin imprint, with peak brightness differences reaching ${\sim}0.9$ mag. At $40\,{\rm Mpc}$, all three fixed $\chi_{\rm eff}=0$ pairs remain above adopted depths at common epochs for all viewing angles, with same-epoch colour differences reaching ${\sim}1.5$ mag. The colour imprint persists when the simulation-derived secular ejecta are replaced by the same parametric disc outflow, indicating that disc mass differences are not the primary driver and that dynamical ejecta make an important contribution. Neutrino absorption systematically brightens the kilonova and shifts peak-associated colours blueward. These EM signatures can break the degeneracy between individual spins in the GW signal.

classification.title_zh: 单个中子星自旋对双中子星并合抛射物、r过程核合成与千新星的印记
classification.abstract_zh: 在领头阶，双中子星的引力波信号仅通过有效自旋参数 χ_eff 依赖于各自自旋 χ1 和 χ2。我们首次系统研究各自自旋对抛射物、r过程核合成和千新星辐射的影响，并在固定总质量、质量比和 χ_eff 下进行比较。我们使用三个总质量区域的数值相对论抛射物，采用有限温度、依赖成分的 SFHo 状态方程以及中微子发射和吸收。对于 M_tot=2.55 M_sun、固定 χ_eff=0，各自自旋使动力学抛射物质量变化约 45 倍，而绝对 A≥140 产额跨越两个数量级以上，镧系与轻 r 过程质量比从约 2 增至约 70。瞬时坍缩的 4.10 M_sun 模型在 χ_eff=0 时重元素产额差异超过四个数量级。千新星保留各自自旋印记，峰值亮度差异可达约 0.9 等。在 40 Mpc 处，所有三组固定 χ_eff=0 的配对在所有视角的常见历元均高于所采用的探测深度，同历元颜色差异可达约 1.5 等。当模拟得到的长期抛射物被同一参数化盘外流替代时，颜色印记仍存在，表明盘质量差异不是主要驱动因素，动力学抛射物有重要贡献。中微子吸收系统性地增亮千新星并使峰值相关颜色蓝移。这些电磁特征可以打破引力波信号中各自自旋之间的简并。
classification.one_liner: 数值相对论显示，在固定有效自旋时双中子星各自自旋仍强烈改变抛射物、r过程产额和千新星颜色，为打破引力波自旋简并提供电磁探针。

papers.title: A Geometric Derivation of the Einstein Equations from the Causal Action Principle
papers.abstract: The causal action principle for causal fermion systems is analyzed for a minimizing measure whose support is assumed to have the structure of a smooth manifold $\tilde{M}$. The concept of osculating vacua is introduced. It is shown that the Lagrangian induces on $\tilde{M}$ a Lorentzian metric. Moreover, the Euler-Lagrange equations of the causal action imply that the Ricci tensor must satisfy the Einstein equations of General Relativity for an energy-momentum tensor given in terms of a power expansion in the regularization length. The gravitational coupling constant is found to be the square of the regularization length. Our methods provide a systematic procedure for deriving corrections to the Einstein equations. The paper includes a self-contained introduction to causal variational principles and the causal action principle. Most geometric structures (connection, Riemannian metric and curvature) are introduced and analyzed in the general setting of causal variational principles for an arbitrary dimension of $\tilde{M}$. The Lorentzian setting works only for causal fermion systems and is worked out only in four spacetime dimensions.

classification.title_zh: 从因果作用量原理几何推导 Einstein 方程
classification.abstract_zh: 本文分析因果费米子系统的因果作用量原理，假设最小化测度的支撑具有光滑流形 \tilde{M} 的结构，并引入“密切真空”（osculating vacua）概念。论文表明，拉格朗日量在 \tilde{M} 上诱导出洛伦兹度规；因果作用量的 Euler-Lagrange 方程进一步要求 Ricci 张量满足广义相对论的 Einstein 方程，其能量-动量张量由正则化长度的幂展开给出，而引力耦合常数为正则化长度的平方。该方法为系统推导 Einstein 方程的修正提供了程序。论文还包含对因果变分原理和因果作用量原理的自足介绍，并在任意维 \tilde{M} 的一般因果变分原理框架下引入和分析大多数几何结构（联络、黎曼度规和曲率）；洛伦兹情形仅适用于因果费米子系统，且只在四维时空中给出。
classification.one_liner: 在因果费米子系统中，因果作用量的 Euler-Lagrange 方程导出 Ricci 张量满足 Einstein 方程，引力耦合常数为正则化长度的平方。

papers.title: A Collapsar-Disk Origin for GW190814
papers.abstract: GW190814 was a remarkable gravitational-wave (GW) event: a merger between a $23 M_\odot$ black hole (BH) and a $2.6\,M_\odot$ compact object, with an extreme mass ratio that is difficult to reproduce through standard isolated-binary or dynamical formation channels. Recent work has shown that neutrino-cooled collapsar disks can become gravitationally unstable and fragment, producing neutron stars (NSs) or low-mass BHs in orbit around the newly formed central BH. These fragments may subsequently interact, scatter, merge with one another, or inspiral into the central remnant. We explore the possibility that GW190814 originated from such a collapsar-disk fragment merging with the central BH. A key prediction of this scenario is a temporal association with a stripped-envelope supernova preceding the GW event, and we identify the Type Ib supernova candidate SN2019npv, which occurred inside the GW190814 credible volume approximately 60 days before coalescence, as a possible electromagnetic precursor. Although this delay is too long for a conventional kilonova counterpart, we show that three-body interactions among disk fragments can excite some compact objects to wide orbits and produce merger delays of weeks to months. While GW190814 itself was not expected to produce detectable tidal-disruption-powered emission, future delayed mergers in this channel could generate luminous transients through either reprocessed kilonova heating or shocks driven as merger ejecta collide with the preceding supernova ejecta. Finally, treating SN2019npv as the electromagnetic counterpart makes GW190814 a bright standard siren and yields $H_{0} = 71.1^{+9.3}_{-7.5} km s^{-1}Mpc^{-1}$.

classification.title_zh: GW190814的坍缩星盘起源
classification.abstract_zh: GW190814是一次显著引力波事件：一个23倍太阳质量黑洞与一个2.6倍太阳质量致密天体并合，其极端质量比难以用标准孤立双星或动力学形成通道解释。近期工作表明，中微子冷却的坍缩星盘可发生引力不稳定并碎裂，在新形成的中心黑洞周围产生中子星或低质量黑洞。这些碎片随后可能相互作用、散射、彼此并合或旋入中心残余。我们探讨GW190814来自此类坍缩星盘碎片与中心黑洞并合的可能性。该情景的关键预言是引力波事件前存在剥离包层超新星的时间关联；我们识别出在并合前约60天、位于GW190814可信体积内的Ib型超新星候选体SN2019npv作为可能的电磁前兆。虽然该延迟对常规千新星对应体而言过长，我们证明盘碎片间的三体相互作用可将部分致密天体激发到宽轨道，并产生数周至数月的并合延迟。尽管GW190814本身预计不会产生可探测的潮汐瓦解驱动辐射，该通道中未来的延迟并合可通过再处理千新星加热或并合抛射物与先前超新星抛射物碰撞驱动的激波产生明亮暂现源。最后，若将SN2019npv视为电磁对应体，GW190814成为明亮标准汽笛，并给出H0=71.1^{+9.3}_{-7.5} km s^{-1} Mpc^{-1}。
classification.one_liner: 该文提出GW190814可能源于坍缩星盘碎片与中心黑洞的延迟并合，并讨论超新星前兆及标准汽笛宇宙学限制。

papers.title: LISA science ground segment conventions
papers.abstract: This document sets out the conventions used for data simulations, waveforms, and analysis pipelines within the Distributed Data Processing Centre (DDPC) of the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA). It can also be considered a best practice guide for all publications related to the LISA mission. Topics covered include time-to-frequency transformations, gravitational-wave source parametrization, the instrumental response to gravitational waves, time-delay interferometry, and reference frame definitions.

classification.title_zh: LISA科学地面段约定
classification.abstract_zh: 本文档规定激光干涉空间天线（LISA）分布式数据处理中心（DDPC）内用于数据模拟、波形和分析管线的约定，也可作为所有与LISA任务相关出版物的最佳实践指南。内容涵盖时频变换、引力波源参数化、仪器对引力波的响应、时间延迟干涉以及参考系定义。
classification.one_liner: LISA数据模拟、波形与分析管线的约定文档。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文是LISA科学地面段的数据与分析约定文档，涉及引力波波形、仪器响应和时间延迟干涉，但不涉及全息对偶或量子引力研究，与用户的全息重点方向关联很低。

papers.title: Eccentricity Distribution for Dynamical Gravitational-Wave Merger Channels in The Pinhole Regime
papers.abstract: We argue that various dynamical astrophysical black hole merger channels are expected to result in a common eccentricity distribution at gravitational-wave (GW) frequencies relevant for LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA (LVK) in the high eccentricity limit. This follows from the large separation of scales between the GW regime required for creating eccentric mergers in LVK, and the underlying astrophysical formation environment. Our analytical solution shows exceptional agreement with numerical studies. This finding has important implications for both theoretical studies and ongoing searches for eccentric GW sources.

classification.title_zh: 针孔区域中动力学引力波并合渠道的偏心率分布
classification.abstract_zh: 作者论证，多种动力学天体物理黑洞并合渠道在高偏心率极限下，预期会在与 LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA 相关的引力波频率处产生共同的偏心率分布。这一结果来自 LVK 中产生偏心并合所需的引力波尺度与底层天体物理形成环境之间的尺度分离。其解析解与数值研究高度一致，对理论研究和正在进行的偏心引力波源搜寻均有重要意义。
classification.one_liner: 多种动力学黑洞并合渠道在LVK频段高偏心率极限下可能给出共同的偏心率分布，解析结果与数值研究一致。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/引力波与黑洞并合天体物理，非全息研究；对经典引力支线中等相关。

papers.title: Entropy-based classification of core-collapse supernova gravitational waves for nuclear equation-of-state inference
papers.abstract: Gravitational waves from core-collapse supernovae provide a unique probe of the physical processes occurring during stellar collapse and of the properties of dense nuclear matter. In this work we investigate the classification of supernova gravitational-wave signals associated with different nuclear equations of state using an entropy-based machine learning framework. The analysis combines signal decomposition, feature extraction, and feature selection techniques to identify informative characteristics of the waveforms and distinguish between different equation of state models. We evaluate the performance of several machine learning classifiers using a compact set of selected features and assess their robustness in the presence of detector noise. We find that entropy-based representations capture the underlying differences between waveform classes and enable accurate classification while maintaining better performance compared to raw data under noisy conditions. These results demonstrate the potential of complexity-based feature extraction as an efficient and interpretable approach for gravitational wave studies of core-collapse supernovae.

classification.title_zh: 基于熵的核坍缩超新星引力波分类用于核状态方程推断
classification.abstract_zh: 核坍缩超新星产生的引力波为探索恒星坍缩期间的物理过程以及致密核物质性质提供了独特探针。本文研究利用基于熵的机器学习框架，对与不同核状态方程相关的超新星引力波信号进行分类。该分析结合信号分解、特征提取和特征选择技术，以识别波形中有信息量的特征并区分不同的状态方程模型。我们使用一组紧凑的选定特征评估了几种机器学习分类器的性能，并考察了它们在探测器噪声存在下的鲁棒性。我们发现，基于熵的表示能够捕捉波形类别之间的潜在差异，并在噪声条件下保持比原始数据更好的性能，从而实现准确分类。这些结果展示了基于复杂度的特征提取作为核坍缩超新星引力波研究中一种高效且可解释方法的潜力。
classification.one_liner: 利用熵基机器学习框架对核坍缩超新星引力波进行分类，以推断核状态方程。
classification.relevance_reason: 涉及引力波与经典引力现象，但侧重于机器学习分类而非理论引力或全息；与经典引力支线相关。

papers.title: Complete quasinormal modes of Type-D black holes. II. Extremal Kerr black holes
papers.abstract: We develop a double-confluent Heun method that extends our previous study of complete quasinormal-mode (QNM) spectra of Type-D black holes to extremal Kerr black holes. Radial boundary conditions and angular regularity determine the gravitational frequencies at extremality. Compared with earlier spectra restricted to the conventional Riemann sheet, analytic continuation across frequency branch cuts reveals additional QNMs on unconventional Riemann sheets. Spin continuation follows our Schwarzschild mode families toward extremality, with the survey extending through the 41st overtone on specified angular branches and Riemann sheets. We show for the first time that unconventional Class I modes with $m<0$, continued from unconventional Schwarzschild modes, form zero-damping sequences approaching the superradiant bound $M\omega=m/2$ in the extremal limit. Within a fixed angular sector, finite-damping and zero-damping sequences are interspersed in the Schwarzschild overtone ordering, so a single overtone cutoff cannot separate them. Matching near the superradiant bound distinguishes nonextremal sequences accumulating at the critical frequency from isolated QNMs at exact extremality. Scattering-amplitude calculations verify representative roots and their sheet assignments. The expanded spectrum clarifies how Schwarzschild mode families reorganize at extremality, with completeness established by contour counting within a bounded frequency domain on a specified angular branch and Riemann sheet.

classification.title_zh: Type-D 黑洞的完整准正规模 II：极端 Kerr 黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 我们发展了一种双合流 Heun 方法，将此前对 Type-D 黑洞完整准正规模（QNM）谱的研究推广到极端 Kerr 黑洞。径向边界条件和角向正则性决定了极端情况下的引力频率。与局限于传统黎曼面的早期谱相比，跨频率分支割线的解析延拓揭示了非传统黎曼面上的额外 QNM。自旋延拓使我们的 Schwarzschild 模族趋向极端性，调查在指定角向分支和黎曼面上延伸到第 41 阶泛音。我们首次证明，由非传统 Schwarzschild 模延拓而来的 m<0 的非传统 Class I 模在极端极限下形成趋近超辐射界 Mω=m/2 的零阻尼序列。在固定角向扇区内，有限阻尼和零阻尼序列在 Schwarzschild 泛音排序中交错，因此单一泛音截断无法将它们分开。在超辐射界附近的匹配区分了在临界频率累积的非极端序列与精确极端性处的孤立 QNM。散射振幅计算验证了代表性根及其黎曼面归属。扩展后的谱澄清了 Schwarzschild 模族在极端性处如何重组，完备性通过在指定角向分支和黎曼面上有界频率域内的围道计数建立。
classification.one_liner: 用双合流 Heun 方法给出极端 Kerr 黑洞的完整 QNM 谱，并揭示跨黎曼面的额外模与超辐射界零阻尼序列。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究极端 Kerr 黑洞的准正规模谱，属于经典引力与 QNM 方向，与用户重点标签“QNM与非线性演化”和“经典引力/广义相对论”高度相关；不涉及全息。

papers.title: Signatures of Novikov-Thorne accretion disks around rotating black holes in semiclassical gravity with trace anomaly
papers.abstract: Semiclassical gravity provides a promising framework to address the black hole singularity problem through quantum backreaction characterized by a coupling parameter, making it essential to thoroughly explore the accretion properties around such objects. In this paper, within the framework of semiclassical gravity with type-A trace anomaly, we investigate the thermal radiative signatures of Novikov-Thorne accretion disks around rotating black holes across diverse parameter spaces, focusing on the energy flux density, temperature profile, and thermal luminosity. Our findings demonstrate that the introduction of a positive coupling parameter suppresses disk emission, leading to lower peak values of both energy flux density and temperature, as well as lower peak values and corresponding peak frequencies in thermal luminosity compared to their Kerr counterparts in general relativity. In particular, this discrepancy becomes remarkably pronounced when the black hole possesses a high spin. Mechanistically, increasing the coupling parameter reinforces the effective gravitational field strength of the central compact object, which pushes the equatorial stable circular orbits outward and increases the specific energy of the orbiting matter, thereby reducing the radiative efficiency and weakening the overall disk emission. This suppression mechanism offers a potential astrophysical window to distinguish semiclassical gravity from general relativity and to place observational constraints on the coupling parameter via thermal disk spectra.

classification.title_zh: 半经典引力中带迹反常的旋转黑洞周围 Novikov-Thorne 吸积盘的特征
classification.abstract_zh: 半经典引力通过由耦合参数刻画的量子反作用为解决黑洞奇点问题提供框架，因此有必要研究此类天体的吸积性质。本文在带 type-A 迹反常的半经典引力框架下，研究不同参数空间中旋转黑洞周围 Novikov-Thorne 吸积盘的热辐射特征，重点分析能流密度、温度分布和热光度。结果表明，引入正耦合参数会抑制盘发射，使能流密度和温度的峰值降低，并使热光度的峰值及对应峰值频率低于广义相对论中的 Kerr 情形；当黑洞具有高自旋时该差异尤为显著。机制上，增大耦合参数会增强中心致密天体的有效引力场强度，使赤道稳定圆轨道外移并提高轨道物质比能，从而降低辐射效率并削弱整体盘发射。该抑制机制为区分半经典引力与广义相对论、并利用热盘谱对耦合参数施加观测限制提供了潜在的天体物理窗口。
classification.one_liner: 在含 type-A 迹反常的半经典引力中，Novikov-Thorne 吸积盘的热辐射被正耦合参数抑制，高自旋时与 Kerr 的差异更显著。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典/半经典黑洞与吸积盘研究，可对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但不涉及全息或其他全息研究支线。

papers.title: Corrected thermodynamics and radiation predictions of modified black bounce compact objects
papers.abstract: We study the thermodynamic properties and radiation characteristics of a regular compact object obtained by applying the Simpson-Visser (SV) regularisation to the Schwarzschild modified gravity black hole. The resulting SV-MOG spacetime, whose lapse function involves both the MOG coupling parameter alpha and the black-bounce parameter l, smoothly interpolates between a regular black hole, a one-way wormhole, and a traversable wormhole depending on the parameter l. We derive the Hawking temperature and heat capacity for the black hole branch, identifying second-order phase transitions signaled by sign changes in CV, and, for the horizonless wormhole branch where no causal horizon and hence no genuine Hawking radiation exists we instead construct a physically well-defined effective temperature from the Lyapunov exponent of the unstable photon sphere. Quantum gravitational corrections to the entropy are incorporated via logarithmic terms parameterized by coefficients beta1, beta2, whose theoretically preferred ranges in loop quantum gravity and string theory we discuss, and we show that deviations from the Bekenstein-Hawking area law become significant at small horizon radii. A linear scalar-perturbation analysis further shows that the effective radial potential remains non-negative throughout the black-hole exterior and across the wormhole throat, indicating stability against monopole perturbations independently of the thermodynamic stability inferred from the heat capacity.
