classification.title_zh: 修改黑洞反弹致密天体的修正热力学与辐射预测
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究对Schwarzschild修改引力黑洞施加Simpson-Visser（SV）正则化后得到的规则致密天体的热力学性质与辐射特征。所得SV-MOG时空的 lapse 函数同时包含MOG耦合参数α和黑洞反弹参数l，并随l在规则黑洞、单向虫洞和可穿越虫洞之间平滑过渡。作者对黑洞分支推导Hawking温度和热容，并通过C_V变号识别二阶相变；对于无视界虫洞分支，由于不存在因果视界因而没有真正Hawking辐射，转而由不稳定光子球的Lyapunov指数构造物理上定义良好的有效温度。熵的量子引力修正通过由系数β1、β2参数化的对数项纳入，并讨论圈量子引力和弦理论中理论上偏好的参数范围，表明在视界半径较小时对Bekenstein-Hawking面积律的偏离变得显著。线性标量扰动分析进一步显示有效径向势在黑洞外部及虫洞喉部保持非负，表明对单极扰动稳定，且这一稳定性独立于由热容推断的热力学稳定性。
classification.one_liner: 研究SV正则化Schwarzschild修改引力黑洞/虫洞的热力学、辐射与标量扰动稳定性。
classification.relevance_reason: 涉及黑洞热力学、相变与经典/修改引力时空稳定性，但不属于AdS/CFT全息或所列全息物态支线；仅与相变和经典引力标签部分相关。

papers.title: A new framework for lightning-fast gravitational wave analysis of pulsar timing data
papers.abstract: Pulsar timing array data analysis is computationally expensive, limiting the complexity of models which can be studied. As pulsar timing datasets and their respective models grow in size and sophistication, faster and scalable inference methods are essential. In this paper, we accelerate pulsar timing analyses by sampling in the space of Fourier coefficients instead of analytically marginalizing over them. Previous studies have shown the Fourier space induces a complex, high-dimensional posterior geometry, from which it is generally difficult to sample. We show that under an appropriate coordinate transformation the Fourier coefficients approximately follow a standard normal distribution, and may be efficiently sampled using a Hamiltonian Monte Carlo scheme. Under this coordinate transformation, for datasets of size and complexity comparable to the NANOGrav 15-year release, the new method produces converged posterior distributions for a range of models which include inter-pulsar correlations, stochastic, and deterministic signals in approximately 15 minutes on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 GPU. By comparison, the legacy pulsar timing analysis software \texttt{ENTERPRISE} would require months of computation on a CPU cluster to analyze comparable datasets under the same joint stochastic and deterministic models.

classification.title_zh: 用于脉冲星计时数据闪电式引力波分析的新框架
classification.abstract_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列数据分析计算成本高昂，限制了可研究模型的复杂度。随着脉冲星计时数据集及相应模型规模与复杂度的增长，快速且可扩展的推断方法至关重要。本文通过在傅里叶系数空间采样而非解析边缘化来加速脉冲星计时分析。以往研究表明，傅里叶空间会诱导复杂的高维后验几何，通常难以采样。作者证明，在适当的坐标变换下，傅里叶系数近似服从标准正态分布，并可采用哈密顿蒙特卡洛方法高效采样。对于规模与复杂度与 NANOGrav 15 年发布相当的数据集，新方法在 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 GPU 上约 15 分钟内即可对包含脉冲星间关联、随机信号和确定性信号的一系列模型得到收敛后验分布。相比之下，传统脉冲星计时分析软件 ENTERPRISE 在 CPU 集群上分析同样联合随机与确定性模型的数据集则需要数月计算时间。
classification.one_liner: 提出基于傅里叶系数坐标变换与哈密顿蒙特卡洛的脉冲星计时阵列引力波数据分析加速方法，将 NANOGrav 规模分析从数月缩短至约 15 分钟。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/引力波观测数据分析的计算方法，不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶、量子引力等理论全息研究，与用户主要研究支线相关性较低。

papers.title: SPLIT: Loosely-coherent inference of long-inspiral gravitational-wave sources for robustness against modeling and data outliers
papers.abstract: The Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA) will detect gravitational waves (GWs) from dozens of extreme- and intermediate-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs/IMRIs). These sources will stay in-band for months to years, offering extraordinary scientific potential. However, their fully phase-coherent analysis standard in current pipelines imposes stringent waveform accuracy requirements; failing to model the signal over such long durations can result in significant systematic biases. To address this, we formulate a robust Bayesian inference framework that segments the data into blocks, infers each block coherently, and recombines the results using loosely-coherent phase information. By restricting full phase-tracking to much shorter block durations, this approach prevents significant accumulation of phase errors. We implement this methodology in \textsc{SPLIT} (Segmented Posteriors for Long-Inspiral Templates), a GPU-accelerated Python package. Applying \textsc{SPLIT} to an environment-rich injection, we demonstrate that while a fully-coherent vacuum-GR analysis incurs a maximum 1D systematic bias of $\approx 4.8\sigma$ from the truth, the shorter integration window of our loosely-coherent approach restricts such biases to $\lesssim 0.5\sigma$. Overall, despite a fractional loss of optimal signal-to-noise ratio, the substantial improvement in parameter accuracy offered by our method presents a highly advantageous trade-off for LISA and other future GW detectors.

classification.title_zh: SPLIT：面向长旋进引力波源的宽松相干推断，以增强对建模与数据异常值的鲁棒性
classification.abstract_zh: 激光干涉空间天线（LISA）将探测数十个极端质量比与中等质量比旋进（EMRI/IMRI）的引力波。这些源将在频带内停留数月至数年，具有非凡的科学潜力。然而，当前流程中完全相位相干分析的标准对波形精度提出严格要求；若无法在如此长的时间内建模信号，可能导致显著的系统偏差。为此，我们构建了一个稳健的贝叶斯推断框架，将数据分段为块，对每块进行相干推断，并利用宽松相干相位信息重组结果。通过将完整相位跟踪限制在更短的块时长内，该方法防止了相位误差的显著累积。我们在 SPLIT（长旋进模板的分段后验）中实现了该方法，这是一个 GPU 加速的 Python 包。将 SPLIT 应用于富含环境的注入，我们证明：完全相干的真空 GR 分析相对真值产生最大一维系统偏差约 4.8σ，而宽松相干方法较短的积分窗口将此类偏差限制在 ≲0.5σ。总体而言，尽管最优信噪比有分数损失，该方法在参数精度上的显著提升为 LISA 和其他未来引力波探测器提供了非常有利的权衡。
classification.one_liner: 提出 SPLIT 分段宽松相干贝叶斯推断方法，用于 LISA 长旋进引力波源，显著抑制波形建模误差导致的系统偏差。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于经典引力波探测与数据分析方法，研究 LISA 长旋进源推断鲁棒性，不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子引力理论。

papers.title: On spherically symmetric Berwald vacuum solutions in Finsler gravity
papers.abstract: Berwald-Finsler spacetimes are Finsler spacetimes that are closest to pseudo-Riemannian geometry, as their canonical nonlinear connection defines an affine connection on spacetime. In this paper, we find the first exact, non-Ricci flat, $SO(3)$-symmetric Berwald solutions to the Finsler gravity vacuum equation. To this aim, we first select from all spherically symmetric Berwald spacetimes, the only class that admits flat Finsler spacetime structures, making it particularly suitable for future investigations of asymptotic flatness. Then, for this class, we completely solve the Finsler gravity vacuum equation, and find three families of solutions. In particular, we show that in Finsler geometry there exist $SO(3)$-symmetric, vacuum solutions that are not Ricci-flat. These solutions are promising candidates to model the gravitational field around compact objects, beyond their Riemannian description.

classification.title_zh: 论Finsler引力中球对称Berwald真空解
classification.abstract_zh: Berwald-Finsler时空是最接近伪黎曼几何的Finsler时空，其典范非线性联络在时空上定义了仿射联络。本文找到了Finsler引力真空方程的首批精确、非Ricci平坦、SO(3)对称的Berwald解。为此，作者先从所有球对称Berwald时空中选出唯一允许平坦Finsler时空结构的类，使其特别适合未来研究渐近平坦性；然后对该类完全求解Finsler引力真空方程，并得到三族解。特别地，文章表明在Finsler几何中存在SO(3)对称、非Ricci平坦的真空解。这些解有望用于在黎曼描述之外建模致密天体周围的引力场。
classification.one_liner: 在Finsler引力中构造并完全求解了一类球对称Berwald真空方程，得到首批非Ricci平坦的SO(3)对称精确解。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论的推广框架，研究Finsler引力真空精确解与致密天体建模，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但不涉及AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子信息。

papers.title: Spectral Butterfly Effect and Resilient Ringdown in Thick Braneworlds
papers.abstract: The quasinormal mode spectrum is a unique fingerprint linking gravitational-wave observations to extra-dimensional geometry. In this article, we show that thick braneworlds exhibit a spectral butterfly effect: infinitesimal deformations of the effective potential trigger dramatic migrations of quasinormal modes, challenging the presumed stability of this fingerprint. Frequency-domain instabilities depend sensitively on the perturbation's location and strength. In the time domain, near-brane perturbations primarily modify the early ringdown, while far-brane perturbations generate clean late-time echoes. Crucially, the graviton zero mode remains localized, preserving four-dimensional gravity. Despite this pronounced spectral fragility, the observable early-stage signal under current detector sensitivities is still dominated by the original fundamental mode. Hence, thick braneworlds display a nontrivial coexistence of a fragile spectrum and a resilient ringdown, supporting the continued use of the standard fingerprint in present-day gravitational-wave astronomy while revealing its hidden sensitivity.

classification.title_zh: 厚膜世界中的谱蝴蝶效应与稳健铃宕
classification.abstract_zh: 准正规模谱是将引力波观测与额外维几何联系起来的独特指纹。本文表明厚膜世界存在谱蝴蝶效应：有效势的无穷小形变会触发准正规模的剧烈迁移，从而挑战该指纹的稳定性。频域不稳定性敏感依赖于扰动的位置和强度。时域上，近膜扰动主要改变早期铃宕，远膜扰动产生干净的晚期回波。关键的是，引力子零模仍保持局域化，维持四维引力。尽管谱很脆弱，当前探测器灵敏度下可观测的早期信号仍由原基模主导。因此厚膜世界呈现脆弱谱与稳健铃宕的非平凡共存，支持当前引力波天文学继续使用标准指纹，同时揭示其隐藏敏感性。
classification.one_liner: 厚膜世界中有效势的微小形变会显著迁移准正规模谱，但当前可观测的早期铃宕仍由原基模主导。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接涉及准正规模谱、铃宕与引力波信号，并属于经典引力/膜世界方向；但未聚焦用户重点的全息超流、multi-trace、D3-D7探针膜或非线性演化。

papers.title: On the mapping between bound states and black hole quasinormal modes via analytic continuation: a spectral instability perspective
papers.abstract: In this work, we investigate the relation between bound states and quasinormal modes within black hole perturbation theory in the context of spectral instability. Our analysis indicates that the reliability of such spectral mapping stretches beyond the domain of validity of the analytic continuation employed to connect the perturbative bound-state problem to the corresponding open-system dynamics. However, for the numerical scheme proposed by V\"olkel to work, the transformations of the metric parameters must be carried out in a region where the underlying Taylor expansion is convergent. As analytically accessible explicit examples, we explore the perturbed delta-function and P\"oschl-Teller potential barriers. For the latter, we construct two distinct perturbative setups for which the convergence of the series expansion involved in the perturbation theory can be rigorously controlled. When the deformation is placed near the potential's extremum, the resulting corrections to the bound-state energies can be analytically continued to yield perturbed quasinormal frequencies, in agreement with known semi-analytic results. In contrast, when the perturbation is localized asymptotically far from the compact object, the bound states are only mildly modified and are accurately described by a perturbative expansion to the first order. However, the associated analytic continuation yields a strongly deformed spectrum that shows no clear connection to the quasinormal modes. These findings contribute to the effort to scrutinize the conditions under which bound states faithfully encode quasinormal spectra and to shed light on the underlying physics of black hole spectral instability.

classification.title_zh: 论通过解析延拓的束缚态与黑洞准正规模映射：谱不稳定性视角
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在谱不稳定性背景下研究黑洞微扰理论中束缚态与准正规模之间的关系。分析表明，这种谱映射的可靠性超出用于连接微扰束缚态问题与相应开放系统动力学的解析延拓的有效域。然而，为使 Völkel 提出的数值方案奏效，度规参数的变换必须在底层 Taylor 展开收敛的区域内进行。作为可解析处理的显式例子，我们考察受扰动的 delta 函数势垒和 Pöschl-Teller 势垒。对于后者，我们构造两种不同的微扰设置，使微扰论中级数展开的收敛性可被严格控制。当形变位于势的极值附近时，所得的束缚态能量修正可解析延拓为受扰动的准正规模频率，并与已知半解析结果一致。相反，当微扰局域在远离致密天体的渐近区域时，束缚态仅被轻微修改，并可由一阶微扰展开准确描述；但相应的解析延拓给出强烈变形的谱，与准正规模没有明显联系。这些发现有助于审视束缚态在何种条件下忠实编码准正规模谱，并有助于理解黑洞谱不稳定性的物理。
classification.one_liner: 研究束缚态—准正规模解析延拓映射在谱不稳定性下的适用条件，指出远离势极值的微扰可破坏该映射。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接讨论黑洞准正规模及谱不稳定性，匹配 QNM 与经典引力重点标签；但不涉及全息。

papers.title: Assessing the robustness of amortized simulation-based inference to transient noise in gravitational-wave ringdowns
papers.abstract: Gravitational waves (GW) emitted by binary systems allow us to perform precision tests of general relativity in the strong field regime. Ringdown signals allow for probing black hole mass and spin with high precision in GW astronomy. With improvements in current and next-generation GW detectors, developing likelihood-free parameter inference methods is crucial. This is especially important when facing challenges such as non-standard noise, partial data, or incomplete signal models that prevent the use of analytical likelihood functions. In this work, we propose an amortized simulation-based inference strategy to estimate ringdown parameters directly. Specifically, our method is based on amortized neural posterior estimation, which trains a neural density estimator of the posterior for all data segments within the prior range. The results show that our trained amortized network achieves valid confidence coverage and yields posteriors in agreement with established Markov-chain methods at moderate signal-to-noise ratios. At higher signal-to-noise ratios, the recovered posteriors agree with the Markov-chain results in location, although the amplitude posterior is broader. The network provides inference speeds that are orders of magnitude faster. Furthermore, we evaluate the robustness of the method against transient noise contamination. Our results indicate that the timing of glitch injection significantly affects estimation bias, in particular when the glitch contaminates the early, high-amplitude portion of the signal. This study not only provides an efficient and statistically validated inference framework under the tested conditions for ringdown analysis but also lays a foundation for developing robust data-processing pipelines for future GW astronomy in realistic noise environments.

classification.title_zh: 评估基于摊销模拟的推断对引力波铃宕瞬态噪声的鲁棒性
classification.abstract_zh: 双星系统发出的引力波使我们能够在强场区对广义相对论进行精确检验。铃宕信号可用于高精度探测黑洞质量和自旋。随着当前和下一代引力波探测器的改进，发展无似然参数推断方法至关重要，尤其在面对非标准噪声、部分数据或不完整信号模型而无法使用解析似然函数时。本文提出一种摊销的基于模拟的推断策略，直接估计铃宕参数。具体而言，方法基于摊销神经后验估计，针对先验范围内的所有数据段训练后验的神经密度估计器。结果表明，训练后的摊销网络具有有效的置信覆盖，并在中等信噪比下给出与成熟马尔可夫链方法一致的后验。在较高信噪比下，恢复的后验在位置上与马尔可夫链结果一致，尽管振幅后验更宽。该网络提供的推断速度快若干数量级。此外，我们评估了方法对瞬态噪声污染的鲁棒性。结果表明，毛刺注入的时序显著影响估计偏差，尤其当毛刺污染信号早期高振幅部分时。本研究不仅在测试条件下为铃宕分析提供了一个高效且经统计验证的推断框架，也为未来真实噪声环境下发展鲁棒数据处理流程奠定基础。
classification.one_liner: 提出摊销神经后验估计用于引力波铃宕参数直接推断，验证其统计覆盖、速度及对瞬态毛刺噪声的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Stability and instability of the sub-extremal Reissner-Nordstr\"om black hole interior for the Einstein-Maxwell-Klein-Gordon equations in spherical symmetry
papers.abstract: We show non-linear stability and instability results in spherical symmetry for the interior of a charged black hole -approaching a sub-extremal Reissner-Nordstr\"om background fast enough at infinity- in presence of a massive and charged scalar field, motivated by the strong cosmic censorship conjecture in that setting : 1. Stability : We prove that spherically symmetric characteristic initial data to the Einstein-Maxwell- Klein-Gordon equations approaching a Reissner-Nordstr\"om background with a sufficiently decaying polynomial decay rate on the event horizon gives rise to a space-time possessing a Cauchy horizon in a neighbourhood of time-like infinity. Moreover if the decay is even stronger, we prove that the spacetime metric admits a continuous extension to the Cauchy horizon. This generalizes the celebrated stability result of Dafermos for Einstein-Maxwell-real-scalar-field in spherical symmetry. 2. Instability : We prove that for the class of space-times considered in the stability part, whose scalar field in addition obeys a polynomial averaged-L^2 (consistent) lower bound on the event horizon, the scalar field obeys an integrated lower bound transversally to the Cauchy horizon. As a consequence we prove that the non-degenerate energy is infinite on any null surface crossing the Cauchy horizon and the curvature of a geodesic vector field blows up at the Cauchy horizon near time-like infinity. This generalizes an instability result due to Luk and Oh for Einstein-Maxwell-real-scalar-field in spherical symmetry. This instability of the black hole interior can also be viewed as a step towards the resolution of the C^2 strong cosmic censorship conjecture for one-ended asymptotically initial data.

classification.title_zh: 球对称 Einstein-Maxwell-Klein-Gordon 方程下亚极端 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞内部的稳定性与不稳定性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在球对称情形下证明带电黑洞内部的非线性稳定性与不稳定性结果；该黑洞在无穷远处足够快地趋近亚极端 Reissner-Nordström 背景，并存在大质量带电标量场，动机来自该设定下的强宇宙监督猜想。1. 稳定性：证明趋近 Reissner-Nordström 背景、且在事件视界上具有足够多项式衰减率的球对称特征初值，对 Einstein-Maxwell-Klein-Gordon 方程产生一个在类时无穷附近邻域内具有 Cauchy 视界的时空；若衰减更强，还证明时空度规可连续延拓到 Cauchy 视界。这推广了 Dafermos 关于球对称 Einstein-Maxwell-实标量场方程的著名稳定性结果。2. 不稳定性：对稳定性部分考虑的时空类，若标量场在事件视界上还满足多项式平均 L² 下界，则标量场在横穿 Cauchy 视界方向满足一个积分下界；由此证明非退化能量在穿过 Cauchy 视界的任意零面上无穷大，且测地矢量场的曲率在类时无穷附近于 Cauchy 视界处发散。这推广了 Luk 与 Oh 关于球对称 Einstein-Maxwell-实标量场方程的不稳定性结果。该黑洞内部的不稳定性也可视为朝解决单端渐近初值的 C² 强宇宙监督猜想迈出的一步。
classification.one_liner: 证明球对称带电黑洞内部在带电大质量标量场扰动下 Cauchy 视界附近的非线性稳定与不稳定，并推进强宇宙监督研究。

papers.title: Mercury (Hg): a relativistic $N$-body simulation for Horndeski gravity
papers.abstract: We present Mercury, a relativistic $N$-body code for cosmological simulations in the $\alpha$-basis formulation of Horndeski gravity. Mercury extends a particle-mesh scheme by incorporating the dynamics of the additional scalar degree of freedom and the corresponding modified Einstein equations, expressed in terms of the time-dependent functions $\alpha_{\rm K}, \alpha_{\rm B}, \alpha_{\rm M}, \alpha_{\rm T}$ and the effective Planck mass $M_*^2$. This generalises our previous implementation of Horndeski subclass models, namely $k$-essence and kinetic gravity braiding (KGB), to the general linear Horndeski $\alpha$-basis. The code evolves the additional scalar degree of freedom and its effective stress--energy tensor alongside the nonlinear matter and metric fields, so that nonlinear structure formation sources the scalar-field evolution and feeds back on the gravitational potentials. Through its interface with hi_class, Mercury supports both phenomenological $\alpha$-function parametrisations and covariant Horndeski theories; we demonstrate the latter using nKGB, the Cubic Galileon, and Brans--Dicke models. We validate the implementation against hi_class in the linear regime and recover the expected nonlinear $k$-essence and KGB limits. For the luminal Horndeski models considered here, we show how a running effective Planck mass generates gravitational slip through the scalar anisotropic stress and modifies the friction terms governing the vector and tensor metric perturbations. The evolution of $M_*^2$ also modifies the normalisation and scale dependence of the effective dark-energy density contrast, leaving a corresponding imprint on its power spectrum. The present framework provides an intermediate step towards nonlinear Horndeski simulations, in which nonlinear scalar self-interactions and screening effects can be incorporated consistently within the same relativistic framework.

classification.title_zh: Mercury（Hg）：Horndeski 引力的相对论 N 体模拟
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出 Mercury，一个用于 Horndeski 引力 α-基表述下宇宙学模拟的相对论 N 体代码。Mercury 扩展了粒子-网格方案，纳入额外标量自由度的动力学以及相应的修改 Einstein 方程，这些方程由含时函数 α_K、α_B、α_M、α_T 和有效 Planck 质量 M_*^2 表示。这将我们此前对 Horndeski 子类模型（k-essence 和 kinetic gravity braiding）的实现推广到一般线性 Horndeski α-基。代码演化额外标量自由度及其有效应力-能量张量，并与非线性物质场和度规场一起演化，从而使非线性结构形成对标量场演化产生源，并反过来反馈到引力势。通过其与 hi_class 的接口，Mercury 支持现象学 α-函数参数化和协变 Horndeski 理论；我们用 nKGB、Cubic Galileon 和 Brans-Dicke 模型展示了后者。我们在线性区域对照 hi_class 验证实现，并恢复预期的非线性 k-essence 和 KGB 极限。对于本文考虑的光速 Horndeski 模型，我们展示跑动的有效 Planck 质量如何通过标量各向异性应力产生引力滑移，并修改支配矢量与张量度规扰动的摩擦项。M_*^2 的演化还修改有效暗能量密度contrast的归一化和尺度依赖，并在其功率谱上留下相应印记。当前框架为非线性 Horndeski 模拟提供了中间步骤，其中非线性标量自相互作用和屏蔽效应可在同一相对论框架内一致地纳入。
classification.one_liner: 介绍并验证用于 Horndeski 引力 α-基宇宙学非线性结构形成的相对论 N 体代码 Mercury。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/修改引力宇宙学，涉及 Horndeski 理论和非线性 N 体模拟；不与全息对偶直接相关。

papers.title: Mass and angular momentum assessement of the neutron star XTEJ 1807-294 using X-ray triplets
papers.abstract: The X-ray power-density spectrum of the accreting millisecond pulsar XTEJ 1807-294 contains several triplets of simultaneously observed quasi-periodic oscillations (QPOs): a lower and a upper kHz QPOs and a low-frequency QPO. This fact allows us to assess the mass and the specific angular momentum of the central neutron star. We also apply an error propagation formula to obtain interval estimates of the parameters of the star. The calculations are repeated with several different models for the kHz QPOs. The degree of consistency of the bounds obtained with the different triplets may provide information for the viability of the used models.

classification.title_zh: 利用X射线三重态评估中子星XTEJ 1807-294的质量和角动量
classification.abstract_zh: 吸积毫秒脉冲星XTEJ 1807-294的X射线功率密度谱包含若干同时观测到的准周期振荡（QPO）三重态：一个下kHz QPO、一个上kHz QPO和一个低频QPO。这一事实使我们能够评估中心中子星的质量和比角动量。我们还应用误差传播公式获得恒星参数的区间估计。计算用几种不同的kHz QPO模型重复进行。不同三重态所得界限的一致程度可能为所用模型的可行性提供信息。
classification.one_liner: 利用XTEJ 1807-294的QPO三重态估计中子星质量与比角动量，并比较不同kHz QPO模型的一致性。

papers.title: Gravitational-Wave Signal from a Short GRB Relativistic MHD Jet
papers.abstract: We analyze the gravitational-wave (GW) signal produced by a relativistic magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) simulation of a short GRB jet with parameters corresponding to those of GRB 170817A. The signal that is generated in the hidden central engine of the GRBs is computed by direct integration of the retarded solution of the linearized Einstein equations of an MHD simulation. Separating the GW signal into its baryonic and electromagnetic contributions, we identify the physical origin of its dominant features. The waveform is of the memory type, with $h(f) \propto 1/f$ at low frequencies and a knee at $\sim 0.5-0.5$Hz set by the energy injection time, which corresponds to the GRB duration. A pronounced early peak reflects the opening of the magnetic field lines and the equatorial kick given to the ejecta at the onset of the jet, demonstrating that the GW signal can reveal processes deep in the GRB engine that cannot be observed otherwise. The signal is strongest for observers far from the jet axis. The total radiated GW energy is only $\sim 10^{42}$ erg, about $10^{-9}$ of the jet energy; it scales as ${\cal E}^2/\tau$ with the shortest variability time $\tau$, so this is a lower limit. Comparing the predicted spectrum with the sensitivity of current and future detectors, we find that events similar to GW170817 are marginally detectable by DECIGO from up to 10 Mpc and by the Einstein Telescope from 1 Mpc. The injected Poynting flux in this simulation was smooth. An engine variable on a millisecond timescale, as predicted in some GRB models, would substantially increase the GW energy and detectability.

classification.title_zh: 短伽马射线暴相对论磁流体喷流的引力波信号
classification.abstract_zh: 我们分析由短伽马射线暴喷流相对论磁流体力学模拟产生的引力波信号，其参数对应 GRB 170817A。通过直接积分该 MHD 模拟的线性化 Einstein 方程推迟解，计算在 GRB 隐藏中心引擎中产生的信号。将引力波信号分为重子贡献和电磁贡献，并识别其主要特征的物理来源。波形为记忆型，低频满足 h(f) ∝ 1/f，并由对应 GRB 持续时间的能量注入时间设定约 0.5 Hz 的拐点。一个显著的早期峰反映磁力线打开以及喷流起始时对抛射物的赤道踢，表明引力波信号可揭示 GRB 引擎深处否则无法观测的过程。信号对远离喷流轴的观测者最强。总辐射引力波能量仅约 10^42 erg，约为喷流能量的 10^-9；它按 E^2/τ 缩放，其中 τ 为最短变化时标，因此该结果是下限。将预测谱与当前和未来探测器灵敏度比较，发现类似 GW170817 的事件可被 DECIGO 从最多 10 Mpc、Einstein Telescope 从 1 Mpc 边缘探测。该模拟中注入的 Poynting 通量是光滑的；若引擎在毫秒时标上变化（一些 GRB 模型预言如此），将显著增加引力波能量和可探测性。
classification.one_liner: 相对论 MHD 模拟显示短 GRB 喷流可产生记忆型引力波信号，但能量低、探测需未来探测器。

papers.title: Cosmological rigidity via $p$-harmonic temporal functions
papers.abstract: We prove a splitting theorem for cosmological spacetimes which admit a globally $p$-harmonic Cauchy temporal function for some $p < 1$, without making any use of timelike lines. In Bartnik's context of cosmological and timelike geodesically complete spacetimes, we establish a Liouville-type unboundedness result which shows that globally $p$-harmonic temporal functions, $p < 1$, are necessarily Cauchy temporal. Moreover, using the theory of elliptic PDEs, we show that locally Lipschitz $p$-harmonic temporal functions with $p < 1$ are in fact smooth. Altogether, our work reduces the resolution of Bartnik's cosmological splitting conjecture to the global weak solvability of the $p$-d'Alembert equation for some $p < 1$ in the class of locally Lipschitz temporal functions.

classification.title_zh: 通过 p-调和时间函数研究宇宙学刚性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明了一个分裂定理：若宇宙学时空允许某个 p<1 的全局 p-调和 Cauchy 时间函数，则无需使用类时线即可得到分裂结论。在 Bartnik 的宇宙学且类时测地完备时空背景下，我们建立了一个 Liouville 型无界性结果，表明 p<1 的全局 p-调和时间函数必为 Cauchy 时间函数。此外，利用椭圆偏微分方程理论，我们证明局部 Lipschitz 的 p<1 p-调和时间函数实际上是光滑的。总之，我们的工作将 Bartnik 宇宙学分裂猜想的解决归结为：对某个 p<1，p-d'Alembert 方程在局部 Lipschitz 时间函数类中具有全局弱可解性。
classification.one_liner: 用 p-调和时间函数与椭圆 PDE 研究宇宙学时空分裂及 Bartnik 猜想。

papers.title: Detectability of an orbital-angular-momentum-based gravitational wave detector
papers.abstract: The orbital angular momentum (OAM) of light provides a new approach to probing gravitational waves (GWs) through transitions between OAM states. Here, we assess the detectability of an OAM-based GW detector by developing a readout scheme and evaluating its noise budget over the frequency range from $1~\mathrm{mHz}$ to $100~\mathrm{Hz}$, including laser-intensity noise, laser-phase noise, mode-impurity noise, and shot noise. For a symmetric superposition OAM state, the GW-induced transition amplitudes satisfy $\alpha_+=-\alpha_-^*$, whereas the noise-induced mode-crosstalk coefficients obey $n_+=n_-^*$. Hence, the GW-induced signal forms a differential-mode contribution, while laser-intensity and mode-impurity noises enter as common-mode contributions, enabling their suppression by the balanced detection. Under a fixed beam-waist constraint, a shorter arm permits a larger paraxial parameter, reducing the equivalent angular-noise strain sensitivity. We adopt an arm length of $L=4\,\mathrm{m}$, $N=160$ round trips, a paraxial parameter of $\gamma=0.1$, a laser power incident on the beam splitter of $P_{\mathrm{BS}}=10\,\mathrm{kW}$, and a wavelength of $\lambda_{\mathrm{opt}}=1064\,\mathrm{nm}$. Using representative noise spectra, we find that, for GWs from an equal-mass binary black hole with source-frame component masses of $M_{\mathrm{src}}=10^{4}\,M_{\odot}$ at redshift $z=1$, balanced detection yields an SNR of $24.7$ for an imbalance parameter of $\epsilon=10^{-3}$ and $239$ for $\epsilon=10^{-5}$, with the sensitivity approaching the shot-noise limit in the latter case. These results highlight the importance of a compact optical configuration and strong common-mode rejection for realizing an OAM-based GW detector.

classification.title_zh: 基于轨道角动量的引力波探测器的可探测性
classification.abstract_zh: 光子的轨道角动量（OAM）可通过OAM态之间的跃迁来探测引力波。本文提出一种读出方案，并评估基于OAM的引力波探测器在1 mHz至100 Hz频段的噪声预算，包括激光强度噪声、激光相位噪声、模式杂质噪声和散粒噪声。对于对称叠加OAM态，引力波诱导的跃迁振幅满足α_+=-α_-^*，而噪声诱导的模式串扰系数满足n_+=n_-^*，因此引力波信号构成差分模贡献，激光强度噪声和模式杂质噪声作为共模贡献可通过平衡探测抑制。在固定束腰约束下，较短臂长允许更大的傍轴参数，从而降低等效角噪声应变灵敏度。采用L=4 m、N=160次往返、傍轴参数γ=0.1、分束器入射激光功率P_BS=10 kW、波长λ_opt=1064 nm，并使用代表性噪声谱，发现对于红移z=1、源架分量质量M_src=10^4 M_⊙的等质量双黑洞引力波，平衡探测在失配参数ε=10^-3时信噪比为24.7，在ε=10^-5时为239，后者灵敏度接近散粒噪声极限。结果表明紧凑光学配置和强共模抑制对实现基于OAM的引力波探测器很重要。
classification.one_liner: 本文设计读出方案并评估基于光轨道角动量跃迁的引力波探测器在1 mHz–100 Hz的噪声预算与探测能力。

papers.title: Surrogate model of gravitational waveforms for quasi-circular, spin-aligned, asymmetric-mass black hole binaries based on the hybridization of WaSABI-C inspirals with numerical relativity waveforms
papers.abstract: With the incorporation of aligned-spin dynamics into self-force waveform models, such as the WaSABI-C inspiral model, and with the release of the SXS collaboration's third public catalog of NR simulations, the gravitational waveform modeling community has made significant advances in the modeling of spinning, asymmetric-mass black hole binaries. In light of these developments, we present WaSABINRHybSur2dq15, the first surrogate model to incorporate information from self-force theory, post-Newtonian theory, and numerical relativity. The model is trained on 65 hybrid waveforms for quasi-circular, spin-aligned, asymmetric-mass black hole binaries with mass ratios spanning 1:1.25 to 1:20 and aligned-spins for the primary black hole ranging -0.5 to 0.5. The hybrid waveforms are generated from a set of WaSABI-C inspirals and NR waveforms from the third SXS public catalog. The model covers the parameter domain $1.25 \leq q \leq 15$ and $|\chi_{1z}| \leq 0.5$, and includes the $(2,2),\, (2,1),\, (3,3),\, (4,4),$ and $(5,5)$ spin-weighted spherical harmonic modes. The model also spans the entire LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA (LVK) frequency band (with $f_{\text{low}}=20$ Hz) for total masses $M \gtrsim 111.5\,M_{\odot}$. We find that the WaSABINRHybSur2dq15 model faithfully reproduces the hybrid waveforms with mismatches less than $10^{-3}$ for total masses in the range $80\,M_{\odot} \leq M \leq 300\,M_{\odot}$.

classification.title_zh: 基于WaSABI-C旋进与数值相对论波形混合的准圆、自旋对齐、非对称质量双黑洞引力波波形代理模型
classification.abstract_zh: 随着自力波形模型（如WaSABI-C旋进模型）引入自旋对齐动力学，以及SXS合作组第三版公开数值相对论模拟目录的发布，自旋、非对称质量双黑洞的引力波建模取得了显著进展。据此，我们提出WaSABINRHybSur2dq15，这是首个融合自力理论、后牛顿理论和数值相对论信息的代理模型。该模型在65个混合波形上训练，这些波形对应准圆、自旋对齐、非对称质量双黑洞，质量比覆盖1:1.25至1:20，主黑洞自旋对齐分量范围为-0.5至0.5。混合波形由一组WaSABI-C旋进波形与第三版SXS公开目录中的数值相对论波形生成。模型覆盖参数域1.25≤q≤15和|χ_{1z}|≤0.5，并包含(2,2)、(2,1)、(3,3)、(4,4)和(5,5)自旋加权球谐模式。对于总质量M≳111.5 M⊙，模型覆盖整个LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA频段（f_low=20 Hz）。我们发现，对于总质量在80 M⊙≤M≤300 M⊙范围内，WaSABINRHybSur2dq15模型能以小于10^{-3}的失配率忠实再现混合波形。
classification.one_liner: 提出首个融合自力、后牛顿与数值相对论波形的双黑洞引力波代理模型WaSABINRHybSur2dq15，并在质量比与自旋对齐参数范围内实现低失配。

papers.title: Pilot search for continuous gravitational waves from Hercules X-1 in O3 LIGO data: enhancements to a hidden Markov model
papers.abstract: A semi-coherent search is conducted for continuous gravitational waves from stellar oscillations in Hercules X-1 with data from Observing Run 3 of the Laser Interferometer Gravitational-wave Observatory, using an established hidden Markov model algorithm to track stochastic wandering of the signal frequency. The primary goal is to implement and test several algorithmic enhancements relevant to future searches, including a second-order projected semi-major axis correction, an orbital eccentricity correction, an adjustment to the width of a search subband, and propagation of the electromagnetically measured orbital parameters with a nonzero orbital period derivative. The enhancements are validated by injecting synthetic signals into Gaussian noise and improve the sensitivity depth by $\approx$ 14% for a Hercules X-1-like target. In the 60--200 Hz band, the pilot search yields four candidates that survive a five-level veto procedure, whose terminating frequencies are 76.41 Hz, 109.47 Hz, 144.40 Hz, and 189.24 Hz. The frequentist upper limit on the maximum detectable wave strain at 95% confidence is arbitrarily set at 174 Hz and found to be $9.3 \times 10^{-26}$, assuming a uniform prior on polarization.

classification.title_zh: O3 LIGO数据中武仙座X-1连续引力波的试点搜索：隐藏马尔可夫模型的增强
classification.abstract_zh: 利用LIGO第三次观测运行数据，对武仙座X-1恒星振荡产生的连续引力波进行半相干搜索，采用隐藏马尔可夫模型追踪信号频率的随机游走。主要目标是实现并测试若干面向未来搜索的算法增强，包括二阶投影半长轴修正、轨道偏心率修正、搜索子带宽度调整，以及用非零轨道周期导数传播电磁测定的轨道参数。通过向高斯噪声注入合成信号验证增强，对类武仙座X-1目标将灵敏度深度提高约14%。在60–200 Hz频段，试点搜索得到四个通过五级否决程序的候选体，终止频率分别为76.41、109.47、144.40和189.24 Hz。在95%置信度下，最大可探测波应变的上限在174 Hz处任意设定为9.3×10^-26，假设偏振均匀先验。
classification.one_liner: 用增强HMM在LIGO O3数据中试点搜索武仙座X-1连续引力波并给出候选与上限。

papers.title: A Singularity Theorem for Quasi-Topological Gravities
papers.abstract: Quasi-topological theories of gravity have recently attracted substantial attention as several theories in this class have a non-singular black hole as a vacuum and spherically symmetric solution. This motivates the expectation that these theories can provide a resolution to the singularity problem and a description of black holes cores. The known solutions, however, possess a Cauchy horizon which denotes the end of predictability of the theory, as the initial data do not determine a unique continuation past this type of horizon. In this paper, we show that Penrose singularity theorem can be extended to all the known classes of quasi-topological theories that have non-singular black holes as solutions. We prove that spherical collapse satisfying the null energy condition necessarily leads to future null geodesic incompleteness once a trapped sphere forms. This implies that the lack of predictability of the theories is not an artefact of vacuum solutions and these theories are as problematic as general relativity for the dynamical studies of black hole interiors.

classification.title_zh: 准拓扑引力的奇点定理
classification.abstract_zh: 准拓扑引力理论近来受到大量关注，因为该类中的若干理论以非奇异黑洞作为真空球对称解。这激发了一种期望：这些理论能够解决奇点问题并描述黑洞核心。然而，已知解具有柯西视界，它标志着可预测性的终点，因为初始数据不能唯一决定该视界之后的延拓。本文表明，Penrose 奇点定理可以推广到所有已知的、具有非奇异黑洞解的准拓扑理论类。我们证明，满足零能量条件的球对称坍缩一旦形成囚禁球面，就必然导致未来零测地线不完备。这意味着这些理论缺乏可预测性并非真空解的假象，并且在黑洞内部动力学研究方面与广义相对论一样有问题。
classification.one_liner: 将 Penrose 奇点定理推广到具有非奇异黑洞解的准拓扑引力，表明球对称坍缩仍导致零测地线不完备。

papers.title: Light Ring Stability Across Spacetime Dimensions and Theories of Gravity
papers.abstract: The light ring theorem states that four-dimensional stationary, axisymmetric, horizonless ultracompact objects (UCOs) possess light rings (LRs) in pairs, one of which is stable if the Null Energy Condition (NEC) holds in General Relativity (GR). The existence of a stable LR may trigger nonlinear spacetime instabilities, thereby raising questions about the viability of UCOs as long-lived black hole mimickers. We extend the LR existence and stability theorem beyond four-dimensional GR to modified gravity theories, in particular, $f(R)$ gravity, scalar-tensor theories, and restricted Horndeski gravity, in ($d \geq 4$) dimensional spacetimes. Our findings show that in four-dimensional modified gravities, the stability of LRs is governed by theory-specific coupling parameters in addition to the NEC. Consequently, a stable LR is not guaranteed to occur in certain parameter regimes. In higher dimensions ($d>4$), we confirm using topological arguments that LRs still emerge in pairs; however, the topological charges are now associated with four distinct types of LRs, including two types of saddle points. The stability analysis further constrains the allowed LR pairings, implying that, unlike in four-dimensional GR, the emergent pair does not necessarily include a stable LR. These findings directly impact tests of GR using UCOs, demonstrating that LR stability is highly sensitive to both the underlying gravitational theory and spacetime dimensionality.

classification.title_zh: 跨时空维度与引力理论的光环稳定性
classification.abstract_zh: 光环定理指出，在四维稳态、轴对称、无视界超紧凑天体（UCO）中，光环（LR）成对出现；若广义相对论中零能量条件（NEC）成立，则其中一个光环是稳定的。稳定光环的存在可能触发非线性时空不稳定性，从而对UCO作为长寿命黑洞模仿者的可行性提出疑问。我们将LR存在性与稳定性定理从四维广义相对论推广到修改引力理论，特别是f(R)引力、标量-张量理论和受限Horndeski引力，并在d≥4维时空中讨论。结果表明，在四维修改引力中，LR稳定性除受NEC约束外，还受理论特定耦合参数控制；因此，在某些参数区域不保证出现稳定LR。在更高维（d>4）中，我们用拓扑论证确认LR仍成对出现；然而，拓扑荷现在与四类不同的LR相关，其中包括两类鞍点。稳定性分析进一步限制允许的LR配对，意味着与四维广义相对论不同，出现的配对不一定包含稳定LR。这些发现直接影响使用UCO检验广义相对论，表明LR稳定性对底层引力理论和时空维度高度敏感。
classification.one_liner: 将光环存在性与稳定性定理推广到修改引力和高维时空，发现稳定光环不再普遍保证。

papers.title: Ricci-Non-metric Holographic Dark Energy
papers.abstract: In this work we propose a holographic dark energy model inspired by the Ricci scalar $R$ and non-metricity scalar $Q$. The infrared cutoff of the holographic dark energy is described by a combination of the Ricci scalar and the non-metricity scalar. Such a structure is very helpful because the evolution is entirely dependent on the universe's current characteristics rather than its previous or future characteristics. Additionally, the theory becomes more fundamental due to the application of invariants. We have built the model and examined its cosmological characteristics. The behavior of several cosmological parameters, including the density parameter, equation of state parameter, and deceleration parameter, is examined. It is observed that the holographic dark energy model may depict every cosmological epoch, beginning with radiation in the early universe, moving on to matter, and concluding with the dark energy-dominated period in later times. Depending on the parameter spaces selected, the equation of state parameter demonstrates that the model may have quintessence nature, phantom-divide crossing, or even phantom nature in future times.

classification.title_zh: Ricci-非度规全息暗能量
classification.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种受Ricci标量R与非度规标量Q启发的全息暗能量模型。该全息暗能量的红外截断由Ricci标量与非度规标量的组合描述。这种结构很有帮助，因为演化完全依赖于宇宙当前特征，而不是其过去或未来特征。此外，由于使用了不变量，该理论变得更基本。我们构建了该模型并考察了其宇宙学特征，分析了密度参数、状态方程参数和减速参数等多个宇宙学参数的行为。结果表明，该全息暗能量模型可以描述每一个宇宙学时期，从早期宇宙的辐射期，到物质期，再到晚期暗能量主导期。根据所选参数空间，状态方程参数表明该模型可能具有精质性质、跨越幽灵分界，甚至在未来具有幽灵性质。
classification.one_liner: 构建了以Ricci标量与非度规标量组合为红外截断的全息暗能量模型，并分析其宇宙学演化与状态方程行为。

papers.title: Effects of radiation on the Laser Interferometer Lunar Antenna (LILA)
papers.abstract: The Moon provides a promising environment for gravitational-wave (GW) observations in the midband. The Laser Interferometer Lunar Antenna (LILA) combines a lunar deformation channel (LDC) and a geodesic deformation channel (GDC) to cover the midband. The LDC uses the Moon's resonant response to GW for the lower portion of the midband while the GDC measures displacement of suspended test masses to measure the latter. Radiation on the lunar surface can produce spurious signals through test-mass charging, momentum transfer, and thermoelastic deformation. We estimate these contributions for a notional 100 kg fused-silica optic using Geant4 transport, a finite-element electrostatic force map, and a spatial thermoelastic response kernel. Solar-minimum galactic cosmic rays and lunar albedo neutrons define a background case; a worst-day solar energetic particle spectrum (1989 solar flare conditions) defines an extreme, but rare, case. Aluminum-equivalent shielding from 50 to 1000 mils (1.27 to 25.4 mm) and two electrostatic actuator voltage configurations are compared. In the uniform-charge approximation, balanced drive with electrode configuration (B) substantially reduces linear charge-to-force coupling. Ideal continuous compensation of the mean charging current suppresses coherent charge accumulation while introducing negligible discharge shot noise. With compensation, charge-related noise dominates the low-frequency response, whereas thermoelastic deformation dominates at higher frequencies. Accumulated-dose and photodetector transient estimates identify additional component-qualification considerations. Estimates indicate that even under solar flare conditions, radiation noise is not a significant contributor to LILA's overall noise budget as long as charge-aware designs are followed.

classification.title_zh: 辐射对激光干涉月基天线（LILA）的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 月球为中频段引力波观测提供了有前景的环境。激光干涉月基天线（LILA）结合月球形变通道（LDC）和测地线形变通道（GDC）覆盖中频段：LDC利用月球对引力波的共振响应覆盖中频段较低部分，GDC通过测量悬浮测试质量的位移覆盖较高部分。月面辐射可通过测试质量充电、动量转移和热弹性变形产生虚假信号。我们针对一个设想的100 kg熔融石英光学元件，使用Geant4输运、有限元静电力图和空间热弹性响应核估计这些贡献。太阳活动极小期银河宇宙线和月球反照中子定义背景情形；最坏日太阳高能粒子谱（1989年太阳耀斑条件）定义极端但罕见情形。比较了50至1000密耳（1.27至25.4 mm）铝等效屏蔽和两种静电驱动器电压配置。在均匀电荷近似下，采用电极配置（B）的平衡驱动显著降低线性电荷-力耦合。对平均充电电流的理想连续补偿可抑制相干电荷积累，同时引入可忽略的放电散粒噪声。有补偿时，电荷相关噪声在低频响应中占主导，而热弹性变形在较高频率占主导。累积剂量和光电探测器瞬态估计指出了额外的部件鉴定考虑。估计表明，即使在大阳耀斑条件下，只要遵循电荷感知设计，辐射噪声也不是LILA总噪声预算的重要贡献者。
classification.one_liner: 评估月面辐射通过测试质量充电、动量转移和热弹性变形对LILA引力波探测噪声的贡献，并指出电荷感知设计下辐射噪声不显著。

papers.title: Gravitational dynamics and backward ray-traced shadows of bumblebee AdS black holes
papers.abstract: We investigate the total observed frequency shift of photons emitted by massive geodesic particles in circular orbits near the event horizon of bumblebee AdS black holes. The cosmological effects of the bumblebee field are investigated through dynamical equations governing the evolution and characteristic features of the Universe. In addition, the bumblebee field generates cosmological anisotropies by acting as a source of anisotropy and selecting a preferred spatial direction. We formulate the characteristic equations for the innermost stable circular orbit using the effective potential approach. Further analysis is devoted to establishing a functional relationship between the BH mass and the observed redshift and blueshift of photons emitted from the accretion disk. Finally, we study the shadow cast by the bumblebee AdS BH using the backward ray tracing process implemented in the Arcmancer code, where photon geodesics are initialized at the observers location and integrated backward in time to generate BH images, typically illuminated by electromagnetic radiation from nearby accretion flows.

classification.title_zh: Bumblebee AdS黑洞的引力动力学与逆向光线追踪阴影
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了bumblebee AdS黑洞事件视界附近圆轨道上大质量测地线粒子所发射光子的总观测频移。通过支配宇宙演化和特征性质的动力学方程，考察bumblebee场的宇宙学效应。此外，bumblebee场作为各向异性源并选择优先空间方向，产生宇宙学各向异性。我们用有效势方法建立最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）的特征方程。进一步分析致力于建立黑洞质量与吸积盘发射光子观测红移/蓝移之间的函数关系。最后，我们使用Arcmancer代码实现的逆向光线追踪过程研究bumblebee AdS黑洞的阴影，其中光子测地线从观测者位置初始化并向时间反演积分以生成黑洞图像，通常由附近吸积流的电磁辐射照亮。
classification.one_liner: 研究bumblebee AdS黑洞附近的测地线频移、ISCO及逆向光线追踪阴影。

papers.title: Strong gravity physics of dynamical horizons in black hole mergers and its imprint in their gravitational radiation
papers.abstract: In a binary black hole merger, the inspiral portion of the gravitational waveform corresponds to two distinct horizons orbiting each other, and the merger and ringdown signals correspond to the final horizon being formed and settling down to equilibrium. However, we still lack a detailed understanding of the relation between the horizon geometry in these three regimes and the observed waveform. In this thesis, we show that the well-known inspiral chirp waveform has a clear counterpart on black hole horizons, namely the shear of the outgoing null rays at the horizon. The shear behaves very much like a compact binary coalescence waveform with increasing frequency and amplitude, and the parameters of the system estimated from the horizon agree with those estimated from the waveform. We then track the source multipole moments of the dynamical horizons in simulations of several binary black hole mergers and calculate the corresponding Love numbers for axisymmetric modes. Unlike the (field) tidal Love numbers of non-spinning black holes, these do not vanish. We present evidence that, at least for modest mass ratios, their behaviour is universal. We extend this to the non-axisymmetric moments and show that the dynamical horizons encode detailed information about the dynamics of the binary, and that their source multipole moments are strongly correlated with the gravitational field at null infinity. Finally, we study the outer common dynamical horizon formed during the merger and its relationship with the outgoing gravitational waves, and show how the deformed common horizon approaches the final Kerr state by absorbing gravitational radiation with signatures of quasi-normal ringing. Its gravitational field shares a similar multipolar structure as that at future null infinity, and we point out some limitations, inconsistencies, and anomalies that need to be addressed.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞并合中动力学视界的强引力物理及其在引力辐射中的印记
classification.abstract_zh: 在双黑洞并合中，引力波的旋进部分对应两个不同视界相互绕转，并合与铃宕信号对应最终视界形成并趋于平衡。然而，这三个阶段中视界几何与观测波形之间的关系仍缺乏细致理解。本论文表明，熟知的旋进啁啾波形在黑洞视界上有明确对应物，即视界处出射零测地线的剪切；该剪切行为很像致密双星并合波形，频率和振幅增加，且由视界估计的系统参数与由波形估计的一致。随后，作者在若干双黑洞并合模拟中追踪动力学视界的源多极矩，并计算轴对称模式的相应Love数；与非自旋黑洞的场潮汐Love数不同，这些量不消失，并给出证据表明至少在中等质量比下其行为具有普适性。论文还将研究推广到非轴对称矩，表明动力学视界编码了双星动力学的详细信息，其源多极矩与零无穷处引力场强相关。最后，论文研究并合期间形成的外共同动力学视界及其与出射引力波的关系，展示变形的共同视界如何通过吸收带有准正规模铃宕特征的引力辐射趋近最终Kerr态；其引力场与未来零无穷处具有相似的多极结构，并指出一些需要解决的局限、不一致和异常。
classification.one_liner: 该论文研究双黑洞并合中动力学视界的剪切、多极矩与Love数，并分析其与引力波、共同视界演化和准正规模铃宕的联系。

papers.title: Probing Hidden Dimensions with Multimessenger Gravitational Waves
papers.abstract: The dimensionality of spacetime is a fundamental property of nature, yet whether our observed four-dimensional spacetime is embedded in a higher-dimensional geometry remains experimentally unresolved. Gravitational waves (GWs) offer a direct probe of compact extra dimensions through the strong-field dynamics of binary coalescences. In this work, we investigate extra-dimensional modifications to GW generation within a compactified Kaluza--Klein framework. We derive the Newtonian conservative binary dynamics and the leading-order extra-dimensional correction to the GW energy flux and formulate the corresponding waveform modifications within the parameterized post-Einsteinian (ppE) framework. Combining these results with the previously derived 1PN amplitude correction arising from perturbations of the internal volume, we construct modified GW waveform templates for ground- and space-based detectors. To alleviate parameter degeneracies in GW parameter estimation, we combine the observed strain data of GW170817 with independent electromagnetic observations in a multimessenger Bayesian analysis, yielding a 95\% credible upper bound of $n<0.11$ on the phenomenological dimensional parameter. We further investigate injected multimessenger massive black hole binary observations with Taiji, finding that the upper bound could be improved by nearly two orders of magnitude to $n<0.00178$. These results highlight the potential of multimessenger GW observations to probe extra-dimensional effects and test fundamental gravity in the strong-field and dynamical regime.

classification.title_zh: 用多信使引力波探测隐藏维度
classification.abstract_zh: 时空维数是自然的基本属性，但我们的四维时空是否嵌入更高维几何仍未在实验上解决。引力波通过双星并合的强场动力学为紧致额外维度提供了直接探针。本文在紧致化Kaluza-Klein框架下研究额外维度对引力波产生的修正，推导牛顿阶守恒双星动力学以及引力波能流的领头阶额外维度修正，并在参数化后爱因斯坦框架（ppE）中给出相应的波形修正。结合此前由内部体积扰动得到的1PN振幅修正，我们构建了适用于地面和空间探测器的修正引力波波形模板。为缓解引力波参数估计中的参数简并，我们将GW170817的应变数据与独立电磁观测结合进行多信使贝叶斯分析，得到现象学维度参数n的95%可信上限n<0.11。我们进一步研究太极对注入的多信使大质量黑洞双星观测，发现该上限可提升近两个数量级至n<0.00178。这些结果凸显了多信使引力波观测在强场和动力学区域探测额外维度效应并检验基础引力的潜力。
classification.one_liner: 在紧致Kaluza-Klein框架下推导额外维度对引力波产生与波形的修正，并用多信使贝叶斯分析给出维度参数上限。

papers.title: The structured pseudospectrum of Schwarzschild black hole
papers.abstract: The non-Hermitian nature of black hole quasinormal modes (QNMs) can give rise to remarkable spectrum instability. Such instability is naturally characterized by the pseudospectrum for the operator. However, conventional pseudospectrum analyses permit arbitrary operator perturbations that may not correspond to physically admissible modifications. In this work, we introduce the structured pseudospectrum into black hole perturbation theory. We construct two physically motivated perturbation spaces based on effective field theory and the Rezzolla--Zhidenko parametrization, and get their structured pseudospectra using two distinct norms. Our numerical results show that imposing physical constraints substantially reduces the accessible spectrum instability, especially for higher overtones. More importantly, at sufficiently small perturbation scales $\varepsilon$, the structured pseudospectrum around isolated QNMs exhibits approximately elliptical contours with preferred directions that depend on both the mode and the perturbation space, revealing an anisotropic structure beyond the familiar circular behavior of the conventional pseudospectrum.

classification.title_zh: 史瓦西黑洞的结构化伪谱
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞准正规模（QNM）的非厄米性质可导致显著的谱不稳定性。这种不稳定性自然由算符的伪谱来刻画。然而，传统伪谱分析允许任意算符扰动，这些扰动可能并不对应物理上可接受的修改。本文把结构化伪谱引入黑洞微扰理论。我们基于有效场论和Rezzolla--Zhidenko参数化构造两个具有物理动机的扰动空间，并使用两种不同范数得到它们的结构化伪谱。数值结果表明，施加物理约束会显著降低可达到的谱不稳定性，尤其对高阶泛音。更重要的是，在足够小的扰动尺度ε下，围绕孤立QNM的结构化伪谱呈现近似椭圆轮廓，其偏好方向同时依赖于模式和扰动空间，揭示出超越传统伪谱熟悉的圆形行为的各向异性结构。
classification.one_liner: 将结构化伪谱引入黑洞微扰理论，在物理约束扰动空间下分析史瓦西黑洞QNM谱不稳定性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究史瓦西黑洞准正规模的谱不稳定性与伪谱方法，属于经典黑洞微扰和QNM分析，与用户重点标签中的QNM与经典引力方向高度相关。

papers.title: Lee-Yang theorems for $q$-deformed oscillators and doubly-scaled SYK
papers.abstract: We show that the vacuum partition function of the $q$-deformed oscillator \[ L_q(z):= \langle0|e^{zT_q}|0\rangle, \qquad T_q := \mathsf{a}_q + \mathsf{a}_q^* \] satisfies the Lee-Yang property, i.e., all zeros of $L_q$ lie on the imaginary line for all $q\in[-1, 1)$, proving the conjectures of Okuyama'23. Using the connection between $q$-deformed oscillators and the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) Hamiltonian in the doubly-scaled regime, we show that the annealed SYK partition function satisfies the Lee-Yang property in the thermodynamic limit, that is, all of its Fisher zeros are on the imaginary axis. As a result, we show that the quenched SYK partition function admits a zero-free strip of constant width with high probability, rigorously complementing the large$-k$ replica calculations of Zlokapa and Kiani'26. We show the imaginary-rootedness of $L_q$ by expressing $\varphi_q(z):= L_q(\mathbf{i} z)$ as a locally uniform limit of ``$q$-deformed'' matching polynomials and then showing that those $q$-deformed polynomials are real-rooted. This establishes that $\varphi_q$ is real-rooted, and in fact belongs to the \emph{Laguerre-P\'olya} class. The real-rootedness of the $q$-deformed polynomials yields novel log-concavity relations on the \emph{$q$-deformed matching moments} \[M_\ell(q):= \sum_{\pi\in\mathcal{P}_2(2\ell)}q^{\operatorname{cr}(\pi)}.\] We show the real-rootedness of the $q$-deformed polynomials by using the Touchard--Riordan formula to derive a partial differential equation relating their $q$-derivatives to their $z$-derivatives, and then analyzing the resulting motion of their roots.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: q-变形振子与双标度 SYK 的 Lee-Yang 定理
classification.abstract_zh: 本文证明 q-变形振子的真空配分函数 L_q(z)=⟨0|e^{zT_q}|0⟩（其中 T_q=a_q+a_q^*）具有 Lee-Yang 性质：对所有 q∈[-1,1)，L_q 的全部零点位于虚轴上，从而证明了 Okuyama'23 的猜想。利用 q-变形振子与双标度区域中 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) 哈密顿量之间的联系，作者证明退火 SYK 配分函数在热力学极限下满足 Lee-Yang 性质，即其全部 Fisher 零点位于虚轴上。由此进一步证明淬火 SYK 配分函数以高概率具有恒定宽度的无零点条带，严格补充了 Zlokapa 与 Kiani'26 的大 k 复本计算。为证明 L_q 的虚根性，文章将 φ_q(z):=L_q(i z) 表示为“q-变形”匹配多项式的局部一致极限，并证明这些 q-变形多项式具有实根，由此得到 φ_q 实根且属于 Laguerre-Pólya 类。q-变形多项式的实根性还给出 q-变形匹配矩 M_ℓ(q):=∑_{π∈P_2(2ℓ)} q^{cr(π)} 的新对数凹性关系。证明通过 Touchard-Riordan 公式导出联系其 q-导数与 z-导数的偏微分方程，并分析相应根的运动。
classification.one_liner: 证明 q-变形振子与双标度 SYK 配分函数的 Lee-Yang 零点性质，并导出 q-匹配矩的对数凹性。

papers.title: Singularities of Separation Coordinates
papers.abstract: We study singularities of separation coordinates for geodesic flows of real-analytic two-dimensional (pseudo-)Riemannian metrics. We obtain a complete local classification of these singularities using the Nijenhuis operator associated with a quadratic first integral. The singular set is locally a smooth curve, an isolated point, or two transversely intersecting curves. We also show that orthogonal separation near one point of an analytic disk extends to a quadratic first integral on the entire disk and provide explicit separation coordinates near singularities.

classification.title_zh: 分离坐标的奇点
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究实解析二维（伪）黎曼度量的测地流的分离坐标的奇点。利用与二次首次积分相关的 Nijenhuis 算子，我们给出了这些奇点的完整局部分类。奇点集局部是一条光滑曲线、一个孤立点，或两条横截相交的曲线。我们还证明，解析圆盘上某一点附近的正文分离可延拓为整个圆盘上的二次首次积分，并给出奇点附近的显式分离坐标。
classification.one_liner: 对二维伪黎曼测地流分离坐标的奇点给出局部完全分类，并证明局部正交分离可延拓为整体二次首次积分。

papers.title: Gravitational form factors of the pion in light-front holographic QCD
papers.abstract: Understanding the internal structure of the pion-particularly the energy-momentum distributions of quarks and gluons and the internal mechanical properties encoded in its gravitational form factors-is a fundamental challenge in quantum chromodynamics (QCD). In this work, we study the gravitational form factors using light-front QCD (LFQCD), combined with the holographic QCD. Our main innovation is the introduction of an effective light-front wave function, with its five-dimensional component obtained from holographic QCD, which is then employed, within the light-front QCD framework, to calculate the pion's gravitational form factors $A(Q^2)$ and $D(Q^2)$ as well as its radius. Our computed pion gravitational form factors show agreement with lattice QCD results, providing nontrivial support for the viability of our phenomenological model.

classification.title_zh: 光前全息QCD中π介子的引力形状因子
classification.abstract_zh: 理解π介子的内部结构，特别是夸克与胶子的能量-动量分布以及由其引力形状因子编码的内部力学性质，是QCD中的基本挑战。本文结合光前QCD与全息QCD研究引力形状因子。主要创新是引入一个有效的光前波函数，其五维分量由全息QCD得到，并在光前QCD框架内用它计算π介子的引力形状因子A(Q^2)、D(Q^2)及其半径。计算得到的π介子引力形状因子与格点QCD结果一致，为该唯象模型的可信性提供了非平凡支持。
classification.one_liner: 结合光前QCD与全息QCD构造有效光前波函数，计算π介子引力形状因子并与格点QCD比较。

papers.title: Stars Can Quench Superradiance Around Supermassive Black Holes
papers.abstract: Light scalar fields trigger an instability around rotating black holes which drives the rapid growth of high-density bound states on astrophysically short timescales---a phenomenon known as black hole superradiance. This process is usually tacitly assumed to happen independent of the local environment. Around supermassive black holes, however, orbiting stars and compact objects act as a perturbation that drains energy from the cloud, potentially preventing its formation altogether. In this work, we quantify under what conditions this happens, focusing on bound-free state transitions. We first compute the rate of energy dissipation due to gravitational interactions, finding that the superradiance growth rate almost always dominates the environmental depletion. The two rates are, however, close enough that the conclusion could be overturned once bound-bound transitions are included. Also, the environment dissipates the cloud faster than gravitational-wave emission, implying that stellar environments must be accounted for in a variety of indirect search strategies. We then investigate the impact of the scalar's quadratic couplings to nucleons and electromagnetism, showing that these interactions can greatly enhance energy dissipation, preventing the cloud's formation. This work highlights the importance of accounting for the local environment in studies of superradiance around intermediate and supermassive black holes.

classification.title_zh: 恒星可抑制超大质量黑洞周围的超辐射
classification.abstract_zh: 轻标量场在旋转黑洞周围会触发超辐射不稳定性，使高密度束缚态在 astrophically short timescales 快速增长。通常默认该过程与局部环境无关；但在超大质量黑洞周围，轨道恒星和致密天体作为微扰会从标量云中带走能量，可能阻止其形成。本文聚焦束缚-自由态跃迁，量化该抑制发生的条件。作者先计算引力相互作用导致的能量耗散率，发现超辐射增长率几乎总占优，但两者接近，若计入束缚-束缚跃迁结论可能改变；环境耗散云的速度快于引力波辐射，因此间接搜寻需考虑恒星环境。随后研究标量场与核子及电磁场的二次耦合，表明这些相互作用可显著增强耗散并阻止云形成。工作强调研究中等质量与超大质量黑洞超辐射时需考虑局部环境。
classification.one_liner: 恒星环境可通过能量耗散抑制超大质量黑洞周围的标量超辐射云形成，改变超辐射搜寻的环境假设。

papers.title: Is XTE J1814-338 a dark matter-admixed neutron star?
papers.abstract: We explore the possibility that the ultracompact object XTE J1814-338 is a dark matter-admixed neutron star (DNS) based on a general-relativistic two-fluid approach, in which one fluid describes ordinary nuclear matter and the other dark matter. The equations of state of nuclear matter and dark matter are described by the Brueckner-Hartree-Fock (BHF) theory with realistic three-body forces and a generic bosonic self-interacting dark matter model, respectively. Based on the observational data, we determine the parameter space for XTE J1814-338 as a DNS, and find that only a halo stellar configuration with a high dark matter fraction is allowed. Furthermore, we predict other observable properties of XTE J1814-338 and provide robust lower bounds for these quantities.

classification.title_zh: XTE J1814-338 是暗物质混合中子星吗？
classification.abstract_zh: 我们基于广义相对论双流体方法，探讨超致密天体 XTE J1814-338 是否为暗物质混合中子星（DNS）的可能性，其中一种流体描述普通核物质，另一种描述暗物质。核物质和暗物质的状态方程分别由包含现实三体力的 Brueckner-Hartree-Fock（BHF）理论和一般性玻色自相互作用暗物质模型描述。根据观测数据，我们确定 XTE J1814-338 作为 DNS 的参数空间，发现只允许具有高暗物质丰度的晕状星体构型。此外，我们预测 XTE J1814-338 的其他可观测性质，并给出这些量的稳健下界。
classification.one_liner: 用广义相对论双流体模型结合 BHF 核物质与自相互作用暗物质状态方程，检验 XTE J1814-338 作为暗物质混合中子星的参数空间并预测可观测性质。

papers.title: An efficient approach to resistive GRMHD simulations of binary neutron star mergers
papers.abstract: Astrophysical plasmas are often highly conducting, but finite resistivity can nevertheless influence the evolution of strongly magnetised systems. Capturing these effects in general relativistic magnetohydrodynamics is computationally challenging because high conductivity leads to stiff source terms in the evolution equations. Standard numerical approaches rely on implicit-explicit (IMEX) time integration to maintain stability, but this substantially increases the complexity and computational cost of the simulations. Building upon the previously developed Resistive Extension upGrade for Ideal MagnEtohydrodynamics (REGIME), we present a new fluid-frame formulation that simplifies the incorporation of leading-order resistive effects by avoiding matrix inversions required in previous approaches. The method is implemented in a general relativistic magnetohydrodynamics code and validated through one-dimensional current-sheet tests and simulations of isolated magnetised neutron stars and binary neutron star mergers. We find that the new formulation reproduces the expected resistive behaviour with accuracy comparable to IMEX-based methods, while substantially reducing the computational cost and complexity of the simulations. In binary neutron star mergers, finite resistivity leads to measurable differences in the post-merger gravitational-wave signal and remnant structure, showing that resistive effects can produce measurable changes in the post-merger dynamics even in the high-conductivity regime.

classification.title_zh: 双中子星并合电阻性 GRMHD 模拟的一种高效方法
classification.abstract_zh: 天体物理等离子体通常具有高电导率，但有限电阻率仍可能影响强磁化系统的演化。在广义相对论磁流体力学中捕捉这些效应在计算上具有挑战性，因为高电导率会在演化方程中导致刚性源项。标准数值方法依赖隐式-显式（IMEX）时间积分来保持稳定，但这显著增加了模拟的复杂性和计算成本。基于先前为理想磁流体力学开发的电阻性扩展升级版 REGIME，我们提出了一种新的流体参考系表述，通过避免先前方法所需的矩阵求逆来简化前导阶电阻效应的纳入。该方法已在广义相对论磁流体力学代码中实现，并通过一维电流片测试以及孤立磁化中子星和双中子星并合的模拟进行了验证。我们发现，新表述再现了预期的电阻行为，其精度与基于 IMEX 的方法相当，同时大幅降低了模拟的计算成本和复杂性。在双中子星并合中，有限电阻率导致并合后引力波信号和残余结构出现可测量的差异，表明即使在高电导率区域，电阻效应也能对并合后动力学产生可测量的改变。
classification.one_liner: 提出一种避免矩阵求逆的流体参考系电阻性 GRMHD 新表述，并在双中子星并合模拟中表明有限电阻率会改变并合后引力波信号与残余结构。

papers.title: Gravitational-Wave Sky Mapping with Pulsar Timing Arrays: The Full Earth-Pulsar Response and Resolution Operational Regimes
papers.abstract: Pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) are usually analyzed in the Earth-term approximation, although the exact response of an Earth--pulsar baseline contains additional angular structure through the pulsar term. We develop a tensor-spherical-harmonic framework for PTA sky mapping of a deterministic, band-limited gravitational-wave strain field, retaining the full Earth--pulsar response. The single-baseline response is reduced to a compact analytical closed form involving two spherical Bessel functions. Its asymptotic analysis reveals four regimes: Earth-term dominance, transition, pulsar-term dominance, and an effective diffraction cutoff at $l_\mathrm{cut}\simeq\omega L$. This scale characterizes the intrinsic exponential suppression of an individual baseline, while the practical angular resolution of a PTA is primarily governed by the finite number, sky distribution and timing noise of the pulsars. Formulating PTA sky mapping as a linear inverse problem; we derive the associated Fisher information matrix and construct an singular-value-decomposition-based reconstruction framework that explicitly separates observable and poorly constrained sky modes. The analysis clarifies the relationship between intrinsic detector resolution and array-sampling limitations and provides a quantitative assessment of the circumstances under which coherent pulsar-term information becomes relevant for full-sky reconstruction. Idealized scaling arguments suggest that exploiting the transition/pulsar-term-dominated regime in global sky mapping imposes a severe $\sim l^4$ penalty on the array size required to maintain uniform reconstruction fidelity at high multipoles. The formalism extends naturally to anisotropic stochastic backgrounds and provides a unified framework for deterministic field reconstruction and angular-power anisotropy inference.

classification.title_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列的引力波天图映射：完整地球-脉冲星响应与分辨率运行区间
classification.abstract_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列通常在地球项近似下分析，但地球-脉冲星基线的精确响应通过脉冲星项包含额外角结构。我们建立张量球谐框架，用于确定性、带限引力波应变场的PTA天图映射，并保留完整地球-脉冲星响应。单基线响应化为涉及两个球贝塞尔函数的紧凑解析闭式；渐近分析揭示四个区间：地球项主导、过渡、脉冲星项主导，以及 l_cut≃ωL 的有效衍射截断。该尺度描述单基线的本征指数压低，而PTA实际角分辨率主要受脉冲星数量、天区分布和计时噪声限制。我们将PTA天图映射表述为线性逆问题，推导Fisher信息矩阵，并构建基于奇异值分解的重建框架，显式分离可观测与约束较差的天图模式。分析澄清本征探测器分辨率与阵列采样限制之间的关系，并定量评估相干脉冲星项信息在全天重建中变得相关的条件。理想化标度论证表明，在全局天图映射中利用过渡/脉冲星项主导区间，会对维持高多极均匀重建保真度所需的阵列规模施加约 l^4 的严酷惩罚。形式体系自然推广到各向异性随机背景，并为确定性场重建与角功率各向异性推断提供统一框架。
classification.one_liner: 建立含完整地球-脉冲星响应的PTA引力波天图映射张量球谐与SVD反演框架，并分析分辨率区间与阵列采样限制。

papers.title: A Primer on Spacetime Singularities II: Spatially Homogeneous Cosmologies
papers.abstract: This article is the second part of a review devoted to spacetime singularities in classical General Relativity. While Primer I developed the mathematical framework for defining, classifying, and proving the existence of singularities, the present work examines their concrete realization in spatially homogeneous cosmological models. After reviewing the geometrical foundations of homogeneity and the Bianchi classification, we derive the field equations for orthogonal and tilted perfect fluid cosmologies and use the Kasner and Bianchi I solutions as elementary prototypes of anisotropic singular behaviour. Raychaudhuri focusing provides general conditions under which the homogeneous Cauchy development reaches a finite proper time boundary. We then distinguish matter singularities, characterized by divergent density and Ricci curvature, from more subtle non-scalar or whimper singularities associated with Cauchy horizons and extreme fluid tilt. The classical Ellis-King analysis is reconsidered in the light of later developments, including rigorous curvature-blow-up results for Bianchi VIII and IX models, kinematic singularities in geodesically complete tilted spacetimes, and the recent reappearance of whimper behaviour in dipole cosmology. The resulting picture shows that even spatially homogeneous cosmologies exhibit a remarkably rich hierarchy of singular boundaries. The detailed dynamical approach to these boundaries - Hamiltonian cosmology, Kasner transitions, Mixmaster dynamics and the BKL conjecture - is reserved for Primer III.

classification.title_zh: 时空奇点入门 II：空间均匀宇宙学
classification.abstract_zh: 本文是关于经典广义相对论中时空奇点的综述第二部分。第一部分建立了定义、分类和证明奇点存在的数学框架；本文则考察奇点在空间均匀宇宙学模型中的具体实现。文章回顾均匀性的几何基础与 Bianchi 分类，推导正交及倾斜理想流体宇宙学的场方程，并以 Kasner 和 Bianchi I 解作为各向异性奇点行为的原型。Raychaudhuri 聚焦给出均匀 Cauchy 发展到达有限固有时边界的普遍条件。文章区分物质奇点（密度和 Ricci 曲率发散）与更微妙的非标量或 whimper 奇点（与 Cauchy 视界和极端流体倾斜相关），并结合后续发展重新审视经典 Ellis-King 分析，包括 Bianchi VIII 和 IX 模型的严格曲率爆炸结果、测地完备倾斜时空中的运动学奇点，以及 whimper 行为在偶极宇宙学中的近期重现。文章指出，即使空间均匀宇宙学也展现出丰富的奇点边界层级；对 Hamiltonian 宇宙学、Kasner 跃迁、Mixmaster 动力学和 BKL 猜想的详细动力学处理留待第三部分。
classification.one_liner: 综述经典广义相对论中空间均匀宇宙学里的时空奇点分类、原型解与奇点边界层级。

papers.title: Searching for gravitational wave echo with group equivariant neural posterior estimation
papers.abstract: Current methods for the gravitational-wave (GW) echo searches generally require substantial computational time and resources. Recent advances in group equivariant neural posterior estimation (GNPE) have demonstrated the potential to substantially accelerate posterior inference. In this work, we adopt this framework and train a GNPE model to perform echo searches, significantly improving computational efficiency while maintaining comparable inference accuracy. We apply it to the O4a events and find no significant evidence for the GW echo.

classification.title_zh: 利用群等变神经后验估计搜寻引力波回声
classification.abstract_zh: 当前引力波回声搜寻方法通常需要大量计算时间和资源。近期群等变神经后验估计（GNPE）的进展显示出显著加速后验推断的潜力。本工作采用该框架，训练GNPE模型执行回声搜寻，在保持相当推断精度的同时显著提高计算效率。我们将其应用于O4a事件，未发现显著的引力波回声证据。
classification.one_liner: 训练群等变神经后验估计模型加速引力波回声搜寻，并在O4a事件中未发现显著回声证据。

papers.title: cWB-space: A time-frequency unmodelled transient-search pipeline for LISA
papers.abstract: The Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA) will observe massive-black-hole mergers and other transient phenomena alongside many long-lived gravitational-wave signals. Some transients may be incompletely modeled or have waveforms that have not been anticipated. We present \texttt{cWB-space}, a pipeline that combines an unmodeled transient search, waveform reconstruction, and a time-frequency glitch classifier. The search identifies concentrations of signal power in time and frequency and reconstructs candidate waveforms without requiring a source template. The glitch classifier compares how candidates appear in different combinations of LISA's laser measurements, with the background estimated from the observed data. We test the pipeline with simulated black-hole binaries with aligned and precessing spins, burst signals with different shapes, and instrumental glitches. The response comparisons help assess a candidate's astrophysical or instrumental origin, while also revealing correlated glitches that can resemble gravitational waves. In the Sangria simulated LISA data, the search recovers all six injected massive-black-hole binaries as its six highest-ranked candidates. Their local reconstructions recover the main features of the injected waveforms over the intervals studied. These results demonstrate how an unmodeled search can connect transient identification with investigation of a candidate's origin and waveform recovery.

classification.title_zh: cWB-space：面向LISA的时频无模型瞬变搜索流程
classification.abstract_zh: LISA将观测大质量黑洞并合等瞬变现象以及大量长时标引力波信号。部分瞬变可能建模不完整或波形未被预期。作者提出cWB-space流程，将无模型瞬变搜索、波形重建与时频毛刺分类器结合：搜索在时频面上识别信号功率聚集，无需源模板即可重建候选波形；毛刺分类器比较候选在不同LISA激光测量组合中的表现，并从观测数据估计背景。作者用含对齐和进动自旋的黑洞双星、不同形状的burst信号及仪器毛刺的模拟数据测试该流程，并说明响应比较有助于判断候选的天体物理或仪器起源，同时可揭示类似引力波的相关毛刺。在Sangria模拟LISA数据中，该搜索将全部六个注入的大质量黑洞双星恢复为排名最高的六个候选，其局部重建在 studied intervals 内恢复了注入波形的主要特征。结果表明无模型搜索可连接瞬变识别、候选起源研究与波形恢复。
classification.one_liner: 提出并测试面向LISA的无模型瞬变搜索、波形重建与时频毛刺分类流程。

papers.title: Resonant transmission of scalar waves through rotating traversable wormhole
papers.abstract: The viability of traversable wormholes as exotic compact objects relies on identifying signatures that distinguish them from black holes and other compact objects. In this work, we investigate the propagation of a massless scalar field in a rotating traversable wormhole described by Teo's class of solutions. We compute the greybody factor (transmissivity) and identify sharp Breit-Wigner-type resonances associated with scalar modes trapped in the potential well surrounding the throat. Rotation modifies these resonances through frame dragging, with counter rotating modes developing deeper trapping wells. We further investigate the stability of the long lived resonant modes through their quasinormal mode spectrum and find that corotating modes exhibit ergoregion instability. We therefore focus on the partial transmission cross section of the stable counter rotating modes, which characterizes the resonant transmission of incident scalar flux through the wormhole to the other asymptotic region. Our findings establish the role of rotation and mode stability in shaping the resonant transmission of scalar waves through traversable wormholes, providing a basis for future studies of analogous resonant phenomena in electromagnetic and gravitational waves, and their potential observational implications.

classification.title_zh: 标量波通过旋转可穿越虫洞的共振透射
classification.abstract_zh: 可穿越虫洞作为奇异致密天体的可行性取决于能否找到将其与黑洞及其他致密天体区分开的特征。本文研究无质量标量场在Teo类解描述的旋转可穿越虫洞中的传播。我们计算灰体因子（透射率），并识别出与囚禁在喉部周围势阱中的标量模式相关的尖锐Breit-Wigner型共振。旋转通过参考系拖曳修正这些共振，反向旋转模式形成更深的囚禁势阱。我们进一步通过准正规模谱研究长寿命共振模式的稳定性，发现同向旋转模式表现出能层不稳定性。因此，我们聚焦稳定反向旋转模式的部分透射截面，它刻画入射标量通量通过虫洞到另一渐近区域的共振透射。我们的结果确立了旋转和模式稳定性在塑造标量波通过可穿越虫洞的共振透射中的作用，为未来研究电磁波和引力波中的类似共振现象及其潜在观测意义提供基础。
classification.one_liner: 研究旋转可穿越虫洞中标量波的灰体因子、Breit-Wigner共振与准正规模稳定性，指出同向模式有能层不稳定性而稳定反向模式可共振透射。

papers.title: Quasinormal modes of charged covariant effective black holes with a cosmological constant
papers.abstract: In this paper, we investigate the quasinormal modes of two covariant effective black holes characterized by the quantum parameter $\zeta$, charge $Q$, and cosmological constant $\Lambda$, under the scalar perturbation. By employing the pseudo-spectral method, we numerically calculate the quasinormal frequencies and analyze the influence of $\zeta$ on the spectra with respect to $Q$. Our results demonstrate that while the quantum parameter $\zeta$ significantly modifies the quasinormal frequency spectrum, the non-monotonic behavior and overtone outbursts persist. Notably, the impact of quantum gravity on the overtone outbursts is not merely limited to enhancement or suppression; instead, it introduces additional spectral features. Furthermore, a comprehensive analysis of the full quasinormal mode spectrum reveals rich interactions between complex and purely imaginary modes, including damping-rate crossings and merging-splitting behavior. These phenomena typically accompany overtone outbursts in near-extremal regimes, suggesting a potential connection between mode interactions and overtone outbursts. This work emphasizes the necessity of analyzing the full quasinormal frequency spectrum rather than focussing solely on fundamental modes, and provides novel insights into its underlying spectral structures.

classification.title_zh: 带宇宙学常数的带电协变有效黑洞的准正规模
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究两个带宇宙学常数、量子参数ζ和电荷Q的协变有效黑洞在标量扰动下的准正规模。作者采用伪谱法数值计算准正频率，并分析ζ随Q变化对频谱的影响。结果表明，量子参数ζ会显著修改准正频率谱，但非单调行为和过模爆发仍然存在；量子引力效应不仅增强或抑制过模爆发，还会引入额外的谱特征。对完整准正规模谱的分析揭示了复模与纯虚模之间丰富的相互作用，包括阻尼率交叉以及合并-分裂行为，这些现象通常伴随近极端区域中的过模爆发出现，暗示模式相互作用与过模爆发之间可能存在联系。作者强调应分析完整的准正频率谱，而非仅关注基模，并由此提供了关于其潜在谱结构的新见解。
classification.one_liner: 用伪谱法研究带宇宙学常数的带电协变有效黑洞的完整准正规模谱，揭示量子参数对过模爆发和模式相互作用的影响。

papers.title: Quasinormal modes of thick branes in $f(R)$ gravity
papers.abstract: We systematically investigate the quasinormal modes of thick branes in $f(R)$ gravity by numerically solving the Schr\"odinger-like perturbation equation of gravitational perturbations. To ensure the reliability of the results, we employ three complementary methods: the asymptotic iteration method, the direct integration of the wave equation, and the time-domain numerical evolution. We analyze how the model parameters influence the shape of the effective potential of gravitational perturbations and find that the structure of the potential barrier plays a significant role in shaping the quasinormal frequency spectrum. The results obtained from the three methods exhibit strong consistency, thereby ensuring the reliability of the calculations. In particular, the real parts of the quasinormal frequencies exhibit an approximately arithmetic progression, suggesting that the quasi-localized states can be understood as resonances between the barriers.

classification.title_zh: f(R) 引力中厚膜的准正规模
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过数值求解引力扰动的薛定谔型扰动方程，系统研究 f(R) 引力中厚膜的准正规模。为保证结果可靠性，我们采用三种互补方法：渐近迭代法、波方程直接积分以及时域数值演化。我们分析模型参数如何影响引力扰动有效势的形状，并发现势垒结构对准正频率谱有显著作用。三种方法得到的结果高度一致，从而保证计算的可靠性。特别地，准正频率的实部近似呈等差数列，表明准局域态可理解为势垒之间的共振。
classification.one_liner: 用三种数值方法计算 f(R) 厚膜引力扰动的准正规模，并揭示势垒结构决定频谱及实部近似等差。

papers.title: On the Geroch conjecture for toric gravitational instantons
papers.abstract: Geroch conjectured that the local solutions of the vacuum Einstein equations with two commuting Killing fields and vanishing twist constants are generated from flat space by an infinite-dimensional group of transformations, and Hauser and Ernst proved this for stationary axisymmetric spacetimes near the axis. The solutions generated from flat space by the transformations with finitely many poles in the spectral parameter are the solitons of Belinski and Zakharov. We prove a solitonic form of the conjecture in Riemannian signature, for toric gravitational instantons. The proof combines Weinstein's uniqueness argument, a closed formula for the soliton metrics in Hankel determinants and a degree argument. It also applies to the toric Ricci-flat metrics with conical singularities constructed by Li and Sun.

classification.title_zh: 关于环面引力瞬子的Geroch猜想
classification.abstract_zh: Geroch猜想：具有两个对易Killing场且扭量常数消失的真空Einstein方程的局部解，可由一个无限维变换群从平直空间生成；Hauser和Ernst在轴线附近的稳态轴对称时空情形证明了该猜想。由谱参数中有限个极点的变换从平直空间生成的解，即Belinski-Zakharov孤子。本文在Riemannian号差下，对环面引力瞬子证明了该猜想的孤子形式。证明结合了Weinstein的唯一性论证、Hankel行列式中孤子度规的闭式公式以及一个次数论证。该结果也适用于Li和Sun构造的带锥奇点的环面Ricci平坦度规。
classification.one_liner: 证明环面引力瞬子情形下Geroch猜想的孤子形式。

papers.title: Two-Fluid Radial Stability of Dark-Matter-Admixed Compact Objects: Dark Compact Planets, Dark White Dwarfs, Dark Neutron Stars, and Dark Oysters
papers.abstract: We investigate the equilibrium structure and stability against radial oscillations of a variety of two-fluid compact objects containing ordinary baryonic matter admixed with cold dark matter coupled through the background spacetime. For the ordinary fluid, we employ a QCD equation of state compatible with chiral effective field theory at nuclear densities (supplemented by the BPS and Negele-Vautherin models at extremely low densities) and with perturbative QCD in the high-density regime while also satisfying also current astrophysical data. For the dark fluid, we assume self-interacting fermionic matter with particle masses of $m_f=$ 2, 5, 10, and 100 GeV and two self-interaction strengths of $y=0.1$ and $10^3$. By scanning a large range of central pressures for both fluids, we identify the presence of dark compact planets, dark white dwarfs, dark neutron stars and the so-called dark oysters. Importantly, these objects are not only in two-fluid hydrostatic equilibrium, but they are also stable against two-fluid radial oscillations. We find that the relative representation of each class in the radially stable sample is strongly sensitive to the combinations of $m_f$ and $y$, with some combinations entirely suppressing some of these object classes within the sampled domain while favoring others. In addition to these classes, strong self-repulsion supports stable, dark-matter-dominated branches with compact ordinary-matter cores and extended dark halos, approaching the self-interacting fermion-star limit. Finally, we calculate the gravitational redshift at the ordinary-matter surface, $z_{\rm OM}$, including the contribution of extended dark-matter halos for which we found radially stable configurations with $z_{\rm OM}>2$.

classification.title_zh: 暗物质混合致密天体的双流体径向稳定性：暗致密行星、暗白矮星、暗中子星与暗牡蛎
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究多种双流体致密天体的平衡结构及径向振荡稳定性，这些天体由普通重子物质与冷暗物质通过背景时空耦合混合而成。普通流体采用与核密度下手征有效场论相容、并在极低密度由BPS和Negele-Vautherin模型补充、在高密度由微扰QCD补充且满足当前天体物理数据的QCD状态方程。暗流体假设为自相互作用费米子物质，粒子质量 m_f=2,5,10,100 GeV，自相互作用强度 y=0.1 和 10^3。通过扫描两种流体的大范围中心压强，我们识别出暗致密行星、暗白矮星、暗中子星及所谓暗牡蛎。重要的是，这些天体不仅处于双流体流体静力平衡，而且对双流体径向振荡稳定。我们发现径向稳定样本中各类天体的相对比例对 m_f 与 y 组合高度敏感，某些组合在采样范围内完全抑制某些类别而偏好其他类别。除这些类别外，强自排斥支持稳定的、暗物质主导的分支，具有致密普通物质核心和延展暗晕，接近自相互作用费米子星极限。最后，我们计算普通物质表面的引力红移 z_OM，包括延展暗晕贡献，并发现 z_OM>2 的径向稳定构型。
classification.one_liner: 研究暗物质与重子物质双流体致密天体的平衡与径向稳定性，并分类暗行星、暗白矮星、暗中子星和暗牡蛎。

papers.title: Surprisingly normal? GW241011 and GW241110 in the context of hierarchical merger classification
papers.abstract: Uncovering the origins of merging binary black holes is a key goal in gravitational-wave astrophysics, but identifying the formation channel of a particular binary is complicated by imprecise measurements and uncertain theoretical predictions. While classification often involves computing metrics from an event's inferred properties, measurement precision varies across parameter space. Using the perhaps-surprising low masses of the hierarchical merger candidates GW241011 and GW241110 as a backdrop, we consider the classifiable distribution, which steps beyond detectability to assess what events may be correctly characterized as part of a population. Interpreting classification outcomes, and assessing the falsifiability of theoretical model predictions, are benefit by understanding the regions of parameter space that a priori enable---and do not enable---confident measurement. For hierarchical mergers, we demonstrate that mass ratio is the largest intrinsic driver of identification, while orbital inclination and signal-to-noise ratio are the key extrinsic factors. Further, we show GW241011 and GW241110 achieve classification metrics consistent with similar simulated hierarchical mergers. Model selection and classification require the context of measurement capacity, especially as catalogs offer growing numbers of events with seemingly unusual properties.

classification.title_zh: 令人惊讶地正常？GW241011与GW241110在层级并合分类中的分析
classification.abstract_zh: 揭示双黑洞并合的起源是引力波天体物理的关键目标，但精确识别某一双星的形成通道受测量精度和理论预测不确定性的限制。分类通常基于事件推断性质计算指标，而测量精度随参数空间变化。以层级并合候选体GW241011和GW241110异常低的质量为背景，我们考虑“可分类分布”，它超越可探测性，评估哪些事件可被正确归类为某群体的一部分。理解参数空间中先验上能够或不能够实现可靠测量的区域，有助于解释分类结果并评估理论模型预测的可证伪性。对于层级并合，我们表明质量比是识别的最主要内禀驱动因素，而轨道倾角和信噪比是关键外禀因素。此外，GW241011和GW241110的分类指标与类似模拟层级并合一致。模型选择和分类需要测量能力的背景，尤其当目录提供越来越多看似异常的事件时。
classification.one_liner: 利用可分类分布分析GW241011与GW241110的低质量是否与层级并合模拟一致，并指出质量比、轨道倾角和信噪比是关键分类因素。

papers.title: A Charged Compact Star Solution for a Conducting Sphere
papers.abstract: This paper considers the simplest charged stellar model, namely, a uniform density star with electric charge distributed on its surface. In this model, we treat the uniform density star as a conducting sphere, where all electric charges are uniformly distributed on the surface and represented by a delta function. We obtain an analytical solution for the background metric of the star spacetime and find that the pressure of the perfect fluid inside the star is directed inward (negative pressure) near the inner surface. This is because the repulsive force between surface electric charges requires an inward pressure to maintain equilibrium. However, when the charge becomes too large, the pressure of the ideal fluid at the stellar center gets directed outwards again. This is because the electric field itself is also a part of the stress energy tensor $T_{\mu\nu}$, acting as a source of gravity. When the gravitational effect of the electric field dominates, the perfect fluid must provide outward pressure to balance the inward gravitational attraction. On the other hand, we have also studied the axial perturbation in charged spacetimes using the finite difference method. We found that axial Maxwell perturbation and axial gravitational perturbation are coupled in the star spacetime, making it difficult to separate the variables by coordinate transformation. The computational results show that the waveforms of quasinormal modes vary with different charges.

classification.title_zh: 导体球对应的带电致密星解
classification.abstract_zh: 本文考虑最简单的带电星模型，即电荷分布在表面的均匀密度星。在该模型中，我们将均匀密度星视为导体球，所有电荷均匀分布在表面并用 delta 函数表示。我们得到了星体时空背景度规的解析解，并发现星体内表面附近理想流体的压力指向内部（负压）。这是因为表面电荷之间的排斥力需要向内的压力来维持平衡。然而，当电荷变得过大时，星体中心理想流体的压力又指向外部。这是因为电场本身也是应力能量张量 T_{\mu\nu} 的一部分，作为引力源起作用；当电场的引力效应占主导时，理想流体必须提供向外的压力以平衡向内的引力吸引。另一方面，我们还使用有限差分法研究了带电时空中的轴向扰动。我们发现，在星体时空中轴向 Maxwell 扰动与轴向引力扰动是耦合的，难以通过坐标变换分离变量。计算结果表明，准正模波形随不同电荷而变化。
classification.one_liner: 构建表面均匀带电导体球致密星的解析背景解，并分析轴向 Maxwell-引力耦合扰动下 QNM 波形随电荷的变化。

papers.title: Scattering of massless scalar waves by higher-dimensional regular black holes in general relativity coupled to nonlinear electrodynamics
papers.abstract: We study the scattering of planar massless scalar waves by the family of higher-dimensional regular black holes in general relativity coupled to nonlinear electrodynamics, which unifies the Bardeen and Hayward models in any dimension. The scalar field is a neutral test field that propagates in the bulk, and in the geometric-optics limit, its rays are the null geodesics of the spacetime, so that the unstable circular null geodesics of the background geometry control the scattering. We combine the classical scattering of null geodesics, the glory approximation, which we generalize to $D$ dimensions, and the partial-wave analysis in $D=5,6,7$. We show that at a fixed frequency, the wave cross section diverges in the forward direction as $\theta^{-4}$ in any dimension, with a coefficient fixed by the mass, while the steeper classical law $\theta^{-(D-2)^{2}/(D-3)}$ appears only at larger angles and higher frequencies. The charge parameter decreases the critical and the glory impact parameters and widens the glory fringes, and in higher dimensions, the glory pattern has fewer and wider fringes and a weaker backward intensity. For the matched configurations studied here, backward intensity and low-frequency absorption provide the clearest differences, while the intermediate-to-high-frequency spectra are close.

classification.title_zh: 广义相对论耦合非线性电动力学中高维正则黑洞对无质量标量波的散射
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究平面无质量标量波被广义相对论耦合非线性电动力学中的一类高维正则黑洞散射的问题，该类黑洞在任意维度上统一了 Bardeen 与 Hayward 模型。标量场是传播于体时空中的中性试探场；在几何光学极限下，其射线为时空的零测地线，因此背景几何的不稳定圆形零测地线控制散射。作者结合零测地线的经典散射、推广到 D 维的 glory 近似，以及在 D=5,6,7 中的分波分析。结果表明：在固定频率下，任意维度的波截面在前向以 θ^{-4} 发散，其系数由质量决定；而更陡的经典规律 θ^{-(D-2)^2/(D-3)} 仅在较大角度和较高频率下出现。电荷参数会减小临界碰撞参数和 glory 碰撞参数，并展宽 glory 条纹；在更高维度中，glory 图样具有更少、更宽的条纹以及更弱的背向强度。对于本文所研究的匹配构型，背向强度和低频吸收提供了最清晰的差异，而中高频谱则较为接近。
classification.one_liner: 研究高维正则黑洞在非线性电动力学框架下对无质量标量波的散射，结合零测地线、D 维 glory 近似与分波分析。
