papers.title: Neutrino Oscillation in a Static Dihole Geometry
papers.abstract: We investigate neutrino flavor oscillations in the static equal-mass Majumdar-Papapetrou dihole geometry, restricting the propagation to the symmetry plane. Within the null approximation, we derive the leading contribution to the neutrino phase and numerically evaluate the geodesic integrals. For two neutrino flavors, interference between different trajectories introduces a dependence on the individual neutrino masses and on the neutrino mass ordering for nonmaximal mixing. We analyze the transition probability in different spacetime configurations possessing two light rings, a merged light ring (critical configuration), and no light rings in the equatorial plane. In the weak-lensing regime, the transition probability generally increases with the black holes' individual masses, while variations in the half-separation produce no qualitative change in the transition probability. In stronger-lensing configurations, variations in both the mass and half-separation modify the heights and positions of the extrema, with no monotonic increase or decrease in the transition probability. For the critical and no-light-ring configurations studied, we identify three zero-winding trajectories connecting the source and detector, including one passing near the symmetry axis. The probability remains oscillatory, and its oscillatory pattern depends strongly on the neutrino energy.

classification.title_zh: 静态双洞几何中的中微子振荡
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究等质量 Majumdar-Papapetrou 双洞静态几何中的中微子味振荡，并将传播限制在对称平面内。在零测地线近似下，作者推导了中微子相位的领头贡献，并对测地线积分进行数值计算。对于两种中微子味，不同轨迹之间的干涉会在非最大混合时引入对单个中微子质量及质量顺序的依赖。文章分析了赤道面内具有两个光环、合并光环（临界构型）以及无光环的不同时空构型中的跃迁概率。在弱透镜区域，跃迁概率通常随两个黑洞各自质量的增加而增加，而半间距变化不产生定性改变；在较强透镜构型中，质量和半间距的变化会改变极值的高度和位置，跃迁概率不呈单调增减。对于所研究的临界和无光环构型，作者识别出三条连接源和探测器的零绕数轨迹，其中一条经过对称轴附近；概率仍呈振荡行为，且振荡模式强烈依赖中微子能量。
classification.one_liner: 研究静态等质量 Majumdar-Papapetrou 双黑洞几何中的中微子味振荡、零测地线干涉与光环构型对跃迁概率的影响。

papers.title: Probing Realistic Neutron Star Equations of State via the Chameleon Mechanism
papers.abstract: We investigate the impact of the Chameleon mechanism on structural properties of neutron stars adopting realistic nucleonic equations of state. The scalar-matter coupling parameter $\beta$ controls the departure from the corresponding general-relativistic configurations, affecting both the maximum mass and the stellar radius. Our numerical results demonstrate that the chameleon mechanism can have a significant impact on the macroscopic properties of neutron stars, even when realistic equations of state are employed. Moreover, well established constraints on masses and radii of neutron stars put stringent limits on the allowed numerical values of the coupling.

classification.title_zh: 利用变色龙机制探测真实中子星物态方程
classification.abstract_zh: 我们采用真实的核子物态方程，研究变色龙机制对中子星结构性质的影响。标量-物质耦合参数 β 控制其相对于相应广义相对论位形的偏离，并影响最大质量和恒星半径。数值结果表明，即使采用真实物态方程，变色龙机制仍可显著影响中子星的宏观性质。此外，已确立的中子星质量和半径约束对耦合参数的允许取值给出严格限制。
classification.one_liner: 在真实核子物态方程下，变色龙标量-物质耦合会改变中子星最大质量和半径，并受观测约束限制。

papers.title: Probing dark sector with decihertz gravitational wave observations of compact binary inspirals in IndIGO-D
papers.abstract: We investigate the potential of decihertz gravitational-wave (GW) observations of compact-binary inspirals to probe atomic dark matter (aDM) and its interactions through an ultralight massive dark photon. We consider a scenario in which neutron stars accumulate DM charged under a dark Abelian massive vector mediator, leading to an additional long-range Yukawa interaction between compact objects and associated dipolar radiation. In this framework, the GW waveform acquires characteristic corrections parameterized by the Yukawa coupling strength $\alpha$, the dipole-radiation parameter $\gamma$, and a parameter related to the mediator mass $\mu$. These corrections include a leading $-1$ post-Newtonian dipole contribution and finite-mediator-mass effects. We relate the aDM corrections to existing parameterized tests of general relativity and perform Bayesian parameter-estimation analyses for simulated binary neutron star (BNS) and neutron star-black hole (NSBH) systems incorporating the modified binary inspiral in a proposed space-based decihertz detector, named IndIGO-D. For a GW170817-like BNS with nonzero aDM couplings chosen near current observational bounds, we find that the dark-photon rest energy can be inferred with a $90\%$ credible uncertainty of $O(10^{-20})\,\mathrm{eV}$, conditional on a detectable dark-sector contribution. Analyses with weaker dark-sector interactions $(\alpha \lesssim O(10^{-8}))$ show that the mediator mass remains unconstrained when both the Yukawa coupling and dipole-radiation contribution are negligible, but can be measured even for a negligible Yukawa coupling if the dipole-radiation contribution is sufficiently strong. Our results demonstrate that future decihertz GW observatories can serve as powerful laboratories for testing dark-sector physics and probing dark matter interactions in compact binaries through precision GW measurements.

classification.title_zh: 利用IndIGO-D分赫兹引力波观测致密双星旋进探测暗扇区
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究分赫兹引力波观测致密双星旋进探测原子暗物质（aDM）及其通过超轻有质量暗光子相互作用的潜力。考虑中子星吸积带暗Abelian有质量矢量媒介子电荷的暗物质，从而在致密天体间产生额外长程Yukawa相互作用及相应偶极辐射。在此框架下，引力波波形获得由Yukawa耦合强度α、偶极辐射参数γ和媒介子质量相关参数μ刻画的特征修正，包括领头-1后牛顿阶偶极贡献和有限媒介子质量效应。作者将aDM修正与现有广义相对论参数化检验相联系，并对含修正双星旋进的模拟双中子星（BNS）和中子星-黑洞（NSBH）系统，在拟议天基分赫兹探测器IndIGO-D中做贝叶斯参数估计。对于类似GW170817、取接近当前观测上限的非零aDM耦合的BNS，在暗扇区贡献可探测的条件下，暗光子静止能量可被推断到O(10^-20)eV的90%可信度不确定度。对较弱暗扇区相互作用（α≲O(10^-8)），当Yukawa耦合和偶极辐射贡献均可忽略时媒介子质量仍不受约束；但若偶极辐射贡献足够强，即使Yukawa耦合可忽略也可测量。结果表明未来分赫兹引力波天文台可作为检验暗扇区物理和通过精确引力波测量探测致密双星中暗物质相互作用的强有力实验室。
classification.one_liner: 评估IndIGO-D分赫兹引力波观测对原子暗物质及超轻暗光子相互作用的探测能力。

papers.title: More Eccentric, Not Always Less Detectable: High Mass Holds Its Ground, Low Mass Loses Reach
papers.abstract: Gravitational waves from eccentric compact binary coalescences trace dynamical binary formation, but matched-filtering searches responsible for most detections rely on quasicircular templates. Quantifying any sensitivity loss is crucial for assessing population completeness and the need for dedicated eccentric template banks. We present the first systematic GstLAL search study spanning eccentricities up to $e_{\rm 15Hz}=0.99$ and broad ranges of chirp mass, mass ratio, inclination, and aligned spin. Using TEOBResumS-Dal\'i waveforms, we inject eccentric signals and measure recovered signal-to-noise ratio, signal-consistency statistics, false-alarm rate, and sensitive volume and distance. For high-mass binaries ($\mathcal{M}_c\gtrsim30\,M_\odot$), sensitive distance is nearly independent of eccentricity, demonstrating that greater eccentricity does not necessarily reduce search sensitivity. In contrast, for low-mass binaries, sensitive distance falls by up to $\sim50\%$ near $e_{\rm 15Hz}\approx0.75$. Although the absolute loss in reach is modest given their low quasicircular sensitivity, this relative reduction exceeds the increase in sensitive distance between the second and third observing runs of the LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA collaboration and is consistent with previous low-mass studies. We also find that waveform matches at fixed source parameters substantially overpredict search sensitivity loss, meaning that the pipeline's signal-consistency test and maximization over its template bank mitigate much of the predicted sensitivity loss. This highlights the need for end-to-end injection campaigns to establish the detectability of eccentric binaries.

classification.title_zh: 更偏心并不总是更难探测：高质量保持优势，低质量失去探测距离
classification.abstract_zh: 偏心致密双星并合产生的引力波追踪双星动力学形成过程，但大多数探测所依赖的匹配滤波搜索使用准圆轨道模板。量化任何灵敏度损失对于评估种群完备性和专用偏心模板库的必要性至关重要。我们给出首个系统的 GstLAL 搜索研究，覆盖直到 e_15Hz=0.99 的偏心率，以及啁啾质量、质量比、倾角和排列自旋的广泛范围。使用 TEOBResumS-Dalí 波形，我们注入偏心信号并测量恢复的信噪比、信号一致性统计量、虚警率、敏感体积和距离。对于高质量双星（Mc ≳ 30 Msun），敏感距离几乎与偏心率无关，表明更大的偏心率不一定降低搜索灵敏度。相反，对于低质量双星，在 e_15Hz≈0.75 附近敏感距离下降最多约50%。尽管鉴于其较低的准圆灵敏度，探测范围的绝对损失不大，但这一相对下降超过了 LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA 合作第二次和第三次观测运行之间敏感距离的增加，并与先前的低质量研究一致。我们还发现，固定源参数下的波形匹配会显著高估搜索灵敏度损失，这意味着流水线的信号一致性检验及其模板库上的最大化缓解了大部分预测的灵敏度损失。这凸显了需要端到端注入活动来确定偏心双星的可探测性。
classification.one_liner: GstLAL 注入研究显示偏心致密双星搜索灵敏度损失依赖质量：高质量几乎不受偏心率影响，低质量在中等高偏心时敏感距离可降约50%。

papers.title: Global and asymptotic properties of self-gravitating nonlinear sigma models
papers.abstract: We present an analytical study of the global and asymptotic properties of static, spherically symmetric, asymptotically flat solutions in general relativity and its \(D\)-dimensional generalization with multiple minimally coupled scalar fields described by a general nonlinear sigma model. Assuming a complete Riemannian target space and a non-negative scalar potential satisfying suitable growth conditions, we prove that solutions remain regular at every finite nonzero radius and can be extended inward to a naked singularity at the center. In particular, this excludes singularities on spherical shells at finite radius. We further show that all solutions exhibit universal asymptotic behavior near the central singularity. Finally, we demonstrate that these spacetimes can possess at most one photon sphere, which, if present, is necessarily unstable.

classification.title_zh: 自引力非线性 sigma 模型的全局与渐近性质
classification.abstract_zh: 本文对广义相对论及其 D 维推广中静态、球对称、渐近平直解的整体和渐近性质进行了解析研究，其中包含由一般非线性 sigma 模型描述的多重最小耦合标量场。假设目标空间为完备黎曼流形，且标量势非负并满足适当的增长条件，我们证明解在每个有限非零半径处保持正则，并可向内延拓至中心的裸奇点。特别地，这排除了有限半径球壳上的奇点。我们进一步证明所有解在中心奇点附近表现出普适的渐近行为。最后，我们证明这些时空至多拥有一个光子球；若存在，该光子球必然不稳定。
classification.one_liner: 证明多标量非线性 sigma 模型自引力球对称解可延拓至中心裸奇点，具有普适渐近行为且至多一个不稳定光子球。

papers.title: Effects of Eddington-inspired Born-Infeld Gravity on Black Hole Accretion
papers.abstract: Black holes offer a unique setting to test gravity in the strong-field regime, where deviations from General Relativity are expected to be most pronounced. We study how modified gravity changes the structure of an advection-dominated accretion flow (ADAF) around a supermassive black hole. The gravitational field governing the disc is described by a Paczy\'{n}ski--Wiita-like potential derived in Eddington-inspired Born--Infeld (EiBI) gravity, formulated \textit{\`a la} Palatini. We solve the ADAF-like equations for this potential and compare the radial profiles of the flow with those obtained for the standard Paczy\'{n}ski--Wiita potential. The largest difference appears in the gas density, which is several orders of magnitude higher in the EiBI case near the inner region and converges to the standard result at large radii. The specific angular momentum and temperature are lower in EiBI gravity, while the radial velocity differs mainly at large radii for both solution branches, $ s=-1$ and $+1$. The angular velocity and the disk aspect ratio $H/r$ change only slightly. These results show that EiBI gravity can modify the density structure of hot accretion flows in the strong-field regime, potentially providing observational discriminators.

classification.title_zh: Eddington-inspired Born-Infeld 引力对黑洞吸积的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞为强场引力检验提供了独特场所。本文研究修改引力如何改变超大质量黑洞周围平流主导吸积流（ADAF）的结构。吸积盘的引力场由 Palatini 形式 Eddington-inspired Born-Infeld（EiBI）引力中导出的类 Paczyński-Wiita 势描述。作者针对该势求解类 ADAF 方程，并与标准 Paczyński-Wiita 势得到的径向剖面比较。最大差异出现在气体密度：EiBI 情形在内区高几个数量级，并在大半径处趋同于标准结果。EiBI 引力中比角动量和温度较低，径向速度主要在较大半径处不同，且对 s=-1 与 +1 两支解均如此。角速度和盘厚比 H/r 仅轻微变化。结果表明，EiBI 引力可在强场区修改热吸积流的密度结构，并可能提供观测判别。
classification.one_liner: 研究 EiBI 引力修正的类 Paczyński-Wiita 势对超大质量黑洞 ADAF 结构的影响，发现内区气体密度显著升高并可能作为观测判别。

papers.title: Thin-shell wormholes from magnetic black holes in exponential electrodynamics
papers.abstract: Transparent magnetic wormholes can share a black hole exterior while their supporting matter controls the response of the throat. We construct symmetric thin shells from the magnetic black hole of exponential nonlinear electrodynamics and derive their equilibrium stresses and linear radial stability criterion. Restricting the seed to its zero-bare-mass magnetic branch ties the charge and coupling along the fixed-mass family. In sampled cases, calibrated linear barotropic shells are unstable, whereas variable phantom and variable Chaplygin laws admit locally stable radial sectors. Explicit radius dependence strengthens the phantom restoring term; the Chaplygin response cancels the divergent inverse lapse contribution and permits stable sectors close to a non-extremal seed horizon. The surface density remains negative, although an inner interval satisfies the tangential null and intrinsic strong energy conditions. At the seed photon sphere, the two variable laws share an exact stabilization threshold. The complete radial averaged null energy remains negative even when the proper shell energy tends to zero. Numerical null geodesic imaging uses independent, minimally coupled light and transparent junctions, with celestial sources and rotating thin disks truncated at the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO). For observer-side disk emission with the prescribed ISCO truncation and a throat below the seed photon sphere, inclined images coincide with the seed black hole image. A throat above that sphere removes selected returning contributions while preserving much of the bright primary structure. Illuminating the opposite exterior adds inner disk arcs, but a central dark region can survive because the disk does not illuminate every transmitted direction. Image degeneracy depends jointly on the retained null trajectories and the emitting support, rather than on the presence of a horizon alone.

classification.title_zh: 指数电动力学中磁黑洞产生的薄壳虫洞
classification.abstract_zh: 透明磁虫洞可以共享黑洞外部，而其支撑物质控制喉部的响应。我们由指数非线性电动力学的磁黑洞构造对称薄壳，并推导其平衡应力与线性径向稳定性判据。将种子限制在零裸质量磁分支上，会使电荷与耦合沿固定质量族相联系。在抽样情形中，标定后的线性正压壳不稳定，而变幻影和变Chaplygin律允许局部稳定的径向扇区。显式半径依赖增强幻影恢复项；Chaplygin响应抵消发散的逆lapse贡献，并允许在接近非极端种子视界处存在稳定扇区。表面密度保持为负，尽管内部区间满足切向零能条件和内禀强能条件。在种子光子球处，两种变律共享精确的稳定化阈值。即使固有壳能量趋于零，完整的径向平均零能条件仍为负。数值零测地线成像采用独立、最小耦合的光和透明连接，天体源和旋转薄盘截断在最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）。对于观察者一侧的盘发射，在给定ISCO截断且喉部位于种子光子球下方时，倾斜图像与种子黑洞图像重合。喉部高于该球时会移除部分返回贡献，同时保留大部分明亮主结构。照亮相反外部会增加内盘弧，但中心暗区仍可存在，因为盘并未照亮所有透射方向。图像简并性共同取决于保留的零测地线轨迹和发射支撑，而非仅取决于视界的存在。
classification.one_liner: 构造指数电动力学磁黑洞薄壳虫洞，分析径向稳定性、能量条件与零测地线成像简并。

papers.title: Gravitational Lensing Signatures of a Black Hole in Mimetic Euler-Heisenberg theory
papers.abstract: The present study delves into the gravitational lensing phenomena in the weak field limit of a charged black hole in the mimetic Euler-Heisenberg theory. The deflection angle of light is computed for the specified asymptotically flat spacetime assuming that the observer and the light source are both located at finite distances from the lens using the Gauss-Bonnet theorem. Additionally, the Einstein ring radius is analytically derived as a direct implementation of the deflection angle. The relevant influence of the Euler-Heisenberg parameter and the charge parameter on the Einstein ring radius is briefly discussed. We also investigate the observational implications of lensing in the weak gravitational limit of the black hole. The magnification and distortion parameter are also analyzed in this manuscript. Furthermore, the time delay of light due to gravitational lensing is also briefly discussed. Our study reveals the significant influence of the model parameters of the specified black hole on the gravitational lensing signatures.

classification.title_zh: Mimetic Euler-Heisenberg 理论中黑洞的引力透镜特征
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在弱场极限下研究 mimetic Euler-Heisenberg 理论中带电黑洞的引力透镜现象。文章在渐近平直时空中，假定观测者与光源均位于距透镜有限距离处，利用 Gauss-Bonnet 定理计算光线偏折角；并由偏折角解析导出爱因斯坦环半径，简要讨论 Euler-Heisenberg 参数与电荷参数对爱因斯坦环半径的影响。文章还探讨该黑洞弱引力极限下透镜效应的观测意义，分析放大率与畸变参数，并简要讨论引力透镜导致的光传播时间延迟。研究表明该黑洞的模型参数对引力透镜特征具有显著影响。
classification.one_liner: 在弱场极限下计算 mimetic Euler-Heisenberg 带电黑洞的偏折角、爱因斯坦环、放大率、畸变与时间延迟，并分析模型参数对透镜特征的影响。

papers.title: Massive Scalar Quasinormal Modes and Quasibound States of Charged Black Holes with Logarithmic corrections
papers.abstract: We study how long-range deformations in a black-hole metric affect the oscillation, trapping, and decay of a neutral, minimally coupled massive scalar field. We choose a logarithmic deformation of Reissner-Nordstr\"om (RN) sourced by nonlinear electrodynamics. It provides an exact solution of Einstein gravity and admits a finite completion. The same geometry also arises in a phenomenological perfect-fluid dark-matter model. In this setup, we analyze both quasinormal modes (QNMs), which describe relaxation, and quasibound states (QBSs), which describe trapped modes with small horizon absorption. We first show that a small scalar mass moves the potential barrier outward, raises it, and reduces its curvature. First-order WKB then predicts weaker damping at every fixed finite multipole and overtone. We then compare several approaches, namely sixth-order WKB, global matching, a generalized Leaver method (adapted to the logarithmic geometry) and time-domain evolution. All methods yield consistent QNM estimates within their ranges of validity. Global matching and Leaver also agree closely for QBSs. Further analytic estimates with a reference trapped state show that a local Pad\'e approximation gives a binding-energy error of about $0.04\%$, while leading Gamow tunnelling underestimates damping by about $25\%$. Across the sampled QBSs, increasing the scalar mass or nonlinear coupling strengthens binding but shortens the lifetime through greater horizon absorption. Finally, using an appropriate horizon regularization and a common complex radial contour, we demonstrate orthogonality of an independently computed QNM-QBS pair using a suitable relativistic bilinear framework.

classification.title_zh: 带对数修正的带电黑洞的大质量标量准正规模与准束缚态
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究黑洞度规中的长程变形如何影响中性最小耦合大质量标量场的振荡、囚禁和衰减。选取由非线性电动力学产生的 Reissner-Nordström (RN) 黑洞的对数变形；它是 Einstein 引力的精确解并具有有限完备化。同一几何也出现在一个唯象完美流体暗物质模型中。在此设置下，我们分析描述弛豫的准正规模 (QNMs) 和描述具有小视界吸收的囚禁模式的准束缚态 (QBSs)。首先表明小标量质量将势垒向外移、抬高并降低其曲率；一阶 WKB 因而预言在任意固定有限多极和泛音下阻尼更弱。然后比较六阶 WKB、全局匹配、适配对数几何的广义 Leaver 方法和时域演化。所有方法在其有效范围内给出一致的 QNM 估计；全局匹配与 Leaver 对 QBS 也高度一致。利用一个参考囚禁态做进一步解析估计，表明局部 Padé 近似给出的结合能误差约 0.04%，而领头 Gamow 隧穿低估阻尼约 25%。在所采样的 QBS 中，增加标量质量或非线性耦合会增强结合，但通过更大的视界吸收缩短寿命。最后，使用适当的视界正则化和共同的复径向围道，我们用合适的相对论双线性框架证明了一对独立计算的 QNM-QBS 的正交性。
classification.one_liner: 研究对数修正 RN 黑洞中大质量标量场的 QNM/QBS，比较多种计算方法并给出正交性结果。

papers.title: Vector modes in Type 3 New GR
papers.abstract: Some time ago, we published the full count of degrees of freedom in the linearised weak gravity limit of arbitrary New GR models. We did it by considering the linear weak gravity equations and presented a thorough analysis with no ambiguity left. A bit later, we generalised it to linear cosmological perturbations and discussed the strong coupling issues that appear already at this level. Recently, there were claims that some dynamical modes had been missed in our work. However, the authors of the new claims did not look at the equations of motion and analysed the quadratic Lagrangian densities instead. In this paper, I take one of the most elementary cases, namely the vector modes in New GR of Type 3, and show what was their mistake that had led them to claiming that those were dynamical. The main message: Do not substitute constraint equations into a Lagrangian.

classification.title_zh: Type 3 New GR 中的矢量模
classification.abstract_zh: 作者此前给出了任意 New GR 模型在线性弱引力极限下的完整自由度计数，并推广到线性宇宙学扰动及强耦合问题。近期有工作声称遗漏了动力学模式，但其作者未分析运动方程，而是分析二次拉格朗日密度。本文以 Type 3 New GR 的矢量模这一最基本情形为例，指出其错误在于将约束方程代入拉格朗日量，从而导致误判这些模式为动力学模式。
classification.one_liner: 澄清 Type 3 New GR 线性矢量模并非动力学：将约束方程代入拉格朗日量导致误判。

papers.title: Black Hole Dynamics at Fifth Post-Newtonian Order
papers.abstract:
Using the worldline action in [2409.05860], we derive the total even-in-velocity (relative) impulse, scattering angle, and time delay at fifth post-Newtonian (5PN) order, including radiation-reaction and hereditary contributions at ${\cal O}(G^5
u^2)$ and ${\cal O}(G^6
u^2)$. We introduce an isotropic-like description which, together with the associated losses of energy and angular momentum, fixes the evolution of the system from scattering data. This framework opens the door to an unambiguous characterization of the underlying two-body dynamics solely in terms of scattering observables. Following [2409.05860], we isolate a conservative component using Feynman's $i0^+$ prescription. This sector contains both "tail-like" and "memory-like" contributions, the latter being nonlocal in time and described by a double Principal-Value integral. Owing to the local-in-time character of the corresponding (in-in) action, we establish a systematic procedure that is consistent with Feynman's prescription while preserving the complete local dynamics. This provides a universal contribution to the conservative (isotropic) Hamiltonian at 5PN order and, as a byproduct, also fixes the value of the Effective One Body coefficients $\{{ ar d}_{5{m loc}}, a_{6{m loc}}\}$ consistently with the Tutti-Frutti framework. For completeness, we analyse the "$\gamma	ext{-}3$" prescription introduced in recent post-Minkowskian computations. When implemented in our formalism, we find exact agreement over the overlapping regime of validity. In contrast, Feynman's prescription yields a (local) memory-like contribution with the opposite sign at ${\cal O}(G^5
u^2)$. We also find that an analogous $\gamma	ext{-}3$ rerouting at ${\cal O}(G^6
u^2)$ would be incompatible with the conjecture that all $\pi^2$ terms arise solely from the potential region, while Feynman's formulation preserves this expectation.

classification.title_zh: 五阶后牛顿阶的黑洞动力学
classification.abstract_zh: 利用[2409.05860]中的世界线作用量，我们导出了五阶后牛顿（5PN）阶的速度偶宇称总（相对）冲量、散射角和时间延迟，包括 O(G^5ν^2) 与 O(G^6ν^2) 的辐射反作用和遗传贡献。我们引入类各向同性描述，并结合相应的能量和角动量损失，由散射数据确定系统演化。该框架为仅用散射可观测量无歧义刻画二体动力学开辟道路。沿用[2409.05860]，我们用费曼 i0^+ prescription 分离出保守部分。该部分包含“尾式”和“记忆式”贡献，后者在时间上非局域并由双主值积分描述。由于相应(in-in)作用量的局域时间性质，我们建立了一套与费曼 prescription 一致且保留完整局域动力学的系统程序。这给出了5PN阶保守（各向同性）哈密顿量的普适贡献，并作为副产品在与 Tutti-Frutti 框架一致的意义下确定了有效单体系数 {dbar_{5loc}, a_{6loc}}。为完整起见，我们分析了近期后闵可夫斯基计算中引入的“γ-3” prescription。将其纳入我们的形式后，在重叠适用范围内发现完全一致。相反，费曼 prescription 在 O(G^5ν^2) 给出符号相反的（局域）类记忆贡献。我们还发现，在 O(G^6ν^2) 进行类似的 γ-3 重路由将不符合“所有 π^2 项仅来自势区域”的猜想，而费曼表述保持这一预期。
classification.one_liner: 在5PN阶从世界线作用量计算黑洞二体散射可观测量，并系统处理辐射反作用与保守/记忆贡献。

papers.title: Kasner Exponents from the Bouncing Singularity
papers.abstract: Thermal two-point functions of holographic CFTs can probe the black hole singularity. When a bouncing geodesic exists, the correlator at leading order in $1/N$ develops a singularity $G(t, \vec{x}=0) \propto (t_c-t)^{-2\Delta+b_t}$, where $\Delta$ is the scaling dimension of the operator. We show that the additional exponent $b_t$ is determined by the Kasner exponents near the singularity. From the wave reflected off the singularity, which gives an exponentially small term in the large-frequency retarded correlator, we derive the formula $b_t=(d-1) \max \left( \frac{p_i-p_t}{1-p_t}, \frac{1}{2} \right)$ for planar black branes in AdS$_{d+1}$, where $p_t$ and $p_i$ are the Kasner exponents of the time and spatial directions. We compare our formula with the numerical values of \v{C}eplak and Valach. It reproduces the relation that they proposed for a special class of black branes. For more general black branes, where no formula had been found, our formula agrees with most of their numerical data and fits them much better than the extension of their relation. We also give predictions for $b_t$ in theories where the Kasner exponents are known, but $b_t$ has not been computed.

classification.title_zh: 从反弹奇点得到的Kasner指数
classification.abstract_zh: 全息CFT的热两点函数可以探测黑洞奇点。当存在反弹测地线时，领头阶1/N关联函数在t_c处出现奇异性 G(t,0)∝(t_c-t)^{-2Δ+b_t}，其中Δ是算符的标度维数。作者表明，额外指数b_t由奇点附近的Kasner指数决定。利用从奇点反射的波（它在大频率推迟关联子中给出指数小项），推导出AdS_{d+1}中平面黑膜的公式 b_t=(d-1)max((p_i-p_t)/(1-p_t),1/2)，其中p_t和p_i分别是时间方向和空间方向的Kasner指数。作者将公式与Čeplak和Valach的数值结果比较：它重现了后者对一类特殊黑膜提出的关系；对更一般的黑膜，公式与大多数数值数据一致，并且比其关系的外推拟合得更好。作者还对Kasner指数已知但b_t尚未计算的理论给出预测。
classification.one_liner: 用全息热关联子中反弹测地线导致的奇异性，将额外指数b_t与AdS黑膜奇点附近的Kasner指数联系起来。

papers.title: Boundary preparation of strong Mpemba states in holography
papers.abstract: We study the boundary preparation of strong Mpemba states in a probe Abelian Higgs model on a fixed AdS black brane. Different drives ending at the same charge density can prepare states with different slow mode amplitudes and relaxation behavior. Two pulses cancel the slowest mode at linear order, but charge exchange during preparation and radial Maxwell feedback regenerate the slow tail at cubic order. We derive the complete cubic correction from the lower order field equations, including feedback after source removal, and use it to predict a compensating pulse. Full nonlinear evolution confirms that cubic compensation reduces the residual slow amplitude from $O(\epsilon^3)$ to $O(\epsilon^5)$. For a representative protocol at final density $\rho_f=3$ and $\epsilon=0.05$, cubic compensation suppresses the slow amplitude by a factor of about $600$ relative to the linear prescription. Cubic compensation extends the period of fast relaxation without changing the final quasinormal mode spectrum. Further nonlinear tuning suppresses the residual slow amplitude to the level of numerical resolution. The excess free energy of the prepared states can exceed that of a weakly driven reference at release and fall below it during subsequent relaxation. Three pulses also suppress a second slow channel over the resolved time window and reveal interference between faster modes. Starting from a common initial state, controls with zero net charge transfer reach a given relaxation threshold sooner than passive relaxation, even when the full control duration is included.

classification.title_zh: 全息中强Mpemba态的边界制备
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在固定AdS黑洞膜上的探针Abelian Higgs模型中研究强Mpemba态的边界制备。终止于同一电荷密度的不同驱动可制备出具有不同慢模振幅和弛豫行为的态。两个脉冲可在线性阶抵消最慢模式，但制备过程中的电荷交换与径向Maxwell反馈会在三阶重新产生慢尾。作者从低阶场方程推导完整的立方修正（包括源移除后的反馈），并据此预测补偿脉冲。完整非线性演化证实立方补偿将残余慢振幅从O(ε^3)降至O(ε^5)；在最终密度ρ_f=3、ε=0.05的代表性协议中，相对线性方案将慢振幅抑制约600倍。立方补偿延长快弛豫周期而不改变最终准正规模谱；进一步非线性调节可将残余慢振幅压至数值分辨率水平。所制备态的过剩自由能在释放时可超过弱驱动参考态，并在随后弛豫中低于该参考态。三个脉冲还可在所解析时间窗口内抑制第二个慢通道，并揭示较快模式间的干涉。从共同初态出发，零净电荷转移的控制在计入完整控制时长后仍比被动弛豫更快达到给定弛豫阈值。
classification.one_liner: 在固定AdS黑洞膜上的探针Abelian Higgs模型中，利用三阶补偿脉冲与非线性调节制备强Mpemba态并延长快弛豫窗口。

papers.title: Black hole cohomologies in N=4 SYM
papers.abstract: We systematically investigate BPS cohomologies of $\mathcal{N}=4$ super-Yang-Mills (SYM) theory with gauge group SU$(N)$ with $N=2, 3, 4$, focusing primarily on the BMN sector. We find non-Coulomb graviton cohomologies for $N>2$. For $N>2$, the lightest black hole cohomology in the BMN sector always carries non-trivial $R$-charge and corresponds to the brane-fused type. Therefore, the `core' black holes without hair are `heavier'. We also find that a family of brane-fused cohomologies in $N=3$ is not lifted at the first quantum order. At a fixed charge sector, gravitons carry definite parity under charge conjugation. Up to the levels we have tested, every black hole cohomology either has opposite parity to that of gravitons or is lifted by quantum corrections. We conjecture that black hole cohomologies always carry parity opposite to gravitons in the same charge sector.

classification.title_zh: N=4 SYM 中的黑洞上同调
classification.abstract_zh: 本文系统研究规范群为 SU(N)（N=2,3,4）的 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论的 BPS 上同调，主要聚焦 BMN 部分。作者发现 N>2 时存在非库仑型引力子上同调；对于 N>2，BMN 部分中最轻的黑洞上同调总带有非平凡的 R-荷，并对应膜融合型，因此无毛的“核心”黑洞反而“更重”。他们还发现 N=3 时一族膜融合上同调在第一量子阶未被抬升。在固定电荷部分，引力子在手征共轭下具有确定宇称；在所检验的能级范围内，每个黑洞上同调要么与引力子宇称相反，要么被量子修正抬升。作者猜想同一电荷部分中黑洞上同调总与引力子宇称相反。
classification.one_liner: 系统分类 N=4 SYM 的 BPS 黑洞上同调，并提出其与引力子宇称相反的猜想。

papers.title: Informational and algebraic renormalization group
papers.abstract: Renormalization group (RG) is a core concept from statistical mechanics to quantum field theory, yet its schemes differ widely across literature. We formulate Wilsonian RG for generic, including finite-dimensional, quantum systems as a quantum channel combining coarse graining with isometric rescaling, whose Kraus representation yields pure conditional trajectories for pure inputs and recovers mixed-state flows upon averaging. We then develop an algebraic extension without assuming tensor-product factorization: the retained low-energy algebra is constructed from the one-particle spectrum, and coarse graining is a conditional expectation onto it. Identifying the channel's Ces\`aro mean with a resource-destroying map onto fixed states establishes a resource theory of RG and yields a relative-entropy monotone without variational optimization. For thermal states in the zero-temperature limit, the resulting Bogoliubov--Kubo--Mori metric per unit spacetime volume is proportional to the Zamolodchikov metric, directly relating the resource density to $c-c_{\rm IR}$ near a two-dimensional IR fixed point. We also introduce the relative entropy of coarse graining to measure discarded UV information, prove its monotonicity along successive coarse grainings, and evaluate it holographically in global $\mathrm{AdS}_3$.

classification.title_zh: 信息论与代数重整化群
classification.abstract_zh: 重整化群（RG）是从统计力学到量子场论的核心概念，但其方案在文献中差异很大。我们将 Wilsonian RG 表述为一般（包括有限维）量子系统的量子通道，结合粗粒化与等距重标度，其 Kraus 表示对纯输入给出纯条件轨迹，平均后恢复混态流。随后，我们在不假设张量积分分解的情况下发展代数推广：保留的低能代数由单粒子谱构造，粗粒化是到该代数的条件期望。将该通道的 Cesàro 均值等同于到固定态的资源销毁映射，建立 RG 的资源理论，并给出无需变分优化的相对熵单调量。对于零温极限下的热态，所得单位时空体积的 Bogoliubov–Kubo–Mori 度规与 Zamolodchikov 度规成正比，在二维红外不动点附近直接将资源密度与 c-c_IR 联系起来。我们还引入粗粒化的相对熵以度量被丢弃的紫外信息，证明其沿逐次粗粒化的单调性，并在整体 AdS3 中全息评估它。
classification.one_liner: 将 Wilsonian/代数重整化群表述为量子通道与资源理论，并在整体 AdS3 中全息计算粗粒化相对熵。

papers.title: Monodromy defects in ABJM theory and integrability
papers.abstract: We establish that supersymmetric monodromy defects in ABJM theory, also known as vortex loops, define integrable boundary states of the underlying alternating SU(4) spin chain. Exploiting the KT relation within the framework of the algebraic Bethe ansatz, we derive a closed-form expression for the leading-order one-point functions of non- protected operators in the presence of these defects. As a special case, our result reproduces the spin-chain overlap governing the three-point functions of two maximal giant gravitons and a single tiny graviton. We furthermore investigate the quantization of the theory in the defect background and compute the first quantum correction to the one-point functions in the simplest setting. Finally, we discuss possible extensions of our overlap formula.

classification.title_zh: ABJM 理论中的单值性缺陷与可积性
classification.abstract_zh: 本文论证 ABJM 理论中的超对称单值性缺陷（又称涡旋环）定义了底层交错 SU(4) 自旋链的可积边界态。作者在代数 Bethe ansatz 框架下利用 KT 关系，给出这些缺陷存在时非保护算符领头阶一点函数的闭式表达式，并说明其结果可复现两个极大巨引子与一个微小巨引子三点函数对应的自旋链重叠。文中还研究缺陷背景下的理论量子化，并在最简单情形计算一点函数的第一阶量子修正，最后讨论重叠公式的可能推广。
classification.one_liner: 证明 ABJM 的涡旋环缺陷对应可积边界态，并用代数 Bethe ansatz 给出非保护算符一点函数的闭式结果。

papers.title: Wavefunctions of AdS$_3$ Universes and $T\bar{T}$-deformed Torus Partition Functions
papers.abstract: We study wavefunctions of quantum gravity in asymptotically AdS$_3$ spacetimes and their relation to $T\bar{T}$-deformed torus partition functions. We show that the deformed partition function is given by an invertible integral transform of bulk wavefunctions, which implements a change of representation from the York time to its conjugate, the spatial volume. The invertibility of the transform allows the bulk wavefunction to be reconstructed from the family of $T\bar{T}$-deformed partition functions. A $T\bar{T}$-deformed partition function at fixed coupling is the amplitude of the bulk state in a finite-width, fixed-volume wavepacket localized at the asymptotic boundary in York time. In the CFT limit, the wavepacket localizes at the boundary, recovering the standard holographic relation. The holographic screen of a given state is the support of the integrand of the transform: at large central charge, it separates from the wavepacket and reproduces finite-cutoff holography for the sign of the coupling with complex energies, and glue-on holography for the opposite sign. In Euclidean signature, the construction arises naturally from wavefunctions of Rindler AdS$_3$, while after a double Wick rotation it admits a Lorentzian interpretation in terms of closed AdS$_3$ torus universes without asymptotic boundaries. We also discuss de Sitter torus universes and generalizations to other spatial topologies and higher dimensions.

classification.title_zh: AdS$_3$宇宙的波函数与$T\bar{T}$变形环面配分函数
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究渐近AdS$_3$时空中的量子引力波函数及其与$T\bar{T}$变形环面配分函数的关系。作者表明，变形配分函数由体波函数的可逆积分变换给出，该变换实现从York时间到其共轭空间体积的表示变换；可逆性允许从一族$T\bar{T}$变形配分函数重构体波函数。固定耦合下的变形配分函数是体态在有限宽度、固定体积波包中的振幅，该波包在York时间上局域于渐近边界；在CFT极限下波包局域到边界，恢复标准全息关系。给定态的全息屏是变换被积函数的支撑；在大中心荷下，它从波包分离，并在特定耦合符号（复能量）下重现有限截断全息，在相反符号下重现glue-on全息。欧氏号差下该构造自然来自Rindler AdS$_3$波函数，双Wick旋转后可给出无渐近边界闭AdS$_3$环面宇宙的洛伦兹解释。文中还讨论de Sitter环面宇宙及向其他空间拓扑和高维的推广。
classification.one_liner: 将$T\bar{T}$变形环面配分函数解释为AdS$_3$体波函数的可逆积分变换，并据此重构波函数与全息屏。

papers.title: $T\overline{T}$ correlators from tensionless strings
papers.abstract: Motivated by earlier approaches, we develop a worldsheet framework for computing correlation functions in the single trace $T \overline{T}$-deformed tensionless AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ duality. By describing the deformed bulk theory as a Berkovits-Vafa $\mathcal{N}=4$ topological string, we obtain a consistent definition of physical states and correlation functions, yielding a tractable setup for testing aspects of holography beyond AdS/CFT. We construct deformed physical vertex operators and compute their tree-level two-point functions exactly. We discuss the relation of our results to previous proposals for $T \overline{T}$-deformed two-point functions obtained from alternative worldsheet approaches, JT gravity, and perturbative field theory computations.

classification.title_zh: 来自无力矩弦的 $T\overline{T}$ 关联函数
classification.abstract_zh: 受此前方法启发，我们建立了一个世界面框架，用于计算单迹 $T\overline{T}$ 形变的无力矩 AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ 对偶中的关联函数。通过将形变后的体理论描述为 Berkovits-Vafa $\mathcal{N}=4$ 拓扑弦，我们得到物理态和关联函数的一致定义，为检验超越 AdS/CFT 的全息性质提供可处理框架。我们构造形变物理顶点算子，并精确计算其树级两点函数。我们讨论结果与先前从其他世界面方法、JT 引力及微扰场论计算得到的 $T\overline{T}$ 形变两点函数提议之间的关系。
classification.one_liner: 用 Berkovits-Vafa N=4 拓扑弦世界面计算单迹 TTbar 形变无力矩 AdS3/CFT2 的顶点算子和树级两点关联函数。

papers.title: Gravitational dressing: from the crossed product to more general algebraic and mathematical structure
papers.abstract: The crossed product, and consequent transition from von Neumann algebras of type III to II, is recovered from a truncation of more general gravitational dressing constructions, about certain spacetimes. This is done by extending "standard dressing" constructions previously used to give a perturbative definition of "gravitational splittings," defining approximate localization of information. This result appears to illustrate that this algebraic transition is a small piece of a more general algebraic, or other mathematical, structure associated with quantum gravity. The leading-order structure involves noncommutativity from separated regions, and at the nonperturbative level connects with a possible explanation of holographic behavior for gravity.

classification.title_zh: 引力修饰：从交叉积到更一般的代数与数学结构
classification.abstract_zh: 本文表明，在某些时空背景下，交叉积以及随之从 III 型到 II 型冯·诺依曼代数的转变，可由更一般的引力修饰构造的截断恢复出来。作者扩展了此前用于微扰定义“引力分裂”、刻画信息近似局域化的“标准修饰”构造。结果似乎说明，这一代数转变只是与量子引力相关的更一般代数结构或其他数学结构的一小部分。领头阶结构涉及分离区域带来的非对易性，而非微扰层面则联系到对引力全息行为的一种可能解释。
classification.one_liner: 把交叉积/III→II 型代数转变视为更一般引力修饰与量子引力代数结构的一个截断特例。

papers.title: From thermogravity to thermocosmology with a running non-conservation scale
papers.abstract: Thermogravity offers a novel approach to cosmic acceleration, deriving trace-free gravitational equations and matter non-conservation from thermodynamic processes in spacetime. We extend this framework towards thermocosmology by introducing a running non-conservation scale $L_2(H)$, while restricting non-conservation to cold dark matter. We investigate two prescriptions, namely a Hubble-proportional rate and an inverse-Hubble running model, deriving their cosmological dynamics and effective geometric dark-energy description. The first admits an exact analytical solution and is related to quadratic running-vacuum cosmologies, while the second approaches standard matter dilution at early times and allows reversals in the direction of energy exchange. Interestingly, the reconstructed geometric dark energy can exhibit quintessence-like and phantom-like behavior, including smooth crossings of the phantom divide, without introducing a phantom field or superacceleration. A unified dynamical-system analysis reveals distinct matter-era critical configurations and a continuous family of de Sitter solutions that are transversely attracting under suitable conditions. Confronting both models with Pantheon+ Type Ia supernovae, cosmic chronometers, and DESI DR2 baryon acoustic oscillations, we find a mild preference for positive present-day matter non-conservation. The Akaike information criterion slightly favors the thermogravity scenarios, whereas the Bayesian information criterion favors the simpler $\Lambda$CDM model. Thus, running thermocosmology provides a viable framework for nontrivial effective dark-energy dynamics.

classification.title_zh: 从热引力到具有跑动非守恒标度的热宇宙学
classification.abstract_zh: 热引力通过时空中的热力学过程导出无迹引力方程和物质非守恒，为宇宙加速提供新途径。我们将该框架扩展到热宇宙学，引入跑动非守恒标度 L2(H)，并将非守恒限制在冷暗物质。研究两种方案：与哈勃成正比的速率和反哈勃跑动模型，推导宇宙学动力学及有效几何暗能量描述。第一种有精确解析解，并与二次跑动真空宇宙学相关；第二种在早期趋于标准物质稀释，并允许能量交换方向反转。重构的几何暗能量可呈现类精质和类幽灵行为，包括平滑穿越幽灵分界，而无需幽灵场或超加速。统一动力系统分析揭示不同物质时代临界组态以及连续族德西特解，在适当条件下横向吸引。用 Pantheon+ Ia 超新星、宇宙钟和 DESI DR2 重子声学振荡检验两模型，发现对当前正的物质非守恒有轻微偏好。AIC 略偏向热引力场景，BIC 偏向更简单的 ΛCDM。因此跑动热宇宙学为非平凡有效暗能量动力学提供可行框架。

papers.title: A systematic study of hydrodynamic attractors in periodically driven systems at weak and strong couplings
papers.abstract: We study equilibration and hydrodynamic response in conformal systems undergoing periodic expansion and contraction along one spatial direction. Using strongly coupled holography (AdS/CFT), weakly coupled kinetic theories (relaxation-time approximation, scalar $\phi^4$ theory and the Yang--Mills sector of QCD effective kinetic theory) and hydrodynamics (Navier--Stokes, M\"uller--Israel--Stewart (MIS) and rBRSSS), we investigate the shear response to a periodic drive of varying amplitude $A$ and frequency $\omega$, both analytically in linear response and numerically. We find that, at the linear level, $A\ll 1$, periodically driven systems approach a cyclic attractor that in general differs from Navier--Stokes behaviour. This attractor is universal among kinetic theories and accurately described by MIS theory: for slow driving, $\omega \tau_\pi \ll 1$, where $\tau_\pi$ is the shear relaxation time, it approaches the Navier--Stokes limit, whereas for fast driving the shear stress saturates at its non-interacting (free-streaming) value. In strongly coupled holographic systems, the periodic drive excites non-hydrodynamic quasinormal modes, which produce a characteristic ringing in the approach to the cyclic attractor, in contrast to the purely exponential approach found in kinetic theories. This difference is a direct consequence of the distinct non-hydrodynamic spectra of the two classes of theories. Moreover, unlike in kinetic theory, the holographic response is sensitive to the curvature terms of second-order hydrodynamics. Over longer times, non-linear viscous heating, which is quadratic in the drive amplitude, raises the temperature and thereby lowers $\omega\tau_\pi$, since $\tau_\pi\sim 1/T$. This induces a slow drift of the cyclic attractor, which eventually converges towards Navier--Stokes hydrodynamics at asymptotically late times.

classification.title_zh: 弱耦合与强耦合下周期驱动系统中流体力学吸引子的系统研究
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究沿一个空间方向周期膨胀和收缩的共形系统中的平衡化与流体力学响应。作者使用强耦合全息（AdS/CFT）、弱耦合动理学理论（弛豫时间近似、标量 φ^4 理论以及 QCD 有效动理学中的 Yang--Mills 部分）和流体力学（Navier--Stokes、MIS 与 rBRSSS），在变化振幅 A 和频率 ω 下研究剪切响应，并同时进行线性响应的解析计算与数值计算。研究发现，在线性层面 A≪1 时，周期驱动系统趋近一个循环吸引子，该吸引子一般不同于 Navier--Stokes 行为；该吸引子在动理学理论之间具有普适性，并可由 MIS 理论准确描述：慢驱动 ωτπ≪1 时趋近 Navier--Stokes 极限，快驱动时剪切应力饱和到非相互作用（自由流）值。在强耦合全息系统中，周期驱动会激发非流体力学准正规模，在趋近循环吸引子时产生特征振铃，这与动理学理论中的纯指数趋近不同；该差异源于两类理论不同的非流体力学谱。此外，与动理学理论不同，全息响应对二阶流体力学的曲率项敏感。在更长时间尺度上，正比于驱动振幅平方的非线性粘性加热会升高温度，从而降低 ωτπ（因为 τπ∼1/T），导致循环吸引子缓慢漂移，并最终在极晚时间趋近 Navier--Stokes 流体力学。
classification.one_liner: 比较全息、动理学与流体力学中周期驱动共形系统的剪切响应，揭示循环吸引子、准正规模振铃与非线性粘性加热导致的漂移。

papers.title: Bounds on the minimum orbital period of general static spherical black holes: a sharp upper bound and a conditional lower bound
papers.abstract: We investigate bounds on the minimum orbital period around four-dimensional general static spherical black holes. For all static spherically symmetric black holes with an event horizon, asymptotic flatness and non-negative energy density outside the horizon, we prove $T_{\min}\leq 6\sqrt{3}\,\pi M$. The bound is sharp and is saturated by the Schwarzschild solution. The lower bound requires an additional condition on the exterior matter: under the tangential pressure condition $p_{\tau}\geq(\kappa/2)\rho$ with $\kappa>1$, imposed for all $r\geq r_{g}$, where $r_{g}$ is the largest radius at which $T(r)$ attains its global minimum, we prove $T_{\min}\geq c(\kappa)M$ with $c(\kappa)=6\sqrt{3}\pi(\kappa-1)\sqrt{\kappa+2}/\kappa^{3/2}$. In summary, both bounds apply to the same geometric class and differ only in what they demand of the matter: non-negative energy density suffices for the upper bound, while the lower bound is established under the additional tangential pressure condition.

classification.title_zh: 一般静态球对称黑洞最小轨道周期的界：一个尖锐上界与一个条件性下界
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究四维一般静态球对称黑洞周围最小轨道周期的界。对于所有具有事件视界、渐近平坦且视界外能量密度非负的静态球对称黑洞，我们证明 T_min ≤ 6√3 π M。该界是尖锐的，并由 Schwarzschild 解饱和。下界需要对外部物质附加条件：在切向压强条件 p_τ ≥ (κ/2)ρ（κ>1）对所有 r ≥ r_g 成立时，其中 r_g 是 T(r) 取得全局最小值的最大半径，我们证明 T_min ≥ c(κ)M，其中 c(κ)=6√3π(κ−1)√(κ+2)/κ^{3/2}。总之，两个界适用于同一几何类，区别仅在于对物质的要求：非负能量密度足以给出上界，而下界需在附加切向压强条件下建立。
classification.one_liner: 证明一般静态球对称黑洞最小轨道周期的尖锐上界，并在切向压强条件下给出条件性下界。

papers.title: Separation of variables for massive spin-2 fields on the Kerr black hole
papers.abstract: Massive spin-2 fields on the Kerr black hole generally obey coupled partial differential equations. We show that these equations separate through two commuting angular operators acting on five components of the field, its curl and its linearised Weyl tensor. A joint angular eigenfunction fixes the relative profiles of the five polarisations and leaves one second-order radial equation. The separation constants satisfy an algebraic relation that follows from the angular operators themselves. The construction removes the obstruction to a Teukolsky-type equation by a radial transport identity, then eliminates the additional radial solution through a first integral. It provides ordinary differential equations for massive spin-2 fields on Kerr, and, equivalently, for Kaluza-Klein perturbations of the Kerr black string.

classification.title_zh: Kerr黑洞上大质量自旋-2场的变量分离
classification.abstract_zh: Kerr黑洞上的大质量自旋-2场通常满足耦合偏微分方程。我们证明，通过作用于场的五个分量、其旋度及线性化Weyl张量的两个对易角向算符，这些方程可以分离。联合角向本征函数固定五个偏振的相对剖面，并留下一个二阶径向方程。分离常数满足由角向算符本身导出的代数关系。该构造通过径向传输恒等式消除Teukolsky型方程的障碍，然后用首次积分消去额外径向解。它为Kerr上的大质量自旋-2场，等价地也为Kerr黑洞弦的Kaluza-Klein扰动，提供了常微分方程。
classification.one_liner: 证明Kerr黑洞上大质量自旋-2场方程可分离为角向本征方程与单个二阶径向方程。

papers.title: On the Role of Gravity in Supercooled Phase Transitions
papers.abstract: Theories with radiative mass generation and radiative symmetry breaking (RSB) lead to first-order phase transitions (FOPTs) and the production of gravitational waves (GWs) as well as primordial black holes if supercooling lasts long enough. Here we investigate the role of gravity in supercooled FOPTs that occur in the RSB scenario. We use a model-independent approach that is valid when a quantity (which we explicitly determine and is computable once the model is specified) is small enough. Eventually, the curvature of spacetime becomes relevant if the FOPT does not complete in the case in which gravity is ignored. We also include the effect on the FOPT of the non-minimal couplings with coefficients of zero mass dimension. Depending on such non-minimal couplings, gravity can enhance or reduce the region of parameter space where the phase transition completes. Observable consequences of the role of gravity on the FOPT that can be probed by current and future GW detectors are then worked out and we explore the possibility that the background of GWs detected by pulsar timing arrays is produced by FOPTs in the RSB scenario. We also estimate the number of e-folds that elapse when the field playing the role of the order parameter is trapped in the false vacuum, which provides important information for cosmology.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 论引力在过冷相变中的作用
classification.abstract_zh: 具有辐射质量产生和辐射对称破缺的理论会导致一阶相变，并在过冷持续足够久时产生引力波以及原初黑洞。本文研究在辐射对称破缺情景下发生的过冷一阶相变中引力的作用。我们采用模型无关方法，该方法在某个可显式确定、且给定模型后即可计算的量足够小时有效。若忽略引力时一阶相变无法完成，时空曲率最终会变得重要。我们还纳入具有零质量量纲系数的非最小耦合对一阶相变的影响；取决于这些非最小耦合，引力可以扩大或缩小相变得以完成的参数空间区域。随后我们给出引力的作用在一阶相变中可由当前和未来引力波探测器检验的可观测后果，并探讨脉冲星计时阵列探测到的引力波背景由辐射对称破缺情景下的一阶相变产生的可能性。我们还估计了当充当序参量的场被困在假真空中时所经过的e-folds数，这为宇宙学提供了重要信息。
classification.one_liner: 研究辐射对称破缺过冷一阶相变中引力的作用、非最小耦合影响及其引力波可观测性。

papers.title: Amplification of metric perturbations by extremal horizons
papers.abstract: Under normal circumstances, an observer falling into a black hole feels nothing special upon crossing the horizon. In this paper we find an intriguing exception: For most of the parameter range of the extremal Kerr-Newman (KN) spacetime, horizon co-rotating perturbations are enhanced near the horizon, such that an infalling observer experiences an anomalously large tidal deformation as they enter the black hole. Such perturbations arise when there is a persistent source outside the black hole that is either co-rotating itself or has discrete Fourier support at the associated frequencies $\omega=m\Omega_H$ (where $m$ is the azimuthal number and $\Omega_H$ is the horizon frequency). The enhancement is formally infinite at precise co-rotation, and we work with a nearly co-rotating mode to keep perturbation theory under control. The underlying physics is the emergence of discrete self-similarity in the extremal limit, with complex scaling weights of the form $-1/2\pm i\alpha$ for real $\alpha$. It is analogous to the black hole Meissner effect, except that the near-horizon field is enhanced rather than screened. We numerically calculate the scaling exponents for coupled gravitoelectromagnetic (GEM) perturbations of extremal KN black holes and show that the complex exponents arise in the parameter range $Q < Q_*$ with $Q_*\approx.93M$. These exponents also predict the decay and growth rates (Aretakis effect) of generic GEM perturbations of the KN spacetime, both on and off the horizon. The enhancement of co-rotating perturbations can be viewed as a driven Aretakis instability.

classification.title_zh: 极端视界对度规扰动的放大
classification.abstract_zh: 通常情况下，落入黑洞的观察者在穿过视界时不会感到任何特殊之处。本文发现一个有趣的例外：在极端 Kerr-Newman（KN）时空的大部分参数范围内，随视界共转的扰动在视界附近被增强，使得落入的观察者在进入黑洞时经历异常大的潮汐形变。当黑洞外部存在持续源，且该源本身共转或在相关频率 ω=mΩ_H（m 为方位角数，Ω_H 为视界频率）处具有离散 Fourier 支撑时，就会产生这类扰动。在精确共转时，增强在形式上为无穷大；我们使用近共转模式来保持微扰论可控。其物理本质是极端极限下离散自相似性的出现，复标度权重形式为 -1/2±iα（α 为实数）。这类似于黑洞 Meissner 效应，区别在于近视界场被增强而非屏蔽。我们数值计算了极端 KN 黑洞耦合 gravitoelectromagnetic（GEM）扰动的标度指数，并表明复指数出现在 Q<Q_*、Q_*≈.93M 的参数范围内。这些指数还预言了 KN 时空的一般 GEM 扰动在视界上和视界外的衰减与增长率（Aretakis 效应）。共转扰动的增强可视为一种驱动 Aretakis 不稳定性。
classification.one_liner: 极端 Kerr-Newman 黑洞近视界的共转度规扰动被放大，使落入观察者经历异常潮汐形变，并可由复标度指数与驱动 Aretakis 不稳定性描述。

papers.title: Far-Zone Gravitational Interactions at the Sixth Post-Newtonian Order
papers.abstract: We compute the nonlinear far-zone dynamics of compact binaries at the sixth post-Newtonian (6PN) order in the effective field theory of general relativity. We derive the complete $\mathcal{O}(G^2)$ far-zone action of a generic multipolar source in both the causal and the conservative prescriptions. Besides the known tails and failed tails, it contains five new sectors generated by the nonlinear memory of the emitted waves. On scattering orbits, they contain a boundary term, nonlocal in time, fixed by the balance of angular momentum. The same construction yields the emitted waveforms, whose energy and angular-momentum fluxes balance the losses of the action. For the binary, the 6PN dynamics also requires PN corrections to the lower-order sectors, the iterated radiation reaction, and a coupling quadratic in the curvature of the composite source, whose coefficient we fix by matching the gravitational Compton amplitude to that of the constituents. We compute the two-radiation contributions to the total scattering angle at fourth, fifth and sixth post-Minkowskian (PM) order and to the conservative angle at 4PM and 5PM, retaining the integer-PN terms through 6PN. For the conservative angle, we give both the local and $\gamma$-3 prescriptions. Combined with the tail and the known potential contributions, our results reproduce the conservative and total 4PM angles and the second-self-force part of the conservative 5PM angle. Including the dissipative tail, we recover the total 5PM angle through 5PN and determine its new 6PN coefficient. At 6PM, the two-radiation contribution to the total angle extends the known 5PN result to 6PN.

classification.title_zh: 六阶后牛顿阶的远区引力相互作用
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在广义相对论有效场论中计算致密双星在六阶后牛顿（6PN）阶的非线性远区动力学。我们推导了因果 prescription 与保守 prescription 下一般多极源完整的 O(G^2) 远区作用量。除已知的 tails 与 failed tails 外，它还包含由辐射波的非线性记忆产生的五个新扇区。在散射轨道上，它们含有一个由角动量平衡固定的、时间非局域的边界项。同一构造给出辐射波形，其能量与角动量通量平衡作用量的损失。对于双星，6PN 动力学还需要低阶扇区的 PN 修正、迭代辐射反作用，以及复合源曲率中的二次耦合；我们通过将引力 Compton 振幅与组成成分的相应振幅匹配来确定该耦合系数。我们计算了两辐射贡献对总散射角在第四、第五和第六 post-Minkowskian（PM）阶的贡献，以及对保守角在 4PM 和 5PM 阶的贡献，并保留到 6PN 的整数-PN 项。对于保守角，我们给出 local 与 gamma-3 两种 prescription。结合 tail 与已知势贡献，我们的结果重现了保守和总 4PM 角以及保守 5PM 角的第二自 force 部分。计入耗散 tail 后，我们重现了通过 5PN 的总 5PM 角，并确定了其新的 6PN 系数。在 6PM 阶，两辐射贡献对总角的贡献将已知的 5PN 结果推广到 6PN。
classification.one_liner: 在广义相对论有效场论中计算致密双星远区 6PN 非线性动力学及散射角。

papers.title: New Effects in Multifield Cosmology Coupled to the Gauss-Bonnet Term
papers.abstract: We study the rapid-turn regime of multifield cosmology coupled to the Gauss-Bonnet term. We derive the corresponding modified relations between the inflationary Hubble and potential slow-roll parameters, in the two-field case. These relations show that including the Gauss-Bonnet coupling broadens the possibilities for realizing rapid turn inflation and for satisfying the swampland conjectures. We also derive a consistency condition relating the scalar field-space metric to the scalar potential and the Gauss-Bonnet coupling, which two-field slow-roll and rapid-turn inflationary solutions have to satisfy. Finally, we find general conditions under which phantom-like behavior is possible in multifield dark energy models coupled to the Gauss-Bonnet term. Notably, although we do not consider a direct interaction between dark matter and dark energy, dark matter is crucial for the occurrence of a phantom regime.

classification.title_zh: 耦合Gauss-Bonnet项的多场宇宙学中的新效应
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了耦合Gauss-Bonnet项的多场宇宙学的快速转向机制。我们在双场情形下推导了暴胀Hubble慢滚参数与势慢滚参数之间相应的修改关系。这些关系表明，引入Gauss-Bonnet耦合拓宽了实现快速转向暴胀以及满足swampland猜想的可能性。我们还推导了一个将标量场空间度规与标量势及Gauss-Bonnet耦合联系起来的相容性条件，双场慢滚和快速转向暴胀解必须满足该条件。最后，我们找到了在耦合Gauss-Bonnet项的多场暗能量模型中可能出现类幻影行为的一般条件。值得注意的是，尽管我们没有考虑暗物质与暗能量之间的直接相互作用，暗物质对于幻影区域的出现仍是至关重要的。
classification.one_liner: 该文研究耦合Gauss-Bonnet项的多场宇宙学中快速转向暴胀、swampland相容性及类幻影暗能量的新条件。

papers.title: Gravitational Memory from AdS States in the Flat-Space Limit
papers.abstract: We study linearized gravitational reconstruction in global AdS$_4$ with dynamical scalar matter, building on vacuum Einstein perturbations with fixed boundary metric and nontrivial normalizable data. External scalar sources prepare an excited state and modify the holographic Ward identities, while subsequent evolution can proceed without boundary driving. Separating the bulk matter-sourced response from vacuum perturbations, we derive an electric quadrupole master equation with the matter-dependent corrections required by the Einstein constraints. We also verify that a cylindrical boundary integral reproduces the Regge--Wheeler master field mode by mode, without identifying it with the full global Fefferman--Graham reconstruction. For weakly interacting scalars that become massless in the flat-space limit, we extract the Bondi shear and news from retarded gravitational evolution. The resulting supertranslation memory agrees numerically with the outgoing energy redistribution and the quadrupole moment of the boundary work. In the ordered flat-space limit, later boundary controls leave the first event's waveform unchanged, despite cancelling residual gravitational modes at finite AdS radius.

classification.title_zh: 平直空间极限下 AdS 态的引力记忆
classification.abstract_zh: 研究全局 AdS4 中带动力学标量物质的线性化引力重构，基于固定边界度规和非平凡可归一化数据的真空 Einstein 扰动。外部标量源制备激发态并修正全息 Ward 恒等式，随后演化可在无边界驱动下进行。将体物质源响应与真空扰动分离，推导出含 Einstein 约束所要求物质修正的电四极主方程。还验证柱形边界积分逐模重现 Regge-Wheeler 主模场，但不将其等同于完整全局 Fefferman-Graham 重构。对弱相互作用标量（在平直空间极限下无质量），从推迟引力演化中提取 Bondi shear 和 news。所得超平移记忆与出射能量重分布及边界功的四极矩数值一致。在有序平直空间极限下，后续边界控制不改变首个事件波形，尽管在有限 AdS 半径下会抵消残余引力模式。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS4 线性化引力中由标量源制备激发态，并在平直空间极限下提取 Bondi shear/news 与超平移引力记忆。

papers.title: Hilbert space in the flat limit of AdS/CFT. II. Massless particles
papers.abstract: Building on Part I of this series, where we described the emergence of massive scattering states, we demonstrate how unitary lowest-weight representations $\mathcal D(\Delta,s)$ of the conformal group with fixed dimension $\Delta$ and arbitrary integer spin $s$ contract to massless Poincar\'e particle representations. This requires combining the In\"on\"u--Wigner contraction $\mathfrak{so}(2,3) \to \mathfrak{iso}(1,3)$ with an infinite boost, in which case massless scattering states naturally emerge in a carrollian basis. For $\Delta>s+1$, we find that $\mathcal D(\Delta,s)$ contracts to the direct sum of massless particles of all spins $s'\leq s$. At the unitarity bound, lower-spin states become null so that $\mathcal D(s+1,s)$ contracts to a single massless particle representation carrying the two maximal helicities $J=\pm s$. In both cases, the inner product converges to the Poincar\'e-invariant one after a single helicity-independent rescaling, so that unitarity is preserved throughout the contraction.

classification.title_zh: AdS/CFT 平直极限中的希尔伯特空间 II. 无质量粒子
classification.abstract_zh: 承接本系列第一部分（其中描述了大质量散射态的出现），本文展示固定维度 Δ 和任意整数自旋 s 的共形群幺正最低权表示 D(Δ,s) 如何收缩为无质量 Poincaré 粒子表示。这需要将 Inönü–Wigner 收缩 so(2,3)→iso(1,3) 与无穷大 boost 结合，此时无质量散射态自然以 Carrollian 基出现。对于 Δ>s+1，D(Δ,s) 收缩为所有自旋 s'≤s 的无质量粒子的直和。在幺正界，低自旋态变为零范数态，因此 D(s+1,s) 收缩为携带两个最大螺旋度 J=±s 的单一无质量粒子表示。两种情形下，内积在一次与螺旋度无关的重标度后收敛到 Poincaré 不变内积，因此整个收缩过程保持幺正性。
classification.one_liner: 通过 so(2,3)→iso(1,3) 收缩与无穷 boost，证明共形群最低权表示在 AdS/CFT 平直极限中给出无质量 Poincaré 粒子并保持幺正性。

papers.title: Umbilic Observatories
papers.abstract: We study gravitational dynamics for the simplest example of an umbilic boundary in four-dimensional general relativity --- a three-dimensional de Sitter hypersurface embedded in a four-dimensional Minkowski world. Generally speaking, an umbilic surface has the property that its induced metric is proportional to its extrinsic curvature. We consider the case of both conformal boundary conditions, as well as Dirichlet boundary conditions imposed at the timelike hypersurface. For both cases, we find that there are no linearised modes whose imaginary frequency grows with angular momentum. The conformal boundary conditions allow for a dynamical boundary degree of freedom, in addition to the bulk excitations. The umbilic property linearly decouples the boundary Weyl mode from the bulk dynamics, yielding linearly stable dynamics. In contrast, the Dirichlet problem has no boundary mode. The umbilic hypersurfaces may thus constitute an improved starting point for defining gravitational dynamics in the presence of a timelike boundary. Throughout our analysis, we draw parallels to the structure of spatial infinity for asymptotically Minkowski spacetimes and a more finite realisation thereof.

classification.title_zh: 脐点观测站
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究四维广义相对论中最简单的脐点边界例子——嵌入四维 Minkowski 时空的三维 de Sitter 超曲面上的引力动力学。脐点面的诱导度规与外曲率成比例。我们考虑在类时超曲面上施加共形边界条件和 Dirichlet 边界条件两种情形。两种情形下均未发现虚频率随角动量增长的线性模式。共形边界条件除体激发外还允许一个动力学边界自由度；脐点性质使边界 Weyl 模式与体动力学线性解耦，从而得到线性稳定的动力学。相反，Dirichlet 问题没有边界模式。因此脐点超曲面可能为在存在类时边界时定义引力动力学提供更好的起点。分析中还将结构与渐近 Minkowski 时空的空间无穷及其更有限的实现进行类比。
classification.one_liner: 研究四维 Minkowski 中嵌入的三维 dS 脐点边界上的线性引力动力学与边界条件稳定性。

papers.title: Conformal boundaries and the photon sphere of AdS black holes
papers.abstract: We study linearized gravitational perturbations of four-dimensional Schwarzschild-AdS black holes with finite timelike boundaries subject to conformal boundary conditions. These fix the conformal class of the induced metric and the mean curvature, while allowing the boundary Weyl mode to fluctuate. The photon sphere plays a distinguished role in this problem: a static boundary at this radius is totally umbilic, and the scalar problem separates exactly into independent bulk and boundary sectors. We prove the absence of exponentially growing scalar and vector modes for spherical harmonics of degree two and higher. We determine how large angular momentum instabilities are suppressed as the boundary approaches umbilicity. Near the horizon, we recover the universal Rindler spectrum, including sound and shear excitations. We numerically follow these fluid modes as the boundary is moved outwards and find that they approach standard gravitational quasinormal modes at the asymptotic AdS$_4$ boundary. For large black holes, these asymptotic endpoints correspond to the sound and shear poles of the dual three-dimensional conformal field theory. We also study perturbations of the AdS$_4$ black brane, where we find an analogous continuation of the fluid modes in the absence of an intermediate umbilic boundary.

classification.title_zh: AdS黑洞的共形边界与光子球
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究具有有限类时边界、并满足共形边界条件的四维Schwarzschild-AdS黑洞的线性化引力扰动。这些边界条件固定诱导度规的共形类与平均曲率，同时允许边界Weyl模涨落。光子球在此问题中具有特殊地位：位于该半径的静态边界是全脐的，标量问题可精确分离为独立的体扇区与边界扇区。作者证明，对于二阶及更高阶球谐，不存在指数增长的标量与矢量模式；并确定当边界趋近全脐时，大角动量不稳定性如何被抑制。在视界附近，他们恢复了通用的Rindler谱，包括声学与剪切激发。随后数值追踪这些流体模式随边界向外移动的演化，发现它们趋近渐近AdS4边界处的标准引力拟正规模。对于大黑洞，这些渐近端点对应对偶三维共形场论中的声学与剪切极点。文章还研究了AdS4黑膜扰动，并在没有中间全脐边界的情况下发现流体模式的类似延拓。
classification.one_liner: 研究有限共形边界下Schwarzschild-AdS黑洞的线性引力扰动，揭示光子球全脐边界、稳定性、Rindler流体模式与对偶CFT声学/剪切极点之间的联系。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接涉及AdS黑洞线性引力扰动、拟正规模与流体/输运模式，并连接经典引力与全息对偶，匹配用户对QNM与经典引力支线的关注。

papers.title: Giant Gravitons in AdS$_5\times$SE$_5$ and the Superconformal Index of Toric Quiver Gauge Theories
papers.abstract: We derive giant-graviton contributions to superconformal indices by quantizing probe D3-branes in type IIB backgrounds $\mathrm{AdS}_{5}\times SE_{5}$. For $SE_{5}=T^{1,1}$ and $Y^{p,q}$, we determine the scalar, vector, and fermionic fluctuations of maximal giant gravitons and extract their BPS spectra. The resulting single-letter indices agree with those predicted by the giant-graviton expansions of the dual toric quiver gauge theories. These results show that the single-giant terms in finite-$N$ supersymmetric counting functions can be recovered directly from quantized D3-brane degrees of freedom and point toward a universal worldvolume origin of giant-graviton expansions directly on the supergravity side. We view the results as a step in an intrinsically gravitational framework, much like the open-closed-open triality, for addressing supersymmetric microstate-counting problems that are conventionally outsourced to the dual field theory.

classification.title_zh: AdS$_5\times$SE$_5$中的巨引力子与环面箭图规范理论的超共形指数
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过在IIB型背景AdS$_5\times SE_5$中量子化探针D3膜，导出巨引力子对超共形指数的贡献。对于$SE_5=T^{1,1}$和$Y^{p,q}$，我们确定最大巨引力子的标量、矢量与费米子涨落，并提取其BPS谱。所得单字母指数与对偶环面箭图规范理论的巨引力子展开预言一致。这些结果表明，有限$N$超对称计数函数中的单巨引力子项可直接由量子化D3膜自由度恢复，并指向巨引力子展开在超引力侧具有普适的世界体起源。我们将结果视为一种内禀引力框架（类似开-闭-开三元性）的一步，用于处理通常外包给对偶场论的超对称微观态计数问题。
